# 1. Cond QC

## 1.1 Import count data and meta data

```{r}
# File paths
counts_fp   <- "count_data/Chd8_Camk2a_Syn_Nuc_counts.txt"
metadata_fp <- "metadata/metadata.csv"
star_dir    <- "STAR_alignment_outs"
gtf_gene_id_col_is_ensembl <- TRUE

# Import count data (keep original colnames)
data_cond_syn_nuc <- read.table(counts_fp, header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE)

annot_cols  <- 1:6
sample_cols <- setdiff(seq_len(ncol(data_cond_syn_nuc)), annot_cols)

# Clean column names
clean_col <- function(x) {
  y <- x
  y <- sub("^X\\.", "", y)
  y <- sub(".*(LC[0-9]+(?:nuc|s)).*", "\\1", y, perl = TRUE)
  y <- sub("^LC", "", y)
  y <- sub("([0-9]+)([A-Za-z]+)$", "\\1_\\2", y)
  y <- sub("_s$", "_syn", y)
  y
}

new_sample_names <- vapply(colnames(data_cond_syn_nuc)[sample_cols], clean_col, character(1), USE.NAMES = FALSE)

# If cleaning created duplicate sample names, STOP (do not sum/merge)
if (any(duplicated(new_sample_names))) {
  dups <- unique(new_sample_names[duplicated(new_sample_names)])
  stop("Duplicate sample names after cleaning: ", paste(dups, collapse = ", "))
}

colnames(data_cond_syn_nuc)[sample_cols] <- new_sample_names

# Build Geneid-level expression matrix (keep Geneid rownames)
count_mat <- as.matrix(data_cond_syn_nuc[, sample_cols, drop = FALSE])
rownames(count_mat) <- as.character(data_cond_syn_nuc$Geneid)

# collapse duplicate Geneid rows if any (AVERAGE, not sum)
if (any(duplicated(rownames(count_mat)))) {
  count_mat <- do.call(rbind, lapply(
    split(seq_len(nrow(count_mat)), rownames(count_mat)),
    function(ii) colMeans(count_mat[ii, , drop = FALSE])
  ))
}

exp_data_cond_syn_nuc <- as.data.frame(count_mat)

# Import metadata
metadata_cond_syn_nuc <- read.csv(metadata_fp, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

metadata_cond_syn_nuc$Genotype <- dplyr::case_when(
  grepl("\\+\\/\\+", metadata_cond_syn_nuc$Genotype) ~ "WT",
  grepl("fl/\\+",    metadata_cond_syn_nuc$Genotype) ~ "HET",
  grepl("fl/fl",     metadata_cond_syn_nuc$Genotype) ~ "HOM",
  TRUE ~ NA_character_
)
metadata_cond_syn_nuc$Genotype <- factor(metadata_cond_syn_nuc$Genotype, levels = c("WT", "HET", "HOM"))

# If Fraction missing, derive from Sample
if (!"Fraction" %in% colnames(metadata_cond_syn_nuc)) {
  metadata_cond_syn_nuc$Fraction <- ifelse(grepl("_syn$", metadata_cond_syn_nuc$Sample, ignore.case = TRUE), "Syn", "Nuc")
}
metadata_cond_syn_nuc$Fraction <- as.character(metadata_cond_syn_nuc$Fraction)
metadata_cond_syn_nuc$Fraction[metadata_cond_syn_nuc$Fraction %in% c("syn","Syn")] <- "Syn"
metadata_cond_syn_nuc$Fraction[metadata_cond_syn_nuc$Fraction %in% c("nuc","Nuc")] <- "Nuc"
metadata_cond_syn_nuc$Fraction <- factor(metadata_cond_syn_nuc$Fraction, levels = c("Nuc", "Syn"))

# Align metadata to counts
stopifnot(all(colnames(exp_data_cond_syn_nuc) %in% metadata_cond_syn_nuc$Sample))
metadata_cond_syn_nuc <- metadata_cond_syn_nuc[match(colnames(exp_data_cond_syn_nuc), metadata_cond_syn_nuc$Sample), , drop = FALSE]
stopifnot(identical(colnames(exp_data_cond_syn_nuc), metadata_cond_syn_nuc$Sample))

# Save clean exp_data_cond_syn_nuc (Geneid rows)
write.table(
  exp_data_cond_syn_nuc,
  file = "count_data/Chd8_Camk2a_Syn_Nuc_counts_clean.txt",
  sep = "\t", row.names = TRUE
)

# Quick sanity checks
stopifnot(all(colnames(exp_data_cond_syn_nuc) == metadata_cond_syn_nuc$Sample))
stopifnot(!any(duplicated(rownames(exp_data_cond_syn_nuc))))


```


## 1.2 Get RPKM data

```{r}

## -------------------------
## RPKM for conditional Syn/Nuc 
## -------------------------

stopifnot(all(c("Geneid", "Length") %in% colnames(data_cond_syn_nuc)))

all_samples_cond <- as.character(metadata_cond_syn_nuc$Sample)
stopifnot(all(all_samples_cond %in% colnames(data_cond_syn_nuc)))

# 1) Geneid-level exp matrix from ORIGINAL table (keeps Length available)
exp_data_id_cond_syn_nuc <- data_cond_syn_nuc
rownames(exp_data_id_cond_syn_nuc) <- as.character(exp_data_id_cond_syn_nuc$Geneid)
exp_data_id_cond_syn_nuc <- exp_data_id_cond_syn_nuc[, all_samples_cond, drop = FALSE]

# collapse duplicate Geneid rows if any (safe)
if (any(duplicated(rownames(exp_data_id_cond_syn_nuc)))) {
  exp_data_id_cond_syn_nuc <- rowsum(as.matrix(exp_data_id_cond_syn_nuc), group = rownames(exp_data_id_cond_syn_nuc))
}

# 2) Geneid-level length vector aligned to Geneids
gene_lengths_id_cond_syn_nuc <- as.numeric(data_cond_syn_nuc$Length)
names(gene_lengths_id_cond_syn_nuc) <- as.character(data_cond_syn_nuc$Geneid)

if (any(duplicated(names(gene_lengths_id_cond_syn_nuc)))) {
  gene_lengths_id_cond_syn_nuc <- tapply(
    gene_lengths_id_cond_syn_nuc,
    names(gene_lengths_id_cond_syn_nuc),
    max
  )
}

gene_lengths_id_cond_syn_nuc <- gene_lengths_id_cond_syn_nuc[rownames(exp_data_id_cond_syn_nuc)]

ok_len <- !is.na(gene_lengths_id_cond_syn_nuc) & gene_lengths_id_cond_syn_nuc > 0
exp_data_id_cond_syn_nuc <- exp_data_id_cond_syn_nuc[ok_len, , drop = FALSE]
gene_lengths_id_cond_syn_nuc <- gene_lengths_id_cond_syn_nuc[ok_len]

stopifnot(identical(rownames(exp_data_id_cond_syn_nuc), names(gene_lengths_id_cond_syn_nuc)))

# 3) RPKM on Geneid-level 
rpkm_id_log2_cond_syn_nuc <- edgeR::rpkm(
  exp_data_id_cond_syn_nuc,
  gene.length = gene_lengths_id_cond_syn_nuc,
  log = TRUE
)

rpkm_id_linear_cond_syn_nuc <- edgeR::rpkm(
  exp_data_id_cond_syn_nuc,
  gene.length = gene_lengths_id_cond_syn_nuc,
  log = FALSE
)

# 4) Rename RPKM rows to symbols (do NOT collapse RPKM)
map <- my_gene[, c("gene_id","gene_name")]
map <- map[!duplicated(map$gene_id), , drop = FALSE]
rownames(map) <- map$gene_id

sym_rpkm <- map[rownames(rpkm_id_log2_cond_syn_nuc), "gene_name"]
sym_rpkm[is.na(sym_rpkm) | sym_rpkm == ""] <- rownames(rpkm_id_log2_cond_syn_nuc)[is.na(sym_rpkm) | sym_rpkm == ""]

rpkm_symbol_log2_precollapse_all_cond_syn_nuc   <- rpkm_id_log2_cond_syn_nuc
rpkm_symbol_linear_precollapse_all_cond_syn_nuc <- rpkm_id_linear_cond_syn_nuc
rownames(rpkm_symbol_log2_precollapse_all_cond_syn_nuc)   <- sym_rpkm
rownames(rpkm_symbol_linear_precollapse_all_cond_syn_nuc) <- sym_rpkm

genes_to_check <- c("Chd8", "Usp11", "Crlf2", "Abca8a")
print(rpkm_symbol_log2_precollapse_all_cond_syn_nuc[genes_to_check, , drop = FALSE])
print(rpkm_symbol_linear_precollapse_all_cond_syn_nuc[genes_to_check, , drop = FALSE])

# SAVE FINAL RPKM WITH ENS ROW NAMES
rpkm_data_cond_syn_nuc <- rpkm_id_log2_cond_syn_nuc
rpkm_data_linear_cond_syn_nuc <- rpkm_id_linear_cond_syn_nuc

write.csv(rpkm_data_cond_syn_nuc, "count_data/rpkm_data_log2_cond_syn_nuc.csv", quote = FALSE)
write.csv(rpkm_data_linear_cond_syn_nuc, "count_data/rpkm_data_linear_cond_syn_nuc.csv", quote = FALSE)

```



## 1.3 Build edgeR object/ dge list

Make one combined object for QC/PCA. Later will make separate ones for DE.

```{r}

dge_all <- edgeR::DGEList(
  counts  = replace(as.matrix(exp_data_cond_syn_nuc), is.na(exp_data_cond_syn_nuc), 0),
  samples = metadata_cond_syn_nuc
)

grp_all <- interaction(metadata_cond_syn_nuc$Genotype, metadata_cond_syn_nuc$Fraction, drop = TRUE)
keep    <- edgeR::filterByExpr(dge_all, group = grp_all)
dge_all <- dge_all[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
dge_all <- edgeR::calcNormFactors(dge_all)

```

## 1.4 Spliced:all mapped reads

Parsing STAR log.final outs for spliced:all mapped reads and getting qc summary

```{r}


star_dir    <- "STAR_alignment_outs"

files <- list.files(
  path = star_dir,
  pattern = "Log\\.final\\.out$",
  full.names = TRUE,
  recursive = TRUE
)
files <- files[grepl("LC[0-9]+(nuc|s)", basename(files))]

if (length(files) == 0) {
  stop("No STAR LC*Log.final.out files found. Check 'star_dir' and file naming.")
}

clean_star_sample <- function(x) {
  y <- sub("Log\\.final\\.out$", "", basename(x))
  y <- sub("_*$", "", y)
  y <- sub(".*(LC[0-9]+(?:nuc|s)).*", "\\1", y, perl = TRUE)
  y <- sub("^LC", "", y)
  y <- sub("([0-9]+)([A-Za-z]+)$", "\\1_\\2", y)
  y <- sub("_s$", "_syn", y)
  y
}

extract_right_of_pipe_numeric <- function(lines, pattern) {
  hits <- grep(pattern, lines, fixed = TRUE)
  if (!length(hits)) return(NA_real_)
  rhs <- sub(".*\\|", "", lines[hits[1]])
  rhs <- trimws(rhs)
  rhs <- gsub(",", "", rhs)
  rhs <- gsub("%", "", rhs)
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(rhs))
}

qc_list <- lapply(files, function(f) {
  stats  <- readLines(f, warn = FALSE)
  sample <- clean_star_sample(f)

  num_input       <- extract_right_of_pipe_numeric(stats, "Number of input reads")
  uniquely_mapped <- extract_right_of_pipe_numeric(stats, "Uniquely mapped reads number")
  splices_total   <- extract_right_of_pipe_numeric(stats, "Number of splices: Total")

  data.frame(
    File                  = f,
    Sample                = sample,
    Num_input_reads       = num_input,
    Uniquely_mapped_reads = uniquely_mapped,
    Splices_total         = splices_total,
    Spliced_ratio         = ifelse(is.finite(uniquely_mapped) & uniquely_mapped > 0,
                                   splices_total / uniquely_mapped, NA_real_),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
})

qc_summary <- do.call(rbind, qc_list)

na_rows <- which(!is.finite(qc_summary$Num_input_reads) |
                 !is.finite(qc_summary$Uniquely_mapped_reads) |
                 !is.finite(qc_summary$Splices_total))
if (length(na_rows)) {
  message("Some STAR fields could not be parsed (showing up to 10):")
  print(utils::head(qc_summary[na_rows, c("File","Sample","Num_input_reads",
                                         "Uniquely_mapped_reads","Splices_total")], 10))
}

not_in_meta   <- setdiff(qc_summary$Sample, metadata_cond_syn_nuc$Sample)
not_in_counts <- setdiff(qc_summary$Sample, colnames(exp_data_cond_syn_nuc))
if (length(not_in_meta))   message("STAR samples not in metadata: ", paste(not_in_meta, collapse = ", "))
if (length(not_in_counts)) message("STAR samples not in counts: ", paste(not_in_counts, collapse = ", "))

qc_summary <- merge(qc_summary, metadata_cond_syn_nuc, by = "Sample", all.x = TRUE)

qc_summary <- qc_summary %>%
  dplyr::filter(!("Outlier" %in% colnames(.)) | as.character(Outlier) != "TRUE") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Spliced_pct = 100 * Spliced_ratio,
    Fraction = factor(as.character(Fraction), levels = c("Nuc", "Syn"))
  )

fraction_cols <- c(
  "Nuc" = "#619CFF",
  "Syn" = "#F8766D"
)

ggplot(qc_summary, aes(x = Spliced_pct, fill = Fraction)) +
  geom_histogram(position = "identity", alpha = 0.5, binwidth = 5, boundary = 0) +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = fraction_cols) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(40, 85),
    breaks = seq(40, 85, by = 5)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of spliced:all uniquely mapped (%)",
    x = "Spliced reads [%]",
    y = "Count"
  )

point_size <- 1.6

thr_df <- data.frame(
  Fraction = factor(c("Nuc", "Syn"), levels = c("Nuc", "Syn")),
  thr      = c(60, 70)
)

qc_plot_spliced <- ggplot(qc_summary, aes(x = Sample, y = Spliced_pct,
                                         color = Genotype, shape = Sex)) +
  geom_point(size = point_size) +
  geom_hline(data = thr_df, aes(yintercept = thr), linetype = 2, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  facet_grid(~ Fraction, scales = "free_x") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(title = "Spliced reads (spliced / uniquely mapped)",
       y = "Spliced reads [%]", x = "") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

qc_plot_spliced

qc_summary <- qc_summary %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Splicing.rate = Spliced_ratio) %>%
  dplyr::select(Sample, Splicing.rate)

metadata_cond_syn_nuc <- dplyr::left_join(metadata_cond_syn_nuc, qc_summary, by = "Sample")

summary(metadata_cond_syn_nuc$Splicing.rate)



```

## 1.6 Check LogCPM distributions

```{r}

# build DGEList just for CPM (no filtering/normalization required for this plot)
dge_cond <- edgeR::DGEList(counts = replace(as.matrix(exp_data_cond_syn_nuc),
                                           is.na(exp_data_cond_syn_nuc), 0))

# Calculate logCPM
logCPM <- edgeR::cpm(dge_cond, log = TRUE)

# Convert to long format
logCPM_long <- reshape2::melt(logCPM)
colnames(logCPM_long) <- c("Gene", "Sample", "logCPM")

# Add metadata
logCPM_long <- dplyr::left_join(
  logCPM_long,
  metadata_cond_syn_nuc %>% dplyr::select(Sample, Fraction, Genotype, Sex),
  by = "Sample"
)

# (optional) order samples by Fraction then Sample
sample_order <- metadata_cond_syn_nuc %>%
  dplyr::distinct(Sample, Fraction) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Fraction, Sample) %>%
  dplyr::pull(Sample)

logCPM_long$Sample <- factor(logCPM_long$Sample, levels = sample_order)

ggplot(logCPM_long, aes(x = Sample, y = logCPM, fill = Fraction)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.3) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(title = "LogCPM distributions across samples",
       x = "Sample",
       y = "logCPM")


```


## 1.7 Check mitochondrial and ribosomal CPM

```{r}


# ensure metadata_cond_syn_nuc rows match exp_data_cond_syn_nuc columns
samples <- colnames(exp_data_cond_syn_nuc)
meta_c  <- metadata_cond_syn_nuc[match(samples, metadata_cond_syn_nuc$Sample), , drop = FALSE]
stopifnot(identical(meta_c$Sample, samples))

# symbol-name vector for matching
map <- my_gene[, c("gene_id","gene_name")]
map <- map[!duplicated(map$gene_id), , drop = FALSE]
rownames(map) <- map$gene_id
rn_sym <- map[rownames(exp_data_cond_syn_nuc), "gene_name"]
rn_sym[is.na(rn_sym) | rn_sym == ""] <- rownames(exp_data_cond_syn_nuc)[is.na(rn_sym) | rn_sym == ""]

# CPM matrix (NA -> 0 for CPM only)
dge_cond <- edgeR::DGEList(counts = replace(as.matrix(exp_data_cond_syn_nuc),
                                           is.na(exp_data_cond_syn_nuc), 0))
cpm_mat <- edgeR::cpm(dge_cond, log = FALSE)

# identify gene sets
# mt genes using SYMBOLS (case-insensitive)
mt_idx <- grep("^mt-", rn_sym, ignore.case = TRUE)

# rRNA genes using gene_biotype from my_gene (match by ENS gene_id / rownames)
rrna_ids <- my_gene$gene_id[my_gene$gene_biotype %in% "rRNA"]
ribo_idx <- which(rownames(exp_data_cond_syn_nuc) %in% rrna_ids)

# compute totals
mt_CPM_vec <- if (length(mt_idx)) {
  colSums(cpm_mat[mt_idx, , drop = FALSE])
} else rep(NA_real_, ncol(cpm_mat))

ribo_CPM_vec <- if (length(ribo_idx)) {
  colSums(cpm_mat[ribo_idx, , drop = FALSE])
} else rep(NA_real_, ncol(cpm_mat))

# library CPM totals (~1e6 each)
lib_cpm_tot <- colSums(cpm_mat)
names(lib_cpm_tot) <- samples

# build QC frame
qc_mt_ribo <- meta_c %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    mt_CPM   = mt_CPM_vec,
    ribo_CPM = ribo_CPM_vec
  ) %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    Sample, Fraction, Genotype, Sex,
    mt_CPM, ribo_CPM,
    mt_pct   = 100 * mt_CPM   / lib_cpm_tot[Sample],
    ribo_pct = 100 * ribo_CPM / lib_cpm_tot[Sample]
  )

# long format
long_pct <- qc_mt_ribo %>%
  dplyr::select(Sample, Fraction, Genotype, Sex, mt_pct, ribo_pct) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(c(mt_pct, ribo_pct), names_to = "metric", values_to = "pct") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(metric = dplyr::recode(metric, mt_pct = "Mito (%)", ribo_pct = "Ribo (%)"))

thr_tbl  <- data.frame(metric = c("Mito (%)", "Ribo (%)"), thr = 10)
label_df <- long_pct %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(thr_tbl, by = "metric") %>%
  dplyr::filter(is.finite(pct) & pct > thr)

ggplot(long_pct, aes(x = Fraction, y = pct, fill = Fraction)) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_jitter(aes(shape = Genotype), width = 0.12, size = 1.6, alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_hline(data = thr_tbl, aes(yintercept = thr), linetype = 2, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = label_df,
    aes(label = Sample),
    size = 3, nudge_y = 1.5, segment.color = "grey50", max.overlaps = Inf
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ metric, scales = "free_y", nrow = 1) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(title = "Percent mito and ribo",
       x = "", y = "Percent of total CPM")

# Add mt/ribo back to metadata_cond_syn_nuc by Sample
```

```{r}
pick_gene_cpm <- function(symbol, rn_sym, mat) {
  hits <- grep(paste0("^", symbol, "$"), rn_sym, ignore.case = TRUE)
  if (length(hits) == 0) return(rep(NA_real_, ncol(mat)))
  if (length(hits) == 1) return(as.numeric(mat[hits, , drop = FALSE]))
  colMeans(mat[hits, , drop = FALSE])
}
```

#### MDS plot

```{r}

# --------------------------
# 0) Subset to Syn/Nuc + remove outliers, keep order consistent
# --------------------------
stopifnot(identical(colnames(exp_data_cond_syn_nuc), metadata_cond_syn_nuc$Sample))

cond_syn_nuc_meta <- metadata_cond_syn_nuc %>%
  dplyr::filter(Fraction %in% c("Syn", "Nuc")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Outlier == "FALSE" | Outlier == FALSE) %>%   # handles character or logical
  droplevels()

use.cols <- cond_syn_nuc_meta$Sample
stopifnot(all(use.cols %in% colnames(exp_data_cond_syn_nuc)))

counts_cond_syn_nuc <- exp_data_cond_syn_nuc[, use.cols, drop = FALSE]

# enforce identical order
cond_syn_nuc_meta <- cond_syn_nuc_meta[match(colnames(counts_cond_syn_nuc), cond_syn_nuc_meta$Sample), , drop = FALSE]
stopifnot(identical(colnames(counts_cond_syn_nuc), cond_syn_nuc_meta$Sample))

# --------------------------
# 1) DGEList + TMM
# --------------------------
y <- DGEList(
  counts  = replace(as.matrix(counts_cond_syn_nuc), is.na(counts_cond_syn_nuc), 0),
  samples = cond_syn_nuc_meta
)
y <- calcNormFactors(y)

# --------------------------
# 2) Filter genes: CPM > 1 in at least 4 samples
# --------------------------
keep <- rowSums(edgeR::cpm(y) > 1) >= 4
y <- y[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]

# --------------------------
# 3) logCPM + MDS
# --------------------------
logCPM <- edgeR::cpm(y, log = TRUE, prior.count = 2)

mds <- plotMDS(logCPM, plot = FALSE)

df_mds <- data.frame(
  Sample = colnames(logCPM),
  dim1   = mds$x,
  dim2   = mds$y,
  cond_syn_nuc_meta[match(colnames(logCPM), cond_syn_nuc_meta$Sample), , drop = FALSE]
)
stopifnot(identical(df_mds$Sample, colnames(logCPM)))

# --------------------------
# 4) Factors (keeps legend order consistent)
# --------------------------
df_mds$Genotype <- factor(df_mds$Genotype, levels = c("HET", "WT", "HOM"))
df_mds$Sex      <- factor(df_mds$Sex, levels = c("F", "M"))
df_mds$Fraction <- factor(df_mds$Fraction, levels = c("Syn", "Nuc"))

# --------------------------
# 5) Plot: fill=Genotype, shape=Sex, label=Fraction
# --------------------------
p_mds_cond_syn_nuc <- ggplot(df_mds, aes(dim1, dim2)) +
  geom_point(
    aes(fill = Genotype, shape = Sex),
    size = 3.6, color = "black", stroke = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = Fraction),
    size = 3,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    box.padding = 0.25,
    point.padding = 0.25,
    seed = 1
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
  values = c(
    "HET" = "#8494FF",
    "WT"  = "#ABA300",
    "HOM" = "#F8766D"
  ),
  breaks = c("HET", "WT", "HOM")
) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("F" = 21, "M" = 22)) +
  labs(
    title = "Cond Syn/Nuc MDS",
    x = "dim1",
    y = "dim2",
    fill = "Gen",
    shape = "Sex"
  ) +
  theme_bw()

p_mds_cond_syn_nuc
```

## 1.11 Checking exon 5

```{r}

gene_sym      <- "Chd8"
bam_dir       <- path.expand("~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/Nord_Lab_Computational_Projects3/Chd8_P60_CamK2a_Syn_Nuc/bam_files/")
paired_end    <- TRUE
strand_specific <- FALSE

# ---- find BAMs and map them to your simplified sample IDs ----
bam_files <- list.files(bam_dir,
                        pattern = "Aligned\\.sortedByCoord\\.out\\.bam$",
                        full.names = TRUE,
                        recursive = TRUE)
stopifnot(length(bam_files) > 0)

# same cleaning logic you used for STAR logs (LC##nuc or LC##s -> "##_(nuc|syn)")
clean_bam_sample <- function(x) {
  y <- basename(x)
  y <- sub("_*Aligned\\.sortedByCoord\\.out\\.bam$", "", y)   # strip STAR suffix
  y <- sub("_*$", "", y)
  y <- sub(".*(LC[0-9]+(?:nuc|s)).*", "\\1", y, perl = TRUE)  # grab LC##nuc or LC##s
  y <- sub("^LC", "", y)                                      # drop LC
  y <- sub("([0-9]+)([A-Za-z]+)$", "\\1_\\2", y)              # 46nuc -> 46_nuc, 46s -> 46_s
  y <- sub("_s$", "_syn", y)                                  # 46_s -> 46_syn
  y
}

bam_map <- data.frame(
  bam_path = bam_files,
  Sample   = vapply(bam_files, clean_bam_sample, character(1)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# keep first occurrence if duplicates
bam_map <- bam_map[!duplicated(bam_map$Sample), , drop = FALSE]

# check coverage vs metadata
missing_in_meta   <- setdiff(bam_map$Sample, metadata_cond_syn_nuc$Sample)
missing_bam_for_meta <- setdiff(metadata_cond_syn_nuc$Sample, bam_map$Sample)
if (length(missing_in_meta))   message("BAM samples not in metadata: ", paste(missing_in_meta, collapse = ", "))
if (length(missing_bam_for_meta)) stop("No BAM found for these metadata$Sample IDs: ",
                                       paste(missing_bam_for_meta, collapse = ", "))

# align to metadata_cond_syn_nuc order and build named vector
bam_map <- bam_map[match(metadata_cond_syn_nuc$Sample, bam_map$Sample), , drop = FALSE]
stopifnot(identical(bam_map$Sample, metadata_cond_syn_nuc$Sample))
bam_paths <- setNames(bam_map$bam_path, bam_map$Sample)



# -----------------------------------------------------------------------

## 1) Get exon 5 ranges from TxDb (mm10)
entrez <- AnnotationDbi::mapIds(org.Mm.eg.db, keys = gene_sym, keytype = "SYMBOL",
                                column = "ENTREZID", multiVals = "first")
txdb <- TxDb.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10.knownGene
exons_by_tx <- GenomicFeatures::exonsBy(txdb, by = "tx")   # GRangesList

tx_tbl <- AnnotationDbi::select(txdb, keys = entrez, keytype = "GENEID", columns = "TXID")
tx_ids <- unique(tx_tbl$TXID)

# Unlist to a single GRanges, then keep only exon_rank == 5 for those transcripts
ex_gr   <- unlist(exons_by_tx[names(exons_by_tx) %in% tx_ids], use.names = FALSE)  # GRanges
ex5_gr  <- ex_gr[mcols(ex_gr)$exon_rank == 5]
stopifnot(length(ex5_gr) > 0)

# Merge overlapping exon-5 pieces across transcripts
ex5_merged <- GenomicRanges::reduce(ex5_gr)   # or reduce(ex5_gr) if GenomicRanges is attached
ex5_len_kb <- sum(width(ex5_merged)) / 1000

## --- Make exon ranges match BAM header seqnames ---
# Peek at the first BAM's header to learn its chromosome names
first_bam <- unname(bam_paths[1])
bam_seqs  <- names(Rsamtools::scanBamHeader(first_bam)[[1]]$targets)

# Pick a style: if BAM has 'chr' prefix, use UCSC; otherwise use Ensembl (no 'chr')
bam_style <- if (any(grepl("^chr", bam_seqs))) "UCSC" else "Ensembl"

# Convert exon ranges to that style
seqlevelsStyle(ex5_merged) <- bam_style

# Drop any seqlevels not present in the BAM header
keep_chrs <- intersect(seqlevels(ex5_merged), bam_seqs)
ex5_merged <- keepSeqlevels(ex5_merged, keep_chrs, pruning.mode = "coarse")

if (length(ex5_merged) == 0L) {
  stop("After seqname style conversion, no exon-5 ranges match BAM chromosomes. ",
       "This suggests a genome build mismatch (e.g., mm10 vs mm39). ",
       "Use a TxDb matching your BAM build (e.g., TxDb.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm39.knownGene) ",
       "or confirm the reference used for alignment.")
}

## 2) Count exon-5 overlaps per BAM with countBam
# For paired-end, count only first mates to avoid double-counting fragments
flag <- if (paired_end) {
  scanBamFlag(isPaired = TRUE, isProperPair = TRUE, isFirstMateRead = TRUE,
              isSecondaryAlignment = FALSE, isSupplementaryAlignment = FALSE,
              isDuplicate = FALSE)
} else {
  scanBamFlag(isPaired = FALSE,
              isSecondaryAlignment = FALSE, isSupplementaryAlignment = FALSE,
              isDuplicate = FALSE)
}
# If stranded, restrict to the correct strand (depends on library prep). Otherwise we ignore strand:
param <- ScanBamParam(which = ex5_merged, flag = flag)

ex5_counts <- sapply(bam_paths, function(bp) {
  sum(countBam(bp, param = param)$records)
})

## 3) Library size (mapped reads) from bam index (idxstats)
lib_mapped <- sapply(bam_paths, function(bp) {
  sum(idxstatsBam(bp)$mapped, na.rm = TRUE)
})

## 4) RPKM for exon 5
rpkm <- (ex5_counts / (lib_mapped / 1e6)) / ex5_len_kb

# 5) Plot by genotype (optionally restrict to syn fraction)
plot_df <- metadata_cond_syn_nuc %>%
  mutate(Exon5_counts = as.numeric(ex5_counts[Sample]),
         Exon5_RPKM   = as.numeric(rpkm[Sample])) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Exon5_RPKM)) %>%
  droplevels()
# plot_df <- dplyr::filter(plot_df, Fraction == "syn")  # syn only

p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = Genotype, y = Exon5_RPKM, color = Genotype, label = Sample)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.25) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 1.8, alpha = 0.85) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    size = 2.6,
    max.overlaps = Inf,      # show all labels
    box.padding = 0.2,
    point.padding = 0.15,
    min.segment.length = 0,
    seed = 123,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(title = paste0(gene_sym, " exon 5 expression (RPKM)"),
       x = "", y = "RPKM (exon 5)") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5), legend.position = "none")

p
```

```{r}


y <- edgeR::DGEList(
  counts  = replace(as.matrix(exp_data_cond_syn_nuc), is.na(exp_data_cond_syn_nuc), 0),
  samples = metadata_cond_syn_nuc
)

keep <- rowSums(edgeR::cpm(y) > 1) >= 4

cpm_mat <- edgeR::cpm(y)

failed <- !keep
kept   <-  keep

gene_syms <- rownames(y)
is_mito   <- grepl("^mt[-\\.]", tolower(gene_syms))
is_energy <- grepl(
  paste0("^nduf|^cox|^uqcr|^sdh|^atp|^slc25|^cycs|^cpt|^pdk|^ppar"),
  tolower(gene_syms)
)

failed_df <- data.frame(
  gene                  = gene_syms[failed],
  n_samples_cpm_gt1     = rowSums(cpm_mat[failed, , drop = FALSE] > 1),
  frac_samples_cpm_gt1  = rowMeans(cpm_mat[failed, , drop = FALSE] > 1),
  mean_cpm              = rowMeans(cpm_mat[failed, , drop = FALSE]),
  max_cpm               = apply(cpm_mat[failed, , drop = FALSE], 1, max),
  is_mito               = is_mito[failed],
  energetics_guess      = is_energy[failed],
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
failed_df <- failed_df[order(-failed_df$n_samples_cpm_gt1, -failed_df$max_cpm), ]

kept_df <- data.frame(

  n_samples_cpm_gt1     = rowSums(cpm_mat[kept, , drop = FALSE] > 1),
  frac_samples_cpm_gt1  = rowMeans(cpm_mat[kept, , drop = FALSE] > 1),
  mean_cpm              = rowMeans(cpm_mat[kept, , drop = FALSE]),
  max_cpm               = apply(cpm_mat[kept, , drop = FALSE], 1, max),
  is_mito               = is_mito[kept],
  energetics_guess      = is_energy[kept],

)
kept_df <- kept_df[order(-kept_df$n_samples_cpm_gt1, -kept_df$max_cpm), ]

writexl::write_xlsx(failed_df, "output/QC/CPM_filter_failed_genes.xlsx")
writexl::write_xlsx(kept_df,   "output/QC/CPM_filter_kept_genes.xlsx")
```

# 2. Cond DE analysis


### DE Function

```{r}

run_DE_with_optional_PCs <- function(
  counts,                         # genes x samples (rownames MUST be Ensembl IDs)
  meta,                           # metadata data.frame
  my_gene,                        # must contain gene_id (Ensembl), gene_name, gene_biotype
  fraction_keep = c("Syn","Nuc"),
  genotypes_keep = c("WT","HET"),
  out_csv = "output/DE/simple_Cond.csv",
  y_out = NULL,
  include_pcs = NULL,             # e.g., c(1,2); NULL = no PCs
  n_pc_check = 10,
  show_heatmap = TRUE,
  sig_r = 0.5,
  sig_p = 0.05,
  include_sex = TRUE,
  include_splicing = FALSE,
  include_mt = FALSE,
  include_mt_resid = FALSE,
  include_batch = FALSE,
  include_ribo = FALSE,
  drop_samples = "Outliers",
  genes_use = c("protein_coding", "all"),   # default protein_coding
  do_tmm = TRUE,                            # DEFAULT TRUE
  heatmap_label = NULL
) {
  stopifnot(all(c("Sample","Genotype","Sex","Fraction") %in% names(meta)))
  genes_use <- match.arg(genes_use)

  # -----------------------------
  # 0) Normalize fraction labels (Syn/Nuc/Cyt) case-insensitive
  # -----------------------------
  norm_frac <- function(x) {
    x <- trimws(tolower(as.character(x)))
    x <- ifelse(x %in% c("syn","synaptic"), "syn", x)
    x <- ifelse(x %in% c("nuc","nuclear","nuclei"), "nuc", x)
    x <- ifelse(x %in% c("cyt","cyto","cytoplasm","cytoplasmic","cytoplasma"), "cyt", x)
    x
  }

  meta_local <- meta
  meta_local$Fraction <- norm_frac(meta_local$Fraction)

  fk_in <- norm_frac(fraction_keep)
  if (length(fraction_keep) == 2L) fk_in <- "syn"

  # -----------------------------
  # 1) Determine which samples to drop
  # -----------------------------
  if (is.null(drop_samples)) drop_samples <- "Outliers"

  drop_none     <- is.character(drop_samples) && length(drop_samples) == 1 && drop_samples == "None"
  drop_outliers <- is.character(drop_samples) && length(drop_samples) == 1 && drop_samples == "Outliers"

  if (!drop_none && !drop_outliers && !is.character(drop_samples)) {
    stop("drop_samples must be 'Outliers' (default), 'None', or a character vector like c('M6M','435F').")
  }

  sample_prefix <- sub("_.*$", "", as.character(meta_local$Sample))
  keep_mask <- rep(TRUE, nrow(meta_local))

  if (drop_outliers) {
    if (!"Outlier" %in% names(meta_local)) {
      message("drop_samples='Outliers' but no 'Outlier' column found; not dropping any outliers.")
    } else {
      ol <- meta_local$Outlier
      if (is.factor(ol)) ol <- as.character(ol)
      if (is.character(ol)) {
        ol <- trimws(tolower(ol)) %in% c("true","t","1","yes","y")
      } else if (is.numeric(ol)) {
        ol <- ol != 0
      } else if (!is.logical(ol)) {
        ol <- as.logical(ol)
      }
      keep_mask <- keep_mask & (!ol)
    }
  }

  if (!drop_none && !drop_outliers) {
    drop_prefixes <- unique(drop_samples)
    keep_mask <- keep_mask & !(sample_prefix %in% drop_prefixes)
  }

  meta_local <- meta_local[keep_mask, , drop = FALSE]

  # -----------------------------
  # 2) Filter metadata to desired comparison
  # -----------------------------
  metadata_filt <- meta_local |>
    dplyr::filter(
      Fraction == fk_in,
      Genotype %in% genotypes_keep
    ) |>
    droplevels()

  if ("WT" %in% unique(metadata_filt$Genotype)) {
    metadata_filt$Genotype <- factor(
      metadata_filt$Genotype,
      levels = unique(c("WT", setdiff(genotypes_keep, "WT")))
    )
  } else {
    metadata_filt$Genotype <- factor(metadata_filt$Genotype, levels = genotypes_keep)
  }
  metadata_filt$Sex <- factor(metadata_filt$Sex)

  # Align counts to filtered metadata
  use.cols <- metadata_filt$Sample
  stopifnot(all(use.cols %in% colnames(counts)))
  test.data <- counts[, use.cols, drop = FALSE]

  rownames(test.data) <- as.character(rownames(test.data))
  test.data <- replace(as.matrix(test.data), is.na(test.data), 0)

  # -----------------------------
  # 2b) Optional gene filtering (protein_coding vs all) USING Ensembl IDs
  # -----------------------------
  if (genes_use == "protein_coding") {
    pc_ids <- my_gene |>
      dplyr::filter(gene_biotype == "protein_coding") |>
      dplyr::pull(gene_id) |>
      unique()

    test.data <- test.data[rownames(test.data) %in% pc_ids, , drop = FALSE]
  }

  md <- metadata_filt[match(colnames(test.data), metadata_filt$Sample), , drop = FALSE]
  stopifnot(identical(colnames(test.data), md$Sample))

  # -----------------------------
  # 3) edgeR object (filter + optional TMM)
  # -----------------------------
  test.group <- factor(as.character(md$Genotype), levels = levels(md$Genotype))
  y <- edgeR::DGEList(counts = test.data, group = test.group)

  keep <- rowSums(edgeR::cpm(y) > 1) >= 4
  y <- y[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]

  if (isTRUE(do_tmm)) {
    y <- edgeR::calcNormFactors(y)
  }

  if (!is.null(y_out)) saveRDS(y, file = y_out)

  # -----------------------------
  # 4) PCA
  # -----------------------------
  pca.results <- prcomp(log(y$counts + 1), center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)

  samps  <- rownames(pca.results$rotation)
  md_pca <- md[match(samps, md$Sample), , drop = FALSE]
  stopifnot(identical(md_pca$Sample, samps))

  # -----------------------------
  # 4c) Optional residualize mt_CPM and store as mito_resid
  # -----------------------------
  if (isTRUE(include_mt_resid)) {
    if (!"mt_CPM" %in% colnames(md_pca)) stop("include_mt_resid=TRUE but 'mt_CPM' not in metadata.")
    md_pca$mt_CPM <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(md_pca$mt_CPM))

    mt_terms <- c("Genotype")
    if (isTRUE(include_batch)) {
      if (!"Sequencing_batch" %in% colnames(md_pca)) stop("include_batch=TRUE but 'Sequencing_batch' not in metadata.")
      md_pca$Sequencing_batch <- factor(md_pca$Sequencing_batch)
      if (nlevels(md_pca$Sequencing_batch) >= 2) mt_terms <- c(mt_terms, "Sequencing_batch")
    }
    if (isTRUE(include_sex)) {
      if (!"Sex" %in% colnames(md_pca)) stop("include_sex=TRUE but 'Sex' not in metadata.")
      md_pca$Sex <- factor(md_pca$Sex)
      if (nlevels(md_pca$Sex) >= 2) mt_terms <- c(mt_terms, "Sex")
    }

    mt_form <- as.formula(paste("mt_CPM ~", paste(mt_terms, collapse = " + ")))
    mt_fit <- stats::lm(mt_form, data = md_pca)

    md_pca$mito_resid <- stats::resid(mt_fit)
    md_pca$mito_resid <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(md_pca$mito_resid))
    if (all(!is.finite(md_pca$mito_resid)) || stats::sd(md_pca$mito_resid, na.rm = TRUE) == 0) {
      message("Dropping mito_resid: constant/non-finite across samples.")
      md_pca$mito_resid <- NA_real_
    } else {
      md_pca$mito_resid <- as.numeric(scale(md_pca$mito_resid))
    }
  }

  # -----------------------------
  # 5) PC–covariate correlation screen (only if include_pcs is NULL)
  # -----------------------------
  if (is.null(include_pcs)) {

    cand_vars <- c(
      "Genotype", "Sex", "Sequencing_batch", "Read_depth", "Splicing.rate",
      "mt_CPM", "ribo_CPM", "rpls_CPM"
    )

    covars <- intersect(cand_vars, colnames(md_pca))
    K <- min(n_pc_check, ncol(pca.results$rotation))

    to_num <- function(x) {
      if (is.factor(x) || is.character(x)) as.numeric(as.factor(x)) else suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
    }

    r_mat <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = length(covars), ncol = K,
                    dimnames = list(covars, paste0("PC", seq_len(K))))
    p_mat <- r_mat

    for (i in seq_along(covars)) {
      xnum <- to_num(md_pca[[covars[i]]])
      for (k in seq_len(K)) {
        r_mat[i, k] <- suppressWarnings(cor(pca.results$rotation[, k], xnum, use = "pair"))
        p_mat[i, k] <- tryCatch(
          cor.test(pca.results$rotation[, k], xnum)$p.value,
          error = function(e) NA_real_
        )
      }
    }

    sig_mask <- (abs(r_mat) >= sig_r) & (p_mat < sig_p)
    sig_mask[is.na(sig_mask)] <- FALSE

    if (isTRUE(show_heatmap) && length(covars) > 0 && K > 0) {
      num_r <- matrix(sprintf("%.2f", r_mat), nrow = nrow(r_mat), dimnames = dimnames(r_mat))
      num_r[sig_mask] <- paste0(num_r[sig_mask], "*")

      num_p <- matrix(sprintf("%.2e", p_mat), nrow = nrow(p_mat), dimnames = dimnames(p_mat))
      num_p[sig_mask] <- paste0(num_p[sig_mask], "*")

      pheatmap::pheatmap(
        r_mat,
        display_numbers = num_r,
        cluster_rows = FALSE,
        cluster_cols = FALSE,
        color = colorRampPalette(c("#4575b4","#f7f7f7","#d73027"))(200),
        number_color = "black",
        fontsize_number = 9,
        na_col = "grey90",
        main = paste0(
          if (!is.null(heatmap_label)) paste0(heatmap_label, ": ") else "",
          "correlation (Pearson r) of PCs vs covariates"
        ),
        angle_col = 0
      )

      pheatmap::pheatmap(
        p_mat,
        display_numbers = num_p,
        cluster_rows = FALSE,
        cluster_cols = FALSE,
        color = colorRampPalette(c("#ffffcc","#fdae61","#d73027"))(200),
        number_color = "black",
        fontsize_number = 9,
        na_col = "grey90",
        main = paste0(
          if (!is.null(heatmap_label)) paste0(heatmap_label, ": ") else "",
          "PC-covariate correlation p values"
        ),
        angle_col = 0
      )
    }
  }

  # -----------------------------
  # 6) Build design matrix (~ covariates + optional PCs + Genotype)
  # -----------------------------
  cov_terms <- character(0)
  if (isTRUE(include_sex)) cov_terms <- c(cov_terms, "Sex")

  if (isTRUE(include_splicing)) {
    if (!"Splicing.rate" %in% colnames(md_pca)) stop("include_splicing=TRUE but 'Splicing.rate' not in metadata.")
    md_pca$Splicing.rate <- as.numeric(md_pca$Splicing.rate)
    cov_terms <- c(cov_terms, "Splicing.rate")
  }

  if (isTRUE(include_mt)) {
    if (!"mt_CPM" %in% colnames(md_pca)) stop("include_mt=TRUE but 'mt_CPM' not in metadata.")
    md_pca$mt_CPM <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(md_pca$mt_CPM))
    if (all(!is.finite(md_pca$mt_CPM)) || sd(md_pca$mt_CPM, na.rm = TRUE) == 0) {
      message("Dropping mt_CPM: constant/non-finite across samples.")
    } else {
      md_pca$mt_CPM <- as.numeric(scale(md_pca$mt_CPM))
      cov_terms <- c(cov_terms, "mt_CPM")
    }
  }

  if (isTRUE(include_mt_resid)) {
    if (!"mito_resid" %in% colnames(md_pca)) stop("include_mt_resid=TRUE but 'mito_resid' not in metadata (unexpected).")
    if (all(!is.finite(md_pca$mito_resid)) || sd(md_pca$mito_resid, na.rm = TRUE) == 0) {
      message("Dropping mito_resid: constant/non-finite across samples.")
    } else {
      cov_terms <- c(cov_terms, "mito_resid")
    }
  }

  if (isTRUE(include_batch)) {
    if (!"Sequencing_batch" %in% colnames(md_pca)) stop("include_batch=TRUE but 'Sequencing_batch' not in metadata.")
    md_pca$Sequencing_batch <- factor(md_pca$Sequencing_batch)
    if (nlevels(md_pca$Sequencing_batch) < 2) {
      message("Dropping Sequencing_batch: <2 levels after filtering.")
    } else {
      cov_terms <- c(cov_terms, "Sequencing_batch")
    }
  }

  if (isTRUE(include_ribo)) {
    if (!"ribo_CPM" %in% colnames(md_pca)) stop("include_ribo=TRUE but 'ribo_CPM' not in metadata.")
    md_pca$ribo_CPM <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(md_pca$ribo_CPM))
    if (all(!is.finite(md_pca$ribo_CPM)) || sd(md_pca$ribo_CPM, na.rm = TRUE) == 0) {
      message("Dropping ribo_CPM: constant/non-finite across samples.")
    } else {
      md_pca$ribo_CPM <- as.numeric(scale(md_pca$ribo_CPM))
      cov_terms <- c(cov_terms, "ribo_CPM")
    }
  }

  if (!is.null(include_pcs) && length(include_pcs) > 0) {
    pcs_keep <- include_pcs[include_pcs %in% seq_len(ncol(pca.results$rotation))]
    if (length(pcs_keep) == 0) stop("include_pcs requested but none are available in PCA results.")
    for (pc in pcs_keep) {
      md_pca[[paste0("PC", pc)]] <- pca.results$rotation[, pc]
    }
    cov_terms <- c(cov_terms, paste0("PC", pcs_keep))
  }

  form_str <- paste("~", paste(c(cov_terms, "Genotype"), collapse = " + "))
  design <- model.matrix(as.formula(form_str), data = md_pca)

  # -----------------------------
  # 7) edgeR DE
  # -----------------------------
  y <- edgeR::estimateGLMCommonDisp(y, design)
  y <- edgeR::estimateGLMTrendedDisp(y, design)
  y <- edgeR::estimateGLMTagwiseDisp(y, design)
  fit <- edgeR::glmFit(y, design)

  if ("HOM" %in% genotypes_keep) {
    coef_name <- grep("^GenotypeHOM$", colnames(design), value = TRUE)
  } else {
    coef_name <- grep("^GenotypeHET$", colnames(design), value = TRUE)
  }
  if (length(coef_name) != 1) {
    stop("Could not find genotype coefficient in design. Columns: ", paste(colnames(design), collapse = ", "))
  }

  lrt <- edgeR::glmLRT(fit, coef = coef_name)

  res <- edgeR::topTags(lrt, n = Inf)$table
  res$gene_id <- rownames(res)
  rownames(res) <- NULL
  res <- res[, c("gene_id","logFC","logCPM","LR","PValue","FDR")]

  map_out <- my_gene[, c("gene_id","gene_name")]
  map_out <- map_out[!duplicated(map_out$gene_id), , drop = FALSE]
  res <- merge(map_out, res, by = "gene_id", all.y = TRUE)
  res <- res[, c("gene_id","gene_name","logFC","logCPM","LR","PValue","FDR")]
  res <- dplyr::arrange(res, PValue)

  # --- write output only if requested ---
  if (!is.null(out_csv)) {
    dir.create(dirname(out_csv), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
    write.csv(res, out_csv, row.names = FALSE)
    message("\nSaved DE to: ", out_csv)
  } else {
    message("\nout_csv is NULL -> not writing DE table to disk.")
  }

  invisible(list(y = y, design = design, pca = pca.results, res = res, md_pca = md_pca))
}


```




### Sample-level heatmap function


```{r}

heatmap_topDEGs_syn_nuc <- function(
  de_syn_fp,
  de_nuc_fp,
  counts,
  meta,
  top_n = 50,
  selection_mode = c("threshold","rank"),
  threshold_type = c("fdr","pval"),
  fdr_thresh = 0.05,
  p_thresh   = 0.05,
  rank_by    = c("auto","fdr","pval"),
  sample_col   = "Sample",
  fraction_col = "Fraction",
  genotype_col = "Genotype",
  sex_col      = "Sex",
  font_size    = 10,
  gene_transform = c("none","toupper","tolower"),
  id_map = NULL, map_from_col = "from_id", map_to_col = "to_id",
  verbose = TRUE,
  comparison = c("WT","HET")   # <-- only plot these two genotypes (order matters)
) {
  selection_mode <- match.arg(selection_mode)
  threshold_type <- match.arg(threshold_type)
  rank_by        <- match.arg(rank_by)
  gene_transform <- match.arg(gene_transform)
  title_mode     <- sprintf("Top %d DEGs per direction", top_n)

  say  <- function(...) if (isTRUE(verbose)) message(sprintf(...))
  must <- function(ok, msg) { if (!isTRUE(ok)) stop(msg, call. = FALSE) }
  pick_col <- function(df, candidates) {
    cl <- tolower(colnames(df)); hit <- match(tolower(candidates), cl); hit <- hit[!is.na(hit)]
    if (length(hit) == 0) return(NA_integer_); hit[1]
  }

  get_top_deg <- function(fp, label) {
    must(file.exists(fp), sprintf("[%s] File not found: %s", label, fp))
    df <- read.csv(fp, check.names = FALSE)
    must(nrow(df) > 0, sprintf("[%s] DE file is empty: %s", label, fp))

    gi <- pick_col(df, c("gene","gene_name","symbol"))
    li <- pick_col(df, c("logFC","logfc","log2FC","log2fc","log2FoldChange","log_fc"))
    fi <- pick_col(df, c("padj","fdr","p_adj","p.adjust","p_val_adj"))
    pi <- pick_col(df, c("pvalue","p_val","p.val"))
    must(!is.na(gi), sprintf("[%s] Could not locate a gene column.", label))
    must(!is.na(li), sprintf("[%s] Could not locate a logFC column.", label))

    gene_col <- colnames(df)[gi]; lfc_col <- colnames(df)[li]
    fdr_col  <- if (!is.na(fi)) colnames(df)[fi] else NA
    p_col    <- if (!is.na(pi)) colnames(df)[pi] else NA

    dd <- df %>%
      dplyr::transmute(
        gene  = as.character(.data[[gene_col]]),
        logFC = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data[[lfc_col]])),
        FDR   = if (!is.na(fdr_col)) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data[[fdr_col]])) else NA_real_,
        P     = if (!is.na(p_col))   suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data[[p_col]]))   else NA_real_
      ) %>%
      dplyr::filter(!is.na(gene), gene != "", !is.na(logFC)) %>%
      dplyr::distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE)

    if (selection_mode == "threshold") {
      if (threshold_type == "fdr") {
        must(!all(is.na(dd$FDR)), sprintf("[%s] FDR column missing/NA.", label))
        dd_keep <- dd %>% dplyr::filter(FDR < fdr_thresh)
      } else {
        must(!all(is.na(dd$P)), sprintf("[%s] P column missing/NA.", label))
        dd_keep <- dd %>% dplyr::filter(P < p_thresh)
      }
      up   <- dd_keep %>% dplyr::filter(logFC > 0) %>% dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(abs(logFC))) %>% dplyr::slice_head(n = top_n) %>% dplyr::pull(gene)
      down <- dd_keep %>% dplyr::filter(logFC < 0) %>% dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(abs(logFC))) %>% dplyr::slice_head(n = top_n) %>% dplyr::pull(gene)
    } else {
      metric <- if (rank_by == "auto") {
        if (!all(is.na(dd$FDR))) "FDR" else if (!all(is.na(dd$P))) "P" else
          stop(sprintf("[%s] No FDR or P for ranking.", label), call. = FALSE)
      } else if (rank_by == "fdr") {
        must(!all(is.na(dd$FDR)), sprintf("[%s] No FDR for rank_by='fdr'.", label)); "FDR"
      } else { must(!all(is.na(dd$P)), sprintf("[%s] No P for rank_by='pval'.", label)); "P" }
      dd_keep <- dd %>% dplyr::arrange(.data[[metric]], dplyr::desc(abs(logFC)))
      up   <- dd_keep %>% dplyr::filter(logFC > 0) %>% dplyr::slice_head(n = top_n) %>% dplyr::pull(gene)
      down <- dd_keep %>% dplyr::filter(logFC < 0) %>% dplyr::slice_head(n = top_n) %>% dplyr::pull(gene)
    }
    say("[%s] kept up=%d, down=%d (top_n=%d)", label, length(up), length(down), top_n)
    list(up = unique(up), down = unique(down))
  }

  # ---- 1) Select genes ----
  syn <- get_top_deg(de_syn_fp, "SYN")
  nuc <- get_top_deg(de_nuc_fp, "NUC")
  plot_genes <- unique(c(syn$up, syn$down, nuc$up, nuc$down))
  must(length(plot_genes) > 0, "No genes selected from DE files.")
  say("[UNION] plot_genes=%d", length(plot_genes))

  # ---- 2) Metadata ----
  must(sample_col %in% names(meta), sprintf("metadata missing '%s'", sample_col))
  must(fraction_col %in% names(meta), sprintf("metadata missing '%s'", fraction_col))
  meta_local <- as.data.frame(meta)
  frac_norm <- tolower(meta_local[[fraction_col]])
  frac_norm <- ifelse(frac_norm %in% c("syn","synaptic"), "Syn",
                 ifelse(frac_norm %in% c("nuc","nuclear","nuclei"), "Nuc", meta_local[[fraction_col]]))
  meta_local[[fraction_col]] <- frac_norm

  if ("Outlier" %in% names(meta_local)) {
    before <- nrow(meta_local); ol <- meta_local$Outlier
    if (is.factor(ol)) ol <- as.character(ol)
    if (is.character(ol))      ol <- trimws(tolower(ol)) %in% c("true","t","1","yes","y")
    else if (is.numeric(ol))   ol <- ol != 0
    else if (!is.logical(ol))  ol <- as.logical(ol)
    keep_mask <- is.na(ol) | !ol
    meta_local <- meta_local[keep_mask, , drop = FALSE]
    say("[META] dropped outliers: %d -> %d (kept %d; dropped %d)",
        before, nrow(meta_local), sum(keep_mask, na.rm = TRUE), before - nrow(meta_local))
  }

  # ---- 3) Counts & alignment ----
  must(is.matrix(counts) || is.data.frame(counts), "counts must be matrix/data.frame (genes x samples).")
  counts_mat <- as.matrix(counts); storage.mode(counts_mat) <- "numeric"; counts_mat[!is.finite(counts_mat)] <- 0
  must(!is.null(rownames(counts_mat)), "counts must have rownames (gene IDs).")
  common_samples <- intersect(colnames(counts_mat), meta_local[[sample_col]])
  must(length(common_samples) > 0, "No overlap between counts colnames and metadata sample IDs.")
  counts_mat <- counts_mat[, common_samples, drop = FALSE]
  meta_local <- meta_local[match(common_samples, meta_local[[sample_col]]), , drop = FALSE]
  rownames(meta_local) <- meta_local[[sample_col]]
  say("[ALIGN] counts samples=%d; metadata samples=%d; common=%d",
      ncol(as.matrix(counts)), nrow(meta), length(common_samples))

  # ---- 4) Optional gene namespace harmonization ----
  if (!is.null(id_map)) {
    must(all(c(map_from_col, map_to_col) %in% colnames(id_map)),
         sprintf("id_map needs '%s' and '%s'.", map_from_col, map_to_col))
    m <- id_map[, c(map_from_col, map_to_col)]
    m <- m[!is.na(m[[map_to_col]]) & m[[map_to_col]] != "", , drop = FALSE]
    m <- m[m[[map_from_col]] %in% plot_genes, , drop = FALSE]
    say("[MAP] mapped %d/%d selected genes to counts namespace.", nrow(m), length(plot_genes))
    plot_genes <- unique(m[[map_to_col]])
  }
  if (gene_transform == "toupper") {
    rownames(counts_mat) <- toupper(rownames(counts_mat)); plot_genes <- toupper(plot_genes)
  } else if (gene_transform == "tolower") {
    rownames(counts_mat) <- tolower(rownames(counts_mat)); plot_genes <- tolower(plot_genes)
  }

  # ---- 5) CPM & subset genes ----
  plot_genes_ok <- intersect(rownames(counts_mat), plot_genes)
  must(length(plot_genes_ok) > 0, "None of the selected genes are in counts rownames.")
  say("[INTERSECT] genes in counts=%d; selected=%d; intersect=%d",
      nrow(counts_mat), length(plot_genes), length(plot_genes_ok))

  logcpm <- edgeR::cpm(counts_mat, log = TRUE, prior.count = 1)
  mat <- logcpm[plot_genes_ok, , drop = FALSE]
  good_rows <- rowSums(is.finite(mat)) == ncol(mat)
  good_cols <- colSums(is.finite(mat)) == nrow(mat)
  mat <- mat[good_rows, good_cols, drop = FALSE]
  must(nrow(mat) > 0 && ncol(mat) > 0, "Matrix empty after removing non-finite values.")

  # ---- 6) Annotations (factors) ----
  col_keep <- c(fraction_col)
  if (genotype_col %in% names(meta_local)) col_keep <- c(col_keep, genotype_col)
  if (sex_col %in% names(meta_local))      col_keep <- c(col_keep, sex_col)
  ann_col_full <- meta_local[colnames(mat), col_keep, drop = FALSE]
  ann_col_full <- as.data.frame(lapply(ann_col_full, \(v){ if(is.factor(v)) v <- as.character(v); factor(v) }),
                                stringsAsFactors = TRUE, check.names = FALSE)
  rownames(ann_col_full) <- colnames(mat)

  ann_row_full <- tibble::tibble(gene = rownames(mat)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      syn_up   = gene %in% syn$up,
      syn_down = gene %in% syn$down,
      nuc_up   = gene %in% nuc$up,
      nuc_down = gene %in% nuc$down
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(-gene, ~factor(.x, levels = c(FALSE, TRUE)))) %>%
    tibble::column_to_rownames("gene")
  ann_row_full <- as.data.frame(ann_row_full, stringsAsFactors = TRUE, check.names = FALSE)

  make_ann_colors <- function(ann_col) {
    ac <- list()
    if (fraction_col %in% colnames(ann_col)) {
      lv <- levels(ann_col[[fraction_col]]); ac[[fraction_col]] <- setNames(c("#F39C12","#3498DB")[seq_along(lv)], lv)
    }
    if (genotype_col %in% colnames(ann_col)) {
      lv <- levels(ann_col[[genotype_col]])
      ac[[genotype_col]] <- setNames(colorRampPalette(c("#2ecc71","#f1c40f","#e74c3c","#7f8c8d"))(length(lv)), lv)
    }
    if (sex_col %in% colnames(ann_col)) {
      lv <- levels(ann_col[[sex_col]]); base <- c(F = "#e84393", M = "#0984e3")
      ac[[sex_col]] <- setNames(base[intersect(names(base), lv)], intersect(names(base), lv))
    }
    ac$nuc_down   <- c(`FALSE` = "grey90", `TRUE` = "#e74c3c")
    ac$syn_down <- c(`FALSE` = "grey90", `TRUE` = "#c0392b")
    ac$nuc_up   <- c(`FALSE` = "grey90", `TRUE` = "#27ae60")
    ac$syn_up <- c(`FALSE` = "grey90", `TRUE` = "#1e8449")
    ac
  }

  scale_rows <- function(x) {
    m <- rowMeans(x, na.rm = TRUE)
    s <- matrixStats::rowSds(as.matrix(x), na.rm = TRUE)
    z <- sweep(x, 1, m, "-"); sweep(z, 1, ifelse(s == 0 | !is.finite(s), 1, s), "/")
  }
  mat_z_full <- scale_rows(mat)

  compute_breaks <- function(M) {
    rng <- range(M, na.rm = TRUE); if (rng[1] == rng[2]) { eps <- 1e-6; rng <- rng + c(-eps, eps) }
    n_col <- 256
    cols  <- colorRampPalette(c("#2c7bb6", "white", "#d7191c"))(n_col)
    brks  <- seq(rng[1], rng[2], length.out = n_col + 1)
    list(cols = cols, brks = brks)
  }

  build_heat <- function(M, ann_col, ann_row, main_title,
                         cluster_rows_auto = TRUE, cluster_cols_auto = TRUE) {
    cfg <- compute_breaks(M)
    pheatmap::pheatmap(
    matrix(as.numeric(M), nrow = nrow(M), dimnames = dimnames(M)),
    color = cfg$cols, breaks = cfg$brks,
    cluster_rows = if (cluster_rows_auto) nrow(M) > 2 else FALSE,
    cluster_cols = if (cluster_cols_auto) ncol(M) > 2 else FALSE,
    show_rownames = TRUE,
    show_colnames = TRUE,                    # <-- show sample names
    labels_col   = colnames(M),              # <-- be explicit (sample IDs)
    angle_col    = 90,                       # <-- vertical labels (fits better)
    fontsize = font_size, border_color = NA,
    annotation_col = ann_col,
    annotation_row = ann_row,
    annotation_colors = make_ann_colors(ann_col),
    main = main_title, scale = "none"
  )
  }

  ## --------- Build the three heatmaps ----------
  # Combined (all selected genes + all row flags)
  p_combined <- build_heat(mat_z_full, ann_col_full, ann_row_full, title_mode)

  # Helper: restrict to comparison genotypes + ordered columns (WT then other)
  restrict_cols <- function(M, ann_col) {
    if (!(genotype_col %in% colnames(ann_col))) return(list(M = M, ann = ann_col))
    g <- factor(ann_col[[genotype_col]], levels = comparison)  # enforce order
    keep <- !is.na(g)
    M2   <- M[, keep, drop = FALSE]
    ann2 <- droplevels(ann_col[keep, , drop = FALSE])
    ann2[[genotype_col]] <- factor(ann2[[genotype_col]], levels = comparison)
    ord <- order(ann2[[genotype_col]])  # WT first, then the other genotype
    list(M = M2[, ord, drop = FALSE], ann = ann2[ord, , drop = FALSE])
  }

  # Syn-only
  syn_rows <- unique(c(syn$up, syn$down))
  syn_rows <- intersect(rownames(mat_z_full), syn_rows)
  syn_cols <- which(ann_col_full[[fraction_col]] == "Syn")
  p_syn <- NULL
  if (length(syn_rows) > 0 && length(syn_cols) > 0) {
    M0  <- mat_z_full[syn_rows, syn_cols, drop = FALSE]
    ac0 <- ann_col_full[syn_cols, setdiff(colnames(ann_col_full), fraction_col), drop = FALSE]
    # order rows: up on top, down on bottom
    ar  <- ann_row_full[syn_rows, c("syn_up","syn_down"), drop = FALSE]
    rord <- c(which(ar[,"syn_up"] == TRUE), which(ar[,"syn_down"] == TRUE))
    if (length(rord)) { M0 <- M0[rord, , drop = FALSE]; ar <- ar[rord, , drop = FALSE] }
    # restrict to requested genotypes and order columns WT | other
    rc <- restrict_cols(M0, ac0); M <- rc$M; ac <- rc$ann
    p_syn <- build_heat(M, ac, ar, paste0(title_mode, " — Syn only"),
                        cluster_rows_auto = FALSE, cluster_cols_auto = FALSE)
  }

  # Nuc-only
  nuc_rows <- unique(c(nuc$up, nuc$down))
  nuc_rows <- intersect(rownames(mat_z_full), nuc_rows)
  nuc_cols <- which(ann_col_full[[fraction_col]] == "Nuc")
  p_nuc <- NULL
  if (length(nuc_rows) > 0 && length(nuc_cols) > 0) {
    M0  <- mat_z_full[nuc_rows, nuc_cols, drop = FALSE]
    ac0 <- ann_col_full[nuc_cols, setdiff(colnames(ann_col_full), fraction_col), drop = FALSE]
    ar  <- ann_row_full[nuc_rows, c("nuc_up","nuc_down"), drop = FALSE]
    rord <- c(which(ar[,"nuc_up"] == TRUE), which(ar[,"nuc_down"] == TRUE))
    if (length(rord)) { M0 <- M0[rord, , drop = FALSE]; ar <- ar[rord, , drop = FALSE] }
    rc <- restrict_cols(M0, ac0); M <- rc$M; ac <- rc$ann
    p_nuc <- build_heat(M, ac, ar, paste0(title_mode, " — Nuc only"),
                        cluster_rows_auto = FALSE, cluster_cols_auto = FALSE)
  }

  invisible(list(
    heatmap_combined = p_combined,
    heatmap_syn      = p_syn,
    heatmap_nuc      = p_nuc,
    mat_z            = mat_z_full,
    annotation_col   = ann_col_full,
    annotation_row   = ann_row_full,
    syn_up = syn$up, syn_down = syn$down,
    nuc_up = nuc$up, nuc_down = nuc$down,
    plot_genes = plot_genes
  ))
}
```

### Volcano plot Function

```{r}


volcano_plot_edger <- function(df, title = "") {
  # Grouping like your colleague’s logic
  grp <- ifelse(is.na(df$pvalue), "Non significant", "Non significant")
  grp <- ifelse(df$log2FoldChange > 0 & df$pvalue < 0.05, "PValue < 0.05 &\nlogFC > 0", grp)
  grp <- ifelse(df$log2FoldChange < 0 & df$pvalue < 0.05, "PValue < 0.05 &\nlogFC < 0", grp)
  grp <- ifelse(df$log2FoldChange > 0 & !is.na(df$padj) & df$padj < 0.05, "Padj < 0.05 &\nlogFC > 0", grp)
  grp <- ifelse(df$log2FoldChange < 0 & !is.na(df$padj) & df$padj < 0.05, "Padj < 0.05 &\nlogFC < 0", grp)

  plotDat <- df %>%
    mutate(
      Group = grp,
      gene_name = gene,
      log2FoldChange = pmax(pmin(log2FoldChange,  2), -2)  # cap at [-2, 2]
    )

  # Labels: top 20 by pvalue + top 10 by |log2FC|
  labels1 <- df %>% arrange(pvalue) %>% slice_head(n = 20) %>% pull(gene)
  labels2 <- df %>% arrange(desc(abs(log2FoldChange))) %>% slice_head(n = 10) %>% pull(gene)
  labels  <- unique(c(labels1, labels2))

  p <- ggplot(plotDat, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = -log10(pvalue), fill = Group, color = Group)) +
    geom_point(aes(text = gene_name), size = 1, pch = 21, alpha = 0.7, stroke = 0.5) +
    theme_light() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(
      "Non significant"              = "grey30",
      "PValue < 0.05 &\nlogFC > 0"   = "#eb5e60",
      "PValue < 0.05 &\nlogFC < 0"   = "#62a0ca",
      "Padj < 0.05 &\nlogFC > 0"     = "#960304",
      "Padj < 0.05 &\nlogFC < 0"     = "#01538a"
    )) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(
      "Non significant"              = "grey30",
      "PValue < 0.05 &\nlogFC > 0"   = "#eb5e60",
      "PValue < 0.05 &\nlogFC < 0"   = "#62a0ca",
      "Padj < 0.05 &\nlogFC > 0"     = "#960304",
      "Padj < 0.05 &\nlogFC < 0"     = "#01538a"
    )) +
    labs(title = title, y = "-log10(PValue)", x = "log2FC") +
    theme(
      plot.title   = element_text(size = rel(2), hjust = 0.5),
      legend.text  = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      axis.text    = element_text(size = 14),
      axis.title   = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-2.2, 2.2)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = 2) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(-2, -1, 0, 1, 2), labels = c("<-2","-1","0","1",">2"))

  # Label points using ggrepel (closest to your LabelPoints behavior)
  lab_df <- plotDat %>% filter(gene_name %in% labels)
  if (nrow(lab_df) > 0) {
    p <- p + geom_text_repel(
      data = lab_df,
      aes(label = gene_name),
      size = 5, color = "black",
      max.overlaps = Inf,
      box.padding = 0.25,
      min.segment.length = 0
    )
  }
  p
}
```

# 3. Const syn/nuc/cyt QC



## 3.1 Get syn/nuc counts and metadata
```{r}


## Read count data and keep original column names 
data_syn_nuc <- read.table("count_data/Chd8_P60_syn_nuc.txt", header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE)

## Identify count columns (everything after the 6 annotation cols)
annot_cols  <- 1:6
sample_cols <- setdiff(seq_len(ncol(data_syn_nuc)), annot_cols)

## Clean sample column names to match metadata$Sample
cn <- colnames(data_syn_nuc)[sample_cols]
cn <- sub("^X\\.", "", cn)               # drop R's "X." if present
cn <- sub("^.*/", "", cn)                # drop any path prefix up to last '/'
cn <- sub("\\.bam$", "", cn)             # drop trailing ".bam" if present
cn <- sub("^P60_", "", cn)               # drop leading "P60_" if present
colnames(data_syn_nuc)[sample_cols] <- cn

## Read metadata and alignment stats
metadata_syn_nuc <- read.csv("metadata/metadata_complete_KC.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
aln      <- read.csv("STAR_alignment_stats.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

## Standardize metadata column name and merge with alignment stats
colnames(metadata_syn_nuc)[1] <- "Sample"
metadata_syn_nuc <- merge(metadata_syn_nuc, aln)
metadata_syn_nuc$Sample <- sub("^P60_", "", metadata_syn_nuc$Sample)

## (Optional) sanity check: the merge should have removed non-existent samples
all(metadata_syn_nuc$Sample == colnames(data_syn_nuc)[7:52])

## Reorder count matrix to metadata$Sample order
# First ensure all metadata samples exist in the count table after cleaning
stopifnot(all(metadata_syn_nuc$Sample %in% colnames(data_syn_nuc)[sample_cols]))

data_syn_nuc <- cbind(
  data_syn_nuc[, annot_cols],
  data_syn_nuc[, metadata_syn_nuc$Sample, drop = FALSE]   # select and order by metadata$Sample
)

## Add a few metadata-derived columns
metadata_syn_nuc$Fraction <- ifelse(grepl("Syn", metadata_syn_nuc$Sample), "Syn", "Nuc")
sample_num <- gsub("P60_", "", metadata_syn_nuc$Sample)
sample_num <- gsub("_Syn|_Nuc", "", sample_num)
sample_num <- gsub("F|M", "", sample_num)
metadata_syn_nuc$sample_num <- sample_num

# Factorize
metadata_syn_nuc$Genotype <- factor(metadata_syn_nuc$Genotype, levels = c("WT", "HET"))
metadata_syn_nuc$Fraction <- factor(metadata_syn_nuc$Fraction, levels = c("Nuc", "Syn"))
metadata_syn_nuc$Sex <- factor(metadata_syn_nuc$Sex, levels = c("M", "F"))

## ----------------------------
## KEEP ENS IDs FOR COUNTS/QC/PCA/DE:
## Build expression matrix at Geneid-level (no ENS->symbol mapping, no rowsum by symbol)
## ----------------------------
count_mat <- as.matrix(data_syn_nuc[, metadata_syn_nuc$Sample, drop = FALSE])
rownames(count_mat) <- as.character(data_syn_nuc$Geneid)

# (optional safety) collapse duplicate Geneid rows if any
if (any(duplicated(rownames(count_mat)))) {
  count_mat <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(seq_len(nrow(count_mat)), rownames(count_mat)),
                                     function(ii) colMeans(count_mat[ii, , drop = FALSE])))
}

exp_data_syn_nuc <- as.data.frame(count_mat)

## Quick sanity checks
stopifnot(all(colnames(exp_data_syn_nuc) == metadata_syn_nuc$Sample))   # columns match metadata order
stopifnot(!any(duplicated(rownames(exp_data_syn_nuc))))                # Geneid are unique now
```

## 3.2 Get cyt counts and metadata; merge with syn/nuc
```{r}


## CYT COUNTS

## Read count data and keep original column names
data_cyt <- read.table("count_data/Chd8_P60_cytosolic_counts_merged.txt",
                       header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE)

## Identify count columns (everything after the Geneid column here)
annot_cols_cyt  <- 1
sample_cols_cyt <- setdiff(seq_len(ncol(data_cyt)), annot_cols_cyt)

## CYT STAR_ALIGNMENT_STATS

## Make STAR_alignment_stats_cyt.csv from STAR Log.final.out files (cyt)

# folder containing files like: P60_432_C.Log.final.out
star_dir <- "STAR_alignment_outs"   # <- change if needed

log_files <- list.files(
  star_dir,
  pattern = "^P60_.*\\.Log\\.final\\.out$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

stopifnot(length(log_files) > 0)

parse_star_log_final_file <- function(fp) {
  x <- readLines(fp, warn = FALSE)

  # STAR lines look like: "Number of input reads | 12345"
  parts <- str_split_fixed(x, "\\s+\\|\\s+", 2)
  key <- str_trim(parts[, 1])
  val <- str_trim(parts[, 2])

  keep <- nzchar(key) & nzchar(val)
  key <- key[keep]
  val <- val[keep]
  m <- setNames(val, key)

  get_num <- function(k) {
    if (!k %in% names(m)) return(NA_real_)
    v <- m[[k]]
    v <- gsub("%", "", v)
    v <- gsub(",", "", v)
    suppressWarnings(as.numeric(v))
  }

  # filename -> sample
  # "P60_432_C.Log.final.out" -> "P60_432_C"
  fn <- basename(fp)
  sample <- sub("\\.Log\\.final\\.out$", "", fn)
  sample <- sub("\\.$", "", sample)                
  sample <- sub("\\.Log$", "", sample)             
  sample <- sub("\\.final\\.out$", "", sample)      
  sample <- sub("\\.Log\\.final\\.out$", "", fn)

  tibble(
    Sample = sample,
    Number.of.input.reads = get_num("Number of input reads"),
    Uniquely.mapped.reads.number = get_num("Uniquely mapped reads number"),
    Uniquely.mapped.reads.. = get_num("Uniquely mapped reads %"),   # percent (0-100)
    Number.of.splices..Total = get_num("Number of splices: Total"),
    Splicing.rate = Number.of.splices..Total / Uniquely.mapped.reads.number
  )
}

aln_cyt <- bind_rows(lapply(log_files, parse_star_log_final_file)) %>%
  mutate(
    # match your existing aln style if you want fraction instead of percent:
    Uniquely.mapped.reads.. = Uniquely.mapped.reads.. / 100
  )

write.csv(aln_cyt, "STAR_alignment_stats_cyt.csv", row.names = FALSE)

## CYT METADATA

metadata_cyt <- read.csv("metadata/metadata_cyt_corrected.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
aln_cyt      <- read.csv("STAR_alignment_stats_cyt.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Standardize sample column name
if ("Sample.ID" %in% colnames(metadata_cyt)) {
  colnames(metadata_cyt)[colnames(metadata_cyt) == "Sample.ID"] <- "Sample"
} else if ("sample" %in% colnames(metadata_cyt)) {
  colnames(metadata_cyt)[colnames(metadata_cyt) == "sample"] <- "Sample"
}

# Clean Sample IDs (strip R's X. prefix if it happened)
metadata_cyt$Sample <- sub("^X\\.", "", metadata_cyt$Sample)
aln_cyt$Sample      <- sub("^X\\.", "", aln_cyt$Sample)

stopifnot(all(c("Sample","Sex") %in% colnames(metadata_cyt)))

# Spreadsheet/original ID is now like "432_Cyt" or "M6_Cyt"
metadata_cyt$Sample_orig <- metadata_cyt$Sample

# Normalize Sex to single-letter M/F (in case spreadsheet has Male/Female)
metadata_cyt$Sex <- toupper(as.character(metadata_cyt$Sex))
metadata_cyt$Sex <- ifelse(metadata_cyt$Sex %in% c("MALE","M"), "M",
                      ifelse(metadata_cyt$Sex %in% c("FEMALE","F"), "F", metadata_cyt$Sex))
stopifnot(all(metadata_cyt$Sex %in% c("M","F")))

# Extract ID prefix from Sample_orig: "432_Cyt" -> "432"; "M6_Cyt" -> "M6"
metadata_cyt$sample_id <- sub("_Cyt$", "", metadata_cyt$Sample_orig, ignore.case = TRUE)
stopifnot(!any(is.na(metadata_cyt$sample_id)) & nzchar(metadata_cyt$sample_id))

# Build final Sample name: "432M_Cyt" / "M6F_Cyt"
metadata_cyt$Sample <- paste0(metadata_cyt$sample_id, metadata_cyt$Sex, "_Cyt")

## ----------------------------
## Make STAR stats have same key as Sample_orig
## ----------------------------
aln_cyt$Sample_key <- aln_cyt$Sample
aln_cyt$Sample_key <- sub("^P60_", "", aln_cyt$Sample_key, ignore.case = TRUE)
aln_cyt$Sample_key <- sub("_C$", "_Cyt", aln_cyt$Sample_key, ignore.case = TRUE)
aln_cyt$Sample_key <- sub("^X\\.", "", aln_cyt$Sample_key)

# Merge STAR stats using the spreadsheet-style key (preserves M6 vs 6)
aln_cyt2 <- aln_cyt[, setdiff(colnames(aln_cyt), "Sample"), drop = FALSE]
metadata_cyt <- merge(
  metadata_cyt,
  aln_cyt2,
  by.x  = "Sample_orig",
  by.y  = "Sample_key",
  all.x = TRUE
)

## ----------------------------
## Rename cyt count columns to match metadata Sample
## ----------------------------
annot_cols_cyt  <- 1
sample_cols_cyt <- setdiff(seq_len(ncol(data_cyt)), annot_cols_cyt)

cyt_cn_raw <- colnames(data_cyt)[sample_cols_cyt]
cyt_cn <- basename(cyt_cn_raw)
cyt_cn <- sub("^X\\.", "", cyt_cn)
cyt_cn <- sub("\\.bam$", "", cyt_cn, ignore.case = TRUE)
cyt_cn <- sub("\\.sorted.*$", "", cyt_cn, ignore.case = TRUE)

cyt_key <- cyt_cn
cyt_key <- sub("^P60_", "", cyt_key, ignore.case = TRUE)
cyt_key <- sub("_C$", "_Cyt", cyt_key, ignore.case = TRUE)

name_map <- setNames(metadata_cyt$Sample, metadata_cyt$Sample_orig)

new_cn <- ifelse(cyt_key %in% names(name_map), unname(name_map[cyt_key]), cyt_cn_raw)
colnames(data_cyt)[sample_cols_cyt] <- new_cn

missing <- setdiff(metadata_cyt$Sample, colnames(data_cyt)[sample_cols_cyt])
stopifnot(length(missing) == 0)

data_cyt <- data_cyt[, c(annot_cols_cyt, match(metadata_cyt$Sample, colnames(data_cyt))), drop = FALSE]

## ----------------------------
## KEEP ENS IDs FOR COUNTS/QC/PCA/DE:
## Build cyt expression matrix at Geneid-level (no ENS->symbol mapping, no rowsum by symbol)
## ----------------------------
count_mat <- as.matrix(data_cyt[, metadata_cyt$Sample, drop = FALSE])
rownames(count_mat) <- as.character(data_cyt$Geneid)

# (optional safety) collapse duplicate Geneid rows if any
if (any(duplicated(rownames(count_mat)))) {
  count_mat <- rowsum(count_mat, group = rownames(count_mat))
}

exp_data_cyt <- as.data.frame(count_mat)

# Fraction + sample_num consistent with syn/nuc (numeric part if present)
metadata_cyt$Fraction <- "Cyt"
metadata_cyt$sample_num <- sub("^([0-9]+).*", "\\1", metadata_cyt$sample_id)

# Factors
metadata_cyt$Genotype <- factor(metadata_cyt$Genotype, levels = c("WT", "HET"))
metadata_cyt$Fraction <- factor(metadata_cyt$Fraction, levels = c("Nuc", "Syn", "Cyt"))
metadata_cyt$Sex      <- factor(metadata_cyt$Sex, levels = c("M", "F"))

metadata_cyt$Sample_orig <- NULL

## Merge syn/nuc metadata with cyt metadata (keep all rows/columns)
metadata_syn_nuc$Fraction <- factor(as.character(metadata_syn_nuc$Fraction), levels = c("Nuc", "Syn", "Cyt"))
metadata_const_syn_nuc_cyt <- dplyr::bind_rows(metadata_syn_nuc, metadata_cyt)

## CLEAN metadata_const_syn_nuc_cyt
cols_to_drop <- c("Dissection.date", "Prep.Date", "Extraction.date",
                  "Concentration", "NOVOGEN.QC", "Comments", "Sample_orig")

metadata_const_syn_nuc_cyt <- metadata_const_syn_nuc_cyt %>%
  dplyr::select(
    -any_of(cols_to_drop),
    -dplyr::starts_with("X")
  )

metadata_const_syn_nuc_cyt$Sequencing_batch[metadata_const_syn_nuc_cyt$Fraction == "Cyt"] <- 3

## MERGING COUNTS (keep Geneid as row key; no symbol collapsing)
data_syn_nuc$Geneid <- as.character(data_syn_nuc$Geneid)
data_cyt$Geneid     <- as.character(data_cyt$Geneid)

syn_annot_names <- colnames(data_syn_nuc)[annot_cols]
cyt_annot_names <- colnames(data_cyt)[annot_cols_cyt]

syn_sample_cols <- intersect(metadata_const_syn_nuc_cyt$Sample, colnames(data_syn_nuc))
cyt_sample_cols <- intersect(metadata_cyt$Sample, colnames(data_cyt))

stopifnot(length(syn_sample_cols) == nrow(metadata_syn_nuc))
stopifnot(length(cyt_sample_cols) == nrow(metadata_cyt))

combined_counts <- merge(
  data_syn_nuc[, c(syn_annot_names, syn_sample_cols), drop = FALSE],
  data_cyt[, c(cyt_annot_names, cyt_sample_cols), drop = FALSE],
  by = "Geneid",
  all = TRUE
)

all_sample_cols <- metadata_const_syn_nuc_cyt$Sample
stopifnot(all(all_sample_cols %in% colnames(combined_counts)))

combined_counts <- combined_counts[, c(colnames(data_syn_nuc)[annot_cols], all_sample_cols), drop = FALSE]

## Build combined expression matrix at Geneid-level
count_mat_all <- as.matrix(combined_counts[, all_sample_cols, drop = FALSE])
rownames(count_mat_all) <- as.character(combined_counts$Geneid)

# (optional safety) collapse duplicate Geneid rows if any (AVERAGE, not sum)
if (any(duplicated(rownames(count_mat_all)))) {
  count_mat_all <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(seq_len(nrow(count_mat_all)), rownames(count_mat_all)),
                                        function(ii) colMeans(count_mat_all[ii, , drop = FALSE])))
}

exp_data_const_syn_nuc_cyt <- as.data.frame(count_mat_all)

## Quick sanity checks
stopifnot(all(colnames(exp_data_const_syn_nuc_cyt) == metadata_const_syn_nuc_cyt$Sample))
stopifnot(!any(duplicated(rownames(exp_data_const_syn_nuc_cyt))))
```

## 3.3 Get RPKM data
```{r}

# -------------------------
# 0) sample order = YOUR metadata order (keep Cyt)
# -------------------------
all_samples <- as.character(metadata_const_syn_nuc_cyt$Sample)
all_samples <- sub("^P60_", "", all_samples)  # harmless if already stripped

stopifnot(all(all_samples %in% colnames(combined_counts)))
stopifnot(all(c("Geneid","Length") %in% colnames(combined_counts)))

# -------------------------
# 1) Geneid-level exp matrix (NO symbol collapsing here)
#    use the raw combined table that still has Length
# -------------------------
exp_data_id <- combined_counts
rownames(exp_data_id) <- as.character(exp_data_id$Geneid)
exp_data_id <- exp_data_id[, all_samples, drop = FALSE]

# collapse duplicate Geneid rows if any (safe)
if (any(duplicated(rownames(exp_data_id)))) {
  exp_data_id <- rowsum(as.matrix(exp_data_id), group = rownames(exp_data_id))
}

# -------------------------
# 2) Geneid-level length vector aligned to Geneids
#    IMPORTANT: if duplicate Geneids exist, keep ONE length per Geneid (max)
# -------------------------
gene_lengths_id <- as.numeric(combined_counts$Length)
names(gene_lengths_id) <- as.character(combined_counts$Geneid)

if (any(duplicated(names(gene_lengths_id)))) {
  gene_lengths_id <- tapply(gene_lengths_id,
                            names(gene_lengths_id),
                            max)
}

# HARD ALIGN lengths to exp matrix rows
gene_lengths_id <- gene_lengths_id[rownames(exp_data_id)]

# drop any invalid lengths + keep matrices aligned
ok_len <- !is.na(gene_lengths_id) & gene_lengths_id > 0
exp_data_id <- exp_data_id[ok_len, , drop = FALSE]
gene_lengths_id <- gene_lengths_id[ok_len]

stopifnot(identical(rownames(exp_data_id), names(gene_lengths_id)))

# -------------------------
# 3) RPKM on Geneid-level 
# -------------------------
rpkm_id_log2   <- edgeR::rpkm(exp_data_id,
                             gene.length = gene_lengths_id,
                             log = TRUE)   # prior.count=2 default

rpkm_id_linear <- edgeR::rpkm(exp_data_id,
                             gene.length = gene_lengths_id,
                             log = FALSE)

# -------------------------
# 4) Rename RPKM rows to symbols (do NOT collapse RPKM)
# -------------------------
map <- my_gene[, c("gene_id","gene_name")]
map <- map[!duplicated(map$gene_id), , drop = FALSE]   # safety
rownames(map) <- map$gene_id

sym_rpkm <- map[rownames(rpkm_id_log2), "gene_name"]
sym_rpkm[is.na(sym_rpkm) | sym_rpkm == ""] <- rownames(rpkm_id_log2)[is.na(sym_rpkm) | sym_rpkm == ""]

rpkm_symbol_log2_precollapse_all   <- rpkm_id_log2
rpkm_symbol_linear_precollapse_all <- rpkm_id_linear
rownames(rpkm_symbol_log2_precollapse_all)   <- sym_rpkm
rownames(rpkm_symbol_linear_precollapse_all) <- sym_rpkm

# -------------------------
# 6) Quick spot check (gene names)
# -------------------------
genes_to_check <- c("Chd8", "Usp11", "Crlf2", "Abca8a")
print(rpkm_symbol_log2_precollapse_all[genes_to_check, , drop = FALSE])
print(rpkm_symbol_linear_precollapse_all[genes_to_check, , drop = FALSE])

# -------------------------
# SAVE FINAL RPKM WITH ENS ROW NAMES
# -------------------------
rpkm_data_const_syn_nuc_cyt <- rpkm_id_log2
rpkm_data_linear_const_syn_nuc_cyt <- rpkm_id_linear

write.csv(rpkm_data_const_syn_nuc_cyt, "count_data/rpkm_data_log2_const_syn_nuc_cyt.csv", quote = FALSE)
write.csv(rpkm_data_linear_const_syn_nuc_cyt, "count_data/rpkm_data_linear_const_syn_nuc_cyt.csv", quote = FALSE)
```

## 3.4 Spliced:all mapped reads

Parsing STAR log.final outs for spliced:all mapped reads and getting qc summary

```{r}

# ---- Sanity checks ----
stopifnot(all(c("Sample","Fraction","Genotype","Sex","Splicing.rate") %in% colnames(metadata_const_syn_nuc_cyt)))

# check metadata samples exist in counts matrix
not_in_counts <- setdiff(metadata_const_syn_nuc_cyt$Sample, colnames(exp_data_const_syn_nuc_cyt))

  message("Metadata samples not in exp_data_const_syn_nuc_cyt: ", paste(not_in_counts, collapse = ", "))
}

qc_summary <- metadata_const_syn_nuc_cyt %>%
  dplyr::filter(as.character(Outlier) != "TRUE")

# Plots ------------------------------------------------------------

# 1) Histogram of spliced:all (percent)
qc_summary <- qc_summary %>%
  mutate(
    Spliced_pct = 100 * Splicing.rate,
    Fraction = factor(as.character(Fraction), levels = c("Nuc", "Cyt", "Syn"))
  )

fraction_cols <- c(
  "Nuc" = "#619CFF",
  "Cyt" = "#00BA38",
  "Syn" = "#F8766D"
)

ggplot(qc_summary, aes(x = Spliced_pct, fill = Fraction)) +
  geom_histogram(position = "identity", alpha = 0.5, binwidth = 5, boundary = 0) +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = fraction_cols) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(40, 85),
    breaks = seq(40, 85, by = 5)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of spliced:all uniquely mapped (%)",
    x = "Spliced reads [%]",
    y = "Count"
  )

# 2) Per-sample spliced:all (percent), faceted by Fraction
point_size <- 1.6

# heuristic thresholds (edit/remove as desired)
thr_df <- data.frame(
  Fraction = c("Syn","Nuc","Cyt"),
  thr      = c(70,   60,   60)   # <- adjust as desired
)

qc_plot_spliced <- ggplot(qc_summary,
                          aes(x = Sample, y = Spliced_pct,
                              color = Genotype, shape = Sex)) +
  geom_point(size = point_size) +
  geom_hline(data = thr_df, aes(yintercept = thr), linetype = 2, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  facet_grid(~ Fraction, scales = "free_x") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(title = "Spliced reads (spliced / uniquely mapped)",
       y = "Spliced reads [%]", x = "") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
```

```{r}
# identify gene sets

# rRNA genes using gene_biotype from my_gene (match by ENS gene_id / rownames)
rrna_ids <- my_gene$gene_id[my_gene$gene_biotype %in% "rRNA"]
ribo_idx <- which(rownames(exp_data_const_syn_nuc_cyt) %in% rrna_ids)

# compute totals (CPM)
mt_CPM_vec <- if (length(mt_idx)) {
  colSums(cpm_mat[mt_idx, , drop = FALSE])
} else rep(NA_real_, ncol(cpm_mat))

ribo_CPM_vec <- if (length(ribo_idx)) {
  colSums(cpm_mat[ribo_idx, , drop = FALSE])
} else rep(NA_real_, ncol(cpm_mat))

# library CPM totals (~1e6 each)
lib_cpm_tot <- colSums(cpm_mat)
names(lib_cpm_tot) <- samples

# build QC frame
qc_mt_ribo <- meta_c %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    mt_CPM   = mt_CPM_vec,
    ribo_CPM = ribo_CPM_vec
  ) %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    Sample, Fraction, Genotype, Sex,
    mt_CPM, ribo_CPM,
    mt_pct   = 100 * mt_CPM   / lib_cpm_tot[Sample],
    ribo_pct = 100 * ribo_CPM / lib_cpm_tot[Sample]
  )

# long format
long_pct <- qc_mt_ribo %>%
  dplyr::select(Sample, Fraction, Genotype, Sex, mt_pct, ribo_pct) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(c(mt_pct, ribo_pct), names_to = "metric", values_to = "pct") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(metric = dplyr::recode(metric, mt_pct = "Mito (%)", ribo_pct = "Ribo (%)"))

# 10% cutoff for both + labels
thr_tbl  <- data.frame(metric = c("Mito (%)", "Ribo (%)"), thr = 10)
label_df <- long_pct %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(thr_tbl, by = "metric") %>%
  dplyr::filter(is.finite(pct) & pct > thr)

# ---- toggle: label all samples or only those above threshold ----
label_all <- FALSE
label_df_plot <- if (label_all) long_pct else label_df

ggplot(long_pct, aes(x = Fraction, y = pct, fill = Fraction)) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_jitter(aes(shape = Genotype), width = 0.12, size = 1.6, alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_hline(data = thr_tbl, aes(yintercept = thr), linetype = 2, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = label_df_plot,
    aes(label = Sample),
    size = 3, nudge_y = 1.5, segment.color = "grey50", max.overlaps = Inf
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ metric, scales = "free_y", nrow = 1) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(title = "Percent mito and ribo (Const syn/nuc/cyt)",
       x = "", y = "Percent of total CPM")


# Add mt/ribo metrics back onto metadata by Sample
cols_to_add <- c("mt_CPM","ribo_CPM","mt_pct","ribo_pct")

metadata_const_syn_nuc_cyt <- metadata_const_syn_nuc_cyt %>%
  dplyr::select(-dplyr::any_of(cols_to_add)) %>%   # drop if present
  dplyr::left_join(
    qc_mt_ribo %>% dplyr::select(Sample, dplyr::all_of(cols_to_add)),
    by = "Sample"
  )

# sanity check: should be TRUE
stopifnot(all(cols_to_add %in% colnames(metadata_const_syn_nuc_cyt)))



```


## 3.8 Check Xist and Eif2s3y CPM

```{r}


## Compute CPMs for Xist and Eif2s3y (const syn/nuc/cyt)

# exp_data_const_syn_nuc_cyt: genes x samples raw counts
# metadata_const_syn_nuc_cyt: sample-level meta with Sample/Fraction/Genotype/Sex

# CPM on NA-safe counts
dge_const <- edgeR::DGEList(counts = replace(as.matrix(exp_data_const_syn_nuc_cyt),
                                            is.na(exp_data_const_syn_nuc_cyt), 0))
cpm_all <- edgeR::cpm(dge_const, log = FALSE)

# symbol-name vector for matching (NO collapsing)
map <- my_gene[, c("gene_id","gene_name")]
map <- map[!duplicated(map$gene_id), , drop = FALSE]
rownames(map) <- map$gene_id
rn_sym <- map[rownames(exp_data_const_syn_nuc_cyt), "gene_name"]
rn_sym[is.na(rn_sym) | rn_sym == ""] <- rownames(exp_data_const_syn_nuc_cyt)[is.na(rn_sym) | rn_sym == ""]

pick_gene_cpm <- function(symbol, rn_sym, mat) {
  hits <- grep(paste0("^", symbol, "$"), rn_sym, ignore.case = TRUE)
  if (length(hits) == 0) return(rep(NA_real_, ncol(mat)))
  if (length(hits) == 1) return(as.numeric(mat[hits, , drop = FALSE]))
  colMeans(mat[hits, , drop = FALSE])  # multiple rows -> AVERAGE CPM (not sum)
}

xist_cpm    <- pick_gene_cpm("Xist",    rn_sym, cpm_all)
eif2s3y_cpm <- pick_gene_cpm("Eif2s3y", rn_sym, cpm_all)
uty_cpm     <- pick_gene_cpm("Uty",     rn_sym, cpm_all)

# Align metadata to count columns and attach CPMs
samples <- colnames(exp_data_const_syn_nuc_cyt)
meta_c  <- metadata_const_syn_nuc_cyt[match(samples, metadata_const_syn_nuc_cyt$Sample), , drop = FALSE]
stopifnot(identical(meta_c$Sample, samples))

meta_c$Xist_CPM    <- xist_cpm
meta_c$Eif2s3y_CPM <- eif2s3y_cpm
meta_c$Uty_CPM     <- uty_cpm

## Plots (facet by Fraction)

  geom_point(size = 2) +
  theme_bw() +
  facet_grid(~ Fraction, scales = "free_x") +
  labs(title = "Xist (CPM) — Const syn/nuc/cyt", x = "", y = "CPM") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

p_eif2s3y <- ggplot(meta_c, aes(x = Sample, y = Eif2s3y_CPM, color = Genotype, shape = Sex)) +

  theme_bw() +
  facet_grid(~ Fraction, scales = "free_x") +
  labs(title = "Eif2s3y (CPM) — Const syn/nuc/cyt", x = "", y = "CPM") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

p_uty <- ggplot(meta_c, aes(x = Sample, y = Uty_CPM, color = Genotype, shape = Sex)) +
```
