## 3.10 PCA

#### Const all

```{r}

# 0) Filter metadata to non-outliers and subset counts to match
metadata_const_syn_nuc_cyt_filt <- metadata_const_syn_nuc_cyt %>%
  dplyr::filter(Outlier == FALSE)

exp_data_const_syn_nuc_cyt_filt <- exp_data_const_syn_nuc_cyt[,
  metadata_const_syn_nuc_cyt_filt$Sample,
  drop = FALSE
]

# Ensure sample order is consistent
stopifnot(identical(
  colnames(exp_data_const_syn_nuc_cyt_filt),
  metadata_const_syn_nuc_cyt_filt$Sample
))

# 1) Build a combined DGEList for filtered samples and normalize (TMM)
y <- DGEList(
  counts  = replace(as.matrix(exp_data_const_syn_nuc_cyt_filt),
                    is.na(exp_data_const_syn_nuc_cyt_filt), 0),
  samples = metadata_const_syn_nuc_cyt_filt
)
y <- calcNormFactors(y)

# 2) Filter genes: CPM > 1 in at least 4 samples
keep <- rowSums(edgeR::cpm(y) > 1) >= 4
y <- y[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]

# 3) LogCPM matrix
logCPM <- edgeR::cpm(y, log = TRUE, prior.count = 2)

# 4) PCA on samples using all kept genes
pca_all <- prcomp(t(logCPM), center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)

# 5) Build plotting DF (rows = samples), align filtered metadata
samps  <- rownames(pca_all$x)
meta_p <- metadata_const_syn_nuc_cyt_filt[match(samps, metadata_const_syn_nuc_cyt_filt$Sample), , drop = FALSE]
stopifnot(identical(meta_p$Sample, samps))

pca_df <- cbind(meta_p, as.data.frame(pca_all$x))

# 6) Plot helpers
PCA_plot <- function(PCx, PCy, variable){
  ggplot(pca_df, aes(x = .data[[PCx]], y = .data[[PCy]],
                     color = .data[[variable]])) +
    geom_point(size = 1.5, alpha = 0.7) +
    #geom_text_repel(aes(label = Sample), size = 2.5, max.overlaps = 50) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(title = variable, x = PCx, y = PCy) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = rel(1.2), hjust = 0.5),
          legend.position = "bottom",
          legend.title = element_blank()) +
    guides(color = guide_legend(nrow = 1, byrow = TRUE))
}

PCA_panel <- function(x, y){
  plot_grid(
    PCA_plot(x, y, "Genotype"),
    PCA_plot(x, y, "Fraction"),
    PCA_plot(x, y, "Sex"),
    nrow = 1
  )
}

# 7) Individual PCA plots
PCA_plot("PC1", "PC2", "Fraction")  
PCA_plot("PC1", "PC2", "Sex")       
PCA_plot("PC1", "PC2", "Genotype")  

PCA_plot("PC3", "PC4", "Fraction")  
PCA_plot("PC3", "PC4", "Sex")       
PCA_plot("PC3", "PC4", "Genotype")

PCA_plot("PC5", "PC6", "Fraction")
PCA_plot("PC5", "PC6", "Sex")     
PCA_plot("PC5", "PC6", "Genotype")
```

##### MDS plot

```{r}


# --------------------------
# Const Syn/Nuc: MDS
# Inputs assumed in env:
#   exp_data_const_syn_nuc_cyt   (genes x samples raw counts)
#   metadata_const_syn_nuc_cyt   (sample meta; includes Sample, Genotype, Sex, Fraction, Sequencing_batch)
# --------------------------

# --------------------------
# 0) Build filtered meta for Const Syn/Nuc
# --------------------------
const_syn_nuc_meta <- metadata_const_syn_nuc_cyt %>%
  dplyr::filter(Fraction %in% c("Syn", "Nuc")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Outlier == FALSE) %>%  
  droplevels()

use.cols <- const_syn_nuc_meta$Sample
stopifnot(all(use.cols %in% colnames(exp_data_const_syn_nuc_cyt)))

counts_syn_nuc <- exp_data_const_syn_nuc_cyt[, use.cols, drop = FALSE]

# enforce identical order
const_syn_nuc_meta <- const_syn_nuc_meta[match(colnames(counts_syn_nuc), const_syn_nuc_meta$Sample), , drop = FALSE]
stopifnot(identical(colnames(counts_syn_nuc), const_syn_nuc_meta$Sample))

# --------------------------
# 1) DGEList + TMM
# --------------------------
y <- DGEList(
  counts  = replace(as.matrix(counts_syn_nuc), is.na(counts_syn_nuc), 0),
  samples = const_syn_nuc_meta
)
y <- calcNormFactors(y)

# --------------------------
# 2) Filter genes: CPM > 1 in at least 4 samples
# --------------------------
keep <- rowSums(edgeR::cpm(y) > 1) >= 4
y <- y[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]

# --------------------------
# 3) logCPM + MDS
# --------------------------
logCPM <- edgeR::cpm(y, log = TRUE, prior.count = 2)

mds <- plotMDS(logCPM, plot = FALSE)

df_mds <- data.frame(
  Sample = colnames(logCPM),
  dim1   = mds$x,
  dim2   = mds$y,
  const_syn_nuc_meta[match(colnames(logCPM), const_syn_nuc_meta$Sample), , drop = FALSE]
)
stopifnot(identical(df_mds$Sample, colnames(logCPM)))

# --------------------------
# 4) Factors (optional)
# --------------------------
df_mds$Genotype         <- factor(df_mds$Genotype, levels = c("HET", "WT"))
df_mds$Sex              <- factor(df_mds$Sex, levels = c("F", "M"))
df_mds$Fraction         <- factor(df_mds$Fraction, levels = c("Syn", "Nuc"))
df_mds$Sequencing_batch <- factor(df_mds$Sequencing_batch)

# pick which sequencing batch gets the extra black ring
batch_outline <- levels(df_mds$Sequencing_batch)[1]  # or set explicitly: "CHD80456"

# --------------------------
# 5) Plot: fill=Genotype, shape=Sex, outline=Sequencing_batch, label=Fraction
# --------------------------
p_mds_const_syn_nuc <- ggplot(df_mds, aes(dim1, dim2)) +
  geom_point(
    aes(fill = Genotype, shape = Sex),
    size = 3.6, color = "black", stroke = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = subset(df_mds, Sequencing_batch == batch_outline),
    aes(shape = Sex),
    size = 3.6, fill = NA, color = "black", stroke = 1.6
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = Fraction),
    size = 3,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    box.padding = 0.25,
    point.padding = 0.25,
    seed = 1
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("HET" = "#8494FF", "WT" = "#ABA300")) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("F" = 21, "M" = 22)) +
  labs(
    title = "Const Syn/Nuc MDS",
    x = "dim1",
    y = "dim2",
    fill = "Gen",
    shape = "Sex"
  ) +
  theme_bw()

p_mds_const_syn_nuc
```

```{r}

# 0) Subset to syn fraction and keep order consistent
meta_syn <- metadata_const_syn_nuc_cyt %>%
  dplyr::filter(Fraction == "Syn") %>%
  dplyr::filter(Outlier == "FALSE") %>%
  droplevels()


meta_syn$Sequencing_batch <- factor(meta_syn$Sequencing_batch)

use.cols <- meta_syn$Sample
stopifnot(all(use.cols %in% colnames(exp_data_const_syn_nuc_cyt)))
counts_syn <- exp_data_const_syn_nuc_cyt[, use.cols, drop = FALSE]

# enforce identical order
meta_syn <- meta_syn[match(colnames(counts_syn), meta_syn$Sample), , drop = FALSE]
stopifnot(identical(colnames(counts_syn), meta_syn$Sample))

# 1) Build a combined DGEList for all samples and normalize (TMM)
y <- edgeR::DGEList(
  counts  = replace(as.matrix(counts_syn), is.na(counts_syn), 0),
  samples = meta_syn
)
y <- edgeR::calcNormFactors(y)

# 2) Filter genes: CPM > 1 in at least 4 samples
keep <- rowSums(edgeR::cpm(y) > 1) >= 4
y <- y[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]

# 3) LogCPM matrix (acts like variance-stabilized for bulk)
logCPM <- edgeR::cpm(y, log = TRUE, prior.count = 2)

# 4) PCA on samples using all kept genes
pca_all <- prcomp(t(logCPM), center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)

# ---- variance explained labels (e.g., PC1 (40%)) ----
var_expl <- (pca_all$sdev^2) / sum(pca_all$sdev^2)
pc_lab <- function(PC) {
  i <- as.integer(gsub("^PC", "", PC))
  paste0(PC, " (", sprintf("%.0f", 100 * var_expl[i]), "%)")
}

# 5) Build plotting DF (rows = samples), align metadata
samps  <- rownames(pca_all$x)
meta_p <- meta_syn[match(samps, meta_syn$Sample), , drop = FALSE]
stopifnot(identical(meta_p$Sample, samps))
pca_df <- cbind(meta_p, as.data.frame(pca_all$x))

# 6) Plot helpers
PCA_plot <- function(PCx, PCy, variable){
  ggplot2::ggplot(
    pca_df,
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = .data[[PCx]],
      y = .data[[PCy]],
      color = .data[[variable]],
      label = Sample
    )
  ) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(size = 1.5, alpha = 0.7) +
    ggplot2::theme_bw() +
    ggplot2::labs(title = variable, x = pc_lab(PCx), y = pc_lab(PCy)) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = ggplot2::rel(1.2), hjust = 0.5),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = ggplot2::element_blank()
    ) +
    ggplot2::guides(color = ggplot2::guide_legend(nrow = 1, byrow = TRUE))
}

PCA_panel <- function(x, y){
  cowplot::plot_grid(
    PCA_plot(x, y, "Genotype"),
    PCA_plot(x, y, "Fraction"),
    PCA_plot(x, y, "Sex"),
    nrow = 1
  )
}

PCA_plot("PC1", "PC2", "Sex")      + ggrepel::geom_text_repel(size = 2.5)
PCA_plot("PC1", "PC2", "Genotype") + ggrepel::geom_text_repel(size = 2.5)
PCA_plot("PC1", "PC2", "Sequencing_batch") + ggrepel::geom_text_repel(size = 2.5)

PCA_plot("PC3", "PC4", "Sex")      + ggrepel::geom_text_repel(size = 2.5)
PCA_plot("PC3", "PC4", "Genotype") + ggrepel::geom_text_repel(size = 2.5)
PCA_plot("PC3", "PC4", "Sequencing_batch") + ggrepel::geom_text_repel(size = 2.5)
```

```{r}
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.title = element_blank())

## ---- Generic helper: numeric ~ Genotype (Wilcoxon) + boxplot ----
plot_numeric_by_genotype <- function(df, yvar, label_prefix = NULL) {
  stopifnot(yvar %in% colnames(df))

  d <- df %>%
    dplyr::select(Genotype, dplyr::all_of(yvar)) %>%
    dplyr::filter(stats::complete.cases(.)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Genotype = droplevels(Genotype),
      y = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data[[yvar]]))
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(is.finite(y))

  stopifnot(nlevels(d$Genotype) == 2)

  w <- wilcox.test(y ~ Genotype, data = d, exact = FALSE)

  ttl <- paste0(ifelse(is.null(label_prefix), yvar, label_prefix),
                " ~ Genotype (Wilcoxon p=", signif(w$p.value, 3), ")")

  p <- ggplot(d, aes(x = Genotype, y = y, fill = Genotype)) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.6, outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.12, size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(title = ttl, x = NULL, y = yvar) +
    theme(legend.position = "none")

  list(test = w, plot = p, data = d)
}

## ---- PC1 ~ Genotype and PC2 ~ Genotype (Wilcoxon + plots) ----
res_PC1 <- plot_numeric_by_genotype(pca_df, "PC1")
res_PC2 <- plot_numeric_by_genotype(pca_df, "PC2")

res_PC1$test
res_PC2$test
res_PC1$plot
res_PC2$plot
```

```{r}
# 0) Subset to nuc fraction and keep order consistent
meta_nuc <- metadata_const_syn_nuc_cyt %>%
  dplyr::filter(Fraction == "Nuc") %>%
  dplyr::filter(Outlier == "FALSE") %>%
  droplevels()


meta_nuc$Sequencing_batch <- factor(meta_nuc$Sequencing_batch)

use.cols <- meta_nuc$Sample
stopifnot(all(use.cols %in% colnames(exp_data_const_syn_nuc_cyt)))

# enforce identical order
meta_nuc <- meta_nuc[match(colnames(counts_nuc), meta_nuc$Sample), , drop = FALSE]
stopifnot(identical(colnames(counts_nuc), meta_nuc$Sample))

# 1) Build a combined DGEList for all samples and normalize (TMM)
y <- DGEList(
  counts  = replace(as.matrix(counts_nuc), is.na(counts_nuc), 0),
  samples = meta_nuc
)
y <- calcNormFactors(y)

# 2) Filter genes: CPM > 1 in at least 4 samples 
keep <- rowSums(cpm(y) > 1) >= 4
y <- y[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]

# 3) LogCPM matrix (acts like variance-stabilized for bulk)
logCPM <- cpm(y, log = TRUE, prior.count = 2)

# 4) PCA on samples using **all kept genes**
pca_all <- prcomp(t(logCPM), center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)

# 5) Build plotting DF (rows = samples), align metadata
samps   <- rownames(pca_all$x)
meta_p  <- meta_nuc[match(samps, meta_nuc$Sample), , drop = FALSE]
stopifnot(identical(meta_p$Sample, samps))

pca_df <- cbind(meta_p, as.data.frame(pca_all$x))

# 6) Plot helpers

}

    PCA_plot(x, y, "Genotype"),
    PCA_plot(x, y, "Fraction"),
    PCA_plot(x, y, "Sex"),
    nrow = 1
  )
}
```

### Check if ribo_CPM and mito_CPM confound genotype effects in syn
```{r}
# =========================================================
# PURPOSE: Check for compositional confounding in Syn fraction
#   A) ribo_CPM confounding (translation-axis / ribosome load)
#   B) mt_CPM   confounding (mito load / QC axis)
#
# EACH BLOCK RUNS THE SAME 3 TESTS:
#   TEST 0 (prep): remove outliers + build TMM CPM matrix
#   TEST 1:  covariate ~ Genotype         (is covariate genotype-shifted?)
#   TEST 2:  GO_score  ~ covariate        (does GO track composition?)
#   TEST 3:  GO_score  ~ Genotype+covariate (genotype effect after adjusting?)
# =========================================================


# =========================================================
# TEST 0 (PREP): subset Syn + remove outliers + TMM CPM matrix
# =========================================================

meta_syn <- metadata_const_syn_nuc_cyt %>%
  dplyr::filter(Fraction == "Syn") %>%
  droplevels()

meta_syn_clean <- meta_syn %>%
  dplyr::filter(Outlier == "FALSE")

use.cols <- meta_syn_clean$Sample

y <- DGEList(
  counts  = replace(as.matrix(exp_data_const_syn_nuc_cyt),
                    is.na(exp_data_const_syn_nuc_cyt), 0),
  samples = metadata_const_syn_nuc_cyt
)
y <- calcNormFactors(y)
keep <- rowSums(edgeR::cpm(y) > 1) >= 4
y <- y[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
y_tmp    <- y[, use.cols, keep.lib.sizes = TRUE]

# TMM normalized CPM (linear scale; NOT logCPM)
cpm_mat <- edgeR::cpm(y_tmp, log = FALSE, normalized.lib.sizes = TRUE)


# =========================================================
# HELPER: generic GO-score vs covariate plot + stats
#   - used for both ribo_CPM and mt_CPM
# =========================================================

plot_go_vs_covariate <- function(go_term, title_label, covar_col){

  # -----------------------------
  # Build GO gene set (BP) -> ENS
  # -----------------------------
  go_syms <- get_go_genes(go_term, ontology = "BP")
  go_ens  <- sym_to_ens(go_syms)

  go_ens <- intersect(go_ens, rownames(cpm_mat))
  go_ens <- intersect(go_ens, pc_ens)

  stopifnot(length(go_ens) >= 10)

  # -----------------------------
  # GO score: mean CPM per sample
  # -----------------------------
  go_score <- colMeans(cpm_mat[go_ens, , drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)

  plot_df <- data.frame(
    Sample   = names(go_score),
    GO_score = as.numeric(go_score),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      meta_syn_clean %>% dplyr::select(Sample, Genotype, dplyr::all_of(covar_col)),
      by = "Sample"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Genotype = factor(as.character(Genotype), levels = c("WT","HET")),
      covar    = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(.data[[covar_col]])))
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(is.finite(GO_score), is.finite(covar), !is.na(Genotype))

  # =========================================================
  # TEST 2: GO_score ~ covariate  (correlation + slope)
  # TEST 3: GO_score ~ Genotype + covariate
  # =========================================================
  cat("\n==============================\n")
  cat("GO TERM:", go_term, "\n")
  cat("COVARIATE:", covar_col, "\n")
  cat("==============================\n\n")

  cat("TEST 2: cor(GO_score, covariate)\n")
  print(cor.test(plot_df$covar, plot_df$GO_score))

  cat("\nTEST 3: GO_score ~ Genotype + covariate\n")
  print(summary(lm(GO_score ~ Genotype + covar, data = plot_df)))

  # slope annotation from GO_score ~ covariate
  fit  <- lm(GO_score ~ covar, data = plot_df)
  smry <- summary(fit)

  pval <- signif(smry$coefficients["covar","Pr(>|t|)"], 3)
  r2   <- signif(smry$r.squared, 3)

  # -----------------------------
  # plot (labels bottom-right)
  # -----------------------------
  ggplot(plot_df, aes(covar, GO_score, color = Genotype)) +
    geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.9) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "black", linewidth = 1) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = Inf, y = -Inf,
      label = paste0(
        "slope p = ", pval,
        "\nR² = ", r2,
        "\n(n=", nrow(plot_df), ")"
      ),
      hjust = 1.1,
      vjust = -0.5,
      size  = 5
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(
      title = title_label,
      x = covar_col,
      y = paste0("Mean CPM (n genes=", length(go_ens), ")")
    ) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom",
          legend.title = element_blank())
}


# =========================================================
# BLOCK A: ribo_CPM confounding
# =========================================================

# -----------------------------
# TEST 1A: ribo_CPM ~ Genotype

meta_test_ribo <- meta_syn %>%
```

## 3.11 Check crams for indel


- Sets the reference genome fasta so CRAM files can be decoded 

- Defines the genomic region covering Chd8 exon 5

- Loops over every *.cram file in the crams/ folder

- For each sample:

    - Counts how many RNA-seq reads overlap exon 5 (total_reads)

    - From those reads, counts how many contain a deletion (3-10bp) in the CIGAR string (reads_with_del)

    - Reports both numbers per sample

- Produces a table you can use to infer who carries the deletion allele

Run in terminal:

```{bash}

cd /Users/salozano/Library/Mobile\ Documents/com~apple~CloudDocs/Documents/Data\ Analysis/2025/Const_Cond_syn_nuc_cyt

REF="/Users/salozano/ref/mm10/mm10.fa"

START=52227566
END=52227605

echo -e "sample\tcontig\ttotal_reads\treads_with_del\tfrac_del"

for cram in crams/*.cram; do
  sample=$(basename "$cram" .cram)

  contig=$(samtools view -H "$cram" \
    | awk -F'\t' '$1=="@SQ"{for(i=1;i<=NF;i++) if($i ~ /^SN:(chr14|14)$/){sub(/^SN:/,"",$i); print $i; exit}}')

  if [ -z "$contig" ]; then
    echo -e "${sample}\tNA\tNA\tNA\tNA"
    continue
  fi

  REGION="${contig}:${START}-${END}"

  total=$(samtools view -T "$REF" "$cram" "$REGION" 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
  del_reads=$(samtools view -T "$REF" "$cram" "$REGION" 2>/dev/null | awk '$6 ~ /5D/' | wc -l | tr -d ' ')

  if [ "$total" -gt 0 ]; then
    frac=$(awk -v d="$del_reads" -v t="$total" 'BEGIN{printf "%.4f", d/t}')
  else
    frac="NA"
  fi

  echo -e "${sample}\t${total}\t${del_reads}\t${frac}"
done

```




# 4. Const syn/nuc/cyt DE


### DE Function

```{r}

run_DE_with_optional_PCs <- function(
  counts,                         # genes x samples (rownames MUST be Ensembl IDs)
  meta,                           # metadata data.frame
  my_gene,                        # must contain gene_id (Ensembl), gene_name, gene_biotype
  fraction_keep = c("Syn","Nuc"),
  genotypes_keep = c("WT","HET"),
  out_csv = "output/DE/simple_Cond.csv",
  y_out = NULL,
  include_pcs = NULL,             # e.g., c(1,2); NULL = no PCs
  n_pc_check = 10,
  show_heatmap = TRUE,
  sig_r = 0.5,
  sig_p = 0.05,
  include_sex = TRUE,
  include_splicing = FALSE,
  include_mt = FALSE,
  include_mt_resid = FALSE,
  include_batch = FALSE,
  include_ribo = FALSE,
  drop_samples = "Outliers",
  genes_use = c("protein_coding", "all"),   # default protein_coding
  do_tmm = TRUE,                            # DEFAULT TRUE
  heatmap_label = NULL
) {
  stopifnot(all(c("Sample","Genotype","Sex","Fraction") %in% names(meta)))
  genes_use <- match.arg(genes_use)

  # -----------------------------
  # 0) Normalize fraction labels (Syn/Nuc/Cyt) case-insensitive
  # -----------------------------
  norm_frac <- function(x) {
    x <- trimws(tolower(as.character(x)))
    x <- ifelse(x %in% c("syn","synaptic"), "syn", x)
    x <- ifelse(x %in% c("nuc","nuclear","nuclei"), "nuc", x)
    x <- ifelse(x %in% c("cyt","cyto","cytoplasm","cytoplasmic","cytoplasma"), "cyt", x)
    x
  }

  meta_local <- meta
  meta_local$Fraction <- norm_frac(meta_local$Fraction)

  fk_in <- norm_frac(fraction_keep)
  if (length(fraction_keep) == 2L) fk_in <- "syn"

  # -----------------------------
  # 1) Determine which samples to drop
  # -----------------------------
  if (is.null(drop_samples)) drop_samples <- "Outliers"

  drop_none     <- is.character(drop_samples) && length(drop_samples) == 1 && drop_samples == "None"
  drop_outliers <- is.character(drop_samples) && length(drop_samples) == 1 && drop_samples == "Outliers"

  if (!drop_none && !drop_outliers && !is.character(drop_samples)) {
    stop("drop_samples must be 'Outliers' (default), 'None', or a character vector like c('M6M','435F').")
  }

  sample_prefix <- sub("_.*$", "", as.character(meta_local$Sample))
  keep_mask <- rep(TRUE, nrow(meta_local))

  if (drop_outliers) {
    if (!"Outlier" %in% names(meta_local)) {
      message("drop_samples='Outliers' but no 'Outlier' column found; not dropping any outliers.")
    } else {
      ol <- meta_local$Outlier
      if (is.factor(ol)) ol <- as.character(ol)
      if (is.character(ol)) {
        ol <- trimws(tolower(ol)) %in% c("true","t","1","yes","y")
      } else if (is.numeric(ol)) {
        ol <- ol != 0
      } else if (!is.logical(ol)) {
        ol <- as.logical(ol)
      }
      keep_mask <- keep_mask & (!ol)
    }
  }

  if (!drop_none && !drop_outliers) {
    drop_prefixes <- unique(drop_samples)
    keep_mask <- keep_mask & !(sample_prefix %in% drop_prefixes)
  }

  meta_local <- meta_local[keep_mask, , drop = FALSE]

  # -----------------------------
  # 2) Filter metadata to desired comparison
  # -----------------------------
  metadata_filt <- meta_local |>
    dplyr::filter(
      Fraction == fk_in,
      Genotype %in% genotypes_keep
    ) |>
    droplevels()

  if ("WT" %in% unique(metadata_filt$Genotype)) {
    metadata_filt$Genotype <- factor(
      metadata_filt$Genotype,
      levels = unique(c("WT", setdiff(genotypes_keep, "WT")))
    )
  } else {
    metadata_filt$Genotype <- factor(metadata_filt$Genotype, levels = genotypes_keep)
  }
  metadata_filt$Sex <- factor(metadata_filt$Sex)

  # Align counts to filtered metadata
  use.cols <- metadata_filt$Sample
  stopifnot(all(use.cols %in% colnames(counts)))
  test.data <- counts[, use.cols, drop = FALSE]

  rownames(test.data) <- as.character(rownames(test.data))
  test.data <- replace(as.matrix(test.data), is.na(test.data), 0)

  # -----------------------------
  # 2b) Optional gene filtering (protein_coding vs all) USING Ensembl IDs
  # -----------------------------
  if (genes_use == "protein_coding") {
    pc_ids <- my_gene |>
      dplyr::filter(gene_biotype == "protein_coding") |>
      dplyr::pull(gene_id) |>
      unique()

    test.data <- test.data[rownames(test.data) %in% pc_ids, , drop = FALSE]
  }

  md <- metadata_filt[match(colnames(test.data), metadata_filt$Sample), , drop = FALSE]
  stopifnot(identical(colnames(test.data), md$Sample))

  # -----------------------------
  # 3) edgeR object (filter + optional TMM)
  # -----------------------------
  test.group <- factor(as.character(md$Genotype), levels = levels(md$Genotype))
  y <- edgeR::DGEList(counts = test.data, group = test.group)

  keep <- rowSums(edgeR::cpm(y) > 1) >= 4
  y <- y[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]

  if (isTRUE(do_tmm)) {
    y <- edgeR::calcNormFactors(y)
  }

  if (!is.null(y_out)) saveRDS(y, file = y_out)

  # -----------------------------
  # 4) PCA
  # -----------------------------
  pca.results <- prcomp(log(y$counts + 1), center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)

  samps  <- rownames(pca.results$rotation)
  md_pca <- md[match(samps, md$Sample), , drop = FALSE]
  stopifnot(identical(md_pca$Sample, samps))

  # -----------------------------
  # 4c) Optional residualize mt_CPM and store as mito_resid
  # -----------------------------
  if (isTRUE(include_mt_resid)) {
    if (!"mt_CPM" %in% colnames(md_pca)) stop("include_mt_resid=TRUE but 'mt_CPM' not in metadata.")
    md_pca$mt_CPM <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(md_pca$mt_CPM))

    mt_terms <- c("Genotype")
    if (isTRUE(include_batch)) {
      if (!"Sequencing_batch" %in% colnames(md_pca)) stop("include_batch=TRUE but 'Sequencing_batch' not in metadata.")
      md_pca$Sequencing_batch <- factor(md_pca$Sequencing_batch)
      if (nlevels(md_pca$Sequencing_batch) >= 2) mt_terms <- c(mt_terms, "Sequencing_batch")
    }
    if (isTRUE(include_sex)) {
      if (!"Sex" %in% colnames(md_pca)) stop("include_sex=TRUE but 'Sex' not in metadata.")
      md_pca$Sex <- factor(md_pca$Sex)
      if (nlevels(md_pca$Sex) >= 2) mt_terms <- c(mt_terms, "Sex")
    }

    mt_form <- as.formula(paste("mt_CPM ~", paste(mt_terms, collapse = " + ")))
    mt_fit <- stats::lm(mt_form, data = md_pca)

    md_pca$mito_resid <- stats::resid(mt_fit)
    md_pca$mito_resid <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(md_pca$mito_resid))
    if (all(!is.finite(md_pca$mito_resid)) || stats::sd(md_pca$mito_resid, na.rm = TRUE) == 0) {
      message("Dropping mito_resid: constant/non-finite across samples.")
      md_pca$mito_resid <- NA_real_
    } else {
      md_pca$mito_resid <- as.numeric(scale(md_pca$mito_resid))
    }
  }

  # -----------------------------
  # 5) PC–covariate correlation screen (only if include_pcs is NULL)
  # -----------------------------
  if (is.null(include_pcs)) {

    cand_vars <- c(
      "Genotype", "Sex", "Sequencing_batch", "Read_depth", "Splicing.rate",
      "mt_CPM", "ribo_CPM", "rpls_CPM"
    )

    covars <- intersect(cand_vars, colnames(md_pca))
    K <- min(n_pc_check, ncol(pca.results$rotation))

    to_num <- function(x) {
      if (is.factor(x) || is.character(x)) as.numeric(as.factor(x)) else suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
    }

    r_mat <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = length(covars), ncol = K,
                    dimnames = list(covars, paste0("PC", seq_len(K))))
    p_mat <- r_mat

    for (i in seq_along(covars)) {
      xnum <- to_num(md_pca[[covars[i]]])
      for (k in seq_len(K)) {
        r_mat[i, k] <- suppressWarnings(cor(pca.results$rotation[, k], xnum, use = "pair"))
        p_mat[i, k] <- tryCatch(
          cor.test(pca.results$rotation[, k], xnum)$p.value,
          error = function(e) NA_real_
        )
      }
    }

    sig_mask <- (abs(r_mat) >= sig_r) & (p_mat < sig_p)
    sig_mask[is.na(sig_mask)] <- FALSE

    if (isTRUE(show_heatmap) && length(covars) > 0 && K > 0) {
      num_r <- matrix(sprintf("%.2f", r_mat), nrow = nrow(r_mat), dimnames = dimnames(r_mat))
      num_r[sig_mask] <- paste0(num_r[sig_mask], "*")

      num_p <- matrix(sprintf("%.2e", p_mat), nrow = nrow(p_mat), dimnames = dimnames(p_mat))
      num_p[sig_mask] <- paste0(num_p[sig_mask], "*")

      pheatmap::pheatmap(
        r_mat,
        display_numbers = num_r,
        cluster_rows = FALSE,
        cluster_cols = FALSE,
        color = colorRampPalette(c("#4575b4","#f7f7f7","#d73027"))(200),
        number_color = "black",
        fontsize_number = 9,
        na_col = "grey90",
        main = paste0(
          if (!is.null(heatmap_label)) paste0(heatmap_label, ": ") else "",
          "correlation (Pearson r) of PCs vs covariates"
        ),
        angle_col = 0
      )

      pheatmap::pheatmap(
        p_mat,
        display_numbers = num_p,
        cluster_rows = FALSE,
        cluster_cols = FALSE,
        color = colorRampPalette(c("#ffffcc","#fdae61","#d73027"))(200),
        number_color = "black",
        fontsize_number = 9,
        na_col = "grey90",
        main = paste0(
          if (!is.null(heatmap_label)) paste0(heatmap_label, ": ") else "",
          "PC-covariate correlation p values"
        ),
        angle_col = 0
      )
    }
  }

  # -----------------------------
  # 6) Build design matrix (~ covariates + optional PCs + Genotype)
  # -----------------------------
  cov_terms <- character(0)
  if (isTRUE(include_sex)) cov_terms <- c(cov_terms, "Sex")

  if (isTRUE(include_splicing)) {
    if (!"Splicing.rate" %in% colnames(md_pca)) stop("include_splicing=TRUE but 'Splicing.rate' not in metadata.")
    md_pca$Splicing.rate <- as.numeric(md_pca$Splicing.rate)
    cov_terms <- c(cov_terms, "Splicing.rate")
  }

  if (isTRUE(include_mt)) {
    if (!"mt_CPM" %in% colnames(md_pca)) stop("include_mt=TRUE but 'mt_CPM' not in metadata.")
    md_pca$mt_CPM <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(md_pca$mt_CPM))
    if (all(!is.finite(md_pca$mt_CPM)) || sd(md_pca$mt_CPM, na.rm = TRUE) == 0) {
      message("Dropping mt_CPM: constant/non-finite across samples.")
    } else {
      md_pca$mt_CPM <- as.numeric(scale(md_pca$mt_CPM))
      cov_terms <- c(cov_terms, "mt_CPM")
    }
  }

  if (isTRUE(include_mt_resid)) {
    if (!"mito_resid" %in% colnames(md_pca)) stop("include_mt_resid=TRUE but 'mito_resid' not in metadata (unexpected).")
    if (all(!is.finite(md_pca$mito_resid)) || sd(md_pca$mito_resid, na.rm = TRUE) == 0) {
      message("Dropping mito_resid: constant/non-finite across samples.")
    } else {
      cov_terms <- c(cov_terms, "mito_resid")
    }
  }

  if (isTRUE(include_batch)) {
    if (!"Sequencing_batch" %in% colnames(md_pca)) stop("include_batch=TRUE but 'Sequencing_batch' not in metadata.")
    md_pca$Sequencing_batch <- factor(md_pca$Sequencing_batch)
    if (nlevels(md_pca$Sequencing_batch) < 2) {
      message("Dropping Sequencing_batch: <2 levels after filtering.")
    } else {
      cov_terms <- c(cov_terms, "Sequencing_batch")
    }
  }

  if (isTRUE(include_ribo)) {
    if (!"ribo_CPM" %in% colnames(md_pca)) stop("include_ribo=TRUE but 'ribo_CPM' not in metadata.")
    md_pca$ribo_CPM <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(md_pca$ribo_CPM))
    if (all(!is.finite(md_pca$ribo_CPM)) || sd(md_pca$ribo_CPM, na.rm = TRUE) == 0) {
      message("Dropping ribo_CPM: constant/non-finite across samples.")
    } else {
      md_pca$ribo_CPM <- as.numeric(scale(md_pca$ribo_CPM))
      cov_terms <- c(cov_terms, "ribo_CPM")
    }
  }

  if (!is.null(include_pcs) && length(include_pcs) > 0) {
    pcs_keep <- include_pcs[include_pcs %in% seq_len(ncol(pca.results$rotation))]
    if (length(pcs_keep) == 0) stop("include_pcs requested but none are available in PCA results.")
    for (pc in pcs_keep) {
      md_pca[[paste0("PC", pc)]] <- pca.results$rotation[, pc]
    }
    cov_terms <- c(cov_terms, paste0("PC", pcs_keep))
  }

  form_str <- paste("~", paste(c(cov_terms, "Genotype"), collapse = " + "))
  design <- model.matrix(as.formula(form_str), data = md_pca)

  # -----------------------------
  # 7) edgeR DE
  # -----------------------------
  y <- edgeR::estimateGLMCommonDisp(y, design)
  y <- edgeR::estimateGLMTrendedDisp(y, design)
  y <- edgeR::estimateGLMTagwiseDisp(y, design)
  fit <- edgeR::glmFit(y, design)

  if ("HOM" %in% genotypes_keep) {
    coef_name <- grep("^GenotypeHOM$", colnames(design), value = TRUE)
  } else {
    coef_name <- grep("^GenotypeHET$", colnames(design), value = TRUE)
  }
  if (length(coef_name) != 1) {
    stop("Could not find genotype coefficient in design. Columns: ", paste(colnames(design), collapse = ", "))
  }

  lrt <- edgeR::glmLRT(fit, coef = coef_name)

  res <- edgeR::topTags(lrt, n = Inf)$table
  res$gene_id <- rownames(res)
  rownames(res) <- NULL
  res <- res[, c("gene_id","logFC","logCPM","LR","PValue","FDR")]

  map_out <- my_gene[, c("gene_id","gene_name")]
  map_out <- map_out[!duplicated(map_out$gene_id), , drop = FALSE]
  res <- merge(map_out, res, by = "gene_id", all.y = TRUE)
  res <- res[, c("gene_id","gene_name","logFC","logCPM","LR","PValue","FDR")]
  res <- dplyr::arrange(res, PValue)

  # --- write output only if requested ---
  if (!is.null(out_csv)) {
    dir.create(dirname(out_csv), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
    write.csv(res, out_csv, row.names = FALSE)
    message("\nSaved DE to: ", out_csv)
  } else {
    message("\nout_csv is NULL -> not writing DE table to disk.")
  }

  invisible(list(y = y, design = design, pca = pca.results, res = res, md_pca = md_pca))
}
```

```{r}
# ---- subset by metadata_const_cond_whole$Sample
sample_cols <- metadata_const_cond_whole$Sample

missing_in_counts <- setdiff(sample_cols, colnames(counts_comb))
if (length(missing_in_counts) > 0) {
  stop("These metadata_const_cond_whole$Sample values are missing from counts_comb colnames:\n",
       paste(missing_in_counts, collapse = ", "))
}

# PASSED! :)
all(colnames(counts_comb)[match(sample_cols, colnames(counts_comb))] == sample_cols)

# Xist counts (exactly in metadata order)
xist_row <- dplyr::filter(counts_comb, Geneid == "ENSMUSG00000086503")
stopifnot(nrow(xist_row) == 1)

metadata_const_cond_whole$Xist_counts <- xist_row %>%
  dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(sample_cols)) %>%
  as.numeric()

# Sequencing depth 
metadata_const_cond_whole$Seq_depth <- colSums(counts_comb[, sample_cols, drop = FALSE])

# Expression matrix for DE etc.
exp_data_const_cond_whole <- counts_comb[, c("Geneid", sample_cols)]

head(exp_data_const_cond_whole)

rownames(exp_data_const_cond_whole) <- exp_data_const_cond_whole$Geneid
exp_data_const_cond_whole$Geneid <- NULL

# (optional safety) collapse duplicate Geneid rows if any
if (any(duplicated(rownames(exp_data_const_cond_whole)))) {
  exp_data_const_cond_whole <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(seq_len(nrow(exp_data_const_cond_whole)),
                                                          rownames(exp_data_const_cond_whole)),
                                                    function(ii) colMeans(exp_data_const_cond_whole[ii, , drop = FALSE])))
}


# keep as data.frame
exp_data_const_cond_whole <- as.data.frame(exp_data_const_cond_whole)

```

```{r}
stopifnot(!any(duplicated(rownames(exp_data_const_cond_whole))))         # symbols are now unique
```

## 5.2 Get RPKM data

```{r}

## -------------------------
##   1) RPKM on Geneid-level using Length (counts_comb)
##   2) Rename rows to symbols (no collapsing of RPKM)
##   3) Optional: symbol-collapsed counts + lengths for downstream
## -------------------------

# -------------------------
# 0) sample order = YOUR metadata order (already filtered to Ctx etc.)
# -------------------------
all_samples_whole <- as.character(metadata_const_cond_whole$Sample)

stopifnot(all(all_samples_whole %in% colnames(counts_comb)))
stopifnot(all(c("Geneid","Length") %in% colnames(counts_comb)))

# -------------------------
# 1) Geneid-level exp matrix (NO symbol collapsing here)
#    use the raw combined table that still has Length
# -------------------------
exp_data_id_whole <- counts_comb
rownames(exp_data_id_whole) <- as.character(exp_data_id_whole$Geneid)
exp_data_id_whole <- exp_data_id_whole[, all_samples_whole, drop = FALSE]

# collapse duplicate Geneid rows if any (safe)
if (any(duplicated(rownames(exp_data_id_whole)))) {
  exp_data_id_whole <- rowsum(as.matrix(exp_data_id_whole), group = rownames(exp_data_id_whole))
}

# -------------------------
# 2) Geneid-level length vector aligned to Geneids
#    IMPORTANT: if duplicate Geneids exist, keep ONE length per Geneid (max)
# -------------------------
gene_lengths_id_whole <- as.numeric(counts_comb$Length)
names(gene_lengths_id_whole) <- as.character(counts_comb$Geneid)

if (any(duplicated(names(gene_lengths_id_whole)))) {
  gene_lengths_id_whole <- tapply(gene_lengths_id_whole,
                                  names(gene_lengths_id_whole),
                                  max)
}

# HARD ALIGN lengths to exp matrix rows
gene_lengths_id_whole <- gene_lengths_id_whole[rownames(exp_data_id_whole)]

# drop any invalid lengths + keep matrices aligned
ok_len <- !is.na(gene_lengths_id_whole) & gene_lengths_id_whole > 0
exp_data_id_whole <- exp_data_id_whole[ok_len, , drop = FALSE]
gene_lengths_id_whole <- gene_lengths_id_whole[ok_len]

stopifnot(identical(rownames(exp_data_id_whole), names(gene_lengths_id_whole)))

# -------------------------
# 3) RPKM on Geneid-level 
# -------------------------
rpkm_id_log2_whole <- edgeR::rpkm(exp_data_id_whole,
                                 gene.length = gene_lengths_id_whole,
                                 log = TRUE)   # prior.count=2 default

rpkm_id_linear_whole <- edgeR::rpkm(exp_data_id_whole,
                                   gene.length = gene_lengths_id_whole,
                                   log = FALSE)

# -------------------------
# 4) Rename RPKM rows to symbols (do NOT collapse RPKM)
# -------------------------
map <- my_gene[, c("gene_id","gene_name")]
map <- map[!duplicated(map$gene_id), , drop = FALSE]   # safety
rownames(map) <- map$gene_id

sym_rpkm <- map[rownames(rpkm_id_log2_whole), "gene_name"]
sym_rpkm[is.na(sym_rpkm) | sym_rpkm == ""] <- rownames(rpkm_id_log2_whole)[is.na(sym_rpkm) | sym_rpkm == ""]

rpkm_symbol_log2_precollapse_all_whole   <- rpkm_id_log2_whole
rpkm_symbol_linear_precollapse_all_whole <- rpkm_id_linear_whole
rownames(rpkm_symbol_log2_precollapse_all_whole)   <- sym_rpkm
rownames(rpkm_symbol_linear_precollapse_all_whole) <- sym_rpkm

# -------------------------
# 5) Optional: ALSO make symbol-collapsed counts + lengths (for downstream)
#    This mirrors your earlier exp_data_const_cond_whole creation,
#    BUT starts from Geneid-level matrix so it matches the reference pattern.
# -------------------------
sym_counts <- map[rownames(exp_data_id_whole), "gene_name"]
keep <- !is.na(sym_counts) & sym_counts != ""

exp_data_symbol_collapsed_whole <- rowsum(exp_data_id_whole[keep, , drop = FALSE],
                                          sym_counts[keep])

gene_lengths_symbol_whole <- tapply(gene_lengths_id_whole[keep],
                                    sym_counts[keep],
                                    max)
gene_lengths_symbol_whole <- gene_lengths_symbol_whole[rownames(exp_data_symbol_collapsed_whole)]

stopifnot(identical(rownames(exp_data_symbol_collapsed_whole),
                    names(gene_lengths_symbol_whole)))

# If you want, you can overwrite your symbol-collapsed counts with the “reference-pattern” one:
# exp_data_const_cond_whole <- as.data.frame(exp_data_symbol_collapsed_whole)

# -------------------------
# 6) Quick spot check
# -------------------------
genes_to_check <- c("Chd8", "Usp11", "Crlf2", "Abca8a")
print(rpkm_symbol_log2_precollapse_all_whole[genes_to_check, , drop = FALSE])
print(rpkm_symbol_linear_precollapse_all_whole[genes_to_check, , drop = FALSE])

# -------------------------
# SAVE FINAL RPKM WITH ENS ROW NAMES
# -------------------------
rpkm_data_const_cond_whole <- rpkm_id_log2_whole
rpkm_data_linear_const_cond_whole <- rpkm_id_linear_whole

write.csv(rpkm_data_const_cond_whole, "count_data/rpkm_data_log2_const_cond_whole.csv", quote = FALSE)
write.csv(rpkm_data_linear_const_cond_whole, "count_data/rpkm_data_linear_const_cond_whole.csv", quote = FALSE)


```

## 5.6 Check mt and ribo CPM

```{r}

# exp_data_const_cond_whole: genes x samples raw counts (ENS rownames)
# metadata_const_cond_whole: sample-level meta with Sample/Batch/Genotype/Sex
#   Batch = "Cond" for cond
#   Batch = "CHD807" or "Chd806" (etc) for const

# --------------------------
# CONST (Batch != "Cond")
# --------------------------

meta_const <- metadata_const_cond_whole %>%
  dplyr::filter(Batch != "Cond")

# subset counts to const samples (keep genes x samples)
samples_const <- colnames(exp_data_const_cond_whole)
samples_const <- samples_const[samples_const %in% meta_const$Sample]
exp_const <- exp_data_const_cond_whole[, samples_const, drop = FALSE]

# ensure metadata rows match exp_const columns
meta_c  <- meta_const[match(samples_const, meta_const$Sample), , drop = FALSE]
stopifnot(identical(meta_c$Sample, samples_const))

# ---- make a symbol-name vector for pattern matching (NO collapsing) ----
map <- my_gene[, c("gene_id","gene_name")]
map <- map[!duplicated(map$gene_id), , drop = FALSE]
rownames(map) <- map$gene_id
rn_sym <- map[rownames(exp_const), "gene_name"]
rn_sym[is.na(rn_sym) | rn_sym == ""] <- rownames(exp_const)[is.na(rn_sym) | rn_sym == ""]

# CPM matrix (NA -> 0 for CPM only)
dge_const <- edgeR::DGEList(counts = replace(as.matrix(exp_const),
                                            is.na(exp_const), 0))
cpm_mat   <- edgeR::cpm(dge_const, log = FALSE)

# identify gene sets
# mt genes using SYMBOLS (case-insensitive)
mt_idx <- grep("^mt-", rn_sym, ignore.case = TRUE)

# rRNA genes using gene_biotype from my_gene (match by ENS gene_id / rownames)
rrna_ids <- my_gene$gene_id[my_gene$gene_biotype %in% "rRNA"]
ribo_idx <- which(rownames(exp_const) %in% rrna_ids)

# compute totals (CPM)
mt_CPM_vec <- if (length(mt_idx)) {
  colSums(cpm_mat[mt_idx, , drop = FALSE])
} else rep(NA_real_, ncol(cpm_mat))

ribo_CPM_vec <- if (length(ribo_idx)) {
  colSums(cpm_mat[ribo_idx, , drop = FALSE])
} else rep(NA_real_, ncol(cpm_mat))

# library CPM totals (~1e6 each)
lib_cpm_tot <- colSums(cpm_mat)
names(lib_cpm_tot) <- samples_const

# build QC frame
qc_mt_ribo_const <- meta_c %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    mt_CPM   = mt_CPM_vec,
    ribo_CPM = ribo_CPM_vec
  ) %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    Sample, Batch, Genotype, Sex,
    mt_CPM, ribo_CPM,
    mt_pct   = 100 * mt_CPM   / lib_cpm_tot[Sample],
    ribo_pct = 100 * ribo_CPM / lib_cpm_tot[Sample]
  )

# long format
long_pct <- qc_mt_ribo_const %>%
  dplyr::select(Sample, Batch, Genotype, Sex, mt_pct, ribo_pct) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(c(mt_pct, ribo_pct), names_to = "metric", values_to = "pct") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(metric = dplyr::recode(metric, mt_pct = "Mito (%)", ribo_pct = "Ribo (%)"))

# 10% cutoff for both + labels
thr_tbl  <- data.frame(metric = c("Mito (%)", "Ribo (%)"), thr = 10)
label_df <- long_pct %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(thr_tbl, by = "metric") %>%
  dplyr::filter(is.finite(pct) & pct > thr)

# ---- toggle: label all samples or only those above threshold ----
label_all <- FALSE
label_df_plot <- if (label_all) long_pct else label_df

ggplot(long_pct, aes(x = Genotype, y = pct, fill = Genotype)) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_jitter(aes(shape = Sex), width = 0.12, size = 1.6, alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_hline(data = thr_tbl, aes(yintercept = thr), linetype = 2) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = label_df_plot,
    aes(label = Sample),
    size = 3, nudge_y = 1.5, segment.color = "grey50", max.overlaps = Inf
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ metric, scales = "free_y", nrow = 1) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(title = "Percent mito and ribo (Const whole)",
       x = "", y = "Percent of total CPM")
```

## 5.6 Check Xist and Ef2s3y CPM


### Const

```{r}

pick_gene_cpm <- function(symbol, rn_sym, mat) {
  hits <- grep(paste0("^", symbol, "$"), rn_sym, ignore.case = TRUE)
  if (length(hits) == 0) return(rep(NA_real_, ncol(mat)))
  if (length(hits) == 1) return(as.numeric(mat[hits, , drop = FALSE]))
  colMeans(mat[hits, , drop = FALSE])  # multiple rows -> AVERAGE CPM (not sum)
}

## -------------------------
## Const
## -------------------------
```

## 5.6 Check Chd8 CPM

### Const

```{r}

pick_gene_cpm <- function(symbol, rn_sym, mat) {
  hits <- grep(paste0("^", symbol, "$"), rn_sym, ignore.case = TRUE)
  if (length(hits) == 0) return(rep(NA_real_, ncol(mat)))
  if (length(hits) == 1) return(as.numeric(mat[hits, , drop = FALSE]))
  colMeans(mat[hits, , drop = FALSE])  # multiple rows -> AVERAGE CPM (not sum)
}
```

## 5.7 PCA


### Function
```{r}

PCA_plot_from_counts <- function(counts_mat, meta_df, title_prefix = "") {

  # 0) Ensure sample order is consistent
  stopifnot(identical(colnames(counts_mat), meta_df$Sample))

  # 1) Build a combined DGEList for all samples and normalize (TMM)
  y <- edgeR::DGEList(
    counts  = replace(as.matrix(counts_mat),
                      is.na(counts_mat), 0),
    samples = meta_df
  )
  y <- edgeR::calcNormFactors(y)

  # 2) Filter genes: CPM > 1 in at least 4 samples 
  keep <- rowSums(edgeR::cpm(y) > 1) >= 4
  y <- y[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]

  # 3) LogCPM matrix (acts like variance-stabilized for bulk)
  logCPM <- edgeR::cpm(y, log = TRUE, prior.count = 2)

  # 4) PCA on samples using all kept genes
  pca_all <- prcomp(t(logCPM), center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)

  # 5) Build plotting DF (rows = samples), align metadata
  samps   <- rownames(pca_all$x)
  meta_p  <- meta_df[match(samps, meta_df$Sample), , drop = FALSE]
  stopifnot(identical(meta_p$Sample, samps))

  pca_df <- cbind(meta_p, as.data.frame(pca_all$x))

  # make sure these are numeric if present
  if ("mt_CPM" %in% colnames(pca_df))   pca_df$mt_CPM   <- as.numeric(pca_df$mt_CPM)
  if ("ribo_CPM" %in% colnames(pca_df)) pca_df$ribo_CPM <- as.numeric(pca_df$ribo_CPM)

  # 6) Plot helper
  PCA_plot <- function(PCx, PCy, variable) {

    p <- ggplot(
      pca_df,
      aes(x = .data[[PCx]], y = .data[[PCy]],
          color = .data[[variable]], label = Sample)
    ) +
      geom_point(size = 1.5, alpha = 0.7) +
      theme_bw() +
      labs(title = paste0(title_prefix, variable), x = PCx, y = PCy) +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(size = rel(1.2), hjust = 0.5),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.title = element_blank()
      )

    if (is.numeric(pca_df[[variable]])) {
      p <- p + scale_color_viridis_c()
    } else {
      p <- p + guides(color = guide_legend(nrow = 1, byrow = TRUE))
    }

    p
  }

  list(
    pca = pca_all,
    pca_df = pca_df,
    p12_genotype = PCA_plot("PC1","PC2","Genotype") + ggrepel::geom_text_repel(size = 2.5, max.overlaps = 50),
    p12_sex      = PCA_plot("PC1","PC2","Sex")      + ggrepel::geom_text_repel(size = 2.5, max.overlaps = 50),
    p12_batch    = PCA_plot("PC1","PC2","Batch")    + ggrepel::geom_text_repel(size = 2.5, max.overlaps = 50),
    p12_mt       = PCA_plot("PC1","PC2","mt_CPM")   + ggrepel::geom_text_repel(size = 2.5, max.overlaps = 50),
    p12_ribo     = PCA_plot("PC1","PC2","ribo_CPM") + ggrepel::geom_text_repel(size = 2.5, max.overlaps = 50),
    p34_genotype = PCA_plot("PC3","PC4","Genotype") + ggrepel::geom_text_repel(size = 2.5, max.overlaps = 50),
    p34_sex      = PCA_plot("PC3","PC4","Sex")      + ggrepel::geom_text_repel(size = 2.5, max.overlaps = 50),
    p34_batch    = PCA_plot("PC3","PC4","Batch")    + ggrepel::geom_text_repel(size = 2.5, max.overlaps = 50),
    p34_mt       = PCA_plot("PC3","PC4","mt_CPM")   + ggrepel::geom_text_repel(size = 2.5, max.overlaps = 50),
    p34_ribo     = PCA_plot("PC3","PC4","ribo_CPM") + ggrepel::geom_text_repel(size = 2.5, max.overlaps = 50)
  )
}
```

```{r}

# Get counts and metadata
meta_const <- metadata_const_cond_whole %>%
  dplyr::filter(Batch != "Cond") %>%
  droplevels()

use.cols_const <- meta_const$Sample
stopifnot(all(use.cols_const %in% colnames(exp_data_const_cond_whole)))

# Run PCA same as above
pca_out_const <- PCA_plot_from_counts(counts_const, meta_const, title_prefix = "Const whole: ")

# ---- pull the PCA plotting data out of returned object ----
# (Most PCA helper functions store this as something like $df, $pca_df, $scores, etc.)
# Try these in order and keep the one that exists:
df <- NULL
if (!is.null(pca_out_const$df))      df <- pca_out_const$df
if (!is.null(pca_out_const$pca_df))  df <- pca_out_const$pca_df
if (!is.null(pca_out_const$scores))  df <- pca_out_const$scores

stopifnot(!is.null(df))

# Factor
df$Genotype <- factor(df$Genotype, levels = c("HET", "WT"))
df$Sex      <- factor(df$Sex,      levels = c("F", "M"))
df$Batch    <- factor(df$Batch)  # should already be

# Choose which batch gets the extra outline ring
batch_outline <- "CHD80456"   # change to "CHD807" (or whichever) if you want explicitly

library(ggplot2)

p12_genotype_custom <- ggplot(df, aes(PC1, PC2)) +
  # base points: fill=Genotype, shape=Sex, thin black outline
  geom_point(
    aes(fill = Genotype, shape = Sex),
    size = 3.6, color = "black", stroke = 0.6
  ) +
  # extra outline layer for one batch (black ring / thicker border)
  geom_point(
    data = subset(df, Batch == batch_outline),
    aes(shape = Sex),
    size = 3.6, fill = NA, color = "black", stroke = 1.6
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("HET" = "#8494FF", "WT" = "#ABA300")) +
  # filled circle + filled square
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("F" = 21, "M" = 22)) +
  labs(
    title = "Const whole",
    x = "PC1",
    y = "PC2",
    fill = "Gen",
    shape = "Sex"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```

#### MDS plot
```{r}

# --------------------------
# 1) Get counts + metadata 
# --------------------------
meta_const <- metadata_const_cond_whole %>%
  dplyr::filter(Batch != "Cond") %>%
  droplevels()

# 2) Build MDS coordinates from counts
# --------------------------
dge <- DGEList(counts = as.matrix(counts_const))
dge <- calcNormFactors(dge)

# logCPM for distance calculation
lcpm <- cpm(dge, log = TRUE, prior.count = 2)

# edgeR MDS (dims 1 and 2)
mds <- plotMDS(lcpm, plot = FALSE)  # returns points, eigenvalues, etc.

df_mds <- data.frame(
  Sample = meta_const$Sample,
  dim1   = mds$x,
  dim2   = mds$y,
  meta_const
)

  ) +
  # extra outline layer for one batch (thicker black ring)

  labs(
    title = "Const whole",
    x = "dim1",
    y = "dim2",
    fill = "Gen",
    shape = "Sex"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```

# 7. DE on WT-only comparing fractions


## Function
```{r}

run_DE_WT_fraction <- function(
  counts,                       # genes x samples (e.g., exp_data_const_syn_nuc_cyt)
  meta,                         # Sample, Genotype, Sex, Fraction (+ optional Outlier)
  my_gene,                      # must include gene_biotype + gene_id
  mode = c("one_vs_mean_others", "pairwise"),
  test_fraction = c("Syn","Nuc","Cyt"),
  compare_to = c("Nuc","Cyt"),   # only used when mode="pairwise"
  fraction_levels = c("Syn","Nuc","Cyt"),
  out_dir = "output/DE",
  prefix = "simple_WT",
  include_sex = TRUE,
  drop_outliers = TRUE,
  min_cpm = 1,
  min_samples = 4
) {
  stopifnot(all(c("Sample","Genotype","Sex","Fraction") %in% names(meta)))
  mode <- match.arg(mode)

  # --- normalize Fraction labels to Syn/Nuc/Cyt (case-insensitive) ---
  norm_frac <- function(x) {
    x <- trimws(tolower(as.character(x)))
    x <- ifelse(x %in% c("syn","synaptic"), "Syn", x)
    x <- ifelse(x %in% c("nuc","nuclear","nuclei"), "Nuc", x)
    x <- ifelse(x %in% c("cyt","cytoplasm","cytoplasmic"), "Cyt", x)
    x
  }

  meta_local <- meta
  meta_local$Fraction <- norm_frac(meta_local$Fraction)
  meta_local$Genotype <- as.character(meta_local$Genotype)
  meta_local$Sex      <- as.character(meta_local$Sex)

  # --- outliers (optional) ---
  ol <- rep(FALSE, nrow(meta_local))
  if (isTRUE(drop_outliers) && "Outlier" %in% names(meta_local)) {
    ol2 <- meta_local$Outlier
    if (is.factor(ol2)) ol2 <- as.character(ol2)
    if (is.character(ol2)) {
      ol2 <- trimws(tolower(ol2)) %in% c("true","t","1","yes","y")
    } else if (is.numeric(ol2)) {
      ol2 <- ol2 != 0
    } else if (is.logical(ol2)) {
      ol2 <- ol2
    } else {
      ol2 <- as.logical(ol2)
    }
    ol <- ol2
  }

  # --- WT-only filter ---
  md0 <- meta_local %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      Genotype == "WT",
      Fraction %in% fraction_levels,
      is.na(ol) | !ol
    ) %>%
    droplevels()

  # align counts to WT metadata
  use.cols <- md0$Sample
  stopifnot(all(use.cols %in% colnames(counts)))
  test.data <- counts[, use.cols, drop = FALSE]

  # protein-coding only (by ENS rownames)
  stopifnot(all(c("gene_biotype", "gene_id") %in% colnames(my_gene)))

  counts_ids <- rownames(test.data)
  counts_ids_stripped <- sub("\\..*$", "", counts_ids)

  protein_coding_ids <- my_gene %>%
    dplyr::filter(gene_biotype == "protein_coding") %>%
    dplyr::pull(gene_id) %>%
    as.character() %>%
    sub("\\..*$", "", .) %>%
    unique()

  keep_pc <- counts_ids_stripped %in% protein_coding_ids
  test.data <- test.data[keep_pc, , drop = FALSE]

  # ensure metadata order matches columns
  md0 <- md0[match(colnames(test.data), md0$Sample), , drop = FALSE]
  stopifnot(identical(colnames(test.data), md0$Sample))

  # factors
  md0$Fraction <- factor(md0$Fraction, levels = fraction_levels)
  md0$Sex      <- factor(md0$Sex)

  # pick test fraction
  test_fraction <- norm_frac(test_fraction)[1]
  if (!test_fraction %in% fraction_levels) {
    stop("test_fraction must be one of: ", paste(fraction_levels, collapse = ", "))
  }

  dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  # helper: fit edgeR on a subset safely (counts + meta must match)
  fit_edgeR_subset <- function(counts_sub, md_sub) {
    md_sub <- md_sub[match(colnames(counts_sub), md_sub$Sample), , drop = FALSE]
    stopifnot(identical(colnames(counts_sub), md_sub$Sample))

    y <- edgeR::DGEList(counts = counts_sub, samples = md_sub)
    keep <- rowSums(edgeR::cpm(y) > min_cpm) >= min_samples
    y <- y[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
    y <- edgeR::calcNormFactors(y)

    if (isTRUE(include_sex)) {
      design <- model.matrix(~ Sex + Fraction, data = md_sub)
    } else {
      design <- model.matrix(~ Fraction, data = md_sub)
    }

    y <- edgeR::estimateGLMCommonDisp(y, design)
    y <- edgeR::estimateGLMTrendedDisp(y, design)
    y <- edgeR::estimateGLMTagwiseDisp(y, design)
    fit <- edgeR::glmFit(y, design)

    list(y = y, design = design, fit = fit)
  }

  # -----------------------------
  # MODE 1: test_fraction vs mean(others)
  # -----------------------------
  if (mode == "one_vs_mean_others") {
    others <- setdiff(fraction_levels, test_fraction)

    md_sub <- md0 %>% dplyr::filter(Fraction %in% c(test_fraction, others)) %>% droplevels()
    cols_sub <- md_sub$Sample
    counts_sub <- test.data[, cols_sub, drop = FALSE]

    # relevel so test_fraction is the reference
    md_sub$Fraction <- factor(as.character(md_sub$Fraction), levels = fraction_levels)
    md_sub$Fraction <- stats::relevel(md_sub$Fraction, ref = test_fraction)

    fitobj <- fit_edgeR_subset(counts_sub, md_sub)

    # contrast = test_fraction - mean(others)
    # With reference=test_fraction, coefficients are (Other - test).
    # So (test - mean(others)) = - mean(Other - test)
    coef_names <- colnames(fitobj$design)
    other_coef <- paste0("Fraction", others)
    other_coef <- other_coef[other_coef %in% coef_names]
    if (length(other_coef) != length(others)) {
      stop("Could not find all fraction coefficients. Design cols: ", paste(coef_names, collapse = ", "))
    }

    cvec <- rep(0, ncol(fitobj$design)); names(cvec) <- coef_names
    cvec[other_coef] <- -(1 / length(other_coef))  # negative gives test - mean(others)

    lrt <- edgeR::glmLRT(fitobj$fit, contrast = cvec)

    res <- edgeR::topTags(lrt, n = Inf)$table
    res$gene <- rownames(res); rownames(res) <- NULL
    res <- res[, c("gene","logFC","logCPM","LR","PValue","FDR")]

    out_csv <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(prefix, "_", tolower(test_fraction), "_vs_all.csv"))
    write.csv(res, out_csv, row.names = FALSE)

    message("Saved: ", out_csv,
            "  (contrast: ", test_fraction, " - mean(", paste(others, collapse = "+"), "))")

    return(invisible(list(
      mode = mode,
      test_fraction = test_fraction,
      meta_wt = md0,
      results = list(res = res, out_csv = out_csv, design = fitobj$design)
    )))
  }

  # -----------------------------
  # MODE 2: pairwise (test_fraction vs each compare_to)
  # logFC>0 means higher in test_fraction
  # -----------------------------
  compare_to <- norm_frac(compare_to)
  compare_to <- unique(compare_to)
  compare_to <- compare_to[compare_to %in% fraction_levels]
  compare_to <- setdiff(compare_to, test_fraction)

  if (length(compare_to) == 0) {
    stop("For mode='pairwise', compare_to must include at least one of: ",
         paste(setdiff(fraction_levels, test_fraction), collapse = ", "))
  }

  results <- list()

  for (other in compare_to) {
    md_sub <- md0 %>% dplyr::filter(Fraction %in% c(test_fraction, other)) %>% droplevels()
    cols_sub <- md_sub$Sample
    counts_sub <- test.data[, cols_sub, drop = FALSE]

    # set baseline = other so that Fraction<test_fraction> coefficient = (test - other)
    md_sub$Fraction <- factor(as.character(md_sub$Fraction), levels = c(other, test_fraction))
    md_sub$Fraction <- stats::relevel(md_sub$Fraction, ref = other)

    fitobj <- fit_edgeR_subset(counts_sub, md_sub)

    coef_name <- paste0("Fraction", test_fraction)
    if (!coef_name %in% colnames(fitobj$design)) {
      stop("Could not find coefficient ", coef_name,
           ". Design cols: ", paste(colnames(fitobj$design), collapse = ", "))
    }

    lrt <- edgeR::glmLRT(fitobj$fit, coef = coef_name)

    res <- edgeR::topTags(lrt, n = Inf)$table
    res$gene <- rownames(res); rownames(res) <- NULL
    res <- res[, c("gene","logFC","logCPM","LR","PValue","FDR")]

    out_csv <- file.path(out_dir,
                         paste0(prefix, "_", tolower(test_fraction),
                                "_vs_", tolower(other), ".csv"))
    write.csv(res, out_csv, row.names = FALSE)

    message("Saved: ", out_csv,
            "  (contrast: ", test_fraction, " - ", other, "; logFC>0 => higher in ", test_fraction, ")")

    results[[paste0(test_fraction, "_vs_", other)]] <- list(
      other = other,
      res = res,
      out_csv = out_csv,
      design = fitobj$design
    )
  }

  invisible(list(
    mode = mode,
    test_fraction = test_fraction,
    meta_wt = md0,
    results = results
  ))
}


```

```{r}
# GO function
run_GO_on_DE_file <- function(in_csv, outdir) {
  
  message("Running GO for: ", in_csv)
  
  de <- read_csv(in_csv, show_col_types = FALSE)

  # --- detect columns ---
  cols_low <- tolower(names(de))
  gene_col <- names(de)[match(TRUE, cols_low %in% c("gene","gene_name","symbol"))]
  fdr_col  <- names(de)[match(TRUE, cols_low %in% c("fdr","padj","p_adj","p.adjust","p_val_adj"))]
  p_col    <- names(de)[match(TRUE, cols_low %in% c("pvalue","p_val","p.val"))]
  lfc_col  <- names(de)[match(TRUE, cols_low %in% c("logfc","log2fc","log2foldchange","log_fc"))]

  stopifnot(!is.na(gene_col), !is.na(p_col), !is.na(lfc_col))

  de <- de %>%
    mutate(
      gene  = as.character(.data[[gene_col]]),
      puse  = as.numeric(.data[[p_col]]),
      logFC = as.numeric(.data[[lfc_col]])
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(gene), gene != "", !is.na(puse), !is.na(logFC))

  # DEG sets
  deg_up   <- de %>% filter(puse < 0.05, logFC > 0) %>% pull(gene) %>% unique()
  deg_down <- de %>% filter(puse < 0.05, logFC < 0) %>% pull(gene) %>% unique()

  # output names derived from filename
  base <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(in_csv))

  run_go(deg_up,   "up",
         out_dir_up   = file.path(outdir, paste0(base, "_BP_up.xlsx")))

  run_go(deg_down, "down",
         out_dir_down = file.path(outdir, paste0(base, "_BP_down.xlsx")))
}



# --- Syn ---
lapply(syn_files, run_GO_on_DE_file, outdir = outdir)

# --- Nuc ---
lapply(nuc_files, run_GO_on_DE_file, outdir = outdir)

# --- Cyt ---
lapply(cyt_files, run_GO_on_DE_file, outdir = outdir)
```

## GO heatmap for energetics terms

```{r}


# ---- function that builds + plots one heatmap ----
make_go_heatmap <- function(go_files, title_suffix) {

  clean_name <- function(x) {
    x <- basename(x)
    x <- sub("_BP_.*", "", x)
    x <- sub("simple_WT_", "", x)
    x
  }

  energetics_terms <- c(
    "electron transport",
    "ATP",
    "oxidative phosphorylation",
    "cellular respiration",
    "aerobic respiration"
  )

  # ---- 1. Read each GO table (full + top50) ----
  go_tables_full  <- list()
  go_tables_top50 <- list()

  for (fp in go_files) {
    contrast <- clean_name(fp)
    df <- readxl::read_xlsx(fp)

    df <- df %>%
      filter(str_detect(Description, regex(paste(energetics_terms, collapse = "|"), ignore_case = TRUE))) %>%
      arrange(p.adjust)

    go_tables_full[[contrast]]  <- df
    go_tables_top50[[contrast]] <- df %>% slice_head(n = 50)
  }

  # ---- 2. Union of GO terms appearing in any top50 ----
  all_terms <- unique(unlist(lapply(go_tables_top50, function(df) df$Description)))

  # ---- 3. Initialize matrix ----
  contrasts <- names(go_tables_full)
  mat <- matrix(NA_real_,
                nrow = length(all_terms),
                ncol = length(contrasts),
                dimnames = list(all_terms, contrasts))

  # ---- 4. Fill matrix ----
  for (term in all_terms) {
    for (con in contrasts) {

      hit <- go_tables_top50[[con]] %>%
        filter(Description == term) %>%
        pull(p.adjust)

      if (length(hit) == 0) {
        hit <- go_tables_full[[con]] %>%
          filter(Description == term) %>%
          pull(p.adjust)
      }

      if (length(hit) == 0 || is.na(hit)) {
        mat[term, con] <- 0
      } else {
        mat[term, con] <- min(-log10(hit), 10)
      }
    }
  }

  # ---- 5. Plot ----
  pheatmap::pheatmap(
    mat,
    color = viridis(100),
    cluster_rows = TRUE,
    cluster_cols = TRUE,
    border_color = NA,
    main = paste("Energetics-related GO terms - WT-only", title_suffix),
    fontsize_row = 9,
    fontsize_col = 10
  )
}


# =========================
# ---- UP heatmap ----
# =========================
go_files_up <- c(
  "output/GO/final_DE/simple_WT_syn_vs_all_BP_up.xlsx",
  "output/GO/final_DE/simple_WT_syn_vs_nuc_BP_up.xlsx",
  "output/GO/final_DE/simple_WT_syn_vs_cyt_BP_up.xlsx",
  "output/GO/final_DE/simple_WT_nuc_vs_all_BP_up.xlsx",
  "output/GO/final_DE/simple_WT_nuc_vs_syn_BP_up.xlsx",
  "output/GO/final_DE/simple_WT_nuc_vs_cyt_BP_up.xlsx",
  "output/GO/final_DE/simple_WT_cyt_vs_all_BP_up.xlsx",
```

```{r}
## --- WT-only universe in ENSEMBL space ---
wt_samples <- metadata_const_syn_nuc_cyt %>%
  dplyr::filter(Genotype == "WT") %>%
  pull(Sample)

wt_samples <- intersect(wt_samples, colnames(exp_data_const_syn_nuc_cyt))

## --- Only the __vs_all DE tables ---
vs_all_files <- c(
  "output/DE/simple_WT_syn_vs_all.csv",
  "output/DE/simple_WT_nuc_vs_all.csv",
  "output/DE/simple_WT_cyt_vs_all.csv"
)

outdir <- "output/GSEA/final_DE"
dir.create(outdir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)


run_GSEA_on_DE_file <- function(in_csv, outdir, universe_ens) {
  
  message("Running GSEA for: ", in_csv)
  
  de <- read_csv(in_csv, show_col_types = FALSE)
  
  ## --- detect columns ---
  cols_low <- tolower(names(de))
  gene_col <- names(de)[match(TRUE, cols_low %in% c("gene","gene_name","symbol","ensembl"))]
  p_col    <- names(de)[match(TRUE, cols_low %in% c("pvalue","p_val","p.val"))]
  lfc_col  <- names(de)[match(TRUE, cols_low %in% c("logfc","log2fc","log2foldchange","log_fc"))]
  
  stopifnot(!is.na(gene_col), !is.na(p_col), !is.na(lfc_col))
  
  de <- de %>%
    mutate(
      gene  = as.character(.data[[gene_col]]),
      gene  = sub("\\.[0-9]+$", "", gene),
      puse  = as.numeric(.data[[p_col]]),
      logFC = as.numeric(.data[[lfc_col]])
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(gene), gene != "", !is.na(puse), !is.na(logFC)) %>%
    filter(gene %in% universe_ens)
  
  message("Genes remaining after universe filter: ", nrow(de))
  print(head(de$gene))
  
  base <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(in_csv))
  
  gsea_go_bp(
    de = de,
    gene_col = "gene",
    p_col = "puse",
    lfc_col = "logFC",
    keyType = "ENSEMBL",
    out_prefix = file.path(outdir, base)
  )
}


lapply(vs_all_files, run_GSEA_on_DE_file, outdir = outdir, universe_ens = universe_ens)
```
