# 8. DE Comparisons

### Function for density plots

```{r}

compare_groups_plot <- function(
  x_group, y_group,
  fp_x, fp_y,
  FDR_padj_xy,
  filter_mode = c("x_only", "y_only", "both"),
  max_bound = 1.0,
  df_pval_save_fp = NULL,
  df_fdr_save_fp = NULL,
  p_value = 0.05,        # p-value cutoff
  plot_pval_only = FALSE,# pval-only: show red density of ALL genes + black dots for p<cutoff (either)
  no_filt = FALSE,       # if TRUE, don't filter by pvalue/fdr; use custom_genes instead
  custom_genes = NULL,   # vector of genes to plot when no_filt=TRUE
  mode = c("concordance", "regression")
) {

  mode <- match.arg(mode)

  load_and_rename <- function(fp, group, is_y_group = FALSE) {
    df <- read.csv(fp, check.names = FALSE)

    group_lower <- tolower(group)
    is_pseudo <- all(c("gene", "log2FoldChange", "pvalue", "padj", "baseMean") %in% colnames(df))

    if (is_pseudo) {
      needed <- c("gene", "log2FoldChange", "pvalue", "padj", "baseMean")
      miss <- setdiff(needed, colnames(df))
      if (length(miss)) {
        stop(
          "Missing expected DESeq2/pseudobulk columns in: ", fp,
          "\nMissing: ", paste(miss, collapse = ", "),
          "\nHave: ", paste(colnames(df), collapse = ", ")
        )
      }
    
      # Pb expression filters
      keep <- !is.na(df$baseMean) & df$baseMean > 10 & log2(df$baseMean + 1) > 1
      df <- df[keep, , drop = FALSE]
    
      df <- df %>%
        dplyr::select(gene, log2FoldChange, pvalue, padj, baseMean) %>%
        dplyr::rename(
          gene   = gene,
          logfc  = log2FoldChange,
          pvalue = pvalue,
          fdr    = padj
        ) %>%
        dplyr::rename_with(~paste0(.x, "_", group_lower), c("logfc", "pvalue", "fdr"))
    
      if (is_y_group) df <- df %>% dplyr::mutate(logCPM = log2(baseMean + 1))
    } else {

      colnames(df) <- tolower(colnames(df))

      gene_col <- dplyr::case_when(
        "gene_name" %in% colnames(df) ~ "gene_name",
        "gene" %in% colnames(df) ~ "gene",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )

      logfc_col <- dplyr::case_when(
        "logfc" %in% colnames(df) ~ "logfc",
        "log2fc" %in% colnames(df) ~ "log2fc",
        "log2foldchange" %in% colnames(df) ~ "log2foldchange",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )

      pval_col <- dplyr::case_when(
        "pvalue" %in% colnames(df) ~ "pvalue",
        "pval" %in% colnames(df) ~ "pval",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )

      fdr_col <- dplyr::case_when(
        "fdr" %in% colnames(df) ~ "fdr",
        "padj" %in% colnames(df) ~ "padj",
        "adjp" %in% colnames(df) ~ "adjp",
        "qvalue" %in% colnames(df) ~ "qvalue",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )

      if (is.na(gene_col) || is.na(logfc_col) || is.na(pval_col) || is.na(fdr_col)) {
        stop(
          "Missing expected edgeR/simple columns in: ", fp, "\n",
          "Need gene/logFC/pvalue/FDR (allowing common variants).\n",
          "Detected: gene=", gene_col, " logFC=", logfc_col, " p=", pval_col, " fdr=", fdr_col, "\n",
          "Have: ", paste(colnames(df), collapse = ", ")
        )
      }

      df <- df %>%
        dplyr::rename(
          gene   = dplyr::all_of(gene_col),
          logfc  = dplyr::all_of(logfc_col),
          pvalue = dplyr::all_of(pval_col),
          fdr    = dplyr::all_of(fdr_col)
        ) %>%
        dplyr::rename_with(~paste0(.x, "_", group_lower), c("logfc", "pvalue", "fdr"))

      if ("logcpm" %in% colnames(df)) df <- df %>% dplyr::rename(logCPM = logcpm)
      else df$logCPM <- NA_real_
    }

    df %>% dplyr::distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE)
  }

  safe_cor <- function(x, y) {
    ok <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(y)
    x <- x[ok]; y <- y[ok]
    if (length(x) < 2) return(NA_real_)
    if (stats::sd(x) == 0 || stats::sd(y) == 0) return(NA_real_)
    stats::cor(x, y)
  }

  calc_concordance <- function(x, y) {
    ok <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(y)
    x <- x[ok]; y <- y[ok]
    if (length(x) == 0) return(NA_real_)

    q1 <- sum(x > 0 & y > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
    q2 <- sum(x < 0 & y > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
    q3 <- sum(x < 0 & y < 0, na.rm = TRUE)
    q4 <- sum(x > 0 & y < 0, na.rm = TRUE)

    ((q1 + q3) - (q2 + q4)) / length(x)
  }

  make_stat_label <- function(x, y) {
    if (mode == "regression") {
      val <- round(safe_cor(x, y), 2)
      paste0("R = ", val)
    } else {
      val <- round(calc_concordance(x, y), 2)
      paste0("C = ", val)
    }
  }

  df_x <- load_and_rename(fp_x, x_group, is_y_group = FALSE)
  df_y <- load_and_rename(fp_y, y_group, is_y_group = TRUE)


  merged_data <- merge(df_y, df_x, by = "gene")

  pval_x  <- paste0("pvalue_", tolower(x_group))
  pval_y  <- paste0("pvalue_", tolower(y_group))
  fdr_x   <- paste0("fdr_", tolower(x_group))
  fdr_y   <- paste0("fdr_", tolower(y_group))
  logFC_x <- paste0("logfc_", tolower(x_group))
  logFC_y <- paste0("logfc_", tolower(y_group))

  merged_data <- merged_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      !is.na(.data[[logFC_x]]), !is.na(.data[[logFC_y]])
      #abs(.data[[logFC_x]]) <= 2.5,
      #abs(.data[[logFC_y]]) <= 2.5
    )

  filter_mode <- match.arg(filter_mode)

  if (isTRUE(no_filt)) {
    if (is.null(custom_genes)) stop("no_filt=TRUE requires custom_genes (vector of gene symbols).")

    df_all <- merged_data %>%
      dplyr::filter(.data[["gene"]] %in% custom_genes)
      #%>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[logFC_x]]), !is.na(.data[[logFC_y]]),.data[[logFC_x]] != 0, .data[[logFC_y]] != 0)  # add back to require genes have non-zero logFC in both datasets

    if (nrow(df_all) == 0) {
      warning("No data to plot after custom_genes filtering. Returning empty plot.")
      return(list(
        merged_data = merged_data,
        plot = ggplot2::ggplot() + ggplot2::theme_void() +
          ggplot2::labs(title = paste(x_group, "vs", y_group), subtitle = "No data after filtering")
      ))
    }

    df_pval <- df_all
    df_fdr <- df_all %>%
      #dplyr::filter(.data[[fdr_x]] < FDR_padj_xy | .data[[fdr_y]] < FDR_padj_xy) # For red = pval passing, black = FDR passing
      dplyr::filter(.data[[pval_x]] < p_value | .data[[pval_y]] < p_value) # For red = ALL genes in custom set, black = of those, pval-passing in groups being compared.

  } else {

    if (filter_mode == "x_only") {
      df_pval <- merged_data %>% dplyr::filter(.data[[pval_x]] < p_value)
      df_fdr  <- merged_data %>% dplyr::filter(.data[[fdr_x]] < FDR_padj_xy)
    } else if (filter_mode == "y_only") {
      df_pval <- merged_data %>% dplyr::filter(.data[[pval_y]] < p_value)
      df_fdr  <- merged_data %>% dplyr::filter(.data[[fdr_y]] < FDR_padj_xy)
    } else {
      df_pval <- merged_data %>% dplyr::filter(.data[[pval_x]] < p_value | .data[[pval_y]] < p_value)
      df_fdr  <- merged_data %>% dplyr::filter(.data[[fdr_x]] < FDR_padj_xy | .data[[fdr_y]] < FDR_padj_xy)
    }
  }

  if (!is.null(df_pval_save_fp)) {
    message("Saving df_pval dataframe to: ", df_pval_save_fp)
    write.csv(df_pval, df_pval_save_fp, row.names = FALSE)
  }

  if (!is.null(df_fdr_save_fp)) {
    message("Saving df_fdr dataframe to: ", df_fdr_save_fp)
    write.csv(df_fdr, df_fdr_save_fp, row.names = FALSE)
  }

  calculate_quadrant_counts <- function(data, col1, col2) {
    c(
      sum(data[[col1]] > 0 & data[[col2]] > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      sum(data[[col1]] < 0 & data[[col2]] > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      sum(data[[col1]] < 0 & data[[col2]] < 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      sum(data[[col1]] > 0 & data[[col2]] < 0, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  }

  quadrant_counts <- calculate_quadrant_counts(df_pval, logFC_x, logFC_y)
  quadrant_counts_black <- calculate_quadrant_counts(df_fdr, logFC_x, logFC_y)

  x_is_pseudo <- all(c("gene", "log2FoldChange", "pvalue", "padj", "baseMean") %in% colnames(read.csv(fp_x, check.names = FALSE)))
  y_is_pseudo <- all(c("gene", "log2FoldChange", "pvalue", "padj", "baseMean") %in% colnames(read.csv(fp_y, check.names = FALSE)))
  is_any_pseudo <- x_is_pseudo || y_is_pseudo

  subtitle_text <- if (is_any_pseudo) {
    paste0(
      "<span style='color:indianred2'>Pvalue < ", p_value, " (n = ", nrow(df_pval), ")</span><br>",
      "<span style='color:black'>Padj < ", FDR_padj_xy, " (n = ", nrow(df_fdr), ")</span>"
    )
  } else {
    paste0(
      "<span style='color:indianred2'>Pvalue < ", p_value, " (n = ", nrow(df_pval), ")</span><br>",
      "<span style='color:black'>FDR < ", FDR_padj_xy, " (n = ", nrow(df_fdr), ")</span>"
    )
  }
  
  if (isTRUE(no_filt) && !is.null(custom_genes)) {
      subtitle_text <- paste0(
        "<span style='color:indianred2'>All genes (n = ", nrow(df_pval), ")</span><br>",
        "<span style='color:black'>Pvalue &lt; ", p_value, " in either dataset (n = ", nrow(df_fdr), ")</span>"
      )
    }  # ^ COMMENT THIS WHOLE if STATEMENT OUT IF YOU WANT RED= PVAL PASSING, BLACK = FDR PASSING for custom gene set

  if (isTRUE(plot_pval_only)) {
    if (isTRUE(no_filt) && !is.null(custom_genes)) {
      subtitle_text <- paste0(
        "<span style='color:indianred2'>all (n = ", nrow(df_pval), ")</span><br>",
        "<span style='color:black'>p&lt;", p_value, " either (n = ", nrow(df_fdr), ")</span>"
      )
    } else {
      subtitle_text <- paste0(
        "<span style='color:black'>Pvalue &lt; ", p_value, " (n = ", nrow(df_pval), ")</span><br>"
      )
    }
  }

  if (nrow(df_pval) == 0) {
    warning("No data to plot after p-value filtering. Returning empty plot.")
    return(list(
      merged_data = merged_data,
      plot = ggplot2::ggplot() + ggplot2::theme_void() +
        ggplot2::labs(title = paste(x_group, "vs", y_group), subtitle = "No data after filtering")
    ))
  }

  inner1 <- max_bound - 0.1
  inner2 <- max_bound - 0.15
  annot1 <- max_bound - 0.12
  annot2 <- max_bound - 0.26
  annot3 <- max_bound - 0.01
  few_fdr_n <- 15L

  r_y_shift <- if (isTRUE(all.equal(max_bound, 1))) 0.05 else 0
  r_y_sep   <- if (isTRUE(all.equal(max_bound, 1))) 0.12 else 0.17
  label_x_in <- if (isTRUE(all.equal(max_bound, 1.5))) 0.02 else 0

  r_y_nudge_red   <- if (isTRUE(all.equal(max_bound, 2))) 0.11 else 0
  r_y_nudge_black <- if (isTRUE(all.equal(max_bound, 2))) 0.19 else 0

  dash_nudge_h <- if (isTRUE(all.equal(max_bound, 2))) 0.02 else 0
  dash_nudge_v <- if (isTRUE(all.equal(max_bound, 2))) 0.03 else 0
  inner2 <- inner2 - dash_nudge_h
  inner1 <- inner1 - dash_nudge_v

  if (isTRUE(all.equal(max_bound, 1))) {
    inner2 <- inner2 + 0.03
  }

  if (isTRUE(all.equal(max_bound, 1.5))) {
    inner1 <- inner1 - 0.02
  }

  dens_fill_scale <- ggplot2::scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "white", high = "red",
    name = "Density",
    limits = c(0, 10),
    oob = scales::squish
  )

  if (isTRUE(plot_pval_only)) {

    stat_red <- make_stat_label(df_pval[[logFC_y]], df_pval[[logFC_x]])
    show_black_r <- nrow(df_fdr) >= 3
    stat_black <- if (show_black_r) make_stat_label(df_fdr[[logFC_y]], df_fdr[[logFC_x]]) else NA_character_

    quadrant_counts_black <- calculate_quadrant_counts(df_fdr, logFC_x, logFC_y)

    plot_combined <- ggplot2::ggplot(df_pval, ggplot2::aes_string(x = logFC_x, y = logFC_y)) +
      ggplot2::geom_bin2d(bins = 70) +
      dens_fill_scale +
      ggplot2::geom_point(
        data = df_fdr,
        ggplot2::aes_string(x = logFC_x, y = logFC_y),
        inherit.aes = FALSE,
        size = 1.2, alpha = 0.5, color = "black"
      ) +
      ggplot2::geom_segment(ggplot2::aes(x = -max_bound, xend = max_bound, y = -inner2, yend = -inner2), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
      ggplot2::geom_segment(ggplot2::aes(x = -max_bound, xend = max_bound, y = inner2, yend = inner2), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
      ggplot2::geom_segment(ggplot2::aes(x = -inner1, xend = -inner1, y = -max_bound, yend = max_bound), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
      ggplot2::geom_segment(ggplot2::aes(x = inner1, xend = inner1, y = -max_bound, yend = max_bound), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
      ggplot2::geom_segment(ggplot2::aes(x = -max_bound, xend = max_bound, y = 0, yend = 0), color = "black") +
      ggplot2::geom_segment(ggplot2::aes(x = 0, xend = 0, y = -max_bound, yend = max_bound), color = "black") +
      ggplot2::geom_rect(xmin = -max_bound, xmax = max_bound, ymin = -max_bound, ymax = max_bound, color = "black", fill = NA) +
      ggplot2::geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
      ggplot2::annotate(
        "text",
        x = -annot1 + label_x_in,
        y = (annot2 - 0.13 - r_y_nudge_red + r_y_shift),
        label = stat_red,
        size = 6, hjust = 0, color = "indianred2"
      ) +
      {if (show_black_r)
        ggplot2::annotate(
          "text",
          x = -annot1 + label_x_in,
          y = (annot2 - 0.13 - r_y_sep - r_y_nudge_black + r_y_shift),
          label = stat_black,
          size = 6, hjust = 0, color = "black"
        )
      } +
      ggplot2::annotate("text", x = (annot1 - label_x_in),  y = annot3,  label = paste("n =", quadrant_counts[1]), hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 5.25, color = "indianred2") +
      ggplot2::annotate("text", x = (-annot1 + label_x_in), y = annot3,  label = paste("n =", quadrant_counts[2]), hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 5.25, color = "indianred2") +
      ggplot2::annotate("text", x = (-annot1 + label_x_in), y = -annot3, label = paste("n =", quadrant_counts[3]), hjust = 0, vjust = 0, size = 5.25, color = "indianred2") +
      ggplot2::annotate("text", x = (annot1 - label_x_in),  y = -annot3, label = paste("n =", quadrant_counts[4]), hjust = 1, vjust = 0, size = 5.25, color = "indianred2") +
      ggplot2::annotate(
        "text", x = (annot1 - label_x_in),
        y = (annot3 - if (isTRUE(all.equal(max_bound, 2))) 0.18 else 0.14),
        label = paste("n =", quadrant_counts_black[1]), hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 5.25, color = "black"
      ) +
      ggplot2::annotate(
        "text", x = (-annot1 + label_x_in),
        y = (annot3 - if (isTRUE(all.equal(max_bound, 2))) 0.18 else 0.14),
        label = paste("n =", quadrant_counts_black[2]), hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 5.25, color = "black"
      ) +
      ggplot2::annotate(
        "text", x = (-annot1 + label_x_in),
        y = (-annot3 + if (isTRUE(all.equal(max_bound, 2))) 0.18 else 0.14),
        label = paste("n =", quadrant_counts_black[3]), hjust = 0, vjust = 0, size = 5.25, color = "black"
      ) +
      ggplot2::annotate(
        "text", x = (annot1 - label_x_in),
        y = (-annot3 + if (isTRUE(all.equal(max_bound, 2))) 0.18 else 0.14),
        label = paste("n =", quadrant_counts_black[4]), hjust = 1, vjust = 0, size = 5.25, color = "black"
      ) +
      ggplot2::labs(
        title = paste(x_group, "vs", y_group),
        subtitle = subtitle_text,
        x = paste0("logFC_", tolower(x_group)),
        y = paste0("logFC_", tolower(y_group))
      ) +
      ggplot2::theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
      ggplot2::theme(
        panel.background = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
        plot.background  = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
        panel.grid = ggplot2::element_blank(),
        axis.line  = ggplot2::element_line(color = "black"),
        axis.ticks = ggplot2::element_line(color = "black"),
        axis.text  = ggplot2::element_text(color = "black"),
        axis.title = ggplot2::element_text(color = "black"),
        plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(color = "black"),
        plot.subtitle = ggtext::element_markdown(size = 20),
        legend.text  = ggplot2::element_text(color = "black"),
        legend.title = ggplot2::element_text(color = "black"),
        legend.background = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
        legend.key = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
      ) +
      ggplot2::coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-max_bound, max_bound), ylim = c(-max_bound, max_bound), expand = FALSE)

  } else if (isTRUE(no_filt)) {

    stat_red <- make_stat_label(df_pval[[logFC_y]], df_pval[[logFC_x]])
    show_black_r <- nrow(df_fdr) >= 3
    stat_black <- if (show_black_r) make_stat_label(df_fdr[[logFC_y]], df_fdr[[logFC_x]]) else NA_character_

    plot_combined <- ggplot2::ggplot(df_pval, ggplot2::aes_string(x = logFC_x, y = logFC_y)) +
      ggplot2::geom_bin2d(bins = 70) +
      dens_fill_scale +
      ggplot2::geom_point(
        data = df_fdr,
        ggplot2::aes_string(x = logFC_x, y = logFC_y),
        inherit.aes = FALSE,
        size = 1.2, alpha = 0.75, color = "black"
      ) +
      ggplot2::geom_segment(ggplot2::aes(x = -max_bound, xend = max_bound, y = -inner2, yend = -inner2), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
      ggplot2::geom_segment(ggplot2::aes(x = -max_bound, xend = max_bound, y = inner2, yend = inner2), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
      ggplot2::geom_segment(ggplot2::aes(x = -inner1, xend = -inner1, y = -max_bound, yend = max_bound), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
      ggplot2::geom_segment(ggplot2::aes(x = inner1, xend = inner1, y = -max_bound, yend = max_bound), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
      ggplot2::geom_segment(ggplot2::aes(x = -max_bound, xend = max_bound, y = 0, yend = 0), color = "black") +
      ggplot2::geom_segment(ggplot2::aes(x = 0, xend = 0, y = -max_bound, yend = max_bound), color = "black") +
      ggplot2::geom_rect(xmin = -max_bound, xmax = max_bound, ymin = -max_bound, ymax = max_bound, color = "black", fill = NA) +
      {if (mode == "regression")
        ggplot2::geom_smooth(
          data = df_fdr,
          ggplot2::aes_string(x = logFC_x, y = logFC_y),
          method = "lm", se = TRUE,
          color = "black", fill = "black", alpha = 0.15,
          inherit.aes = FALSE
        )
      } +
      ggplot2::geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
      ggplot2::annotate(
        "text",
        x = -annot1 + label_x_in,
        y = (annot2 - 0.13 - r_y_nudge_red + r_y_shift),
        label = stat_red,
        size = 7.5, hjust = 0, color = "indianred2"
      ) +
      {if (show_black_r)
        ggplot2::annotate(
          "text",
          x = -annot1 + label_x_in,
          y = (annot2 - 0.13 - r_y_sep - r_y_nudge_black + r_y_shift),
          label = stat_black,
          size = 7.5, hjust = 0, color = "black"
        )
      } +
      ggplot2::annotate("text", x = (annot1 - label_x_in),  y = annot3,  label = paste("n =", quadrant_counts[1]), hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 7, color = "indianred2") +
      ggplot2::annotate("text", x = (-annot1 + label_x_in), y = annot3,  label = paste("n =", quadrant_counts[2]), hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 7, color = "indianred2") +
      ggplot2::annotate("text", x = (-annot1 + label_x_in), y = -annot3, label = paste("n =", quadrant_counts[3]), hjust = 0, vjust = 0, size = 7, color = "indianred2") +
      ggplot2::annotate("text", x = (annot1 - label_x_in),  y = -annot3, label = paste("n =", quadrant_counts[4]), hjust = 1, vjust = 0, size = 7, color = "indianred2") +
      ggplot2::annotate(
        "text", x = (annot1 - label_x_in),
        y = (annot3 - if (isTRUE(all.equal(max_bound, 2))) 0.18 else 0.14),
        label = paste("n =", quadrant_counts_black[1]), hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 6.25, color = "black"
      ) +
      ggplot2::annotate(
        "text", x = (-annot1 + label_x_in),
        y = (annot3 - if (isTRUE(all.equal(max_bound, 2))) 0.18 else 0.14),
        label = paste("n =", quadrant_counts_black[2]), hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 6.25, color = "black"
      ) +
      ggplot2::annotate(
        "text", x = (-annot1 + label_x_in),
        y = (-annot3 + if (isTRUE(all.equal(max_bound, 2))) 0.18 else 0.14),
        label = paste("n =", quadrant_counts_black[3]), hjust = 0, vjust = 0, size = 6.25, color = "black"
      ) +
      ggplot2::annotate(
        "text", x = (annot1 - label_x_in),
        y = (-annot3 + if (isTRUE(all.equal(max_bound, 2))) 0.18 else 0.14),
        label = paste("n =", quadrant_counts_black[4]), hjust = 1, vjust = 0, size = 6.25, color = "black"
      ) +
      ggplot2::labs(
        title = paste(x_group, "vs", y_group),
        subtitle = subtitle_text,
        x = paste0("logFC_", tolower(x_group)),
        y = paste0("logFC_", tolower(y_group))
      ) +
      ggplot2::theme_classic(base_size = 18) +
      ggplot2::theme(
        panel.background = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
        plot.background  = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
        panel.grid = ggplot2::element_blank(),
        axis.line  = ggplot2::element_line(color = "black"),
        axis.ticks = ggplot2::element_line(color = "black"),
        axis.text  = ggplot2::element_text(color = "black"),
        axis.title = ggplot2::element_text(color = "black"),
        plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(color = "black"),
        plot.subtitle = ggtext::element_markdown(size = 20),
        legend.text  = ggplot2::element_text(color = "black"),
        legend.title = ggplot2::element_text(color = "black"),
        legend.background = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
        legend.key = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
      ) +
      ggplot2::coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-max_bound, max_bound), ylim = c(-max_bound, max_bound), expand = FALSE)

  } else if (nrow(df_fdr) < few_fdr_n) {

    stat_red <- make_stat_label(df_pval[[logFC_y]], df_pval[[logFC_x]])

    plot_combined <- ggplot2::ggplot(df_pval, ggplot2::aes_string(x = logFC_x, y = logFC_y)) +
      ggplot2::geom_bin2d(bins = 70) +
      dens_fill_scale +
      ggplot2::geom_point(
        data = df_fdr,
        ggplot2::aes_string(x = logFC_x, y = logFC_y),
        inherit.aes = FALSE,
        size = 1.2, alpha = 0.75, color = "black"
      ) +
      ggplot2::geom_segment(ggplot2::aes(x = -max_bound, xend = max_bound, y = -inner2, yend = -inner2), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
      ggplot2::geom_segment(ggplot2::aes(x = -max_bound, xend = max_bound, y = inner2, yend = inner2), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
      ggplot2::geom_segment(ggplot2::aes(x = -inner1, xend = -inner1, y = -max_bound, yend = max_bound), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
      ggplot2::geom_segment(ggplot2::aes(x = inner1, xend = inner1, y = -max_bound, yend = max_bound), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
      ggplot2::geom_segment(ggplot2::aes(x = -max_bound, xend = max_bound, y = 0, yend = 0), color = "black") +
      ggplot2::geom_segment(ggplot2::aes(x = 0, xend = 0, y = -max_bound, yend = max_bound), color = "black") +
      ggplot2::geom_rect(xmin = -max_bound, xmax = max_bound, ymin = -max_bound, ymax = max_bound, color = "black", fill = NA) +
      ggplot2::geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
      ggplot2::annotate("text", x = (-annot1 + label_x_in), y = (annot2 - r_y_nudge_red), label = stat_red, size = 7.5, hjust = 0, color = "indianred2") +
      ggplot2::annotate("text", x = (annot1 - label_x_in),  y = annot3,  label = paste("n =", quadrant_counts[1]), hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 7, color = "indianred2") +
      ggplot2::annotate("text", x = (-annot1 + label_x_in), y = annot3,  label = paste("n =", quadrant_counts[2]), hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 7, color = "indianred2") +
      ggplot2::annotate("text", x = (-annot1 + label_x_in), y = -annot3, label = paste("n =", quadrant_counts[3]), hjust = 0, vjust = 0, size = 7, color = "indianred2") +
      ggplot2::annotate("text", x = (annot1 - label_x_in),  y = -annot3, label = paste("n =", quadrant_counts[4]), hjust = 1, vjust = 0, size = 7, color = "indianred2") +
      ggplot2::labs(
        title = paste(x_group, "vs", y_group),
        subtitle = subtitle_text,
        x = paste0("logFC_", tolower(x_group)),
        y = paste0("logFC_", tolower(y_group))
      ) +
      ggplot2::theme_classic(base_size = 18) +
      ggplot2::theme(
        panel.background = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
        plot.background  = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
        panel.grid = ggplot2::element_blank(),
        axis.line  = ggplot2::element_line(color = "black"),
        axis.ticks = ggplot2::element_line(color = "black"),
        axis.text  = ggplot2::element_text(color = "black"),
        axis.title = ggplot2::element_text(color = "black"),
        plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(color = "black"),
        plot.subtitle = ggtext::element_markdown(size = 20),
        legend.text  = ggplot2::element_text(color = "black"),
        legend.title = ggplot2::element_text(color = "black"),
        legend.background = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
        legend.key = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
      ) +
      ggplot2::coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-max_bound, max_bound), ylim = c(-max_bound, max_bound), expand = FALSE)

  } else {

    stat_black <- make_stat_label(df_fdr[[logFC_y]], df_fdr[[logFC_x]])
    stat_red   <- make_stat_label(df_pval[[logFC_y]], df_pval[[logFC_x]])

    plot_combined <- ggplot2::ggplot(df_pval, ggplot2::aes_string(x = logFC_x, y = logFC_y)) +
      ggplot2::geom_bin2d(bins = 70) +
      dens_fill_scale +
      ggplot2::geom_point(
        data = df_fdr,
        ggplot2::aes_string(x = logFC_x, y = logFC_y),
        inherit.aes = FALSE,
        size = 1.2, alpha = 0.75, color = "black"
      ) +
      ggplot2::geom_segment(ggplot2::aes(x = -max_bound, xend = max_bound, y = -inner2, yend = -inner2), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
      ggplot2::geom_segment(ggplot2::aes(x = -max_bound, xend = max_bound, y = inner2, yend = inner2), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
      ggplot2::geom_segment(ggplot2::aes(x = -inner1, xend = -inner1, y = -max_bound, yend = max_bound), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
      ggplot2::geom_segment(ggplot2::aes(x = inner1, xend = inner1, y = -max_bound, yend = max_bound), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
      ggplot2::geom_segment(ggplot2::aes(x = -max_bound, xend = max_bound, y = 0, yend = 0), color = "black") +
      ggplot2::geom_segment(ggplot2::aes(x = 0, xend = 0, y = -max_bound, yend = max_bound), color = "black") +
      ggplot2::geom_rect(xmin = -max_bound, xmax = max_bound, ymin = -max_bound, ymax = max_bound, color = "black", fill = NA) +
      ggplot2::geom_smooth(
        data = df_fdr,
        ggplot2::aes_string(x = logFC_x, y = logFC_y),
        method = "lm", se = TRUE,
        color = "black", fill = "black", alpha = 0.15,
        inherit.aes = FALSE
      ) +
      ggplot2::geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
      ggplot2::annotate(
        "text",
        x = -annot1 + label_x_in,
        y = (annot2 - 0.13 - r_y_nudge_red + r_y_shift),
        label = stat_red,
        size = 7.5, hjust = 0, color = "indianred2"
      ) +
      ggplot2::annotate(
        "text",
        x = -annot1 + label_x_in,
        y = (annot2 - 0.13 - r_y_sep - r_y_nudge_black + r_y_shift),
        label = stat_black,
        size = 7.5, hjust = 0, color = "black"
      ) +
      ggplot2::annotate("text", x = (annot1 - label_x_in),  y = annot3,  label = paste("n =", quadrant_counts[1]), hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 7, color = "indianred2") +
      ggplot2::annotate("text", x = (-annot1 + label_x_in), y = annot3,  label = paste("n =", quadrant_counts[2]), hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 7, color = "indianred2") +
      ggplot2::annotate("text", x = (-annot1 + label_x_in), y = -annot3, label = paste("n =", quadrant_counts[3]), hjust = 0, vjust = 0, size = 7, color = "indianred2") +
      ggplot2::annotate("text", x = (annot1 - label_x_in),  y = -annot3, label = paste("n =", quadrant_counts[4]), hjust = 1, vjust = 0, size = 7, color = "indianred2") +
      ggplot2::annotate(
        "text", x = (annot1 - label_x_in),
        y = (annot3 - if (isTRUE(all.equal(max_bound, 2))) 0.18 else 0.14),
        label = paste("n =", quadrant_counts_black[1]), hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 6.25, color = "black"
      ) +
      ggplot2::annotate(
        "text", x = (-annot1 + label_x_in),
        y = (annot3 - if (isTRUE(all.equal(max_bound, 2))) 0.18 else 0.14),
        label = paste("n =", quadrant_counts_black[2]), hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 6.25, color = "black"
      ) +
      ggplot2::annotate(
        "text", x = (-annot1 + label_x_in),
        y = (-annot3 + if (isTRUE(all.equal(max_bound, 2))) 0.18 else 0.14),
        label = paste("n =", quadrant_counts_black[3]), hjust = 0, vjust = 0, size = 6.25, color = "black"
      ) +
      ggplot2::annotate(
        "text", x = (annot1 - label_x_in),
        y = (-annot3 + if (isTRUE(all.equal(max_bound, 2))) 0.18 else 0.14),
        label = paste("n =", quadrant_counts_black[4]), hjust = 1, vjust = 0, size = 6.25, color = "black"
      ) +
      ggplot2::labs(
        title = paste(x_group, "vs", y_group),
        subtitle = subtitle_text,
        x = paste0("logFC_", tolower(x_group)),
        y = paste0("logFC_", tolower(y_group))
      ) +
      ggplot2::theme_classic(base_size = 18) +
      ggplot2::theme(
        panel.background = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
        plot.background  = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
        panel.grid = ggplot2::element_blank(),
        axis.line  = ggplot2::element_line(color = "black"),
        axis.ticks = ggplot2::element_line(color = "black"),
        axis.text  = ggplot2::element_text(color = "black"),
        axis.title = ggplot2::element_text(color = "black"),
        plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(color = "black"),
        plot.subtitle = ggtext::element_markdown(size = 20),
        legend.text  = ggplot2::element_text(color = "black"),
        legend.title = ggplot2::element_text(color = "black"),
        legend.background = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
        legend.key = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
      ) +
      ggplot2::coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-max_bound, max_bound), ylim = c(-max_bound, max_bound), expand = FALSE)
  }

  list(merged_data = merged_data, plot = plot_combined)
}
```

## Genes DISCORDANT between syn/nuc in cyt vs syn

```{r}

# First: run the syn vs nuc comparison
syn_nuc_res <- compare_groups_plot(
  x_group = "Const_syn",
  y_group = "Const_nuc",
  fp_x = "output/DE/Const_syn_PC12.csv",
  fp_y = "output/DE/Const_nuc_PC12.csv",
  FDR_padj_xy = 1,
  p_value = 1,
  plot_pval_only = FALSE
)

# Pull merged table
syn_nuc_df <- syn_nuc_res$merged_data

# Column names used by your function
pval_x  <- "pvalue_const_syn"
pval_y  <- "pvalue_const_nuc"
logFC_x <- "logfc_const_syn"
logFC_y <- "logfc_const_nuc"

# Genes passing p < 0.05 in either dataset AND discordant (quadrants 2 and 4)
discordant_genes_syn_nuc <- syn_nuc_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    (.data[[pval_x]] < 0.05 | .data[[pval_y]] < 0.05),
    (
      (.data[[logFC_x]] < 0 & .data[[logFC_y]] > 0) |   # quadrant 2
      (.data[[logFC_x]] > 0 & .data[[logFC_y]] < 0)     # quadrant 4
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::pull(gene) %>%
  unique()

length(discordant_genes_syn_nuc)
head(discordant_genes_syn_nuc)


discordant_plot <- compare_groups_plot(
  x_group = "Const_syn",
  y_group = "Const_cyt",
  fp_x = "output/DE/Const_syn_PC12.csv",
  fp_y = "output/DE/Const_cyt_PC12.csv",
  FDR_padj_xy = 0.1,
  no_filt = TRUE,
  custom_genes = discordant_genes_syn_nuc,
  p_value = 0.05,
  max_bound = 1.0
  )


# Save the plot as a PDF
pdf("output/DE/comps/final_DE/Discordant_syn_nuc_in_syn_vs_cyt.pdf", width = 7.25, height = 6)
print(discordant_plot$plot)
dev.off()
```

```{r}
  const_whole = "output/DE/Const_whole_PC12.csv"
)

density_scale_cap_module <- 5

cap_density_scale_module <- function(plot_obj) {
  plot_obj +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_gradient(
      low = "white",
      high = "red",
      name = "Density",
      limits = c(0, density_scale_cap_module),
      oob = scales::squish
    )
}

make_module_comparison <- function(module_id, module_genes, x_group, y_group, show_legend = FALSE) {
  res <- compare_groups_plot(
    x_group = x_group,
    y_group = y_group,
    fp_x = de_fp_module[[x_group]],
    fp_y = de_fp_module[[y_group]],
    FDR_padj_xy = 0.05,
    filter_mode = "both",
    max_bound = 1.0,
    plot_pval_only = TRUE,
    p_value = 0.05,
    no_filt = TRUE,
    custom_genes = module_genes,
    mode = "concordance"
  )

  p <- cap_density_scale_module(res$plot) +
    ggplot2::ggtitle(paste0(module_id, ": ", x_group, " vs ", y_group))

  if (!show_legend) {
    p <- p + ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "none")
  }

  p
}

divider_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot() +
  ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = 0.5, linewidth = 1.1, color = "black") +
  ggplot2::coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1), clip = "off") +
  ggplot2::theme_void()

module_plot_rows <- list()

for (module_id in module_order) {
  module_genes <- mod_genes %>%
    dplyr::filter(module == module_id) %>%
    dplyr::pull(gene_name) %>%
    unique()

  if (length(module_genes) < 2) next

  module_glut <- module_primary_glut[[module_id]]

  row_plots <- list(
    make_module_comparison(module_id, module_genes, "Glut", "const_nuc"),
    make_module_comparison(module_id, module_genes, module_glut, "const_nuc"),
    divider_plot,
    make_module_comparison(module_id, module_genes, "Glut", "const_syn"),
    make_module_comparison(module_id, module_genes, module_glut, "const_syn"),
    divider_plot,
    make_module_comparison(module_id, module_genes, "Glut", "const_whole"),
    make_module_comparison(module_id, module_genes, module_glut, "const_whole"),
    divider_plot
  )

  if (module_id == "M7") {
    row_plots <- c(
      row_plots,
      list(
        make_module_comparison(module_id, module_genes, "Gabaergic", "const_whole"),
        make_module_comparison(module_id, module_genes, "Glial", "const_whole"),
        make_module_comparison(module_id, module_genes, "Vasc", "const_whole"),
        make_module_comparison(module_id, module_genes, "Astro", "const_whole"),
        make_module_comparison(module_id, module_genes, "Oligo", "const_whole"),
        make_module_comparison(module_id, module_genes, "OPC", "const_whole"),
        make_module_comparison(module_id, module_genes, "VLMC", "const_whole"),
        make_module_comparison(module_id, module_genes, "L23", "const_cyt", show_legend = TRUE)
      )
    )
  } else {
    row_plots <- c(
      row_plots,
      list(
        make_module_comparison(module_id, module_genes, "Gabaergic", "const_nuc"),
        make_module_comparison(module_id, module_genes, "Glial", "const_nuc"),
        make_module_comparison(module_id, module_genes, "Vasc", "const_nuc"),
        make_module_comparison(module_id, module_genes, "Astro", "const_nuc"),
        make_module_comparison(module_id, module_genes, "Oligo", "const_nuc"),
        make_module_comparison(module_id, module_genes, "OPC", "const_nuc"),
        make_module_comparison(module_id, module_genes, "VLMC", "const_nuc"),
        make_module_comparison(module_id, module_genes, "Microglia", "const_nuc", show_legend = TRUE)
      )
    )
  }

  module_plot_rows[[module_id]] <- patchwork::wrap_plots(
    row_plots,
    nrow = 1,
    widths = c(1, 1, 0.08, 1, 1, 0.08, 1, 1, 0.08, rep(1, 8))
  )
}

if (length(module_plot_rows) == 0) {
  stop("No module plots were generated. Check module gene names and input DE files.")
}

# Print plots from list in one high-resolution raster-backed PDF page for better Preview zooming.
pdf_width_module  <- 54
pdf_height_module <- max(18, length(module_plot_rows) * 4.2)

combined_module_plot <- patchwork::wrap_plots(module_plot_rows, ncol = 1) +
  patchwork::plot_annotation(
    title = "snRNA-seq glutamatergic module genes"
  )

tmp_module_png <- tempfile(fileext = ".png")
ragg::agg_png(

)

grDevices::pdf(
  "output/DE/comps/final_DE/snRNAseq_module_gene_comparisons.pdf",
```

```{r}
  )

get_go_symbols_clean <- function(term_exact, ontology = "BP", use_goall = TRUE) {
  term2go <- suppressMessages(
    AnnotationDbi::select(
      x = GO.db::GO.db,
      keys = term_exact,
      keytype = "TERM",
      columns = c("GOID", "ONTOLOGY")
    )
  )

  if (is.null(term2go) || nrow(term2go) == 0) return(character())

  goids <- term2go[!is.na(term2go$GOID) & term2go$ONTOLOGY == ontology, "GOID", drop = TRUE]
  goids <- unique(as.character(goids))
  if (!length(goids)) return(character())

  go2sym <- suppressMessages(
    AnnotationDbi::select(
      x = org.Mm.eg.db::org.Mm.eg.db,
      keys = goids,
      keytype = if (isTRUE(use_goall)) "GOALL" else "GO",
      columns = "SYMBOL"
    )
  )

  if (is.null(go2sym) || nrow(go2sym) == 0) return(character())

  genes <- go2sym$SYMBOL
  genes <- genes[!is.na(genes) & genes != ""]
  unique(as.character(genes))
}

get_component_genes_clean <- function(gsea_pathway, module_genes) {
  term_i <- match(gsea_pathway, component_go_terms_clean$GSEA_pathway)
  go_terms <- if (is.na(term_i)) gsea_pathway else component_go_terms_clean$go_terms[[term_i]]

  component_genes <- unique(unlist(lapply(go_terms, get_go_symbols_clean), use.names = FALSE))
  intersect(module_genes, component_genes)
}

cap_density_scale_clean <- function(plot_obj) {

    ggplot2::scale_fill_gradient(
      low = "white",
      high = "red",
      name = "Density",
      limits = c(0, density_scale_cap_clean),
      oob = scales::squish
    )
}

get_visible_module_genes_clean <- function(merged_data, module_genes, x_group) {
  x_col <- paste0("logfc_", tolower(x_group))
  y_col <- "logfc_const_nuc"
  pval_x_col <- paste0("pvalue_", tolower(x_group))
  pval_y_col <- "pvalue_const_nuc"

  if (!all(c("gene", x_col, y_col, pval_x_col, pval_y_col) %in% colnames(merged_data))) {
    return(character())
  }

  merged_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      gene %in% module_genes,
      is.finite(.data[[x_col]]),
      is.finite(.data[[y_col]]),
      .data[[pval_x_col]] < component_overlay_p_value_clean |
        .data[[pval_y_col]] < component_overlay_p_value_clean
    ) %>%
    dplyr::pull(gene) %>%
    unique()
}

is_extra_component_term_clean <- function(term) {
  term_lower <- term %>%
    stringr::str_to_lower() %>%
    stringr::str_replace_all("_", " ") %>%
    stringr::str_squish()

  generic_terms <- c(
    "biological process",
    "cellular process",
    "biological regulation",
    "regulation of biological process",
    "regulation of cellular process",
    "metabolic process",
    "cellular metabolic process",
    "primary metabolic process",
    "organic substance metabolic process",
    "nitrogen compound metabolic process",
    "cellular nitrogen compound metabolic process",
    "response to stimulus",
    "cell communication",
    "cellular component organization",
    "cellular component organization or biogenesis",
    "multicellular organismal process",
    "gene expression",
    "signaling",
    "signal transduction",
    "localization",
    "transport",
    "developmental process",
    "multicellular organism development",
    "anatomical structure development"
  )

  !(term_lower %in% generic_terms) &&
    !stringr::str_detect(term_lower, "^(positive |negative )?regulation of (biological|cellular|metabolic|developmental|signaling|localization|transport|response to stimulus)") &&
    !stringr::str_detect(term_lower, "^(cellular |organic substance |primary |nitrogen compound |macromolecule )?(metabolic|biosynthetic|catabolic) process$") &&
    !stringr::str_detect(term_lower, "^cellular component organization")
}

get_extra_component_terms_clean <- function(module_id, module_genes, visible_genes, covered_genes) {
  remaining_genes <- setdiff(visible_genes, covered_genes)
  go_fp <- file.path(module_go_dir_clean, paste0("Glut-", module_id, "_GOterms.xlsx"))

  if (length(remaining_genes) < 2 || !file.exists(go_fp)) {
    return(tibble::tibble())
  }

  go_tbl <- readxl::read_excel(go_fp) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(Description), !is.na(geneID)) %>%
    dplyr::filter(vapply(Description, is_extra_component_term_clean, logical(1))) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      component_genes = stringr::str_split(as.character(geneID), "/"),
      component_genes = lapply(component_genes, function(x) intersect(module_genes, x)),
      remaining_hits = lapply(component_genes, function(x) intersect(remaining_genes, x)),
      n_remaining_hits = vapply(remaining_hits, length, integer(1))
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(n_remaining_hits > 1)

  selected <- list()

  for (i in seq_len(component_overlay_max_fallback_terms_clean)) {
    go_tbl <- go_tbl %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        current_hits = lapply(component_genes, function(x) intersect(remaining_genes, x)),
        n_current_hits = vapply(current_hits, length, integer(1))
      ) %>%
      dplyr::filter(n_current_hits > 1) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(n_current_hits), p.adjust, pvalue)

    if (nrow(go_tbl) == 0) break

    selected[[length(selected) + 1]] <- go_tbl[1, , drop = FALSE]
    remaining_genes <- setdiff(remaining_genes, go_tbl$component_genes[[1]])
    if (length(remaining_genes) < 2) break
  }

  if (length(selected) == 0) {
    return(tibble::tibble())
  }

  dplyr::bind_rows(selected) %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      module_summary = as.character(Description),
      alignment_label = "EXTRA",
      alignment_color = "#2B2B2B",
      const_nuc_NES = NA_real_,
      GSEA_pathway = module_summary,
      component_genes
    )
}

add_component_overlay_clean <- function(plot_obj, merged_data, module_genes, x_group, component_info) {
  if (!isTRUE(show_component_overlays_clean) || is.null(component_info) || nrow(component_info) < 1) {
    return(plot_obj)
  }

  x_col <- paste0("logfc_", tolower(x_group))
  y_col <- "logfc_const_nuc"
  pval_x_col <- paste0("pvalue_", tolower(x_group))
  pval_y_col <- "pvalue_const_nuc"

  if (!all(c("gene", x_col, y_col, pval_x_col, pval_y_col) %in% colnames(merged_data))) {
    return(plot_obj)
  }

  plotted_df <- merged_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      gene %in% module_genes,
      is.finite(.data[[x_col]]),
      is.finite(.data[[y_col]]),
      .data[[pval_x_col]] < component_overlay_p_value_clean |
        .data[[pval_y_col]] < component_overlay_p_value_clean
    )

  if (nrow(plotted_df) == 0) {
    return(plot_obj)
  }

  component_gene_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(component_info)), function(i) {
    component_genes <- if ("component_genes" %in% colnames(component_info)) {
      component_info$component_genes[[i]]
    } else {
      get_component_genes_clean(component_info$GSEA_pathway[i], module_genes)
    }

    tibble::tibble(
      gene = component_genes,
      component = component_info$module_summary[i],
      component_color = component_info$component_color[i],
      component_rank = i
    )
  })) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(component_rank) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE)

  overlay_df <- plotted_df %>%
    dplyr::left_join(component_gene_df, by = "gene") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      component = dplyr::coalesce(component, "Other module genes"),
      component_color = dplyr::coalesce(component_color, component_overlay_other_color_clean)
    )

  plot_obj +
    ggplot2::geom_point(
      data = overlay_df,
      ggplot2::aes(x = .data[[x_col]], y = .data[[y_col]], color = component_color),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      shape = 16,
      size = 2.1,
      alpha = 1.0,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_color_identity()
}

make_alignment_label_plot <- function(module_id, alignment_detail) {
  detail_df <- alignment_detail %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      y = seq(0.52, 0.06, length.out = dplyr::n()),
      term_label = stringr::str_wrap(
        dplyr::if_else(
          is.na(const_nuc_NES),
          module_summary,
          paste0(module_summary, "\nNES=", round(const_nuc_NES, 2))
        ),
        width = 34
      )
    )
  term_text_size <- if (nrow(detail_df) > 4) 2.0 else 2.35

  ggplot() +
    annotate(
      "rect",
      xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
      fill = "#F4F4F4",
      alpha = 1
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 0.5, y = 0.70,
      label = module_id,
      color = "#2B2B2B",
      fontface = "bold",
      size = 7.5
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = detail_df,
      aes(x = 0.08, y = y, color = component_color),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      size = 3.0
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = detail_df,
      aes(x = 0.16, y = y, label = term_label),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      color = "#2B2B2B",
      size = term_text_size,
      lineheight = 0.68,
      hjust = 0
    ) +
    scale_color_identity() +
    coord_cartesian(
      xlim = c(0, 1),
      ylim = c(0, 1),
      clip = "off"
    ) +
    labs(title = module_id) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 18),
      plot.margin = margin(8, 18, 8, 8)
    )
}

make_module_compare_plot <- function(module_id, module_genes, x_group, component_info = NULL, res = NULL) {
  if (is.null(res)) {
    res <- compare_groups_plot(
      x_group = x_group,
      y_group = "const_nuc",
      fp_x = de_fp_clean[[x_group]],
      fp_y = de_fp_clean[["const_nuc"]],
      FDR_padj_xy = 0.05,
      filter_mode = "both",
      max_bound = 1.0,
      plot_pval_only = TRUE,
      p_value = 0.05,
      no_filt = TRUE,
      custom_genes = module_genes,
      mode = "concordance"
    )
  }

  p <- res$plot +
    ggplot2::ggtitle(paste0(module_id, ": ", x_group, " vs Const_nuc"))

  add_component_overlay_clean(
    plot_obj = cap_density_scale_clean(p),
    merged_data = res$merged_data,
    module_genes = module_genes,
    x_group = x_group,
    component_info = component_info
  )
}

module_plot_rows_clean <- list()
max_clean_compare_cols <- 1 + length(x_groups_clean_all)

for (module_id in module_order_clean) {
  module_genes <- mod_genes_clean %>%
    dplyr::filter(module == module_id) %>%
    dplyr::pull(gene_name) %>%
    unique()

  if (length(module_genes) < 2) next

  module_info <- module_alignment_clean %>%
    dplyr::filter(module == module_id) %>%
    dplyr::slice(1)

  if (nrow(module_info) == 0) next

  x_groups <- x_groups_clean_all

  comparison_results <- lapply(
    x_groups,
    function(x_group) {
      compare_groups_plot(
        x_group = x_group,
        y_group = "const_nuc",
        fp_x = de_fp_clean[[x_group]],
        fp_y = de_fp_clean[["const_nuc"]],
        FDR_padj_xy = 0.05,
        filter_mode = "both",
        max_bound = 1.0,
        plot_pval_only = TRUE,
        p_value = 0.05,
        no_filt = TRUE,
        custom_genes = module_genes,
        mode = "concordance"
      )
    }
  )
  names(comparison_results) <- x_groups

  component_info <- module_info$alignment_detail[[1]] %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      component_genes = lapply(GSEA_pathway, get_component_genes_clean, module_genes = module_genes)
    )

  visible_genes <- unique(unlist(
    Map(
      function(res, x_group) get_visible_module_genes_clean(res$merged_data, module_genes, x_group),
      comparison_results,
      x_groups
    ),
    use.names = FALSE
  ))

  covered_genes <- unique(unlist(component_info$component_genes, use.names = FALSE))
  extra_components <- get_extra_component_terms_clean(
    module_id = module_id,
    module_genes = module_genes,
    visible_genes = visible_genes,
    covered_genes = covered_genes
  )

  component_info <- dplyr::bind_rows(component_info, extra_components) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      component_color = component_overlay_palette_clean[
        ((dplyr::row_number() - 1) %% length(component_overlay_palette_clean)) + 1
      ]
    )

  label_plot <- make_alignment_label_plot(
    module_id = module_id,
    alignment_detail = component_info
  )

  compare_plots <- lapply(
    x_groups,
    function(x_group) make_module_compare_plot(
      module_id,
      module_genes,
      x_group,
      component_info,
      res = comparison_results[[x_group]]
    )
  )

  row_plots <- c(list(label_plot), compare_plots)
  n_blank <- max_clean_compare_cols - length(row_plots)
  if (n_blank > 0) {
    row_plots <- c(row_plots, rep(list(patchwork::plot_spacer()), n_blank))
  }

  module_plot_rows_clean[[module_id]] <- patchwork::wrap_plots(
    row_plots,
    nrow = 1,
    widths = c(2.1, rep(1, max_clean_compare_cols - 1))
  )
}

if (length(module_plot_rows_clean) == 0) {
  stop("No clean module plots were generated. Check module names and input files.")
}

grDevices::pdf(
  "output/DE/comps/final_DE/snRNAseq_module_gene_comparisons_clean.pdf",
  width = 45,
  height = max(8.5, length(module_plot_rows_clean) * 4.4),
  onefile = TRUE
)
print(
  patchwork::wrap_plots(module_plot_rows_clean, ncol = 1) +
    patchwork::plot_annotation(
      title = "hdWGCNA glutamatergic module genes vs bulk Const_nuc"
    )
)
grDevices::dev.off()
```

## snRNA-seq module genes - fraction comparisons - v6

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(readxl)
  library(stringr)
  library(patchwork)
  library(AnnotationDbi)
  library(GO.db)
  library(org.Mm.eg.db)
})

mod_genes_fig_v6 <- readxl::read_excel(
  "/Users/salozano/Library/Mobile Documents/com~apple~CloudDocs/Documents/Data Analysis/2022/Chd8_P60_ctx/output/hdWGCNA_v11_glut_only/plots/Glutamatergic_v2/modules.xlsx"
) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(module), !is.na(gene_name), module != "grey") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    module = stringr::str_remove(as.character(module), "^Glut-"),
    gene_name = as.character(gene_name)
  )

de_fp_fig_v6 <- list(
  Glut = "output/DE/DE_Glutamatergic.csv",
  L5 = "output/DE/DE_L5 IT Glut.csv",
  L23 = "output/DE/DE_L2_3 IT Glut.csv",
  L45 = "output/DE/DE_L4_5 IT Glut.csv",
  const_nuc = "output/DE/Const_nuc_PC12.csv",
  cond_het_nuc = "output/DE/Cond_nuc_HETvsWT_NOPC.csv",
  cond_hom_nuc = "output/DE/Cond_nuc_HOMvsWT_NOPC.csv"
)

comparison_info_v6 <- tibble::tribble(
  ~y_group,        ~title_prefix,
  "const_nuc",     "Const Nuc vs ",
  "cond_het_nuc",  "Cond HET Nuc vs ",
  "cond_hom_nuc",  "Cond HOM Nuc vs "
)

module_order_v6 <- c("M1", "M2", "M3", "M4", "M6", "M7", "M9", "M10")

module_celltype_v6 <- c(
  "M1" = "Glut",
  "M2" = "L5",
  "M3" = "L45",
  "M4" = "L23",
  "M6" = "L45",
  "M7" = "Glut",
  "M9" = "L23",
  "M10" = "L45"
)

gene_sets_v6 <- stats::setNames(
  lapply(module_order_v6, function(module_id) {
    mod_genes_fig_v6 %>%
      dplyr::filter(module == module_id) %>%
      dplyr::pull(gene_name) %>%
      unique()
  }),
  module_order_v6
)

point_colors_v6 <- c(
  "Neither" = "grey70",
  "X only" = "#2C7FB8",
  "Y only" = "#D95F5F",
  "Both" = "black"
)

remove_density_and_point_layers_v6 <- function(plot_obj) {
  plot_obj$layers <- plot_obj$layers[
    !vapply(
      plot_obj$layers,
      function(layer) {
        inherits(layer$geom, "GeomTile") || inherits(layer$geom, "GeomPoint")
      },
      logical(1)
    )
  ]
  plot_obj$scales$scales <- plot_obj$scales$scales[
    !vapply(
      plot_obj$scales$scales,
      function(scale_obj) "fill" %in% scale_obj$aesthetics,
      logical(1)
    )
  ]
  plot_obj
}

restyle_annotation_text_v6 <- function(plot_obj) {
  keep_layer <- rep(TRUE, length(plot_obj$layers))

  for (i in seq_along(plot_obj$layers)) {
    layer <- plot_obj$layers[[i]]
    if (!inherits(layer$geom, "GeomText")) next

    layer_color <- layer$aes_params$colour
    if (is.null(layer_color)) layer_color <- layer$aes_params$color

    if (identical(layer_color, "indianred2")) {
      keep_layer[i] <- FALSE
    } else if (identical(layer_color, "black")) {
      plot_obj$layers[[i]]$aes_params$colour <- "black"
      plot_obj$layers[[i]]$aes_params$color <- NULL
    }
  }

  plot_obj$layers <- plot_obj$layers[keep_layer]
  plot_obj
}

plot_fraction_comp_v6 <- function(gene_set_name, genes, x_group, y_group, title_text) {
  if (length(genes) == 0) {
    return(
      ggplot2::ggplot() +
        ggplot2::theme_void() +
        ggplot2::labs(title = title_text)
    )
  }

  res <- compare_groups_plot(
    x_group = x_group,
    y_group = y_group,
    fp_x = de_fp_fig_v6[[x_group]],
    fp_y = de_fp_fig_v6[[y_group]],
    FDR_padj_xy = 0.05,
    filter_mode = "both",
    max_bound = 1.0,
    plot_pval_only = TRUE,
    p_value = 0.1,
    no_filt = TRUE,
    custom_genes = genes,
    mode = "concordance"
  )

  x_logfc <- paste0("logfc_", tolower(x_group))
  y_logfc <- paste0("logfc_", tolower(y_group))
  x_pvalue <- paste0("pvalue_", tolower(x_group))
  y_pvalue <- paste0("pvalue_", tolower(y_group))

  point_data <- res$merged_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      gene %in% genes,
      is.finite(.data[[x_logfc]]),
      is.finite(.data[[y_logfc]])
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      sig_x = !is.na(.data[[x_pvalue]]) & .data[[x_pvalue]] < 0.1,
      sig_y = !is.na(.data[[y_pvalue]]) & .data[[y_pvalue]] < 0.1,
      significance = dplyr::case_when(
        sig_x & sig_y ~ "Both",
        sig_x ~ "X only",
        sig_y ~ "Y only",
        TRUE ~ "Neither"
      ),
      significance = factor(
        significance,
        levels = c("Neither", "X only", "Y only", "Both")
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(significance)

  p <- remove_density_and_point_layers_v6(res$plot)
  p <- restyle_annotation_text_v6(p)

  subtitle_text_v6 <- paste0(
    "p<0.1 in either dataset (n = ",
    sum(point_data$sig_x | point_data$sig_y),
    ")"
  )

  p +
    ggplot2::geom_point(
      data = point_data,
      ggplot2::aes(
        x = .data[[x_logfc]],
        y = .data[[y_logfc]],
        color = significance
      ),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      size = 1.5,
      alpha = 0.85
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_color_manual(
      name = "p < 0.1",
      values = point_colors_v6,
      drop = FALSE,
      guide = ggplot2::guide_legend(
        keywidth = grid::unit(0.55, "lines"),
        keyheight = grid::unit(0.7, "lines"),
        override.aes = list(size = 2.2, alpha = 1)
      )
    ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = title_text,
      subtitle = subtitle_text_v6
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
      plot.subtitle = ggtext::element_markdown(color = "black", size = 12),
      axis.title.x = ggplot2::element_text(color = point_colors_v6[["X only"]]),
      axis.title.y = ggplot2::element_text(color = point_colors_v6[["Y only"]]),
      plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(8, 18, 8, 18),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 10),
      legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 9, margin = ggplot2::margin(l = 2, r = 4)),
      legend.spacing.x = grid::unit(2, "pt")
    )
}

plot_rows_v6 <- lapply(names(gene_sets_v6), function(gene_set_name) {
  genes <- gene_sets_v6[[gene_set_name]]
  x_group <- unname(module_celltype_v6[[gene_set_name]])

  row_plots <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(comparison_info_v6)), function(i) {
    plot_fraction_comp_v6(
      gene_set_name = gene_set_name,
      genes = genes,
      x_group = x_group,
      y_group = comparison_info_v6$y_group[i],
      title_text = paste0(comparison_info_v6$title_prefix[i], x_group)
    )
  })

  row_title_v6 <- ggplot2::ggplot() +
    ggplot2::annotate(
      "text",
      x = 0,
      y = 0.5,
      label = paste0(gene_set_name, " (n = ", length(genes), ")"),
      hjust = 0,
      vjust = 0.5,
      fontface = "bold",
      size = 5.5
    ) +
    ggplot2::coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1), clip = "off") +
    ggplot2::theme_void() +
    ggplot2::theme(plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(0, 0, 0, 8))

  row_title_v6 /
    patchwork::wrap_plots(row_plots, nrow = 1, guides = "keep") +
    patchwork::plot_layout(heights = c(0.12, 1))
})

p_fig_v6 <- patchwork::wrap_plots(plot_rows_v6, ncol = 1)

grDevices::pdf(
  "output/DE/comps/final_DE/snRNAseq_module_gene_comparisons_for_fig_v6.pdf",
  width = 17,
  height = max(34, length(plot_rows_v6) * 5),
  onefile = TRUE
)
print(p_fig_v6)
grDevices::dev.off()

```

```{r}
      axis.title.x = ggplot2::element_text(color = point_colors_v6[["X only"]]),
      axis.title.y = ggplot2::element_text(color = point_colors_v6[["Y only"]]),
      plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(8, 18, 8, 18),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 10),
      legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 9, margin = ggplot2::margin(l = 2, r = 4)),
      legend.spacing.x = grid::unit(2, "pt")
    )
}

plot_rows_v7 <- lapply(names(gene_sets_v6), function(gene_set_name) {
```

```{r}
plot_module_comp_v8 <- function(
    genes,
    label_genes,
    x_group,
    y_group,
    title_text,
    x_axis_text,
    y_axis_text,
    spread_labels = FALSE
) {
  res <- compare_groups_plot(
    x_group = x_group,
    y_group = y_group,
    fp_x = de_fp_fig_v8[[x_group]],
    fp_y = de_fp_fig_v8[[y_group]],
    FDR_padj_xy = 0.05,
    filter_mode = "both",
    max_bound = 1.0,
    plot_pval_only = TRUE,
    p_value = 0.1,
    no_filt = TRUE,
    custom_genes = genes,
    mode = "concordance"
  )

  x_logfc <- paste0("logfc_", tolower(x_group))
  y_logfc <- paste0("logfc_", tolower(y_group))
  x_pvalue <- paste0("pvalue_", tolower(x_group))
  y_pvalue <- paste0("pvalue_", tolower(y_group))

  point_data <- res$merged_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      gene %in% genes,
      is.finite(.data[[x_logfc]]),
      is.finite(.data[[y_logfc]])
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      sig_x = !is.na(.data[[x_pvalue]]) & .data[[x_pvalue]] < 0.1,
      sig_y = !is.na(.data[[y_pvalue]]) & .data[[y_pvalue]] < 0.1,
      significance = dplyr::case_when(
        sig_x & sig_y ~ "Both",
        sig_x ~ "X only",
        sig_y ~ "Y only",
        TRUE ~ "Neither"
      ),
      significance = factor(
        significance,
        levels = c("Neither", "X only", "Y only", "Both")
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(significance)

  label_data <- point_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(gene %in% label_genes)

  p <- remove_density_and_point_layers_v6(res$plot)
  p <- restyle_annotation_text_v6(p)

  for (i in seq_along(p$layers)) {
    if (inherits(p$layers[[i]]$geom, "GeomText")) {
      p$layers[[i]]$aes_params$size <- 6
    }
  }

  p <- p +
    ggplot2::geom_point(
      data = point_data,
      ggplot2::aes(
        x = .data[[x_logfc]],
        y = .data[[y_logfc]],
        color = significance
      ),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      size = 1.45,
      alpha = 0.82
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_color_manual(
      name = "p < 0.1",
      values = point_colors_v8,
      drop = FALSE,
      guide = ggplot2::guide_legend(
        keywidth = grid::unit(0.55, "lines"),
        keyheight = grid::unit(0.7, "lines"),
        override.aes = list(size = 4, alpha = 1)
      )
    ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = title_text,
      subtitle = paste0(
        "p<0.1 in either dataset (n = ",
        sum(point_data$sig_x | point_data$sig_y),
        ")"
      ),
      x = paste0(x_axis_text, " logFC"),
      y = paste0(y_axis_text, " logFC")
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 18),
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", size = 20),
      plot.subtitle = ggtext::element_markdown(color = "black", size = 16),
      axis.title.x = ggplot2::element_text(
        color = point_colors_v8[["X only"]],
        size = 17
      ),
      axis.title.y = ggplot2::element_text(
        color = point_colors_v8[["Y only"]],
        size = 17
      ),
      axis.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 15),
      plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(8, 12, 8, 12),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 15),
      legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(
        size = 14,
        margin = ggplot2::margin(l = 2, r = 4)
      ),
      legend.spacing.x = grid::unit(2, "pt")
    )

  if (nrow(label_data) > 0) {
    for (sig_level in levels(point_data$significance)) {
      label_subset <- label_data %>%
        dplyr::filter(significance == sig_level)

      if (nrow(label_subset) == 0) next

      label_jitter_v8 <- if (spread_labels) 0.11 else 0.012
      label_seed_v8 <- 42 + match(
        sig_level,
        levels(point_data$significance)
      )

      p <- p +
        ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
          data = label_subset,
          ggplot2::aes(
            x = .data[[x_logfc]],
            y = .data[[y_logfc]],
            label = gene
          ),
          inherit.aes = FALSE,
          position = ggplot2::position_jitter(
            width = label_jitter_v8,
            height = label_jitter_v8,
            seed = label_seed_v8
          ),
          size = 5,
          fontface = "bold",
          color = unname(point_colors_v8[[sig_level]]),
          box.padding = if (spread_labels) 1.2 else 0.25,
          point.padding = if (spread_labels) 0.5 else 0.15,
          min.segment.length = 0,
          segment.color = unname(point_colors_v8[[sig_level]]),
          segment.size = 0.35,
          force = if (spread_labels) 12 else 1,
          force_pull = if (spread_labels) 0.1 else 1,
          max.time = if (spread_labels) 8 else 0.5,
          max.iter = if (spread_labels) 60000 else 10000,
          max.overlaps = Inf,
          seed = label_seed_v8
        )
    }
  }

  p
}

module_pages_v8 <- lapply(names(gene_sets_v6), function(module_id) {
  genes <- gene_sets_v6[[module_id]]
  labels <- if (module_id %in% c("M4", "M9")) {
    label_genes_v8[[module_id]]
  } else {
    character()
  }
  our_group <- unname(module_celltype_v6[[module_id]])

  noonan_row <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(noonan_comparisons_v8)), function(i) {
    plot_module_comp_v8(
      genes = genes,
      label_genes = labels,
      x_group = our_group,
      y_group = noonan_comparisons_v8$y_group[i],
      title_text = noonan_comparisons_v8$title[i],
      x_axis_text = paste0("P60 ", our_group),
      y_axis_text = paste0("Noonan P28 ", noonan_comparisons_v8$cell_type[i]),
      spread_labels = FALSE
    )
  })

  bulk_row <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(bulk_comparisons_v8)), function(i) {
    x_group <- bulk_comparisons_v8$x_group[i]
    y_group <- bulk_comparisons_v8$y_group[i]

    plot_module_comp_v8(
      genes = genes,
      label_genes = labels,
      x_group = x_group,
      y_group = y_group,
      title_text = bulk_comparisons_v8$title[i],
      x_axis_text = stringr::str_to_title(
        stringr::str_remove(x_group, "^const_")
      ),
      y_axis_text = stringr::str_to_title(
        stringr::str_remove(y_group, "^const_")
      ),
      spread_labels = module_id %in% c("M4", "M9")
    )
  })

  row_heading_v8 <- function(label) {
    ggplot2::ggplot() +
      ggplot2::annotate(
        "text",
        x = 0,
        y = 0.5,
        label = label,
        hjust = 0,
        vjust = 0.5,
        fontface = "bold",
        size = 7
      ) +
      ggplot2::coord_cartesian(
        xlim = c(0, 1),
        ylim = c(0, 1),
        clip = "off"
      ) +
      ggplot2::theme_void()
  }

  page <- (
    row_heading_v8("P60 vs Noonan P28 snRNA-seq") /
      patchwork::wrap_plots(noonan_row, nrow = 1, guides = "keep") /
      row_heading_v8("Constitutive bulk fraction comparisons") /
      patchwork::wrap_plots(bulk_row, nrow = 1, guides = "keep")
  ) +
    patchwork::plot_layout(heights = c(0.08, 1, 0.08, 1)) +
    patchwork::plot_annotation(
      title = paste0(module_id, " (n = ", length(genes), ")"),
      subtitle = if (module_id %in% c("M4", "M9")) {
        paste0(
          "Labeled genes: translation genes down in Syn, Nuc, and Cyt but up in Whole (n = ",
          length(labels),
          ")"
        )
      } else {
        NULL
      },
      theme = ggplot2::theme(
        plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", size = 30),
        plot.subtitle = ggplot2::element_text(size = 20)
      )
    )

  page
})

grDevices::pdf(
  "output/DE/comps/final_DE/snRNAseq_module_gene_comparisons_for_fig_v8.pdf",
  width = 34,
  height = 17,
  onefile = TRUE
)
for (page in module_pages_v8) print(page)
```

### Mitochondrial/ energetics genes Const whole vs fraction -  

Using exhaustive list of expressed mitochondrial/energetics genes

#### Modified function
```{r}

compare_groups_plot_genes <- function(
  x_group, y_group, fp_x, fp_y,
  genes_to_plot,                
  max_bound = 0.8
) {

  # -----------------------------
  # 1) Load + standardize DE tables
  # -----------------------------
  load_and_rename <- function(fp, group, is_y_group = FALSE) {
    df <- read.csv(fp, check.names = FALSE)

    is_pseudo <- (group == "Pseudobulk")

    if (is_pseudo) {
      needed <- c("gene", "log2FoldChange", "pvalue", "padj", "baseMean")
      miss <- setdiff(needed, colnames(df))
      if (length(miss)) {
        stop("Missing expected DESeq2/pseudobulk columns in: ", fp,
             "\nMissing: ", paste(miss, collapse = ", "),
             "\nHave: ", paste(colnames(df), collapse = ", "))
      }

      df <- df %>%
        dplyr::select(gene, log2FoldChange, pvalue, padj, baseMean) %>%
        dplyr::rename(
          gene   = gene,
          logfc  = log2FoldChange,
          pvalue = pvalue,
          fdr    = padj
        ) %>%
        dplyr::rename_with(~paste0(.x, "_", tolower(group)), c("logfc", "pvalue", "fdr"))

      if (is_y_group) df <- df %>% dplyr::mutate(logCPM = log2(baseMean + 1))

    } else {
      colnames(df) <- tolower(colnames(df))

      gene_col <- dplyr::case_when(
        "gene_name" %in% colnames(df) ~ "gene_name",
        "gene"      %in% colnames(df) ~ "gene",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )

      logfc_col <- dplyr::case_when(
        "logfc" %in% colnames(df) ~ "logfc",
        "log2fc" %in% colnames(df) ~ "log2fc",
        "log2foldchange" %in% colnames(df) ~ "log2foldchange",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )

      pval_col <- dplyr::case_when(
        "pvalue" %in% colnames(df) ~ "pvalue",
        "pval"   %in% colnames(df) ~ "pval",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )

      fdr_col <- dplyr::case_when(
        "fdr"    %in% colnames(df) ~ "fdr",
        "padj"   %in% colnames(df) ~ "padj",
        "adjp"   %in% colnames(df) ~ "adjp",
        "qvalue" %in% colnames(df) ~ "qvalue",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )

      if (is.na(gene_col) || is.na(logfc_col) || is.na(pval_col) || is.na(fdr_col)) {
        stop(
          "Missing expected edgeR/simple columns in: ", fp, "\n",
          "Need gene/logFC/pvalue/FDR (allowing common variants).\n",
          "Detected: gene=", gene_col, " logFC=", logfc_col, " p=", pval_col, " fdr=", fdr_col, "\n",
          "Have: ", paste(colnames(df), collapse = ", ")
        )
      }

      df <- df %>%
        dplyr::rename(
          gene   = dplyr::all_of(gene_col),
          logfc  = dplyr::all_of(logfc_col),
          pvalue = dplyr::all_of(pval_col),
          fdr    = dplyr::all_of(fdr_col)
        ) %>%
        dplyr::rename_with(~paste0(.x, "_", tolower(group)), c("logfc", "pvalue", "fdr"))

      if (is_y_group) {
        if ("logcpm" %in% colnames(df)) df <- df %>% dplyr::rename(logCPM = logcpm) else df$logCPM <- NA_real_
      }
    }

    df %>% dplyr::distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE)
  }

  df_x <- load_and_rename(fp_x, x_group, is_y_group = FALSE)
  df_y <- load_and_rename(fp_y, y_group, is_y_group = TRUE)

  # LogCPM filter
  # median_val <- median(df_y$logCPM, na.rm = TRUE)
  # mad_val <- mad(df_y$logCPM, na.rm = TRUE)
  # cutoff <- median_val - 1 * mad_val
  # df_y <- df_y %>% dplyr::filter(logCPM >= cutoff)

  merged_data <- merge(df_y, df_x, by = "gene")

  logFC_x <- paste0("logfc_", tolower(x_group))
  logFC_y <- paste0("logfc_", tolower(y_group))

  # -----------------------------
  # 2) Filter to provided genes (THIS replaces pval/fdr-based filtering)
  # -----------------------------
  genes_to_plot <- unique(as.character(genes_to_plot))
  df_plot <- merged_data %>% dplyr::filter(gene %in% genes_to_plot)

  if (nrow(df_plot) == 0) {
    warning("No genes from genes_to_plot were found in the merged DE tables. Returning empty plot.")
    return(list(
      merged_data = merged_data,
      plot = ggplot() + theme_void() +
        labs(title = paste(x_group, "vs", y_group),
             subtitle = "No requested genes found in DE tables")
    ))
  }

  # Quadrants (now counts reflect *genes_to_plot*)
  calculate_quadrant_counts <- function(data, col1, col2) {
    c(
      sum(data[[col1]] > 0 & data[[col2]] > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      sum(data[[col1]] < 0 & data[[col2]] > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      sum(data[[col1]] < 0 & data[[col2]] < 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      sum(data[[col1]] > 0 & data[[col2]] < 0, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  }
  quadrant_counts <- calculate_quadrant_counts(df_plot, logFC_x, logFC_y)

  # Correlation (now based on the plotted genes)
  cor_val <- round(cor(df_plot[[logFC_y]], df_plot[[logFC_x]]), 2)

  # Subtitle (simple + black)
  subtitle_text <- paste0("Genes plotted: n = ", nrow(df_plot))

  # Offsets relative to max_bound (kept identical)
  inner1 <- max_bound - 0.1
  inner2 <- max_bound - 0.15
  annot1 <- max_bound - 0.12
  annot2 <- max_bound - 0.23
  annot3 <- max_bound - 0.01

  # -----------------------------
  # 3) Plot (simple: no density; all points black)
  # -----------------------------
  plot_combined <- ggplot(df_plot, aes_string(x = logFC_x, y = logFC_y)) +
    geom_point(size = 1.2, alpha = 0.75, color = "black") +
    geom_segment(aes(x = -max_bound, xend =  max_bound, y = -inner2, yend = -inner2), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
    geom_segment(aes(x = -max_bound, xend =  max_bound, y =  inner2, yend =  inner2), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
    geom_segment(aes(x = -inner1,   xend = -inner1,   y = -max_bound, yend =  max_bound), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
    geom_segment(aes(x =  inner1,   xend =  inner1,   y = -max_bound, yend =  max_bound), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
    geom_segment(aes(x = -max_bound, xend =  max_bound, y = 0, yend = 0), color = "black") +
    geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend = 0, y = -max_bound, yend = max_bound), color = "black") +
    geom_rect(xmin = -max_bound, xmax = max_bound, ymin = -max_bound, ymax = max_bound, color = "black", fill = NA) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
    geom_smooth(data = df_plot, aes_string(x = logFC_x, y = logFC_y),
                method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black", fill = "black",
                alpha = 0.15, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    annotate("text", x = -annot1, y =  annot2, label = paste0("R = ", cor_val),
             size = 4.5, hjust = 0, color = "black") +
    annotate("text", x =  annot1, y =  annot3, label = paste("n =", quadrant_counts[1]),
             hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 4, color = "black") +
    annotate("text", x = -annot1, y =  annot3, label = paste("n =", quadrant_counts[2]),
             hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 4, color = "black") +
    annotate("text", x = -annot1, y = -annot3, label = paste("n =", quadrant_counts[3]),
             hjust = 0, vjust = 0, size = 4, color = "black") +
    annotate("text", x =  annot1, y = -annot3, label = paste("n =", quadrant_counts[4]),
             hjust = 1, vjust = 0, size = 4, color = "black") +
    labs(
      title = paste(x_group, "vs", y_group),
      subtitle = subtitle_text,
      x = paste0("logFC_", tolower(x_group)),
      y = paste0("logFC_", tolower(y_group))
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      panel.grid       = element_blank(),
      axis.line        = element_line(color = "black"),
      axis.ticks       = element_line(color = "black"),
      axis.text        = element_text(color = "black"),
      axis.title       = element_text(color = "black"),
      plot.title       = element_text(color = "black"),
      plot.subtitle    = element_text(color = "black"),
      legend.position  = "none"
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-max_bound, max_bound), ylim = c(-max_bound, max_bound), expand = FALSE)

  return(list(merged_data = merged_data, plot = plot_combined, df_plot = df_plot))
}
```

#### Get genes

```{r}


library(AnnotationDbi)
library(org.Mm.eg.db)
library(edgeR)
library(dplyr)

# ----------------------------
# 0) Inputs you already have
# ----------------------------
# exp_data_const_syn_nuc_cyt: genes x samples raw counts (rownames are gene SYMBOLS)
# my_gene: annotation df with gene_biotype + gene_name (SYMBOL)

# ----------------------------
# 1) Energetics GO gene set (mouse) — expanded ATP + NADH
# ----------------------------
go_ids <- c(
  "GO:0006119", # oxidative phosphorylation
  "GO:0022904", # respiratory electron transport chain
  "GO:0042775", # mitochondrial ATP synthesis coupled electron transport
  "GO:0042773", # ATP synthesis coupled electron transport
  "GO:0009060", # aerobic respiration
  "GO:0045333", # cellular respiration

  "GO:0046034", # ATP metabolic process
  "GO:0006754", # ATP biosynthetic process
  "GO:0006753", # nucleoside phosphate metabolic process (broad)
  "GO:1902600", # proton transmembrane transport

  "GO:0006120", # mitochondrial electron transport, NADH to ubiquinone
  "GO:0006734", # NADH metabolic process
  "GO:0019646"  # aerobic electron transport chain
)

# ----------------------------
# 2) Keep only GO IDs that exist in this OrgDb build
# ----------------------------
valid_go <- keys(org.Mm.eg.db, keytype = "GO")
go_ok <- intersect(go_ids, valid_go)
go_bad <- setdiff(go_ids, valid_go)

if (length(go_bad) > 0) {
  message("Dropping GO IDs not found in org.Mm.eg.db: ", paste(go_bad, collapse = ", "))
}
stopifnot(length(go_ok) > 0)

# ----------------------------
# 3) Map GO -> Entrez -> Symbol
# ----------------------------
entrez <- bind_rows(lapply(go_ok, function(go) {
  AnnotationDbi::select(
    org.Mm.eg.db,
    keys = go,
    keytype = "GO",
    columns = c("ENTREZID", "ONTOLOGY")
  )
})) %>%
  filter(ONTOLOGY == "BP", !is.na(ENTREZID)) %>%
  distinct(ENTREZID)

sym <- AnnotationDbi::select(
  org.Mm.eg.db,
  keys = unique(entrez$ENTREZID),
  keytype = "ENTREZID",
  columns = "SYMBOL"
)

energetics_genes <- sym$SYMBOL
energetics_genes <- energetics_genes[!is.na(energetics_genes)]
energetics_genes <- unique(energetics_genes)  # <-- removes duplicates across GO terms

# ----------------------------
# 4) Expressed genes from counts (simple CPM filter)
# ----------------------------
dge <- edgeR::DGEList(counts = exp_data_const_syn_nuc_cyt)
cpm_mat <- edgeR::cpm(dge, log = FALSE)
expressed_genes <- rownames(cpm_mat)[rowSums(cpm_mat > 1) >= 4]

# ----------------------------
# 5) Protein-coding genes from your annotation
# ----------------------------
protein_coding_genes <- my_gene %>%
  filter(gene_biotype == "protein_coding") %>%
  pull(gene_name) %>%
  unique()

# ----------------------------
# 6) Final list: energetics ∩ expressed ∩ protein-coding
# ----------------------------
energetics_expressed_pc <- Reduce(intersect, list(
  energetics_genes,
  expressed_genes,
  protein_coding_genes
))

message("Final energetics expressed protein-coding genes: ", length(energetics_expressed_pc))
head(energetics_expressed_pc)
```

#### Get strong peaks

```{r}

# Read in Table 4
df <- read_excel("Table_4.xlsx", sheet = "ChIP Genes")

# Filter for P60 ctx
p60_cols <- c("Cotney_Mm.Frontal_Cx_WT_1-vs.Input",
              "Cotney_Mm.Frontal_Cx_WT_2-vs.Input")

# Filter for strong peaks
p60_targets <- df %>%
  filter(if_all(all_of(p60_cols), ~ .x > 0.50)) %>%
  dplyr::select(NearestTSS, all_of(p60_cols))

# Rename genes
p60_targets <- p60_targets %>%
  mutate(
    NearestTSS = ifelse(
      is.na(NearestTSS),
      NA_character_,
      paste0(toupper(substr(as.character(NearestTSS), 1, 1)),
             tolower(substr(as.character(NearestTSS), 2, nchar(as.character(NearestTSS)))))
    )
  )
```
