#### Scatterplot function

```{r}

plot_strongpeaks_DE <- function(x_group, y_group, fp_x, fp_y,
                                strong_df, peak_cols = c("Cotney_Mm.Frontal_Cx_WT_1-vs.Input",
                                                         "Cotney_Mm.Frontal_Cx_WT_2-vs.Input"),
                                max_bound = 0.8) {

  # helper to load & normalize a DE csv to columns:
  # gene, logfc_<group>, pvalue_<group>, (fdr_<group> if present), and for y adds logCPM if available
  load_and_rename <- function(fp, group, is_y_group = FALSE) {
    df <- read.csv(fp)
    is_pseudo <- (group == "Pseudobulk")

    if (is_pseudo) {
      df <- df %>%
        dplyr::select(gene, log2FoldChange, pvalue, padj, baseMean) %>%
        dplyr::rename(
          gene   = gene,
          logfc  = log2FoldChange,
          pvalue = pvalue,
          fdr    = padj
        ) %>%
        dplyr::rename_with(~paste0(.x, "_", tolower(group)), c("logfc","pvalue","fdr"))
      if (is_y_group) df <- df %>% dplyr::mutate(logCPM = log2(baseMean + 1))
    } else {
      colnames(df) <- tolower(colnames(df))
      gene_col <- ifelse("gene_name" %in% colnames(df), "gene_name", "gene")
      df <- df %>%
        dplyr::rename(
          gene   = dplyr::all_of(gene_col),
          logfc  = logfc,
          pvalue = pvalue
        ) %>%
        dplyr::rename_with(~paste0(.x, "_", tolower(group)), c("logfc","pvalue"))
      if ("fdr" %in% colnames(df)) {
        df <- df %>% dplyr::rename_with(~paste0(.x, "_", tolower(group)), "fdr")
      }
      if (is_y_group) {
        if ("logcpm" %in% colnames(df)) df <- df %>% dplyr::rename(logCPM = logcpm) else df$logCPM <- NA_real_
      }
    }
    df %>% dplyr::distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE)
  }

  # Load DE tables
  df_x <- load_and_rename(fp_x, x_group, is_y_group = FALSE)
  df_y <- load_and_rename(fp_y, y_group, is_y_group = TRUE)

  # Filter y_group by expression (same robust rule you use)
  median_val <- median(df_y$logCPM, na.rm = TRUE)
  mad_val    <- mad(df_y$logCPM, na.rm = TRUE)
  cutoff     <- median_val - 1 * mad_val
  df_y <- df_y %>% dplyr::filter(logCPM >= cutoff | is.na(logCPM))

  # Merge DE tables
  merged_data <- merge(df_y, df_x, by = "gene")

  # Dynamic colnames
  pval_x  <- paste0("pvalue_", tolower(x_group))
  pval_y  <- paste0("pvalue_", tolower(y_group))
  logFC_x <- paste0("logfc_",  tolower(x_group))
  logFC_y <- paste0("logfc_",  tolower(y_group))

  # Strong-peak gene set: NearestTSS with BOTH Cotney cols > 0.50
  strong_set <- strong_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(dplyr::if_all(dplyr::all_of(peak_cols), ~ .x > 0.50)) %>%
    dplyr::pull(NearestTSS) %>%
    unique()

  # Background for density = all strong-peak genes found in merged_data
  df_peaks <- merged_data %>% dplyr::filter(gene %in% strong_set)

  # Foreground points = strong peaks with pval < 0.05 in either dataset 
  df_pval <- merged_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(gene %in% strong_set, .data[[pval_x]] < 0.05 | .data[[pval_y]] < 0.05)

  # Subtitle text
  subtitle_text <- paste0(
    "<span style='color:indianred2'>Peak percentile &gt; 0.50 in both Cotney datasets: n = ", nrow(df_peaks), "</span><br>",
    "<span style='color:black'>High peak percentile + p-value &lt; 0.05 in either DE: n = ", nrow(df_pval), "</span>"
  )

  # Decorations (same layout vibe)
  inner1 <- max_bound - 0.1
  inner2 <- max_bound - 0.15
  annot1 <- max_bound - 0.12  # x for quadrant counts
  annot2 <- max_bound - 0.23  # y for R text (like your original)
  annot3 <- max_bound - 0.01  # base y for counts
  delta  <- 0.06              # small vertical offset so red/black counts don't overlap

  # Quadrant counts
  calculate_quadrant_counts <- function(data, col1, col2) {
    c(
      sum(data[[col1]] > 0 & data[[col2]] > 0, na.rm = TRUE),  # Q1
      sum(data[[col1]] < 0 & data[[col2]] > 0, na.rm = TRUE),  # Q2
      sum(data[[col1]] < 0 & data[[col2]] < 0, na.rm = TRUE),  # Q3
      sum(data[[col1]] > 0 & data[[col2]] < 0, na.rm = TRUE)   # Q4
    )
  }
  q_peaks <- calculate_quadrant_counts(df_peaks, logFC_x, logFC_y)
  q_pval  <- calculate_quadrant_counts(df_pval,  logFC_x, logFC_y)

  # R from the black dots
  cor_val <- round(cor(df_pval[[logFC_y]], df_pval[[logFC_x]], use = "complete.obs"), 2)

  plot_combined <- ggplot(df_peaks, aes_string(x = logFC_x, y = logFC_y)) +
    # red density from strong-peak genes
    geom_bin2d(bins = 70) +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "red", name = "Density") +
    # black points for significant p-values (overlay)
    geom_point(
      data = df_pval,
      aes_string(x = logFC_x, y = logFC_y),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      size = 1.2, alpha = 0.85, color = "black"
    ) +
    # Regression line from black points + identity line
    geom_smooth(
      data = df_pval,
      aes_string(x = logFC_x, y = logFC_y),
      method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black", fill = "black",
      alpha = 0.15, inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
    # Dashed quadrant boundaries
    geom_segment(aes(x = -max_bound, xend =  max_bound, y = -inner2, yend = -inner2), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
    geom_segment(aes(x = -max_bound, xend =  max_bound, y =  inner2, yend =  inner2), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
    geom_segment(aes(x = -inner1,   xend = -inner1,   y = -max_bound, yend =  max_bound), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
    geom_segment(aes(x =  inner1,   xend =  inner1,   y = -max_bound, yend =  max_bound), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
    # Axes at 0
    geom_segment(aes(x = -max_bound, xend =  max_bound, y = 0, yend = 0), color = "black") +
    geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend = 0, y = -max_bound, yend = max_bound), color = "black") +
    # Outer rectangle
    geom_rect(xmin = -max_bound, xmax = max_bound, ymin = -max_bound, ymax = max_bound, color = "black", fill = NA) +
    # R annotation
    annotate("text", x = -annot1, y = annot2, label = paste0("R = ", cor_val),
             size = 4.5, hjust = 0, color = "black") +
    # Quadrant count annotations: black (df_pval) and red (df_peaks)
    annotate("text", x =  annot1, y =  annot3,           label = paste("n =", q_pval[1]), hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 4, color = "black") +
    annotate("text", x =  annot1, y =  annot3 - delta,   label = paste("n =", q_peaks[1]), hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 4, color = "indianred2") +
    annotate("text", x = -annot1, y =  annot3,           label = paste("n =", q_pval[2]), hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 4, color = "black") +
    annotate("text", x = -annot1, y =  annot3 - delta,   label = paste("n =", q_peaks[2]), hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 4, color = "indianred2") +
    annotate("text", x = -annot1, y = -annot3,           label = paste("n =", q_pval[3]), hjust = 0, vjust = 0, size = 4, color = "black") +
    annotate("text", x = -annot1, y = -annot3 + delta,   label = paste("n =", q_peaks[3]), hjust = 0, vjust = 0, size = 4, color = "indianred2") +
    annotate("text", x =  annot1, y = -annot3,           label = paste("n =", q_pval[4]), hjust = 1, vjust = 0, size = 4, color = "black") +
    annotate("text", x =  annot1, y = -annot3 + delta,   label = paste("n =", q_peaks[4]), hjust = 1, vjust = 0, size = 4, color = "indianred2") +
    # Title + subtitle
    labs(
      title = paste(x_group, "vs", y_group),
      subtitle = subtitle_text,
      x = paste0("logFC_", tolower(x_group)),
      y = paste0("logFC_", tolower(y_group))
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      panel.grid       = element_blank(),
      axis.line        = element_line(color = "black"),
      axis.ticks       = element_line(color = "black"),
      axis.text        = element_text(color = "black"),
      axis.title       = element_text(color = "black"),
      plot.title       = element_text(color = "black"),
      plot.subtitle    = ggtext::element_markdown(),
      legend.text      = element_text(color = "black"),
      legend.title     = element_text(color = "black"),
      legend.background= element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      legend.key       = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-max_bound, max_bound), ylim = c(-max_bound, max_bound), expand = FALSE)

  return(list(merged_data = merged_data, peaks_df = df_peaks, sig_df = df_pval, plot = plot_combined))
}

```

```{r}
res <- plot_strongpeaks_DE(
  x_group = "Cond_HET_syn",
  y_group = "Cond_HET_nuc",
  fp_x = "output/DE/simple_HOMvsWT_syn.csv", 
  fp_y = "output/DE/simple_HOMvsWT_nuc.csv",
  strong_df = p60_targets,  # your filtered table with NearestTSS + Cotney cols
  peak_cols = c("Cotney_Mm.Frontal_Cx_WT_1-vs.Input","Cotney_Mm.Frontal_Cx_WT_2-vs.Input"),
```

#### Scatterplot function with points colored blue if Chd8 target

```{r}

# library(dplyr); library(ggplot2); library(ggtext)

plot_strongpeaks_DE_blue <- function(
  x_group, y_group, fp_x, fp_y,
  p60_targets,                          # data frame with NearestTSS
  threshold_type = c("pval", "fdr"),    # choose which threshold to use
  p_thresh = 0.05,                      # p-value cutoff
  fdr_thresh = 0.05,                    # FDR cutoff
  filter_mode = c("x_only", "both"),
  max_bound = 0.8
) {
  threshold_type <- match.arg(threshold_type)
  filter_mode    <- match.arg(filter_mode)

  # Helper to load & normalize DE csv: gene, logfc_<group>, pvalue_<group>, fdr_<group> (if present)
  load_and_rename <- function(fp, group, is_y_group = FALSE) {
    df <- read.csv(fp)
    is_pseudo <- (group == "Pseudobulk")

    if (is_pseudo) {
      df <- df %>%
        dplyr::select(gene, log2FoldChange, pvalue, padj, baseMean) %>%
        dplyr::rename(
          gene   = gene,
          logfc  = log2FoldChange,
          pvalue = pvalue,
          fdr    = padj
        ) %>%
        dplyr::rename_with(~paste0(.x, "_", tolower(group)), c("logfc","pvalue","fdr"))
      if (is_y_group) df <- df %>% dplyr::mutate(logCPM = log2(baseMean + 1))
    } else {
      colnames(df) <- tolower(colnames(df))
      gene_col <- ifelse("gene_name" %in% colnames(df), "gene_name", "gene")
      df <- df %>%
        dplyr::rename(
          gene   = dplyr::all_of(gene_col),
          logfc  = logfc,
          pvalue = pvalue
        ) %>%
        dplyr::rename_with(~paste0(.x, "_", tolower(group)), c("logfc","pvalue"))
      if ("fdr" %in% colnames(df)) {
        df <- df %>% dplyr::rename_with(~paste0(.x, "_", tolower(group)), "fdr")
      }
      if (is_y_group) {
        if ("logcpm" %in% colnames(df)) df <- df %>% dplyr::rename(logCPM = logcpm) else df$logCPM <- NA_real_
      }
    }
    df %>% dplyr::distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE)
  }

  # Load DE tables
  df_x <- load_and_rename(fp_x, x_group, is_y_group = FALSE)
  df_y <- load_and_rename(fp_y, y_group, is_y_group = TRUE)

  # Expression filter on y (same robust rule you use)
  median_val <- median(df_y$logCPM, na.rm = TRUE)
  mad_val    <- mad(df_y$logCPM, na.rm = TRUE)
  cutoff     <- median_val - 1 * mad_val
  df_y <- df_y %>% dplyr::filter(logCPM >= cutoff | is.na(logCPM))

  # Merge
  merged_data <- merge(df_y, df_x, by = "gene")

  # Dynamic column names
  pval_x  <- paste0("pvalue_", tolower(x_group))
  pval_y  <- paste0("pvalue_", tolower(y_group))
  fdr_x   <- paste0("fdr_",    tolower(x_group))
  fdr_y   <- paste0("fdr_",    tolower(y_group))
  logFC_x <- paste0("logfc_",  tolower(x_group))
  logFC_y <- paste0("logfc_",  tolower(y_group))

  # Choose thresholding to get plotted genes
  if (threshold_type == "pval") {
    if (filter_mode == "x_only") {
      df_keep <- merged_data %>% dplyr::filter(.data[[pval_x]] < p_thresh)
    } else {
      df_keep <- merged_data %>% dplyr::filter(.data[[pval_x]] < p_thresh | .data[[pval_y]] < p_thresh)
    }
    subline <- paste0("P-value < ", p_thresh, " (n = ", nrow(df_keep), ")")
  } else { # FDR
    if (!fdr_x %in% names(merged_data)) merged_data[[fdr_x]] <- NA_real_
    if (!fdr_y %in% names(merged_data)) merged_data[[fdr_y]] <- NA_real_
    if (filter_mode == "x_only") {
      df_keep <- merged_data %>% dplyr::filter(.data[[fdr_x]] < fdr_thresh)
    } else {
      df_keep <- merged_data %>% dplyr::filter(.data[[fdr_x]] < fdr_thresh | .data[[fdr_y]] < fdr_thresh)
    }
    subline <- paste0("FDR < ", fdr_thresh, " (n = ", nrow(df_keep), ")")
  }

  # Early return if nothing to plot
  if (nrow(df_keep) == 0) {
    warning("No genes passed the selected threshold. Returning empty plot.")
    return(list(
      merged_data = merged_data,
      kept_df = df_keep,
      plot = ggplot() + theme_void() + labs(
        title = paste(x_group, "vs", y_group),
        subtitle = "No genes passed the selected threshold"
      )
    ))
  }

  # Split: p60_targets = black points; others = blue density
  strong_genes <- unique(p60_targets$NearestTSS)
  df_keep$flag_p60 <- df_keep$gene %in% strong_genes
  df_p60   <- df_keep[df_keep$flag_p60, , drop = FALSE]   # black points
  df_other <- df_keep[!df_keep$flag_p60, , drop = FALSE]  # blue density

  # Quadrant counts (separately for black points and blue density)
  calculate_quadrant_counts <- function(data, col1, col2) {
    c(
      sum(data[[col1]] > 0 & data[[col2]] > 0, na.rm = TRUE),  # Q1
      sum(data[[col1]] < 0 & data[[col2]] > 0, na.rm = TRUE),  # Q2
      sum(data[[col1]] < 0 & data[[col2]] < 0, na.rm = TRUE),  # Q3
      sum(data[[col1]] > 0 & data[[col2]] < 0, na.rm = TRUE)   # Q4
    )
  }
  q_black <- calculate_quadrant_counts(df_p60,  logFC_x, logFC_y)   # p60 targets (points) — black
  q_blue  <- calculate_quadrant_counts(df_other, logFC_x, logFC_y)  # non-targets (density) — blue

  # R from all plotted genes
  cor_val <- round(cor(df_keep[[logFC_y]], df_keep[[logFC_x]], use = "complete.obs"), 2)

  # Layout offsets
  inner1 <- max_bound - 0.1     # vertical dashed lines
  inner2 <- max_bound - 0.15    # horizontal dashed lines
  annot1 <- max_bound - 0.12    # x for R text and quadrant counts
  annot2 <- max_bound - 0.23    # y for R text
  annot3 <- max_bound - 0.01    # base y for counts
  delta  <- 0.06                # vertical offset so blue/black counts don't overlap

  # Colors
  blue_col <- "#00BFFF"  # blue for density (non-targets)

  # Subtitle: threshold line in blue (pval or FDR), p60 count in black
  subtitle_text <- paste0(
    "<span style='color:", blue_col, "'>", subline, "</span><br>",
    "<span style='color:black'>in p60_targets (n=", nrow(df_p60), ")</span>"
  )

  # Plot: blue density for non-targets, black points for p60_targets
  plot_combined <- ggplot() +
    # Blue density for non-target genes
    geom_bin2d(
      data = df_other,
      aes_string(x = logFC_x, y = logFC_y),
      bins = 70
    ) +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = blue_col, name = "Density") +
    # Black points for p60_targets (on top)
    geom_point(
      data = df_p60,
      aes_string(x = logFC_x, y = logFC_y),
      color = "black", alpha = 0.9, size = 1.2
    ) +
    # Regression line from all plotted dots + identity line
    geom_smooth(
      data = df_keep,
      aes_string(x = logFC_x, y = logFC_y),
      method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black", fill = "black", alpha = 0.15
    ) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
    # Dashed quadrant boundaries
    geom_segment(aes(x = -max_bound, xend =  max_bound, y = -inner2, yend = -inner2),
                 linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
    geom_segment(aes(x = -max_bound, xend =  max_bound, y =  inner2, yend =  inner2),
                 linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
    geom_segment(aes(x = -inner1,   xend = -inner1,   y = -max_bound, yend =  max_bound),
                 linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
    geom_segment(aes(x =  inner1,   xend =  inner1,   y = -max_bound, yend =  max_bound),
                 linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
    # Axes at 0
    geom_segment(aes(x = -max_bound, xend =  max_bound, y = 0, yend = 0), color = "black") +
    geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend = 0, y = -max_bound, yend = max_bound), color = "black") +
    # Outer rectangle
    geom_rect(xmin = -max_bound, xmax = max_bound, ymin = -max_bound, ymax = max_bound,
              color = "black", fill = NA) +
    # R annotation
    annotate("text", x = -annot1, y = annot2, label = paste0("R = ", cor_val),
             size = 4.5, hjust = 0, color = "black") +
    # Quadrant count annotations (black = p60 targets; blue = non-targets)
    annotate("text", x =  annot1, y =  annot3,         label = paste("n =", q_black[1]),
             hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 4, color = "black") +
    annotate("text", x =  annot1, y =  annot3 - delta, label = paste("n =", q_blue[1]),
             hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 4, color = blue_col) +
    annotate("text", x = -annot1, y =  annot3,         label = paste("n =", q_black[2]),
             hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 4, color = "black") +
    annotate("text", x = -annot1, y =  annot3 - delta, label = paste("n =", q_blue[2]),
             hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 4, color = blue_col) +
    annotate("text", x = -annot1, y = -annot3,         label = paste("n =", q_black[3]),
             hjust = 0, vjust = 0, size = 4, color = "black") +
    annotate("text", x = -annot1, y = -annot3 + delta, label = paste("n =", q_blue[3]),
             hjust = 0, vjust = 0, size = 4, color = blue_col) +
    annotate("text", x =  annot1, y = -annot3,         label = paste("n =", q_black[4]),
             hjust = 1, vjust = 0, size = 4, color = "black") +
    annotate("text", x =  annot1, y = -annot3 + delta, label = paste("n =", q_blue[4]),
             hjust = 1, vjust = 0, size = 4, color = blue_col) +
    labs(
      title = paste(x_group, "vs", y_group),
      subtitle = subtitle_text,
      x = paste0("logFC_", tolower(x_group)),
      y = paste0("logFC_", tolower(y_group))
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      panel.grid       = element_blank(),
      axis.line        = element_line(color = "black"),
      axis.ticks       = element_line(color = "black"),
      axis.text        = element_text(color = "black"),
      axis.title       = element_text(color = "black"),
      plot.title       = element_text(color = "black"),
      plot.subtitle    = ggtext::element_markdown(),
      legend.position  = "none"
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-max_bound, max_bound), ylim = c(-max_bound, max_bound), expand = FALSE)

  return(list(merged_data = merged_data, kept_df = df_keep,
              p60_df = df_p60, other_df = df_other, plot = plot_combined))
}
```

```{r}
# Use symbols for custom gene-set plotting and heatmap concordance.
target_gene_map <- my_gene %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_id, gene_name, gene_biotype) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(gene_name), gene_name != "") %>%
  dplyr::distinct(gene_name, .keep_all = TRUE)

ens_to_symbol_target <- setNames(target_gene_map$gene_name, target_gene_map$gene_id)
protein_coding_symbols_target <- target_gene_map %>%
  dplyr::filter(gene_biotype == "protein_coding") %>%
  dplyr::pull(gene_name) %>%
  unique()

dge_target <- edgeR::DGEList(counts = exp_data_const_syn_nuc_cyt)
cpm_target <- edgeR::cpm(dge_target, log = FALSE)
expressed_gene_raw_target <- rownames(cpm_target)[rowSums(cpm_target > 1, na.rm = TRUE) >= 4]
expressed_symbols_target <- ifelse(
  grepl("^ENSMUSG", expressed_gene_raw_target),
  ens_to_symbol_target[sub("\\..*$", "", expressed_gene_raw_target)],
  expressed_gene_raw_target
) %>%
  unique() %>%
  stats::na.omit() %>%
  as.character()

target_clean_symbols <- function(x, require_expressed = TRUE) {
  x <- unique(as.character(x))
  x <- x[!is.na(x) & x != ""]
  if (require_expressed) {
    x <- intersect(x, expressed_symbols_target)
  }
  intersect(x, protein_coding_symbols_target)
}

target_go_symbols_from_ids <- function(go_ids, ontology = "BP") {
  valid_go <- AnnotationDbi::keys(org.Mm.eg.db, keytype = "GO")
  go_ok <- intersect(go_ids, valid_go)
  go_bad <- setdiff(go_ids, valid_go)
  if (length(go_bad) > 0) {
    message("Dropping GO IDs not found in org.Mm.eg.db: ", paste(go_bad, collapse = ", "))
  }
  if (length(go_ok) == 0) return(character())

  entrez <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(go_ok, function(go) {
    AnnotationDbi::select(
      org.Mm.eg.db,
      keys = go,
      keytype = "GO",
      columns = c("ENTREZID", "ONTOLOGY")
    )
  })) %>%
    dplyr::filter(ONTOLOGY == ontology, !is.na(ENTREZID)) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(ENTREZID)

  sym <- AnnotationDbi::select(
    org.Mm.eg.db,
    keys = unique(entrez$ENTREZID),
    keytype = "ENTREZID",
    columns = "SYMBOL"
  )
  unique(stats::na.omit(sym$SYMBOL))
}

target_go_symbols_from_terms <- function(go_terms, ontology = "BP") {
  valid_terms <- AnnotationDbi::keys(GO.db::GO.db, keytype = "TERM")
  bad_terms <- setdiff(go_terms, valid_terms)
  if (length(bad_terms) > 0) {
    warning("Dropping GO TERM(s) not found exactly in GO.db: ", paste(bad_terms, collapse = ", "))
  }
  terms_ok <- intersect(go_terms, valid_terms)
  if (length(terms_ok) == 0) return(character())

  go_ids <- unique(unlist(lapply(terms_ok, function(term_i) {
    AnnotationDbi::select(
      GO.db::GO.db,
      keys = term_i,
      keytype = "TERM",
      columns = c("GOID", "ONTOLOGY")
    ) %>%
      dplyr::filter(ONTOLOGY == ontology) %>%
      dplyr::pull(GOID)
  }), use.names = FALSE))

  target_go_symbols_from_ids(go_ids, ontology = ontology)
}

)

target_standardize_de <- function(fp) {
  df <- read.csv(fp, check.names = FALSE)
  names_lower <- tolower(colnames(df))

  gene_col <- colnames(df)[match(TRUE, names_lower %in% c("gene_name", "gene", "symbol", "genesymbol"))]
  if (is.na(gene_col) && "gene_id" %in% colnames(df)) gene_col <- "gene_id"

  logfc_col <- colnames(df)[match(TRUE, names_lower %in% c("logfc", "log2foldchange", "log2fc"))]
  p_col <- colnames(df)[match(TRUE, names_lower %in% c("pvalue", "pval", "p.value", "p_val"))]
  fdr_col <- colnames(df)[match(TRUE, names_lower %in% c("fdr", "padj", "adjp", "qvalue", "p.adjust"))]

  if (is.na(gene_col) || is.na(logfc_col) || is.na(p_col)) {
    stop(
      "Could not detect gene/logFC/pvalue columns in ", fp, "\n",
      "Columns: ", paste(colnames(df), collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  gene_raw <- as.character(df[[gene_col]])
  gene_sym <- ifelse(
    grepl("^ENSMUSG", gene_raw),
    ens_to_symbol_target[sub("\\..*$", "", gene_raw)],
    gene_raw
  )

  out <- tibble::tibble(
    gene = gene_sym,
    logfc = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(df[[logfc_col]])),
    pvalue = pmin(pmax(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(df[[p_col]])), 1e-300), 1),
    fdr = if (!is.na(fdr_col)) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(df[[fdr_col]])) else NA_real_
  ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(gene), gene != "", is.finite(logfc), is.finite(pvalue)) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE)

  # Match the expression filter currently embedded in compare_groups_plot for pseudobulk DESeq2 tables.
  if (all(c("gene", "log2FoldChange", "pvalue", "padj", "baseMean") %in% colnames(df))) {
    base_mean <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(df$baseMean))
    keep_gene <- gene_sym[!is.na(base_mean) & base_mean > 10 & log2(base_mean + 1) > 1]
    out <- out %>% dplyr::filter(gene %in% keep_gene)
  }

  out
}

target_de_list <- lapply(target_dataset_info$fp, target_standardize_de)
names(target_de_list) <- target_dataset_info$dataset

target_calc_c <- function(df1, df2, genes) {
  joined <- dplyr::inner_join(
    df1 %>% dplyr::filter(gene %in% genes) %>% dplyr::select(gene, logfc),
    df2 %>% dplyr::filter(gene %in% genes) %>% dplyr::select(gene, logfc),
    by = "gene",
    suffix = c(".x", ".y")
  ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(is.finite(logfc.x), is.finite(logfc.y))

  n_overlap <- nrow(joined)
  if (n_overlap == 0) {
    return(list(score = NA_real_, n = 0L))
  }

  same_dir <- sum(
    (joined$logfc.x > 0 & joined$logfc.y > 0) |
      (joined$logfc.x < 0 & joined$logfc.y < 0),
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
  opp_dir <- sum(
    (joined$logfc.x > 0 & joined$logfc.y < 0) |
      (joined$logfc.x < 0 & joined$logfc.y > 0),
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
  denom <- same_dir + opp_dir
  score <- if (denom == 0) NA_real_ else (same_dir - opp_dir) / denom
  list(score = score, n = n_overlap)
}

target_calc_direction_score <- function(df, genes, p_cutoff = 0.05, min_sig_genes = 5) {
  df2 <- df %>%
    dplyr::filter(gene %in% genes, is.finite(logfc), is.finite(pvalue), pvalue < p_cutoff)

  n_up <- sum(df2$logfc > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  n_down <- sum(df2$logfc < 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  n_total <- n_up + n_down

  if (n_total <= min_sig_genes) return(NA_real_)
  (n_up - n_down) / n_total
}

target_direction_color <- function(score) {
  if (is.na(score)) return("#B8B8B8")

  score <- max(min(score, 1), -1)
  scales::col_numeric(
    palette = c("#08306B", "#2CA25F", "#D9C93B", "#F28E2B", "#B30000"),
    domain = c(-1, 1)
  )(score)
}

target_direction_bar_df <- function(xmin = 9.5, xmax = 15.8, ymin = -2.95, ymax = -2.70, n = 240) {
  breaks <- seq(-1, 1, length.out = n + 1)
  mids <- (breaks[-length(breaks)] + breaks[-1]) / 2
  x_breaks <- seq(xmin, xmax, length.out = n + 1)

  data.frame(
    xmin = x_breaks[-length(x_breaks)],
    xmax = x_breaks[-1],
    ymin = ymin,
    ymax = ymax,
    direction_score = mids,
    fill = vapply(mids, target_direction_color, character(1)),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

target_build_heatmap_mats <- function(genes) {
  ds <- target_dataset_info$dataset
  k <- length(ds)
  score_mat <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = k, ncol = k, dimnames = list(ds, ds))
  n_mat <- matrix(NA_integer_, nrow = k, ncol = k, dimnames = list(ds, ds))

  for (i in seq_len(k)) {
    for (j in seq_len(k)) {
      if (i == j) {
        n_self <- sum(target_de_list[[ds[i]]]$gene %in% genes)
        score_mat[i, j] <- 1
        n_mat[i, j] <- n_self
      } else {
        res <- target_calc_c(target_de_list[[ds[i]]], target_de_list[[ds[j]]], genes)
        score_mat[i, j] <- res$score
        n_mat[i, j] <- res$n
      }
    }
  }
  list(score_mat = score_mat, n_mat = n_mat)
}

target_plot_heatmap <- function(score_mat, n_mat, set_name, n_genes, direction_scores) {
  ds <- target_dataset_info$dataset
  labels <- setNames(target_dataset_info$label, target_dataset_info$dataset)
  label_cols <- setNames(vapply(direction_scores[ds], target_direction_color, character(1)), ds)
  direction_bar_df <- target_direction_bar_df()

  plot_df <- as.data.frame(as.table(score_mat), stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
    dplyr::rename(Row = Var1, Col = Var2, Score = Freq) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      as.data.frame(as.table(n_mat), stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
        dplyr::rename(Row = Var1, Col = Var2, N = Freq),
      by = c("Row", "Col")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Row = factor(Row, levels = rev(ds)),
      Col = factor(Col, levels = ds),
      x = as.numeric(Col),
      y = as.numeric(Row),
      label = ifelse(is.na(Score), paste0("NA\nn=", N), paste0(sprintf("%.2f", Score), "\nn=", N))
    )

  x_lab_df <- tibble::tibble(
    dataset = ds,
    x = seq_along(ds),
    y = 0.20,
    label = labels[ds],
    label_col = label_cols[ds]
  )

  y_lab_df <- tibble::tibble(
    dataset = rev(ds),
    x = 0.20,
    y = seq_along(ds),
    label = labels[rev(ds)],
    label_col = label_cols[rev(ds)]
  )

  ggplot2::ggplot(plot_df, ggplot2::aes(x = x, y = y, fill = Score)) +
    ggplot2::geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.45) +
    ggplot2::geom_text(ggplot2::aes(label = label), size = 4.0, lineheight = 0.95) +
    ggplot2::geom_text(
      data = x_lab_df,
      ggplot2::aes(x = x, y = y, label = label, color = label_col),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1,
      vjust = 0.5,
      size = 5.7,
      fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_text(
      data = y_lab_df,
      ggplot2::aes(x = x, y = y, label = label, color = label_col),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      hjust = 1,
      vjust = 0.5,
      size = 5.7,
      fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_color_identity() +
    ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
      limits = c(0.10, length(ds) + 0.60),
      breaks = seq_along(ds),
      labels = rep("", length(ds)),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(-3.45, length(ds) + 0.55),
      breaks = seq_along(ds),
      labels = rep("", length(ds)),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_gradientn(
      colours = c("#6B4FD8", "white", "white", "#B89200"),
      values = scales::rescale(c(-1, -0.05, 0.05, 1), from = c(-1, 1)),
      limits = c(-1, 1),
      na.value = "grey90",
      breaks = c(-1, -0.5, 0, 0.5, 1),
      name = "C"
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_rect(
      data = direction_bar_df,
      ggplot2::aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      fill = direction_bar_df$fill,
      color = NA
    ) +
    ggplot2::annotate(
      "text",
      x = 12.65,
      y = -2.35,
      label = "p-value filtered direction score",
      size = 5.2,
      fontface = "bold",
      hjust = 0.5
    ) +
    ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 9.5, y = -3.12, label = "DOWN", size = 4.4, hjust = 0.5) +
    ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 12.65, y = -3.12, label = "balanced", size = 4.4, hjust = 0.5) +
    ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 15.8, y = -3.12, label = "UP", size = 4.4, hjust = 0.5) +
    ggplot2::annotate(
      "rect",
      xmin = 16.25, xmax = 16.65,
      ymin = -2.95, ymax = -2.70,
      fill = "#B8B8B8",
      color = NA
    ) +
    ggplot2::annotate(
      "text",
      x = 16.85,
      y = -2.82,
      label = "grey = <=5 genes with p-value < 0.05",
      size = 4.4,
      hjust = 0
    ) +
    ggplot2::coord_fixed(clip = "off") +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = paste0(set_name, " concordance heatmap"),
      subtitle = paste0(
        "Gene set size: n = ", n_genes,
        ". Cell labels show C and overlap n. Axis colors show direction score among p < 0.05 genes."
      ),
      x = NULL,
      y = NULL
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", size = 24),
      plot.subtitle = ggplot2::element_text(size = 16),
      axis.text = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      panel.grid = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 17),
      legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 15),
      plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(20, 90, 170, 160)
    )
}

target_plot_comparison <- function(comp_row, genes) {
  x_info <- target_dataset_info %>% dplyr::filter(dataset == comp_row$x_dataset)
  y_info <- target_dataset_info %>% dplyr::filter(dataset == comp_row$y_dataset)

  compare_groups_plot(
    x_group = comp_row$x_dataset,
    y_group = comp_row$y_dataset,
    fp_x = x_info$fp,
    fp_y = y_info$fp,
    FDR_padj_xy = 0.05,
    filter_mode = "both",
    p_value = 0.05,
    plot_pval_only = FALSE,
    no_filt = TRUE,
    custom_genes = genes,
    max_bound = comp_row$max_bound,
    mode = "concordance"
  )$plot +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = paste(x_info$label, "vs", y_info$label),
      x = paste0(x_info$label, " logFC"),
      y = paste0(y_info$label, " logFC")
    )
}

target_slug <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    stringr::str_to_lower() %>%
    stringr::str_replace_all("[^a-z0-9]+", "_") %>%
    stringr::str_replace_all("^_+|_+$", "")
}

target_pdf_fp <- file.path(target_outdir, "targeted_gene_set_concordance_heatmaps_and_plots.pdf")
target_plot_summary <- list()

grDevices::pdf(target_pdf_fp, width = 26, height = 17, onefile = TRUE)

for (set_name in names(target_gene_sets)) {
  genes_use <- unique(target_gene_sets[[set_name]])
  message("Targeted concordance gene set: ", set_name, " (n=", length(genes_use), ")")

  if (length(genes_use) < 3) {
    warning("Skipping ", set_name, ": fewer than 3 genes.")
    next
  }

  mats <- target_build_heatmap_mats(genes_use)
  direction_scores <- vapply(
    target_dataset_info$dataset,
    function(ds) target_calc_direction_score(target_de_list[[ds]], genes_use, p_cutoff = 0.05, min_sig_genes = 5),
    numeric(1)
  )
  print(target_plot_heatmap(mats$score_mat, mats$n_mat, set_name, length(genes_use), direction_scores))

  plot_list <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(target_comparisons)), function(i) {
    comp_row <- target_comparisons[i, ]
    tryCatch(
      target_plot_comparison(comp_row, genes_use),
      error = function(e) {
        ggplot2::ggplot() +
          ggplot2::theme_void() +
          ggplot2::labs(
            title = comp_row$name,
            subtitle = paste("Plot failed:", conditionMessage(e))
          )
      }
    )
  })

  names(plot_list) <- target_comparisons$name
  plot_pages <- split(plot_list, ceiling(seq_along(plot_list) / 6))

  for (page_i in seq_along(plot_pages)) {
    page_title <- ggplot2::ggplot() +
      ggplot2::theme_void() +
      ggplot2::labs(title = paste0(set_name, " concordance plots, page ", page_i)) +
      ggplot2::theme(plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 24, face = "bold"))

    print(
      page_title /
        patchwork::wrap_plots(plot_pages[[page_i]], ncol = 3) +
        patchwork::plot_layout(heights = c(0.08, 1))
    )
  }

  comp_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(target_comparisons)), function(i) {
    comp_row <- target_comparisons[i, ]
    res <- target_calc_c(
      target_de_list[[comp_row$x_dataset]],
      target_de_list[[comp_row$y_dataset]],
      genes_use
    )
    tibble::tibble(
      gene_set = set_name,
      comparison = comp_row$name,
      x_dataset = comp_row$x_dataset,
      y_dataset = comp_row$y_dataset,
      x_direction_score_p05 = direction_scores[[comp_row$x_dataset]],
      y_direction_score_p05 = direction_scores[[comp_row$y_dataset]],
      c_score = res$score,
      n_overlap = res$n
    )
  }))

  target_plot_summary[[set_name]] <- comp_summary
}

grDevices::dev.off()

target_plot_summary_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(target_plot_summary)
readr::write_csv(
  target_plot_summary_df,
  file.path(target_outdir, "targeted_gene_set_comparison_summary.csv")
)

message("Wrote targeted gene-set concordance PDF: ", target_pdf_fp)
```

#### Scatterplot function

```{r}

plot_strongpeaks_DE <- function(x_group, y_group, fp_x, fp_y,
                                strong_df, peak_cols = c("Cotney_Mm.Frontal_Cx_WT_1-vs.Input",
                                                         "Cotney_Mm.Frontal_Cx_WT_2-vs.Input"),
                                max_bound = 0.8) {

  # helper to load & normalize a DE csv to columns:
  # gene, logfc_<group>, pvalue_<group>, (fdr_<group> if present), and for y adds logCPM if available
  load_and_rename <- function(fp, group, is_y_group = FALSE) {
    df <- read.csv(fp)
    is_pseudo <- (group == "Pseudobulk")

    if (is_pseudo) {
      df <- df %>%
        dplyr::select(gene, log2FoldChange, pvalue, padj, baseMean) %>%
        dplyr::rename(
          gene   = gene,
          logfc  = log2FoldChange,
          pvalue = pvalue,
          fdr    = padj
        ) %>%
        dplyr::rename_with(~paste0(.x, "_", tolower(group)), c("logfc","pvalue","fdr"))
      if (is_y_group) df <- df %>% dplyr::mutate(logCPM = log2(baseMean + 1))
    } else {
      colnames(df) <- tolower(colnames(df))
      gene_col <- ifelse("gene_name" %in% colnames(df), "gene_name", "gene")
      df <- df %>%
        dplyr::rename(
          gene   = dplyr::all_of(gene_col),
          logfc  = logfc,
          pvalue = pvalue
        ) %>%
        dplyr::rename_with(~paste0(.x, "_", tolower(group)), c("logfc","pvalue"))
      if ("fdr" %in% colnames(df)) {
        df <- df %>% dplyr::rename_with(~paste0(.x, "_", tolower(group)), "fdr")
      }
      if (is_y_group) {
        if ("logcpm" %in% colnames(df)) df <- df %>% dplyr::rename(logCPM = logcpm) else df$logCPM <- NA_real_
      }
    }
    df %>% dplyr::distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE)
  }

  # Load DE tables
  df_x <- load_and_rename(fp_x, x_group, is_y_group = FALSE)
  df_y <- load_and_rename(fp_y, y_group, is_y_group = TRUE)

  # Filter y_group by expression (same robust rule you use)
  median_val <- median(df_y$logCPM, na.rm = TRUE)
  mad_val    <- mad(df_y$logCPM, na.rm = TRUE)
  cutoff     <- median_val - 1 * mad_val
  df_y <- df_y %>% dplyr::filter(logCPM >= cutoff | is.na(logCPM))

  # Merge DE tables
  merged_data <- merge(df_y, df_x, by = "gene")

  # Dynamic colnames
  pval_x  <- paste0("pvalue_", tolower(x_group))
  pval_y  <- paste0("pvalue_", tolower(y_group))
  logFC_x <- paste0("logfc_",  tolower(x_group))
  logFC_y <- paste0("logfc_",  tolower(y_group))

  # Strong-peak gene set: NearestTSS with BOTH Cotney cols > 0.50
  strong_set <- strong_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(dplyr::if_all(dplyr::all_of(peak_cols), ~ .x > 0.50)) %>%
    dplyr::pull(NearestTSS) %>%
    unique()

  # Background for density = all strong-peak genes found in merged_data
  df_peaks <- merged_data %>% dplyr::filter(gene %in% strong_set)

  # Foreground points = strong peaks with pval < 0.05 in either dataset 
  df_pval <- merged_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(gene %in% strong_set, .data[[pval_x]] < 0.05 | .data[[pval_y]] < 0.05)

  # Subtitle text
  subtitle_text <- paste0(
    "<span style='color:indianred2'>Peak percentile &gt; 0.50 in both Cotney datasets: n = ", nrow(df_peaks), "</span><br>",
    "<span style='color:black'>High peak percentile + p-value &lt; 0.05 in either DE: n = ", nrow(df_pval), "</span>"
  )

  # Decorations (same layout vibe)
  inner1 <- max_bound - 0.1
  inner2 <- max_bound - 0.15
  annot1 <- max_bound - 0.12  # x for quadrant counts
  annot2 <- max_bound - 0.23  # y for R text (like your original)
  annot3 <- max_bound - 0.01  # base y for counts
  delta  <- 0.06              # small vertical offset so red/black counts don't overlap

  # Quadrant counts
  calculate_quadrant_counts <- function(data, col1, col2) {
    c(
      sum(data[[col1]] > 0 & data[[col2]] > 0, na.rm = TRUE),  # Q1
      sum(data[[col1]] < 0 & data[[col2]] > 0, na.rm = TRUE),  # Q2
      sum(data[[col1]] < 0 & data[[col2]] < 0, na.rm = TRUE),  # Q3
      sum(data[[col1]] > 0 & data[[col2]] < 0, na.rm = TRUE)   # Q4
    )
  }
  q_peaks <- calculate_quadrant_counts(df_peaks, logFC_x, logFC_y)
  q_pval  <- calculate_quadrant_counts(df_pval,  logFC_x, logFC_y)

  # R from the black dots
  cor_val <- round(cor(df_pval[[logFC_y]], df_pval[[logFC_x]], use = "complete.obs"), 2)

  plot_combined <- ggplot(df_peaks, aes_string(x = logFC_x, y = logFC_y)) +
    # red density from strong-peak genes
    geom_bin2d(bins = 70) +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "red", name = "Density") +
    # black points for significant p-values (overlay)
    geom_point(
      data = df_pval,
      aes_string(x = logFC_x, y = logFC_y),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      size = 1.2, alpha = 0.85, color = "black"
    ) +
    # Regression line from black points + identity line
    geom_smooth(
      data = df_pval,
      aes_string(x = logFC_x, y = logFC_y),
      method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black", fill = "black",
      alpha = 0.15, inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
    # Dashed quadrant boundaries
    geom_segment(aes(x = -max_bound, xend =  max_bound, y = -inner2, yend = -inner2), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
    geom_segment(aes(x = -max_bound, xend =  max_bound, y =  inner2, yend =  inner2), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
    geom_segment(aes(x = -inner1,   xend = -inner1,   y = -max_bound, yend =  max_bound), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
    geom_segment(aes(x =  inner1,   xend =  inner1,   y = -max_bound, yend =  max_bound), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
    # Axes at 0
    geom_segment(aes(x = -max_bound, xend =  max_bound, y = 0, yend = 0), color = "black") +
    geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend = 0, y = -max_bound, yend = max_bound), color = "black") +
    # Outer rectangle
    geom_rect(xmin = -max_bound, xmax = max_bound, ymin = -max_bound, ymax = max_bound, color = "black", fill = NA) +
    # R annotation
    annotate("text", x = -annot1, y = annot2, label = paste0("R = ", cor_val),
             size = 4.5, hjust = 0, color = "black") +
    # Quadrant count annotations: black (df_pval) and red (df_peaks)
    annotate("text", x =  annot1, y =  annot3,           label = paste("n =", q_pval[1]), hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 4, color = "black") +
    annotate("text", x =  annot1, y =  annot3 - delta,   label = paste("n =", q_peaks[1]), hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 4, color = "indianred2") +
    annotate("text", x = -annot1, y =  annot3,           label = paste("n =", q_pval[2]), hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 4, color = "black") +
    annotate("text", x = -annot1, y =  annot3 - delta,   label = paste("n =", q_peaks[2]), hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 4, color = "indianred2") +
    annotate("text", x = -annot1, y = -annot3,           label = paste("n =", q_pval[3]), hjust = 0, vjust = 0, size = 4, color = "black") +
    annotate("text", x = -annot1, y = -annot3 + delta,   label = paste("n =", q_peaks[3]), hjust = 0, vjust = 0, size = 4, color = "indianred2") +
    annotate("text", x =  annot1, y = -annot3,           label = paste("n =", q_pval[4]), hjust = 1, vjust = 0, size = 4, color = "black") +
    annotate("text", x =  annot1, y = -annot3 + delta,   label = paste("n =", q_peaks[4]), hjust = 1, vjust = 0, size = 4, color = "indianred2") +
    # Title + subtitle
    labs(
      title = paste(x_group, "vs", y_group),
      subtitle = subtitle_text,
      x = paste0("logFC_", tolower(x_group)),
      y = paste0("logFC_", tolower(y_group))
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      panel.grid       = element_blank(),
      axis.line        = element_line(color = "black"),
      axis.ticks       = element_line(color = "black"),
      axis.text        = element_text(color = "black"),
      axis.title       = element_text(color = "black"),
      plot.title       = element_text(color = "black"),
      plot.subtitle    = ggtext::element_markdown(),
      legend.text      = element_text(color = "black"),
      legend.title     = element_text(color = "black"),
      legend.background= element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      legend.key       = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-max_bound, max_bound), ylim = c(-max_bound, max_bound), expand = FALSE)

  return(list(merged_data = merged_data, peaks_df = df_peaks, sig_df = df_pval, plot = plot_combined))
}
```

#### Scatterplot function with points colored blue if Chd8 target

```{r}

# library(dplyr); library(ggplot2); library(ggtext)

plot_strongpeaks_DE_blue <- function(
  x_group, y_group, fp_x, fp_y,
  p60_targets,                          # data frame with NearestTSS
  threshold_type = c("pval", "fdr"),    # choose which threshold to use
  p_thresh = 0.05,                      # p-value cutoff
  fdr_thresh = 0.05,                    # FDR cutoff
  filter_mode = c("x_only", "both"),
  max_bound = 0.8
) {
  threshold_type <- match.arg(threshold_type)
  filter_mode    <- match.arg(filter_mode)

  # Helper to load & normalize DE csv: gene, logfc_<group>, pvalue_<group>, fdr_<group> (if present)
  load_and_rename <- function(fp, group, is_y_group = FALSE) {
    df <- read.csv(fp)
    is_pseudo <- (group == "Pseudobulk")

    if (is_pseudo) {
      df <- df %>%
        dplyr::select(gene, log2FoldChange, pvalue, padj, baseMean) %>%
        dplyr::rename(
          gene   = gene,
          logfc  = log2FoldChange,
          pvalue = pvalue,
          fdr    = padj
        ) %>%
        dplyr::rename_with(~paste0(.x, "_", tolower(group)), c("logfc","pvalue","fdr"))
      if (is_y_group) df <- df %>% dplyr::mutate(logCPM = log2(baseMean + 1))
    } else {
      colnames(df) <- tolower(colnames(df))
      gene_col <- ifelse("gene_name" %in% colnames(df), "gene_name", "gene")
      df <- df %>%
        dplyr::rename(
          gene   = dplyr::all_of(gene_col),
          logfc  = logfc,
          pvalue = pvalue
        ) %>%
        dplyr::rename_with(~paste0(.x, "_", tolower(group)), c("logfc","pvalue"))
      if ("fdr" %in% colnames(df)) {
        df <- df %>% dplyr::rename_with(~paste0(.x, "_", tolower(group)), "fdr")
      }
      if (is_y_group) {
        if ("logcpm" %in% colnames(df)) df <- df %>% dplyr::rename(logCPM = logcpm) else df$logCPM <- NA_real_
      }
    }
    df %>% dplyr::distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE)
  }

  # Load DE tables
  df_x <- load_and_rename(fp_x, x_group, is_y_group = FALSE)
  df_y <- load_and_rename(fp_y, y_group, is_y_group = TRUE)

  # Expression filter on y (same robust rule you use)
  median_val <- median(df_y$logCPM, na.rm = TRUE)
  mad_val    <- mad(df_y$logCPM, na.rm = TRUE)
  cutoff     <- median_val - 1 * mad_val
  df_y <- df_y %>% dplyr::filter(logCPM >= cutoff | is.na(logCPM))

  # Merge
  merged_data <- merge(df_y, df_x, by = "gene")

  # Dynamic column names
  pval_x  <- paste0("pvalue_", tolower(x_group))
  pval_y  <- paste0("pvalue_", tolower(y_group))
  fdr_x   <- paste0("fdr_",    tolower(x_group))
  fdr_y   <- paste0("fdr_",    tolower(y_group))
  logFC_x <- paste0("logfc_",  tolower(x_group))
  logFC_y <- paste0("logfc_",  tolower(y_group))

  # Choose thresholding to get plotted genes
  if (threshold_type == "pval") {
    if (filter_mode == "x_only") {
      df_keep <- merged_data %>% dplyr::filter(.data[[pval_x]] < p_thresh)
    } else {
      df_keep <- merged_data %>% dplyr::filter(.data[[pval_x]] < p_thresh | .data[[pval_y]] < p_thresh)
    }
    subline <- paste0("P-value < ", p_thresh, " (n = ", nrow(df_keep), ")")
  } else { # FDR
    if (!fdr_x %in% names(merged_data)) merged_data[[fdr_x]] <- NA_real_
    if (!fdr_y %in% names(merged_data)) merged_data[[fdr_y]] <- NA_real_
    if (filter_mode == "x_only") {
      df_keep <- merged_data %>% dplyr::filter(.data[[fdr_x]] < fdr_thresh)
    } else {
      df_keep <- merged_data %>% dplyr::filter(.data[[fdr_x]] < fdr_thresh | .data[[fdr_y]] < fdr_thresh)
    }
    subline <- paste0("FDR < ", fdr_thresh, " (n = ", nrow(df_keep), ")")
  }

  # Early return if nothing to plot
  if (nrow(df_keep) == 0) {
    warning("No genes passed the selected threshold. Returning empty plot.")
    return(list(
      merged_data = merged_data,
      kept_df = df_keep,
      plot = ggplot() + theme_void() + labs(
        title = paste(x_group, "vs", y_group),
        subtitle = "No genes passed the selected threshold"
      )
    ))
  }

  # Split: p60_targets = black points; others = blue density
  strong_genes <- unique(p60_targets$NearestTSS)
  df_keep$flag_p60 <- df_keep$gene %in% strong_genes
  df_p60   <- df_keep[df_keep$flag_p60, , drop = FALSE]   # black points
  df_other <- df_keep[!df_keep$flag_p60, , drop = FALSE]  # blue density

  # Quadrant counts (separately for black points and blue density)
  calculate_quadrant_counts <- function(data, col1, col2) {
    c(
      sum(data[[col1]] > 0 & data[[col2]] > 0, na.rm = TRUE),  # Q1
      sum(data[[col1]] < 0 & data[[col2]] > 0, na.rm = TRUE),  # Q2
      sum(data[[col1]] < 0 & data[[col2]] < 0, na.rm = TRUE),  # Q3
      sum(data[[col1]] > 0 & data[[col2]] < 0, na.rm = TRUE)   # Q4
    )
  }
  q_black <- calculate_quadrant_counts(df_p60,  logFC_x, logFC_y)   # p60 targets (points) — black
  q_blue  <- calculate_quadrant_counts(df_other, logFC_x, logFC_y)  # non-targets (density) — blue

  # R from all plotted genes
  cor_val <- round(cor(df_keep[[logFC_y]], df_keep[[logFC_x]], use = "complete.obs"), 2)

  # Layout offsets
  inner1 <- max_bound - 0.1     # vertical dashed lines
  inner2 <- max_bound - 0.15    # horizontal dashed lines
  annot1 <- max_bound - 0.12    # x for R text and quadrant counts
  annot2 <- max_bound - 0.23    # y for R text
  annot3 <- max_bound - 0.01    # base y for counts
  delta  <- 0.06                # vertical offset so blue/black counts don't overlap

  # Colors
  blue_col <- "#00BFFF"  # blue for density (non-targets)

  # Subtitle: threshold line in blue (pval or FDR), p60 count in black
  subtitle_text <- paste0(
    "<span style='color:", blue_col, "'>", subline, "</span><br>",
    "<span style='color:black'>in p60_targets (n=", nrow(df_p60), ")</span>"
  )

  # Plot: blue density for non-targets, black points for p60_targets
  plot_combined <- ggplot() +
    # Blue density for non-target genes
    geom_bin2d(
      data = df_other,
      aes_string(x = logFC_x, y = logFC_y),
      bins = 70
    ) +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = blue_col, name = "Density") +
    # Black points for p60_targets (on top)
    geom_point(
      data = df_p60,
      aes_string(x = logFC_x, y = logFC_y),
      color = "black", alpha = 0.9, size = 1.2
    ) +
    # Regression line from all plotted dots + identity line
    geom_smooth(
      data = df_keep,
      aes_string(x = logFC_x, y = logFC_y),
      method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black", fill = "black", alpha = 0.15
    ) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
    # Dashed quadrant boundaries
    geom_segment(aes(x = -max_bound, xend =  max_bound, y = -inner2, yend = -inner2),
                 linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
    geom_segment(aes(x = -max_bound, xend =  max_bound, y =  inner2, yend =  inner2),
                 linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
    geom_segment(aes(x = -inner1,   xend = -inner1,   y = -max_bound, yend =  max_bound),
                 linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
    geom_segment(aes(x =  inner1,   xend =  inner1,   y = -max_bound, yend =  max_bound),
                 linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
    # Axes at 0
    geom_segment(aes(x = -max_bound, xend =  max_bound, y = 0, yend = 0), color = "black") +
    geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend = 0, y = -max_bound, yend = max_bound), color = "black") +
    # Outer rectangle
    geom_rect(xmin = -max_bound, xmax = max_bound, ymin = -max_bound, ymax = max_bound,
              color = "black", fill = NA) +
    # R annotation
    annotate("text", x = -annot1, y = annot2, label = paste0("R = ", cor_val),
             size = 4.5, hjust = 0, color = "black") +
    # Quadrant count annotations (black = p60 targets; blue = non-targets)
    annotate("text", x =  annot1, y =  annot3,         label = paste("n =", q_black[1]),
             hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 4, color = "black") +
    annotate("text", x =  annot1, y =  annot3 - delta, label = paste("n =", q_blue[1]),
             hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 4, color = blue_col) +
    annotate("text", x = -annot1, y =  annot3,         label = paste("n =", q_black[2]),
             hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 4, color = "black") +
    annotate("text", x = -annot1, y =  annot3 - delta, label = paste("n =", q_blue[2]),
             hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 4, color = blue_col) +
    annotate("text", x = -annot1, y = -annot3,         label = paste("n =", q_black[3]),
             hjust = 0, vjust = 0, size = 4, color = "black") +
    annotate("text", x = -annot1, y = -annot3 + delta, label = paste("n =", q_blue[3]),
             hjust = 0, vjust = 0, size = 4, color = blue_col) +
    annotate("text", x =  annot1, y = -annot3,         label = paste("n =", q_black[4]),
             hjust = 1, vjust = 0, size = 4, color = "black") +
    annotate("text", x =  annot1, y = -annot3 + delta, label = paste("n =", q_blue[4]),
             hjust = 1, vjust = 0, size = 4, color = blue_col) +
    labs(
      title = paste(x_group, "vs", y_group),
      subtitle = subtitle_text,
      x = paste0("logFC_", tolower(x_group)),
      y = paste0("logFC_", tolower(y_group))
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      panel.grid       = element_blank(),
      axis.line        = element_line(color = "black"),
      axis.ticks       = element_line(color = "black"),
      axis.text        = element_text(color = "black"),
      axis.title       = element_text(color = "black"),
      plot.title       = element_text(color = "black"),
      plot.subtitle    = ggtext::element_markdown(),
      legend.position  = "none"
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-max_bound, max_bound), ylim = c(-max_bound, max_bound), expand = FALSE)

  return(list(merged_data = merged_data, kept_df = df_keep,
              p60_df = df_p60, other_df = df_other, plot = plot_combined))
}
```

```{r}
# Read in DE results
DE_Const_whole <- read.csv("/Users/salozano/Library/Mobile Documents/com~apple~CloudDocs/Documents/Data Analysis/2022/Regional bulk RNA-seq/DE/DE_Ctx_full.csv")
DE_Const_syn <- read.csv("/Users/salozano/Library/Mobile Documents/com~apple~CloudDocs/Documents/Data Analysis/2025/Conditional_syn_nuc/output/DE/simple_Const_syn_NOPC.csv")
DE_Const_nuc <- read.csv("/Users/salozano/Library/Mobile Documents/com~apple~CloudDocs/Documents/Data Analysis/2025/Conditional_syn_nuc/output/DE/simple_Const_nuc_NOPC.csv")
DE_Cond_whole <- read.csv("/Users/salozano/Library/Mobile Documents/com~apple~CloudDocs/Documents/Data Analysis/2025/Conditional_syn_nuc/output/DE/DE_simple_conditional.csv")
DE_Cond_nuc_het <- read.csv("/Users/salozano/Library/Mobile Documents/com~apple~CloudDocs/Documents/Data Analysis/2025/Conditional_syn_nuc/output/DE/simple_HETvsWT_nuc.csv")
DE_Cond_syn_het <- read.csv("/Users/salozano/Library/Mobile Documents/com~apple~CloudDocs/Documents/Data Analysis/2025/Conditional_syn_nuc/output/DE/simple_HETvsWT_syn.csv")
DE_Cond_nuc_hom <- read.csv("/Users/salozano/Library/Mobile Documents/com~apple~CloudDocs/Documents/Data Analysis/2025/Conditional_syn_nuc/output/DE/simple_HOMvsWT_nuc.csv")
DE_Cond_syn_hom <- read.csv("/Users/salozano/Library/Mobile Documents/com~apple~CloudDocs/Documents/Data Analysis/2025/Conditional_syn_nuc/output/DE/simple_HOMvsWT_syn.csv")




## ---- helper to standardize DE tables (keeps gene) ----
std_de <- function(df) {
  gene_col  <- intersect(c("gene","Gene","symbol","gene_name","GeneSymbol"), colnames(df))[1]
  logfc_col <- intersect(c("logFC","log2FoldChange"), colnames(df))[1]
  p_col     <- intersect(c("PValue","pvalue","pvalue_to_significance","p.value","p_val"), colnames(df))[1]
  fdr_col   <- intersect(c("FDR","FDR_syn","FDR_nuc","padj","p.adjust"), colnames(df))[1]
  stopifnot(!is.na(gene_col), !is.na(logfc_col), !is.na(p_col))

  out <- df[, unique(na.omit(c(gene_col, logfc_col, p_col, fdr_col))), drop = FALSE]
  colnames(out)[match(c(gene_col, logfc_col, p_col), colnames(out))] <- c("gene","logFC","PValue")
  if (!is.na(fdr_col)) colnames(out)[colnames(out) == fdr_col] <- "FDR"
  out %>%
    mutate(
      gene   = as.character(gene),
      logFC  = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(logFC)),
      PValue = pmin(pmax(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(PValue)), 1e-300), 1),  # avoid 0
      FDR    = if ("FDR" %in% colnames(.)) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(FDR)) else NA_real_
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(gene), gene != "", is.finite(PValue), !is.na(logFC)) %>%
    distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE)
}

## ---- collect all datasets ----
de_raw <- list(
  Const_whole = DE_Const_whole,
  Const_syn   = DE_Const_syn,
  Const_nuc   = DE_Const_nuc,
  Cond_whole  = DE_Cond_whole,
  Cond_nuc_HET = DE_Cond_nuc_het,
  Cond_syn_HET = DE_Cond_syn_het,
  Cond_nuc_HOM = DE_Cond_nuc_hom,
  Cond_syn_HOM = DE_Cond_syn_hom
)

de <- lapply(de_raw, std_de)

## ---- pick top-25 per dataset (by P, within direction) ----
pick_top_genes <- function(df, direction = c("up","down"), n = 25) {
  direction <- match.arg(direction)
  fil <- if (direction == "up") df$logFC > 0 else df$logFC < 0
  df %>%
    filter(fil) %>%
    arrange(PValue, desc(abs(logFC))) %>%
    slice_head(n = n) %>%
    pull(gene)
}

top_up_genes   <- unique(unlist(lapply(de, pick_top_genes, direction = "up",   n = 25)))
top_down_genes <- unique(unlist(lapply(de, pick_top_genes, direction = "down", n = 25)))

## ---- build -log10(pvalue) matrices (fill missing with 0) ----
build_pmat <- function(genes, de_list) {
  M <- sapply(names(de_list), function(ds) {
    df  <- de_list[[ds]]
    pby <- setNames(df$PValue, df$gene)
    pv  <- unname(pby[genes])
    pv[is.na(pv)] <- 1  # missing genes -> p=1
    as.numeric(-log10(pv))
  })
  rownames(M) <- genes
  M
}

mat_up   <- build_pmat(top_up_genes,   de)
mat_down <- build_pmat(top_down_genes, de)

## ---- cap at 5 ----
mat_up_cap   <- pmin(mat_up, 5)
mat_down_cap <- pmin(mat_down, 5)

## ---- new breaks (0 to 5) ----
brks <- seq(0, 5, length.out = 201)

## ---- colors ----
cols_up   <- colorRampPalette(c("#F7F7F7", "#B2182B"))(200)
cols_down <- colorRampPalette(c("#F7F7F7", "#2166AC"))(200)

## ---- plot capped heatmaps ----
pheatmap(mat_up_cap,
         color = cols_up, breaks = brks,
         cluster_rows = TRUE, cluster_cols = TRUE,
         show_rownames = FALSE, show_colnames = TRUE,
         main = "-log10(pval) Top 25 upregulated DEGs per dataset",
         legend = TRUE, border_color = NA)

pheatmap(mat_down_cap,
         color = cols_down, breaks = brks,
         cluster_rows = TRUE, cluster_cols = TRUE,
         show_rownames = FALSE, show_colnames = TRUE,
         main = "-log10(pval) Top 25 downregulated DEGs per dataset",
         legend = TRUE, border_color = NA)


```


# 9. GO enrichment analysis


## Function
```{r}


run_go <- function(
  in_csv,
  y_rds,
  outdir = "output/GO/final_DE",
  prefix = NULL,            # e.g. "Const_syn_NOPC"
  p_thresh = 0.05,
  ont = "BP"
) {
  stopifnot(file.exists(in_csv), file.exists(y_rds))
  dir.create(outdir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

  top30_dir <- file.path(outdir, "top30")
  dir.create(top30_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

  # packages (fail loudly if missing)
  stopifnot(requireNamespace("readr", quietly = TRUE))
  stopifnot(requireNamespace("dplyr", quietly = TRUE))
  stopifnot(requireNamespace("openxlsx", quietly = TRUE))
  stopifnot(requireNamespace("clusterProfiler", quietly = TRUE))
  stopifnot(requireNamespace("org.Mm.eg.db", quietly = TRUE))
  stopifnot(requireNamespace("AnnotationDbi", quietly = TRUE))

  # -----------------------------
  # 1) Read DE table + detect columns
  # -----------------------------
  de <- readr::read_csv(in_csv, show_col_types = FALSE)

  cols_low <- tolower(names(de))
  gene_col <- names(de)[match(TRUE, cols_low %in% c("gene","gene_name","symbol"))]
  fdr_col  <- names(de)[match(TRUE, cols_low %in% c("fdr","padj","p_adj","p.adjust","p_val_adj"))]
  p_col    <- names(de)[match(TRUE, cols_low %in% c("pvalue","p_val","p.val"))]
  lfc_col  <- names(de)[match(TRUE, cols_low %in% c("logfc","log2fc","log2foldchange","log_fc"))]

  stopifnot(!is.na(gene_col), !is.na(p_col), !is.na(lfc_col))

  de <- de |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      gene  = as.character(.data[[gene_col]]),
      puse  = as.numeric(.data[[p_col]]),
      logFC = as.numeric(.data[[lfc_col]])
    ) |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(gene), gene != "", !is.na(puse), !is.na(logFC))

  # -----------------------------
  # 2) Load y object + universe
  # -----------------------------
  y <- readRDS(y_rds)
  if (!("counts" %in% names(y))) stop("y object does not contain y$counts.")
  universe_raw <- unique(rownames(y$counts))

  # -----------------------------
  # 3) DEG sets
  # -----------------------------
  deg_up   <- de |> dplyr::filter(puse < p_thresh, logFC > 0) |> dplyr::pull(gene) |> unique()
  deg_down <- de |> dplyr::filter(puse < p_thresh, logFC < 0) |> dplyr::pull(gene) |> unique()

  # -----------------------------
  # 3b) Align ID space between DE genes and universe
  # -----------------------------
  looks_ensembl <- function(x) mean(grepl("^ENS", x)) > 0.5
  deg_are_ens <- looks_ensembl(deg_up)
  uni_are_ens <- looks_ensembl(universe_raw)

  keyType <- if (deg_are_ens) "ENSEMBL" else "SYMBOL"
  universe_syms <- universe_raw

  if (keyType == "SYMBOL" && uni_are_ens) {
    m <- AnnotationDbi::select(
      org.Mm.eg.db::org.Mm.eg.db,
      keys = universe_raw,
      keytype = "ENSEMBL",
      columns = c("SYMBOL")
    )
    m <- m[!is.na(m$SYMBOL) & m$SYMBOL != "", , drop = FALSE]
    m <- m[!duplicated(m$ENSEMBL), , drop = FALSE]
    universe_syms <- unique(m$SYMBOL)
  }

  if (keyType == "ENSEMBL" && !uni_are_ens) {
    m <- AnnotationDbi::select(
      org.Mm.eg.db::org.Mm.eg.db,
      keys = universe_raw,
      keytype = "SYMBOL",
      columns = c("ENSEMBL")
    )
    m <- m[!is.na(m$ENSEMBL) & m$ENSEMBL != "", , drop = FALSE]
    m <- m[!duplicated(m$SYMBOL), , drop = FALSE]
    universe_syms <- unique(m$ENSEMBL)
  }

  if (length(universe_syms) < 1000) {
    message("Warning: universe looks small (", length(universe_syms), "). Check that rownames(y$counts) map cleanly to ", keyType, ".")
  }

  # -----------------------------
  # 4) Helper: run enrichGO + write outputs
  # -----------------------------
  run_go_one <- function(gene_set, label, out_fp_full, out_fp_top30) {
    if (length(gene_set) == 0) {
      openxlsx::write.xlsx(
        data.frame(note = paste("No", label, "DE genes under threshold")),
        out_fp_full
      )
      openxlsx::write.xlsx(
        data.frame(note = paste("No", label, "DE genes under threshold")),
        out_fp_top30
      )
      return(invisible(NULL))
    }

    eg <- tryCatch(
      clusterProfiler::enrichGO(
        gene      = gene_set,
        universe  = universe_syms,
        OrgDb     = org.Mm.eg.db::org.Mm.eg.db,
        keyType   = keyType,
        ont       = ont,
        pAdjustMethod = "BH",
        readable  = TRUE
      ),
      error = function(e) e
    )

    if (inherits(eg, "error") || is.null(eg)) {
      openxlsx::write.xlsx(
        data.frame(note = paste("enrichGO error for", label, "genes")),
        out_fp_full
      )
      openxlsx::write.xlsx(
        data.frame(note = paste("enrichGO error for", label, "genes")),
        out_fp_top30
      )
      return(invisible(NULL))
    }

    eg_df <- as.data.frame(eg@result)
    if (nrow(eg_df) == 0) {
      openxlsx::write.xlsx(
        data.frame(note = paste("No enriched", ont, "terms for", label, "genes")),
        out_fp_full
      )
      openxlsx::write.xlsx(
        data.frame(note = paste("No enriched", ont, "terms for", label, "genes")),
        out_fp_top30
      )
      return(invisible(NULL))
    }

    # Ensure final output gene list is SYMBOLS, not ENSEMBL
    if (keyType == "ENSEMBL" && ("geneID" %in% names(eg_df))) {
      ens_all <- unique(unlist(strsplit(eg_df$geneID, "/", fixed = TRUE)))
      ens_all <- ens_all[!is.na(ens_all) & ens_all != ""]
      if (length(ens_all) > 0) {
        map <- AnnotationDbi::select(
          org.Mm.eg.db::org.Mm.eg.db,
          keys = ens_all,
          keytype = "ENSEMBL",
          columns = c("SYMBOL")
        )
        map <- map[!is.na(map$SYMBOL) & map$SYMBOL != "", , drop = FALSE]
        map <- map[!duplicated(map$ENSEMBL), , drop = FALSE]
        ens2sym <- stats::setNames(map$SYMBOL, map$ENSEMBL)

        eg_df$geneID <- vapply(
          eg_df$geneID,
          function(s) {
            ids <- strsplit(s, "/", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
            syms <- unname(ens2sym[ids])
            syms <- syms[!is.na(syms) & syms != ""]
            paste(unique(syms), collapse = "/")
          },
          character(1)
        )
      }
    }

    # Write FULL table to outdir
    openxlsx::write.xlsx(eg_df, out_fp_full)

    # Build TOP30 (sorted by pvalue) and write to top30 folder
    eg_df_p <- eg_df
    if (!("pvalue" %in% names(eg_df_p))) eg_df_p$pvalue <- NA_real_
    if (!("p.adjust" %in% names(eg_df_p))) eg_df_p$p.adjust <- NA_real_

    has_FE <- "FoldEnrichment" %in% names(eg_df_p)
    has_z  <- "zScore" %in% names(eg_df_p)

    top30 <- eg_df_p |>
      dplyr::arrange(.data$pvalue) |>
      dplyr::slice_head(n = 30) |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        FoldEnrichment = if (has_FE) .data$FoldEnrichment else NA_real_,
        zScore = if (has_z) .data$zScore else NA_real_
      ) |>
      dplyr::select(
        dplyr::any_of(c("Description", "GeneRatio", "BgRatio")),
        dplyr::any_of(if (has_FE) "FoldEnrichment" else if (has_z) "zScore" else character(0)),
        dplyr::any_of(c("pvalue", "p.adjust"))
      )

    openxlsx::write.xlsx(top30, out_fp_top30)

    invisible(list(full = eg_df, top30 = top30))
  }

  # -----------------------------
  # 5) Output paths
  # -----------------------------
  if (is.null(prefix) || prefix == "") {
    prefix <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(in_csv))
  }

  out_up_full    <- file.path(outdir,     paste0(prefix, "_", ont, "_up_full.xlsx"))
  out_up_top30   <- file.path(top30_dir,  paste0(prefix, "_", ont, "_up_top30.xlsx"))
  out_down_full  <- file.path(outdir,     paste0(prefix, "_", ont, "_down_full.xlsx"))
  out_down_top30 <- file.path(top30_dir,  paste0(prefix, "_", ont, "_down_top30.xlsx"))

  # -----------------------------
  # 6) Run
  # -----------------------------
  up_res   <- run_go_one(deg_up,   "up",   out_up_full,   out_up_top30)
  down_res <- run_go_one(deg_down, "down", out_down_full, out_down_top30)

  message("Wrote: ", out_up_full)
  message("Wrote: ", out_up_top30)
  message("Wrote: ", out_down_full)
  message("Wrote: ", out_down_top30)

  invisible(list(
    deg_up = deg_up,
    deg_down = deg_down,
    universe = universe_syms,
    go_up_full = if (is.list(up_res)) up_res$full else NULL,
    go_up_top30 = if (is.list(up_res)) up_res$top30 else NULL,
    go_down_full = if (is.list(down_res)) down_res$full else NULL,
    go_down_top30 = if (is.list(down_res)) down_res$top30 else NULL,
    out_up_full = out_up_full,
    out_up_top30 = out_up_top30,
    out_down_full = out_down_full,
    out_down_top30 = out_down_top30
  ))
}
```

## Conc-only Function

```{r}


conc_only_go <- function(
  x_group, y_group,
  fp_x, fp_y,
  universe_syms,
  out_up_fp,
  out_down_fp,
  out_conc_fp,
  pval_thresh = 0.05,
  ont = "BP",
  pAdjustMethod = "BH"
) {
  stopifnot(file.exists(fp_x), file.exists(fp_y))

  # packages (fail loudly if missing)
  stopifnot(requireNamespace("dplyr", quietly = TRUE))
  stopifnot(requireNamespace("writexl", quietly = TRUE))
  stopifnot(requireNamespace("clusterProfiler", quietly = TRUE))
  stopifnot(requireNamespace("org.Mm.eg.db", quietly = TRUE))
  stopifnot(requireNamespace("AnnotationDbi", quietly = TRUE))

  looks_ensembl <- function(x) {
    x <- x[!is.na(x) & x != ""]
    if (!length(x)) return(FALSE)
    mean(grepl("^ENS", x)) > 0.5
  }

  strip_ens_version <- function(x) {
    x <- as.character(x)
    x <- ifelse(grepl("^ENS", x), sub("\\.[0-9]+$", "", x), x)
    x
  }

  # Helper: harmonize columns from a DE CSV
  load_and_rename <- function(fp, group, add_logCPM = FALSE) {
    df <- read.csv(fp, check.names = FALSE)
    cl <- tolower(colnames(df))

    # IMPORTANT: prefer gene_name for SYMBOLs (your file: gene_id=ENS, gene_name=SYMBOL)
    gene_col <- colnames(df)[match(TRUE, cl %in% c("gene_name","symbol","gene"))]
    p_col    <- colnames(df)[match(TRUE, cl %in% c("pvalue","p_val","p.val"))]
    fdr_col  <- colnames(df)[match(TRUE, cl %in% c("fdr","padj","p_adj","p.adjust","p_val_adj"))]
    lfc_col  <- colnames(df)[match(TRUE, cl %in% c("logfc","log2fc","log2foldchange","log_fc"))]

    stopifnot(!is.na(gene_col), !is.na(p_col), !is.na(lfc_col))

    df <- df %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        gene  = as.character(.data[[gene_col]]),
        pval  = as.numeric(.data[[p_col]]),
        fdr   = if (!is.na(fdr_col)) as.numeric(.data[[fdr_col]]) else NA_real_,
        logfc = as.numeric(.data[[lfc_col]])
      ) %>%
      dplyr::filter(!is.na(gene), gene != "", !is.na(pval), !is.na(logfc)) %>%
      dplyr::distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE)

    # rename each one explicitly (avoid misalignment)
    names(df)[names(df) == "logfc"] <- paste0("logfc_", tolower(group))
    names(df)[names(df) == "pval"]  <- paste0("pval_",  tolower(group))
    names(df)[names(df) == "fdr"]   <- paste0("fdr_",   tolower(group))

    # optional: carry logCPM if present
    if (add_logCPM) {
      if ("logcpm" %in% cl) {
        df$logCPM <- as.numeric(df[[ which(cl == "logcpm") ]])
      } else {
        df$logCPM <- NA_real_
      }
    }

    df
  }

  # --- top30 dir (mirror run_go behavior) ---
  outdir <- dirname(out_up_fp)
  top30_dir <- file.path(outdir, "top30")
  dir.create(outdir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  dir.create(top30_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

  make_top30_fp <- function(out_full_fp) {
    base <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(out_full_fp))
    file.path(top30_dir, paste0(base, "_top30.xlsx"))
  }

  out_up_top30_fp   <- make_top30_fp(out_up_fp)
  out_down_top30_fp <- make_top30_fp(out_down_fp)

  # 1) Load both tables (gene column now SYMBOL space)
  dx <- load_and_rename(fp_x, x_group, add_logCPM = FALSE)
  dy <- load_and_rename(fp_y, y_group, add_logCPM = TRUE)

  # (Optional) filter very low-abundance in y set (same logic you used elsewhere)
  if (!all(is.na(dy$logCPM))) {
    cutoff <- median(dy$logCPM, na.rm = TRUE) - mad(dy$logCPM, na.rm = TRUE)
    dy <- dy %>% dplyr::filter(is.na(logCPM) | logCPM >= cutoff)
  }

  # 2) Merge on gene SYMBOL
  m <- dplyr::inner_join(dy, dx, by = "gene")

  # dynamic column names
  p_x   <- paste0("pval_",  tolower(x_group))
  p_y   <- paste0("pval_",  tolower(y_group))
  lfc_x <- paste0("logfc_", tolower(x_group))
  lfc_y <- paste0("logfc_", tolower(y_group))
  stopifnot(all(c(p_x, p_y, lfc_x, lfc_y) %in% colnames(m)))

  # 2b) Make universe SYMBOL (map if it looks ENSEMBL)
  universe_syms <- unique(as.character(universe_syms))
  if (looks_ensembl(universe_syms)) {
    uni0 <- strip_ens_version(universe_syms)
    mm <- AnnotationDbi::select(
      org.Mm.eg.db::org.Mm.eg.db,
      keys    = uni0,
      keytype = "ENSEMBL",
      columns = c("SYMBOL")
    )
    mm <- mm[!is.na(mm$SYMBOL) & mm$SYMBOL != "", , drop = FALSE]
    mm <- mm[!duplicated(mm$ENSEMBL), , drop = FALSE]
    universe_syms <- unique(mm$SYMBOL)
  } else {
    universe_syms <- unique(universe_syms[!is.na(universe_syms) & universe_syms != ""])
  }

  # 3) p < threshold in either comparison
  m_p <- m %>% dplyr::filter(.data[[p_x]] < pval_thresh | .data[[p_y]] < pval_thresh)

  # 4) concordant only (quadrants 1 & 3): same sign & non-zero
  m_conc <- m_p %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      sign(.data[[lfc_x]]) == sign(.data[[lfc_y]]),
      .data[[lfc_x]] != 0, .data[[lfc_y]] != 0
    )

  # --- Save concordant table ---
  if (!missing(out_conc_fp) && !is.null(out_conc_fp) && out_conc_fp != "") {
    writexl::write_xlsx(m_conc, out_conc_fp)
    message("Saved concordant filtered table: ", out_conc_fp)
  }

  # 5) split into up and down
  up_genes <- m_conc %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data[[lfc_x]] > 0 & .data[[lfc_y]] > 0) %>%
    dplyr::pull(gene) %>% unique()

  dn_genes <- m_conc %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data[[lfc_x]] < 0 & .data[[lfc_y]] < 0) %>%
    dplyr::pull(gene) %>% unique()

  # helper: build top30 table like run_go (sorted by pvalue)
  build_top30 <- function(eg_df) {
    eg_df_p <- eg_df
    if (!("pvalue" %in% names(eg_df_p))) eg_df_p$pvalue <- NA_real_
    if (!("p.adjust" %in% names(eg_df_p))) eg_df_p$p.adjust <- NA_real_

    has_FE <- "FoldEnrichment" %in% names(eg_df_p)
    has_z  <- "zScore" %in% names(eg_df_p)

    top30 <- eg_df_p %>%
      dplyr::arrange(.data$pvalue) %>%
      dplyr::slice_head(n = 30) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        FoldEnrichment = if (has_FE) .data$FoldEnrichment else NA_real_,
        zScore = if (has_z) .data$zScore else NA_real_
      ) %>%
      dplyr::select(
        dplyr::any_of(c("Description", "GeneRatio", "BgRatio")),
        dplyr::any_of(if (has_FE) "FoldEnrichment" else if (has_z) "zScore" else character(0)),
        dplyr::any_of(c("pvalue", "p.adjust"))
      )

    top30
  }

  # helper to run & save GO (FULL + TOP30)
  run_save_go <- function(genes, out_full_fp, out_top30_fp, label) {
    if (length(genes) == 0) {
      writexl::write_xlsx(
        data.frame(note = paste("No", label, "concordant genes at p <", pval_thresh)),
        out_full_fp
      )
      writexl::write_xlsx(
        data.frame(note = paste("No", label, "concordant genes at p <", pval_thresh)),
        out_top30_fp
      )
      return(NULL)
    }

    eg <- tryCatch(
      clusterProfiler::enrichGO(
        gene      = genes,
        universe  = universe_syms,
        OrgDb     = org.Mm.eg.db::org.Mm.eg.db,
        keyType   = "SYMBOL",
        ont       = ont,
        pAdjustMethod = pAdjustMethod,
        readable  = TRUE
      ),
      error = function(e) e
    )

    if (inherits(eg, "error") || is.null(eg)) {
      writexl::write_xlsx(data.frame(note = paste("enrichGO error for", label, "genes")), out_full_fp)
      writexl::write_xlsx(data.frame(note = paste("enrichGO error for", label, "genes")), out_top30_fp)
      return(NULL)
    }

    eg_df <- as.data.frame(eg@result)
    if (nrow(eg_df) == 0) {
      writexl::write_xlsx(
        data.frame(note = paste("No enriched", ont, "terms for", label, "genes")),
        out_full_fp
      )
      writexl::write_xlsx(
        data.frame(note = paste("No enriched", ont, "terms for", label, "genes")),
        out_top30_fp
      )
      return(eg)
    }

    # FULL
    writexl::write_xlsx(eg_df, out_full_fp)

    # TOP30
    top30 <- build_top30(eg_df)
    writexl::write_xlsx(top30, out_top30_fp)

    invisible(list(full = eg_df, top30 = top30, eg = eg))
  }

  up_res <- run_save_go(up_genes, out_up_fp, out_up_top30_fp, "upregulated")
  dn_res <- run_save_go(dn_genes, out_down_fp, out_down_top30_fp, "downregulated")

  message("Wrote: ", out_up_fp)
  message("Wrote: ", out_up_top30_fp)
  message("Wrote: ", out_down_fp)
  message("Wrote: ", out_down_top30_fp)

  invisible(list(
    merged = m,
    filtered_p_any = m_p,
    concordant = m_conc,
    up_genes = up_genes,
    down_genes = dn_genes,
    go_up_full = if (is.list(up_res)) up_res$full else NULL,
    go_up_top30 = if (is.list(up_res)) up_res$top30 else NULL,
    go_down_full = if (is.list(dn_res)) dn_res$full else NULL,
    go_down_top30 = if (is.list(dn_res)) dn_res$top30 else NULL,
    out_up_fp = out_up_fp,
    out_up_top30_fp = out_up_top30_fp,
    out_down_fp = out_down_fp,
    out_down_top30_fp = out_down_top30_fp,
    out_conc_fp = out_conc_fp
  ))
}

```

```{r}
disc_only_go <- function(
  x_group, y_group,
  fp_x, fp_y,
  universe_syms,
  out_up_fp,
  out_down_fp,
  out_disc_fp,
  pval_thresh = 0.05,
  ont = "BP",
  pAdjustMethod = "BH"
) {
  stopifnot(file.exists(fp_x), file.exists(fp_y))

  # packages (fail loudly if missing)
  stopifnot(requireNamespace("dplyr", quietly = TRUE))
  stopifnot(requireNamespace("writexl", quietly = TRUE))
  stopifnot(requireNamespace("clusterProfiler", quietly = TRUE))
  stopifnot(requireNamespace("org.Mm.eg.db", quietly = TRUE))
  stopifnot(requireNamespace("AnnotationDbi", quietly = TRUE))

  looks_ensembl <- function(x) {
    x <- x[!is.na(x) & x != ""]
    if (!length(x)) return(FALSE)
    mean(grepl("^ENS", x)) > 0.5
  }

  strip_ens_version <- function(x) {
    x <- as.character(x)
    x <- ifelse(grepl("^ENS", x), sub("\\.[0-9]+$", "", x), x)

  }

  # Helper: harmonize columns from a DE CSV
  load_and_rename <- function(fp, group, add_logCPM = FALSE) {

    cl <- tolower(colnames(df))

    # IMPORTANT: prefer gene_name for SYMBOLs (your file: gene_id=ENS, gene_name=SYMBOL)
    gene_col <- colnames(df)[match(TRUE, cl %in% c("gene_name","symbol","gene"))]
    p_col    <- colnames(df)[match(TRUE, cl %in% c("pvalue","p_val","p.val"))]

    lfc_col  <- colnames(df)[match(TRUE, cl %in% c("logfc","log2fc","log2foldchange","log_fc"))]

      dplyr::mutate(
        gene  = as.character(.data[[gene_col]]),
        pval  = as.numeric(.data[[p_col]]),

        logfc = as.numeric(.data[[lfc_col]])
      ) %>%
      dplyr::filter(!is.na(gene), gene != "", !is.na(pval), !is.na(logfc)) %>%
      dplyr::distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE)

    # rename each one explicitly (avoid misalignment)
    names(df)[names(df) == "logfc"] <- paste0("logfc_", tolower(group))
    names(df)[names(df) == "pval"]  <- paste0("pval_",  tolower(group))
    names(df)[names(df) == "fdr"]   <- paste0("fdr_",   tolower(group))

    # optional: carry logCPM if present

      }
```
