```{r}
  }

  # --- top30 dir (mirror run_go behavior) ---
  outdir <- dirname(out_up_fp)
  top30_dir <- file.path(outdir, "top30")
  dir.create(outdir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  dir.create(top30_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

  make_top30_fp <- function(out_full_fp) {
    base <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(out_full_fp))
    file.path(top30_dir, paste0(base, "_top30.xlsx"))
  }

  out_up_top30_fp   <- make_top30_fp(out_up_fp)
  out_down_top30_fp <- make_top30_fp(out_down_fp)

  # 1) Load both tables (gene column now SYMBOL space)
  dx <- load_and_rename(fp_x, x_group, add_logCPM = FALSE)
  dy <- load_and_rename(fp_y, y_group, add_logCPM = TRUE)

  # (Optional) filter very low-abundance in y set (same logic you used elsewhere)
  if (!all(is.na(dy$logCPM))) {
    cutoff <- median(dy$logCPM, na.rm = TRUE) - mad(dy$logCPM, na.rm = TRUE)
    dy <- dy %>% dplyr::filter(is.na(logCPM) | logCPM >= cutoff)
  }

  # 2) Merge on gene SYMBOL
  m <- dplyr::inner_join(dy, dx, by = "gene")

  # dynamic column names
  p_x   <- paste0("pval_",  tolower(x_group))
  p_y   <- paste0("pval_",  tolower(y_group))
  lfc_x <- paste0("logfc_", tolower(x_group))
  lfc_y <- paste0("logfc_", tolower(y_group))
  stopifnot(all(c(p_x, p_y, lfc_x, lfc_y) %in% colnames(m)))

  # 2b) Make universe SYMBOL (map if it looks ENSEMBL)
  universe_syms <- unique(as.character(universe_syms))
  if (looks_ensembl(universe_syms)) {
    uni0 <- strip_ens_version(universe_syms)
    mm <- AnnotationDbi::select(
      org.Mm.eg.db::org.Mm.eg.db,
      keys    = uni0,
      keytype = "ENSEMBL",
      columns = c("SYMBOL")
    )
    mm <- mm[!is.na(mm$SYMBOL) & mm$SYMBOL != "", , drop = FALSE]
    mm <- mm[!duplicated(mm$ENSEMBL), , drop = FALSE]
    universe_syms <- unique(mm$SYMBOL)
  } else {
    universe_syms <- unique(universe_syms[!is.na(universe_syms) & universe_syms != ""])
  }

  # 3) p < threshold in either comparison
  m_p <- m %>% dplyr::filter(.data[[p_x]] < pval_thresh | .data[[p_y]] < pval_thresh)

  # 4) discordant only (quadrants 2 & 4): opposite sign & non-zero
  m_disc <- m_p %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      sign(.data[[lfc_x]]) == -sign(.data[[lfc_y]]),
      .data[[lfc_x]] != 0, .data[[lfc_y]] != 0
    )

  # --- Save discordant table ---
  if (!missing(out_disc_fp) && !is.null(out_disc_fp) && out_disc_fp != "") {
    writexl::write_xlsx(m_disc, out_disc_fp)
    message("Saved discordant filtered table: ", out_disc_fp)
  }

  # 5) split into "up" and "down" using your convention:
  #    up   = x up, y down
  #    down = x down, y up
  up_genes <- m_disc %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data[[lfc_x]] > 0 & .data[[lfc_y]] < 0) %>%
    dplyr::pull(gene) %>% unique()

  dn_genes <- m_disc %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data[[lfc_x]] < 0 & .data[[lfc_y]] > 0) %>%
    dplyr::pull(gene) %>% unique()

  # helper: build top30 table like run_go (sorted by pvalue)
  build_top30 <- function(eg_df) {
    eg_df_p <- eg_df
    if (!("pvalue" %in% names(eg_df_p))) eg_df_p$pvalue <- NA_real_
    if (!("p.adjust" %in% names(eg_df_p))) eg_df_p$p.adjust <- NA_real_

    has_FE <- "FoldEnrichment" %in% names(eg_df_p)
    has_z  <- "zScore" %in% names(eg_df_p)

    top30 <- eg_df_p %>%
      dplyr::arrange(.data$pvalue) %>%
      dplyr::slice_head(n = 30) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        FoldEnrichment = if (has_FE) .data$FoldEnrichment else NA_real_,
        zScore = if (has_z) .data$zScore else NA_real_
      ) %>%
      dplyr::select(
        dplyr::any_of(c("Description", "GeneRatio", "BgRatio")),
        dplyr::any_of(if (has_FE) "FoldEnrichment" else if (has_z) "zScore" else character(0)),
        dplyr::any_of(c("pvalue", "p.adjust"))
      )

    top30
  }

  # helper to run & save GO (FULL + TOP30)
  run_save_go <- function(genes, out_full_fp, out_top30_fp, label) {
    if (length(genes) == 0) {
      writexl::write_xlsx(
        data.frame(note = paste("No", label, "discordant genes at p <", pval_thresh)),
        out_full_fp
      )
      writexl::write_xlsx(
        data.frame(note = paste("No", label, "discordant genes at p <", pval_thresh)),
        out_top30_fp
      )
      return(NULL)
    }

    eg <- tryCatch(
      clusterProfiler::enrichGO(
        gene      = genes,
        universe  = universe_syms,
        OrgDb     = org.Mm.eg.db::org.Mm.eg.db,
        keyType   = "SYMBOL",
        ont       = ont,
        pAdjustMethod = pAdjustMethod,
        readable  = TRUE
      ),
      error = function(e) e
    )

    if (inherits(eg, "error") || is.null(eg)) {
      writexl::write_xlsx(data.frame(note = paste("enrichGO error for", label, "genes")), out_full_fp)
      writexl::write_xlsx(data.frame(note = paste("enrichGO error for", label, "genes")), out_top30_fp)
      return(NULL)
    }

    eg_df <- as.data.frame(eg@result)
    if (nrow(eg_df) == 0) {
      writexl::write_xlsx(
        data.frame(note = paste("No enriched", ont, "terms for", label, "genes")),
        out_full_fp
      )
      writexl::write_xlsx(
        data.frame(note = paste("No enriched", ont, "terms for", label, "genes")),
        out_top30_fp
      )
      return(eg)
    }

    # FULL
    writexl::write_xlsx(eg_df, out_full_fp)

    # TOP30
    top30 <- build_top30(eg_df)
    writexl::write_xlsx(top30, out_top30_fp)

    invisible(list(full = eg_df, top30 = top30, eg = eg))
  }

  up_res <- run_save_go(up_genes, out_up_fp, out_up_top30_fp, "x_up_y_down")
  dn_res <- run_save_go(dn_genes, out_down_fp, out_down_top30_fp, "x_down_y_up")

  message("Wrote: ", out_up_fp)
  message("Wrote: ", out_up_top30_fp)
  message("Wrote: ", out_down_fp)
  message("Wrote: ", out_down_top30_fp)

  invisible(list(
    merged = m,
    filtered_p_any = m_p,
    discordant = m_disc,
    up_genes = up_genes,         # x up / y down
    down_genes = dn_genes,       # x down / y up
    go_up_full = if (is.list(up_res)) up_res$full else NULL,
    go_up_top30 = if (is.list(up_res)) up_res$top30 else NULL,
    go_down_full = if (is.list(dn_res)) dn_res$full else NULL,
    go_down_top30 = if (is.list(dn_res)) dn_res$top30 else NULL,
    out_up_fp = out_up_fp,
    out_up_top30_fp = out_up_top30_fp,
    out_down_fp = out_down_fp,
    out_down_top30_fp = out_down_top30_fp,
    out_disc_fp = out_disc_fp
  ))
}


```

## Discordant genes only - Cond HET vs Const syn/nuc

### Function
```{r}


disc_only_go <- function(x_group, y_group,
                         fp_x, fp_y,
                         universe_syms,
                         out_up_fp,
                         out_down_fp,
                         out_disc_fp,   
                         pval_thresh = 0.05) {

  # Helper: harmonize columns from a DE CSV
  load_and_rename <- function(fp, group, add_logCPM = FALSE) {
    df <- read.csv(fp, check.names = FALSE)
    cl <- tolower(colnames(df))

    gene_col <- colnames(df)[match(TRUE, cl %in% c("gene","gene_name","symbol"))]
    p_col    <- colnames(df)[match(TRUE, cl %in% c("pvalue","p_val","p.val"))]
    fdr_col  <- colnames(df)[match(TRUE, cl %in% c("fdr","padj","p_adj","p.adjust","p_val_adj"))]
    lfc_col  <- colnames(df)[match(TRUE, cl %in% c("logfc","log2fc","log2foldchange","log_fc"))]

    stopifnot(!is.na(gene_col), !is.na(p_col), !is.na(lfc_col))

    df <- df %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        gene  = as.character(.data[[gene_col]]),
        pval  = as.numeric(.data[[p_col]]),
        fdr   = if (!is.na(fdr_col)) as.numeric(.data[[fdr_col]]) else NA_real_,
        logfc = as.numeric(.data[[lfc_col]])
      ) %>%
      dplyr::filter(!is.na(gene), gene != "", !is.na(pval), !is.na(logfc)) %>%
      dplyr::distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE)

    # rename explicitly
    names(df)[names(df) == "logfc"] <- paste0("logfc_", tolower(group))
    names(df)[names(df) == "pval"]  <- paste0("pval_",  tolower(group))
    names(df)[names(df) == "fdr"]   <- paste0("fdr_",   tolower(group))

    # optional: carry logCPM if present
    if (add_logCPM) {
      if ("logcpm" %in% cl) {
        df$logCPM <- as.numeric(df[[ which(cl == "logcpm") ]])
      } else {
        df$logCPM <- NA_real_
      }
    }

    df
  }

  # 1) Load tables
  dx <- load_and_rename(fp_x, x_group, add_logCPM = FALSE)
  dy <- load_and_rename(fp_y, y_group, add_logCPM = TRUE)

  # (Optional) filter very low-abundance in y set
  if (!all(is.na(dy$logCPM))) {
    cutoff <- median(dy$logCPM, na.rm = TRUE) - mad(dy$logCPM, na.rm = TRUE)
    dy <- dy %>% dplyr::filter(is.na(logCPM) | logCPM >= cutoff)
  }

  # 2) Merge
  m <- dplyr::inner_join(dy, dx, by = "gene")

  # dynamic names
  p_x   <- paste0("pval_",  tolower(x_group))
  p_y   <- paste0("pval_",  tolower(y_group))
  lfc_x <- paste0("logfc_", tolower(x_group))
  lfc_y <- paste0("logfc_", tolower(y_group))

  stopifnot(all(c(p_x, p_y, lfc_x, lfc_y) %in% colnames(m)))

  # 3) p < threshold in either
  m_p <- m %>% dplyr::filter(.data[[p_x]] < pval_thresh | .data[[p_y]] < pval_thresh)

  # 4) DISCORDANT only (quadrants II & IV): opposite signs & non-zero
  m_disc <- m_p %>%
    dplyr::filter(sign(.data[[lfc_x]]) != 0,
                  sign(.data[[lfc_y]]) != 0,
                  sign(.data[[lfc_x]]) != sign(.data[[lfc_y]]))

  # --- Save discordant table ---
  if (!missing(out_disc_fp)) {
    writexl::write_xlsx(m_disc, out_disc_fp)
    message("Saved DISCORDANT filtered table: ", out_disc_fp)
  }

  # 5) split into x_up & y_down (QIV) and x_down & y_up (QII)
  xup_ydown_genes <- m_disc %>% dplyr::filter(.data[[lfc_x]] > 0 & .data[[lfc_y]] < 0) %>%
    dplyr::pull(gene) %>% unique()
  xdown_yup_genes <- m_disc %>% dplyr::filter(.data[[lfc_x]] < 0 & .data[[lfc_y]] > 0) %>%
    dplyr::pull(gene) %>% unique()

  # helper to run & save GO
  run_save_go <- function(genes, out_fp, label) {
    if (length(genes) == 0) {
      writexl::write_xlsx(
        data.frame(note = paste("No", label, "discordant genes at p <", pval_thresh)),
        out_fp
      )
      return(NULL)
    }
    eg <- tryCatch(
      clusterProfiler::enrichGO(
        gene      = genes,
        universe  = universe_syms,
        OrgDb     = org.Mm.eg.db,
        keyType   = "SYMBOL",
        ont       = "BP",
        pAdjustMethod = "BH",
        readable  = TRUE
      ),
      error = function(e) e
    )
    if (inherits(eg, "error") || is.null(eg)) {
      writexl::write_xlsx(data.frame(note = paste("enrichGO error for", label, "genes")), out_fp)
      return(NULL)
    }
    eg_df <- as.data.frame(eg@result)
    if (nrow(eg_df) == 0) {
      writexl::write_xlsx(data.frame(note = paste("No enriched BP terms for", label, "genes")), out_fp)
      return(eg)
    }
    writexl::write_xlsx(eg_df, out_fp)
    eg
  }

  eg_xup_ydown <- run_save_go(xup_ydown_genes, out_up_fp,   paste0(x_group, " up / ", y_group, " down"))
  eg_xdown_yup <- run_save_go(xdown_yup_genes, out_down_fp, paste0(x_group, " down / ", y_group, " up"))

  invisible(list(
    merged = m,
    filtered_p_any = m_p,
    discordant = m_disc,
    x_up_y_down = xup_ydown_genes,
    x_down_y_up = xdown_yup_genes,
    eg_x_up_y_down = eg_xup_ydown,
    eg_x_down_y_up = eg_xdown_yup
  ))
}


```

# 10. GSEA

## Function

```{r}

gsea_go_bp <- function(de,
                       gene_col   = "gene",
                       p_col      = "PValue",
                       lfc_col    = "logFC",
                       rank_by    = c("logfc_p", "signed_p"),
                       keyType    = c("SYMBOL","ENSEMBL"),   
                       strip_ens_version = TRUE,            
                       minSize    = 10,
                       maxSize    = 2000,
                       workers    = 12,
                       seed       = 123,
                       eps          = 0,   
                       nPermSimple  = 10000,
                       wrap_width = 40,
                       out_prefix = "output/GSEA/final_DE/GO_BP") {

  stopifnot(all(c(gene_col, p_col, lfc_col) %in% names(de)))
  rank_by <- match.arg(rank_by)
  keyType <- match.arg(keyType)

  # --- rank ---
  df <- de %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      g = as.character(.data[[gene_col]]),
      Rank = dplyr::case_when(
        rank_by == "logfc_p" ~ -log10(pmax(.data[[p_col]], 1e-300)) * .data[[lfc_col]],
        rank_by == "signed_p" ~ sign(.data[[lfc_col]]) * -log10(pmax(.data[[p_col]], 1e-300))
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(g), g != "", is.finite(Rank))

  # If using ENSEMBL IDs, strip version suffix (e.g. ENSMUSG... .1)
  if (keyType == "ENSEMBL" && isTRUE(strip_ens_version)) {
    df$g <- sub("\\.[0-9]+$", "", df$g)
  }

  df <- df %>%
    dplyr::group_by(g) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(Rank = Rank[which.max(abs(Rank))], .groups = "drop")

  gene_list <- stats::setNames(df$Rank, df$g)
  gene_list <- sort(gene_list, decreasing = TRUE)

  # --- run GSEA ---
  set.seed(seed)
  param <- BiocParallel::MulticoreParam(workers = workers)
  gsea_res <- clusterProfiler::gseGO(
    geneList     = gene_list,
    OrgDb        = org.Mm.eg.db,
    keyType      = keyType,      # CHANGED
    ont          = "BP",
    minGSSize    = minSize,
    maxGSSize    = maxSize,
    pvalueCutoff = 1,
    verbose      = FALSE,
    seed         = seed,
    BPPARAM      = param
  )

  res_df <- as.data.frame(gsea_res)
  res_df <- res_df %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(p.adjust), !is.na(NES))
  if (!nrow(res_df)) stop("gseGO returned no results.")

  # --- Count and GeneRatio ---
  res_df$Count     <- sapply(strsplit(res_df$core_enrichment, "/", fixed = TRUE), length)
  res_df$GeneRatio <- res_df$Count / res_df$setSize

  # --- full directional tables (UNFILTERED by top-N; sorted by padj) ---
  go_down_full <- res_df %>% dplyr::filter(NES < 0) %>% dplyr::arrange(p.adjust)
  go_up_full   <- res_df %>% dplyr::filter(NES > 0) %>% dplyr::arrange(p.adjust)

  dir.create(dirname(out_prefix), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  utils::write.csv(go_up_full,   paste0(out_prefix, "_up.csv"),   row.names = FALSE)
  utils::write.csv(go_down_full, paste0(out_prefix, "_down.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

  # --- Helpers for top-N plots ---
  make_plot <- function(df, title, color,
                        wrap_threshold = 100, wrap_width = 75,
                        y_text_size = 9) {
    if (!nrow(df)) return(NULL)
    df <- df %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        label = ifelse(
          nchar(Description) > wrap_threshold,
          stringr::str_wrap(Description, width = wrap_width),
          Description
        ),
        label = forcats::fct_reorder(label, GeneRatio)
      )

    ggplot2::ggplot(df, ggplot2::aes(x = GeneRatio, y = label)) +
      ggplot2::geom_point(ggplot2::aes(size = Count), color = color) +
      ggplot2::scale_y_discrete(limits = levels(df$label)) +
      ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.05))) +
      ggplot2::labs(title = title, x = "Gene Ratio", y = NULL, size = "Count") +
      ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
      ggplot2::theme(
        plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_text(size = y_text_size, lineheight = 0.95)
      )
  }

  save_plot_pdf <- function(plot_obj, file, width, height) {
    if (is.null(plot_obj)) {
      message("No rows to plot for: ", file)
      return(invisible(NULL))
    }
    grDevices::pdf(file, width = width, height = height)
    print(plot_obj)
    grDevices::dev.off()
  }

  # --- Top-25 ---
  top25_dn <- go_down_full %>% dplyr::slice_head(n = 25)
  top25_up <- go_up_full   %>% dplyr::slice_head(n = 25)

  p25_dn <- make_plot(top25_dn, "NES < 0 (Top 25)", "blue",
                      wrap_threshold = 100, wrap_width = 75, y_text_size = 9)
  p25_up <- make_plot(top25_up, "NES > 0 (Top 25)", "red",
                      wrap_threshold = 100, wrap_width = 75, y_text_size = 9)

  save_plot_pdf(p25_up, paste0(out_prefix, "_top25_up.pdf"),   width = 8, height = 3.5)
  save_plot_pdf(p25_dn, paste0(out_prefix, "_top25_down.pdf"), width = 8, height = 3.5)

  # --- Top-50 ---
  top50_dn <- go_down_full %>%
    dplyr::filter(nchar(Description) <= 125) %>%
    dplyr::slice_head(n = 50)

  top50_up <- go_up_full %>%
    dplyr::filter(nchar(Description) <= 125) %>%
    dplyr::slice_head(n = 50)

  p50_dn <- make_plot(top50_dn, "NES < 0 (Top 50)", "blue",
                      wrap_threshold = 100, wrap_width = 75, y_text_size = 6)
  p50_up <- make_plot(top50_up, "NES > 0 (Top 50)", "red",
                      wrap_threshold = 100, wrap_width = 75, y_text_size = 6)

  save_plot_pdf(p50_up, paste0(out_prefix, "_top50_up.pdf"),   width = 5.75, height = 6.25)
  save_plot_pdf(p50_dn, paste0(out_prefix, "_top50_down.pdf"), width = 5.75, height = 6.25)

  # --- Top-150 ---
  top150_dn <- go_down_full %>% dplyr::slice_head(n = 150)
  top150_up <- go_up_full   %>% dplyr::slice_head(n = 150)

  p150_dn <- make_plot(top150_dn, "NES < 0 (Top 150)", "blue",
                       wrap_threshold = 100, wrap_width = 75, y_text_size = 9)
  p150_up <- make_plot(top150_up, "NES > 0 (Top 150)", "red",
                       wrap_threshold = 100, wrap_width = 75, y_text_size = 9)

  save_plot_pdf(p150_up, paste0(out_prefix, "_top150_up.pdf"),   width = 8, height = 20)
  save_plot_pdf(p150_dn, paste0(out_prefix, "_top150_down.pdf"), width = 8, height = 20)

  invisible(list(
    gsea      = gsea_res,
    table     = res_df,
    full_up   = go_up_full,
    full_down = go_down_full,
    top25_up  = top25_up,
    top25_dn  = top25_dn,
    top150_up = top150_up,
    top150_dn = top150_dn,
    plots = list(
      top25_up  = p25_up,  top25_down  = p25_dn,
      top150_up = p150_up, top150_down = p150_dn
    ),
    files = list(
      csv_up   = paste0(out_prefix, "_up.csv"),
      csv_down = paste0(out_prefix, "_down.csv"),
      pdf_top25_up   = paste0(out_prefix, "_top25_up.pdf"),
      pdf_top25_down = paste0(out_prefix, "_top25_down.pdf"),
      pdf_top150_up   = paste0(out_prefix, "_top150_up.pdf"),
      pdf_top150_down = paste0(out_prefix, "_top150_down.pdf")
    )
  ))
}
```

# 11. Sex-stratified DE

## Const whole

### Male

```{r}

meta_const_male <- metadata_const_cond_whole %>%
  dplyr::filter(Batch != "Cond") %>%
  dplyr::filter(Sex == "M") %>%
  droplevels()

use.cols_const_male <- meta_const_male$Sample
stopifnot(all(use.cols_const_male %in% colnames(exp_data_const_cond_whole)))
counts_const_male <- exp_data_const_cond_whole[, use.cols_const_male, drop = FALSE]

# enforce identical order
meta_const_male <- meta_const_male[match(colnames(counts_const_male), meta_const_male$Sample), , drop = FALSE]
stopifnot(identical(colnames(counts_const_male), meta_const_male$Sample))

# Optional PC check
tmp_male <- run_DE_with_optional_PCs(
  counts = counts_const_male,
  meta = meta_const_male,
  my_gene = my_gene,
  fraction_keep = "Whole",
  genotypes_keep = c("WT","HET"),
  out_csv = NULL,
  y_out = NULL,
  include_pcs = NULL,      # inspect first if you want
  include_batch = FALSE,
  include_sex = FALSE,     # IMPORTANT: already stratified by sex
  n_pc_check = 10,
  show_heatmap = TRUE,
  sig_r = 0.4,
  sig_p = 0.05,
  genes_use = "protein_coding"
)



# Final run

res_male <- run_DE_with_optional_PCs(
  counts = counts_const_male,
  meta = meta_const_male,
  my_gene = my_gene,
  fraction_keep = "Whole",
  genotypes_keep = c("WT","HET"),
  out_csv = "output/DE/sex_stratified/Const_whole_PC12_male.csv",
  y_out = "output/objects/y_Const_whole_PC12_male.rds",
  include_pcs = c(1,2),    # or NULL if not using PCs
  include_sex = FALSE,     # IMPORTANT
  include_splicing = FALSE,
  include_mt = FALSE,
  include_mt_resid = FALSE,
  include_batch = TRUE,
  include_ribo = FALSE,
  n_pc_check = 10,
  show_heatmap = FALSE,
  genes_use = "protein_coding"
)

```

```{r}


base_size <- 19

# ----------------------------
# Paths
# ----------------------------
dir_comb <- "output/DE"
dir_sex  <- "output/DE/sex_stratified"
out_pdf  <- file.path(dir_sex, "sex_stratified_scatterplots.pdf")

# ----------------------------
# Files (combined + sex-stratified)
# ----------------------------
files <- list(
  Const_whole = list(
    comb   = file.path(dir_comb, "Const_whole_PC12.csv"),
    male   = file.path(dir_sex,  "Const_whole_PC12_male.csv"),
    female = file.path(dir_sex,  "Const_whole_PC12_female.csv")
  ),
  Const_syn = list(
    comb   = file.path(dir_comb, "Const_syn_PC12.csv"),
    male   = file.path(dir_sex,  "Const_syn_NOPC_male.csv"),
    female = file.path(dir_sex,  "Const_syn_PC1_female.csv")
  ),
  Const_nuc = list(
    comb   = file.path(dir_comb, "Const_nuc_PC12.csv"),
    male   = file.path(dir_sex,  "Const_nuc_PC12_male.csv"),
    female = file.path(dir_sex,  "Const_nuc_PC12_female.csv")
  ),
  Cond_whole = list(
    comb   = file.path(dir_comb, "Cond_whole_NOPC.csv"),
    male   = file.path(dir_sex,  "Cond_whole_NOPC_male.csv"),
    female = file.path(dir_sex,  "Cond_whole_NOPC_female.csv")
  ),
  Cond_syn_HETvsWT = list(
    comb   = file.path(dir_comb, "Cond_syn_HETvsWT_NOPC.csv"),
    male   = file.path(dir_sex,  "Cond_syn_HETvsWT_PC1_male.csv"),
    female = file.path(dir_sex,  "Cond_syn_HETvsWT_NOPC_female.csv")
  ),
  Cond_nuc_HETvsWT = list(
    comb   = file.path(dir_comb, "Cond_nuc_HETvsWT_NOPC.csv"),
    male   = file.path(dir_sex,  "Cond_nuc_HETvsWT_NOPC_male.csv"),
    female = file.path(dir_sex,  "Cond_nuc_HETvsWT_PC2_female.csv")
  )
)

# ----------------------------
# Gene selection mode
# Choose ONE:
#   selection_mode <- "top_n"
#   selection_mode <- "threshold"
# ----------------------------
selection_mode <- "top_n"

# used if selection_mode == "top_n"
top_n <- 400

# used if selection_mode == "threshold"
# metric must be "FDR" or "PValue"
# cutoff is dataset-specific
threshold_rules <- list(
  Cond_whole       = list(metric = "PValue", cutoff = 0.05),
  Const_whole      = list(metric = "FDR",    cutoff = 0.10),
  Const_syn        = list(metric = "FDR",    cutoff = 0.10),
  Const_nuc        = list(metric = "FDR",    cutoff = 0.25),
  Cond_syn_HETvsWT = list(metric = "PValue", cutoff = 0.05),
  Cond_nuc_HETvsWT = list(metric = "PValue", cutoff = 0.05)
)

# ----------------------------
# Small helpers
# ----------------------------
read_de <- function(fp) {
  stopifnot(file.exists(fp))
  df <- read.csv(fp, check.names = FALSE)

  needed <- c("gene_id", "logFC", "PValue", "FDR")
  miss <- setdiff(needed, colnames(df))
  if (length(miss) > 0) stop("Missing cols in ", fp, ": ", paste(miss, collapse = ", "))

  df %>%
    transmute(
      gene_id = as.character(gene_id),
      logFC   = as.numeric(logFC),
      PValue  = as.numeric(PValue),
      FDR     = as.numeric(FDR)
    )
}

make_scatter <- function(df, x, y, xlab, ylab) {
  r <- suppressWarnings(cor(df[[x]], df[[y]], use = "pairwise.complete.obs"))

  ggplot(df, aes(x = .data[[x]], y = .data[[y]])) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_point(size = 1, alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
    labs(x = xlab, y = ylab) +
    annotate("text",
             x = -Inf, y = Inf,
             label = sprintf("R = %.2f", r),
             hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.8,
             size = 9) +
    theme_bw(base_size = base_size)
}

# ----------------------------
# Make PDF (one page per dataset)
# ----------------------------
pdf(out_pdf, width = 15, height = 4.5)

for (nm in names(files)) {

  comb   <- read_de(files[[nm]]$comb)
  male   <- read_de(files[[nm]]$male)
  female <- read_de(files[[nm]]$female)

  # ----------------------------
  # Select genes from COMBINED table only
  # ----------------------------
  if (selection_mode == "top_n") {

    genes_plot <- comb %>%
      filter(is.finite(FDR)) %>%
      arrange(FDR) %>%
      slice_head(n = top_n)

    ttl <- paste0(nm, " | top ", nrow(genes_plot), " comb DEGs by FDR")

  } else if (selection_mode == "threshold") {

    rule <- threshold_rules[[nm]]
    if (is.null(rule)) stop("No threshold rule supplied for dataset: ", nm)

    metric <- rule$metric
    cutoff <- rule$cutoff

    if (!(metric %in% c("FDR", "PValue"))) {
      stop("metric must be 'FDR' or 'PValue' for dataset: ", nm)
    }

    genes_plot <- comb %>%
      filter(is.finite(.data[[metric]]), .data[[metric]] < cutoff) %>%
      arrange(FDR, PValue)

    ttl <- paste0(nm, " | comb ", metric, " < ", cutoff, " (n=", nrow(genes_plot), ")")

  } else {
    stop("selection_mode must be either 'top_n' or 'threshold'")
  }

  n_deg <- nrow(genes_plot)
  if (n_deg == 0) stop("No genes selected for combined table: ", files[[nm]]$comb)

  # join male/female logFC onto selected set
  df <- genes_plot %>%
    select(gene_id, comb_logFC = logFC) %>%
    left_join(male   %>% select(gene_id, male_logFC   = logFC), by = "gene_id") %>%
    left_join(female %>% select(gene_id, female_logFC = logFC), by = "gene_id")

  p1 <- make_scatter(df, "comb_logFC", "male_logFC",
                     "comb logFC", "male logFC")

  p2 <- make_scatter(df, "comb_logFC", "female_logFC",
                     "comb logFC", "female logFC")

  p3 <- make_scatter(df, "male_logFC", "female_logFC",
                     "male logFC", "female logFC")

  print(
    (p1 + p2 + p3 + patchwork::plot_layout(ncol = 3)) +
      patchwork::plot_annotation(
        title = ttl,
        theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(size = base_size + 2))
      )
  )
}

dev.off()
message("Saved: ", out_pdf)

```


# 12. Checking if mt_CPM or ribo_CPM predict genotype

## Function

```{r}


check_qc_predicts_genotype <- function(
  meta,
  fraction_keep = c("Syn","Nuc"),
  genotypes_keep = c("WT","HET"),
  alpha = 0.05
) {
  stopifnot(all(c("Sample","Genotype","Fraction") %in% names(meta)))

  # ---- normalize fraction ----
  if (length(fraction_keep) == 2L) fraction_keep <- "Syn"
  fk_in <- tolower(fraction_keep)
  fk_in <- if (fk_in %in% c("syn","synaptic")) "syn" else
           if (fk_in %in% c("nuc","nuclear","nuclei")) "nuc" else fk_in

  meta_local <- meta
  frac_norm <- tolower(meta_local$Fraction)
  frac_norm <- ifelse(frac_norm %in% c("syn","synaptic"), "syn",
                 ifelse(frac_norm %in% c("nuc","nuclear","nuclei"), "nuc", frac_norm))
  meta_local$Fraction <- frac_norm

  ## outlier handling
  if ("Outlier" %in% names(meta_local)) {
    ol <- meta_local$Outlier
    if (is.factor(ol)) ol <- as.character(ol)
    if (is.character(ol)) {
      ol <- trimws(tolower(ol)) %in% c("true","t","1","yes","y")
    } else if (is.numeric(ol)) {
      ol <- ol != 0
    } else if (!is.logical(ol)) {
      ol <- as.logical(ol)
    }
  } else {
    message("Didn't remove outliers; Outlier col not present in metadata")
    ol <- rep(FALSE, nrow(meta_local))
  }

  # subset
  df <- meta_local |>
    dplyr::filter(Fraction == fk_in,
                  Genotype %in% genotypes_keep,
                  is.na(ol) | !ol) |>
    droplevels()
  if (nrow(df) < 4) stop("Too few samples after filtering.")

  # binary outcome: WT (0) vs other (1)
  if ("WT" %in% df$Genotype) {
    df$Genotype <- factor(df$Genotype, levels = unique(c("WT", setdiff(genotypes_keep, "WT"))))
  } else {
    df$Genotype <- factor(df$Genotype, levels = genotypes_keep)
  }
  if (nlevels(df$Genotype) != 2) stop("Genotype must have exactly 2 levels.")
  y <- as.integer(df$Genotype == levels(df$Genotype)[2])

  # predictors present?
  have_mt   <- "mt_CPM"   %in% names(df)
  have_ribo <- "ribo_CPM" %in% names(df)
  if (!have_mt && !have_ribo) stop("Neither 'mt_CPM' nor 'ribo_CPM' present in metadata.")

  if (have_mt)   df$mt_CPM   <- as.numeric(df$mt_CPM)
  if (have_ribo) df$ribo_CPM <- as.numeric(df$ribo_CPM)
  good_mt   <- have_mt   && all(is.finite(df$mt_CPM))   && stats::sd(df$mt_CPM)   > 0
  good_ribo <- have_ribo && all(is.finite(df$ribo_CPM)) && stats::sd(df$ribo_CPM) > 0

  # ---- helper to fit/log one model ----
  fit_one <- function(formula, data) {
    # 1) Fit null (intercept only) logistic model and the requested model
    m0 <- stats::glm(y ~ 1, family = binomial(), data = data)
    m  <- stats::glm(formula, family = binomial(), data = data)

    # 2) Summarize coefficients from the requested model
    summ <- summary(m)
    coefs <- summ$coef[-1, , drop = FALSE]  # drop intercept

    # 3) Effect sizes as odds ratios with 95% CI
    beta <- coefs[,1]; se <- coefs[,2]
    OR   <- exp(beta); CIlo <- exp(beta - 1.96*se); CIhi <- exp(beta + 1.96*se)

    # 4) Simple model fit metric: McFadden pseudo-R² via log-likelihoods
    r2 <- max(0, 1 - as.numeric(logLik(m)) / as.numeric(logLik(m0)))

    tibble::tibble(
      term   = rownames(coefs),
      beta   = beta,
      SE     = se,
      z      = coefs[,3],
      p      = coefs[,4],
      OR     = OR,
      OR.lo  = CIlo,
      OR.hi  = CIhi,
      AIC    = AIC(m),
      pseudoR2 = r2
    )
  }

  stats_list <- list()
  if (good_mt)   stats_list$mt   <- fit_one(y ~ scale(mt_CPM), df) else if (have_mt)   message("Skipping mt_CPM model: constant or non-finite.")
  if (good_ribo) stats_list$ribo <- fit_one(y ~ scale(ribo_CPM), df) else if (have_ribo) message("Skipping ribo_CPM model: constant or non-finite.")
  if (good_mt && good_ribo) stats_list$both <- fit_one(y ~ scale(mt_CPM) + scale(ribo_CPM), df)

  # print summary
  cat("\n=== Genotype predictability by QC covariates ===\n")
  cat(sprintf("Group: %s | Fraction: %s | n = %d\n",
              paste(levels(df$Genotype), collapse = " vs "),
              fraction_keep, nrow(df)))
  any_sig <- FALSE
  print_block <- function(lbl, tb) {
    if (is.null(tb)) return(invisible(FALSE))
    cat("\n--", lbl, "--\n", sep = "")
    print(dplyr::mutate(tb,
                        beta = round(beta, 3), SE = round(SE, 3), z = round(z, 2),
                        p = signif(p, 3), OR = round(OR, 3),
                        OR.lo = round(OR.lo, 3), OR.hi = round(OR.hi, 3),
                        AIC = round(AIC, 2), pseudoR2 = round(pseudoR2, 3)))
    any(tb$p < alpha)
  }
  if ("mt" %in% names(stats_list))   any_sig <- print_block("mt_CPM -> Genotype (univariate)", stats_list$mt)   || any_sig
  if ("ribo" %in% names(stats_list)) any_sig <- print_block("ribo_CPM -> Genotype (univariate)", stats_list$ribo) || any_sig
  if ("both" %in% names(stats_list)) any_sig <- print_block("mt_CPM + ribo_CPM -> Genotype (joint)", stats_list$both) || any_sig

  if (any_sig) {
    cat("\nConclusion:", sprintf("At least one QC covariate predicts Genotype at alpha=%.2f.\n", alpha))
  } else {
    cat("\nConclusion:", "Neither mt_CPM nor ribo_CPM significantly predicts Genotype at the chosen alpha.\n")
  }

  invisible(list(data = df, models = stats_list))
}


```

```{r}

# Make all rownames identical 
all_genes <- rownames(counts_Const_syn)

# Ensure every matrix has the same genes in the same order
fix_counts <- function(mat) {
  mat <- mat[all_genes, , drop = FALSE]
  return(mat)
}

counts_list <- list(
  Const_syn      = fix_counts(counts_Const_syn),
  Const_nuc      = fix_counts(counts_Const_nuc),
  Cond_syn_HET   = fix_counts(counts_Cond_syn_het),
  Cond_nuc_HET   = fix_counts(counts_Cond_nuc_het),
  Cond_syn_HOM   = fix_counts(counts_Cond_syn_hom),
  Cond_nuc_HOM   = fix_counts(counts_Cond_nuc_hom)
)

# Merge side-by-side
counts_all <- do.call(cbind, counts_list)




meta_Const_syn$Dataset <- "Const_syn"
meta_Const_nuc$Dataset <- "Const_nuc"
meta_Cond_syn_het$Dataset <- "Cond_syn_HET"
meta_Cond_nuc_het$Dataset <- "Cond_nuc_HET"
meta_Cond_syn_hom$Dataset <- "Cond_syn_HOM"
meta_Cond_nuc_hom$Dataset <- "Cond_nuc_HOM"

meta_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  meta_Const_syn,
  meta_Const_nuc,
  meta_Cond_syn_het,
  meta_Cond_nuc_het,
  meta_Cond_syn_hom,
  meta_Cond_nuc_hom
)

# Keep only samples present in final counts matrix
meta_all <- meta_all[meta_all$Sample %in% colnames(counts_all), ]
rownames(meta_all) <- meta_all$Sample

# Order metadata to match counts
meta_all <- meta_all[colnames(counts_all), ]




# Convert to dummy variables (one per dataset)
dataset_factor <- factor(meta_all$Dataset)
dataset_trait <- model.matrix(~ dataset_factor)[, -1]  
colnames(dataset_trait) <- levels(dataset_factor)[-1]


# Prepare for WGCNA
logCPM <- cpm(counts_all, log = TRUE, prior.count = 1) # Normalize 
datExpr <- t(logCPM)   # WGCNA requires samples × genes


```



### Run WGCNA
```{r}


allowWGCNAThreads()

# Soft threshold
powers <- 1:20
sft <- pickSoftThreshold(datExpr, powerVector = powers, verbose = 5)

softPower <- sft$powerEstimate


net <- blockwiseModules(
  datExpr,
  power = softPower,
  TOMType = "signed",
  minModuleSize = 30,
  reassignThreshold = 0,
  mergeCutHeight = 0.25,
  numericLabels = FALSE,
  saveTOMs = FALSE,
  verbose = 3
)


# Get module trait correlations
MEs <- net$MEs

# Relate each module to each dataset-group dummy variable
moduleTraitCor <- cor(MEs, dataset_trait, use = "p")
moduleTraitP   <- corPvalueStudent(moduleTraitCor, nrow(datExpr))

```

```{r}
  Sex_corrected = c("F","F","F","F","F","M","F","F","M","M","F","F","F","M","M","M"),

  stringsAsFactors = FALSE

## ----------------------------
## Cyt: standardize Sample + rename Cyt count columns
## ----------------------------
standardize_cyt_sample <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  id <- sub("_.*$", "", x)      # "425_MHET" -> "425"
  paste0(id, "_Cyt")            # -> "425_Cyt"
}

# For descriptive labels: "425_Cyt" + Sex/Genotype -> "425_MHET" or "425_FWT"
make_cyt_label <- function(sample_cyt, sex, genotype) {
  id <- sub("_Cyt$", "", as.character(sample_cyt))
  sex <- toupper(as.character(sex))
  genotype <- toupper(as.character(genotype))
  paste0(id, "_", sex, genotype)  # e.g. 425_MHET
}

# Rename Cyt count columns to standardized *_Cyt
colnames(counts_Const_cyt) <- standardize_cyt_sample(colnames(counts_Const_cyt))

# Standardize Cyt metadata Sample to *_Cyt
meta_Const_cyt_std <- meta_Const_cyt
meta_Const_cyt_std$Sample <- standardize_cyt_sample(meta_Const_cyt_std$Sample)

# Fail loudly if standardization creates collisions
if (any(duplicated(colnames(counts_Const_cyt)))) {
  dup <- unique(colnames(counts_Const_cyt)[duplicated(colnames(counts_Const_cyt))])
  stop("Duplicate Cyt column names after standardization: ", paste(dup, collapse = ", "))

  dup <- unique(meta_Const_cyt_std$Sample[duplicated(meta_Const_cyt_std$Sample)])
  stop("Duplicate Cyt meta Sample names after standardization: ", paste(dup, collapse = ", "))
}

## ----------------------------
## Helpers
## ----------------------------
align_meta_counts <- function(meta, counts) {
  stopifnot(all(c("Sample","Genotype","Sex") %in% colnames(meta)))
  stopifnot(all(meta$Sample %in% colnames(counts)))
  meta2 <- meta[match(colnames(counts), meta$Sample), , drop = FALSE]
  stopifnot(identical(meta2$Sample, colnames(counts)))
  meta2
}

logcpm_mat <- function(counts) {
  y <- edgeR::DGEList(counts = counts)
  y <- edgeR::calcNormFactors(y)
  edgeR::cpm(y, log = TRUE, prior.count = 2)
}

norm_genotype <- function(x) {
  x <- toupper(as.character(x))
  factor(x, levels = c("WT","HET"))
}

norm_sex <- function(x) {
  x <- toupper(as.character(x))
  x <- ifelse(x %in% c("F","FEMALE"), "F",
              ifelse(x %in% c("M","MALE"), "M", x))
  factor(x, levels = c("F","M"))
}

plot_gene_one_dataset <- function(gene, dataset_name, meta, logcpm) {
  if (!gene %in% rownames(logcpm)) {
    return(
      ggplot2::ggplot() +
        ggplot2::theme_void() +
        ggplot2::labs(title = paste(dataset_name, "-", gene), subtitle = "gene not found")
    )
  }

  df_plot <- meta %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      Sample = as.character(Sample),  # for indexing logcpm
      Sample_label = if ("Sample_label" %in% colnames(meta)) as.character(Sample_label) else as.character(Sample),
      Genotype = norm_genotype(Genotype),
      Sex = norm_sex(Sex),
      Outlier = if ("Outlier" %in% colnames(meta)) as.logical(Outlier) else FALSE,
      expr = as.numeric(logcpm[gene, Sample])
    )

  # t-test WT vs HET
  pval <- NA_real_
  if (all(c("WT","HET") %in% unique(as.character(df_plot$Genotype)))) {
    tmp <- df_plot %>% dplyr::filter(Genotype %in% c("WT","HET"))
    if (nrow(tmp) >= 2) {
      pval <- tryCatch(t.test(expr ~ Genotype, data = tmp)$p.value, error = function(e) NA_real_)
    }
  }
  p_label <- if (is.finite(pval) && pval < 0.05) "*" else ""

  y_max <- max(df_plot$expr, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_min <- min(df_plot$expr, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_pos <- y_max + 0.10 * (y_max - y_min + 1e-6)

  # Cyt outliers forced red (apply to both Cyt + Cyt_corrected)
  df_plot <- df_plot %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      point_group = dplyr::if_else(dataset_name %in% c("Cyt","Cyt_corrected") & Outlier,
                                   "Outlier",
                                   as.character(Genotype))
    )

  pos <- ggplot2::position_jitter(width = 0.12, height = 0, seed = 1)

  ggplot2::ggplot(df_plot, ggplot2::aes(x = Genotype, y = expr)) +
    ggplot2::geom_boxplot(
      ggplot2::aes(color = Genotype),
      fill = NA, width = 0.5, size = 0.9, outlier.shape = NA
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(
      ggplot2::aes(shape = Sex, color = point_group),
      position = pos, size = 3
    ) +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
      ggplot2::aes(label = Sample_label, color = point_group),
        size = 2.6,
        max.overlaps = Inf,
        box.padding = 0.2,
        point.padding = 0.1,
        show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = c(
      "WT" = "steelblue3",
      "HET" = "tan2",
      "HOM" = "tan2",
      "Outlier" = "red"
    )) +
    ggplot2::scale_shape_manual(values = c("F" = 16, "M" = 17)) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = paste(dataset_name, "-", gene),
      x = "Genotype",
      y = "Expression (log2 CPM)"
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_bw() +
    ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = y_pos, label = p_label, size = 6, color = "black")
}

make_pdf_for_gene_set <- function(genes, pdf_fp) {
  pre <- lapply(datasets, function(x) {
    meta <- align_meta_counts(x$meta, x$counts)
    lcpm <- logcpm_mat(x$counts)
    list(meta = meta, logcpm = lcpm)
  })

  plots <- list()
  for (g in genes) {
    for (ds in names(pre)) {
      plots[[paste(g, ds, sep = "__")]] <- plot_gene_one_dataset(
        gene = g,
        dataset_name = ds,
        meta = pre[[ds]]$meta,
        logcpm = pre[[ds]]$logcpm
      )
    }
  }

  plots <- plots[unlist(lapply(genes, function(g) paste0(g, "__", names(pre))))]

  ncol_grid <- length(pre)
  grDevices::pdf(pdf_fp, width = 4.6 * ncol_grid, height = 3.1 * length(genes))
  print(patchwork::wrap_plots(plots, ncol = ncol_grid))
  grDevices::dev.off()

  message("Saved: ", pdf_fp)
}

## ----------------------------
## Run
## ----------------------------
make_pdf_for_gene_set(bulk_up,   file.path(out_dir, "bulk_up_gene_boxplots.pdf"))
```

## PCA using core Chd8 genes

```{r}


## ----------------------------
## Load whole-tissue DE table + define Top200 genes
## ----------------------------
whole_tissue_DE <- read.csv("output/DE/DE_Ctx_full.csv")

# Pick the column that contains gene symbols
gene_col <- dplyr::case_when(
  "gene" %in% colnames(whole_tissue_DE) ~ "gene",
  "Gene" %in% colnames(whole_tissue_DE) ~ "Gene",
  "symbol" %in% colnames(whole_tissue_DE) ~ "symbol",
  "SYMBOL" %in% colnames(whole_tissue_DE) ~ "SYMBOL",
  "gene_name" %in% colnames(whole_tissue_DE) ~ "gene_name",
  TRUE ~ NA_character_
)
if (is.na(gene_col)) stop("Couldn't find a gene symbol column in whole_tissue_DE.")

# Pick the FDR column
fdr_col <- dplyr::case_when(
  "FDR" %in% colnames(whole_tissue_DE) ~ "FDR",
  "padj" %in% colnames(whole_tissue_DE) ~ "padj",
  "adj.P.Val" %in% colnames(whole_tissue_DE) ~ "adj.P.Val",
  "qval" %in% colnames(whole_tissue_DE) ~ "qval",
  TRUE ~ NA_character_
)
if (is.na(fdr_col)) stop("Couldn't find an FDR/adjusted p-value column in whole_tissue_DE.")

# Top 200 genes by FDR (gene symbols)
top200_genes <- whole_tissue_DE %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[fdr_col]])) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(.data[[fdr_col]]) %>%
  dplyr::pull(.data[[gene_col]]) %>%
  as.character() %>%
  unique() %>%
  head(200)

message("Top200 whole-tissue DE genes by ", fdr_col, ": ", length(top200_genes))

## ----------------------------
## PCA helpers
## ----------------------------

# Ensure we only use genes present in ALL datasets (so PCA comparable across panels)
core_genes_present <- function(genes, datasets_pre) {
  genes <- unique(genes)
  keep <- genes
  for (ds in names(datasets_pre)) {
    keep <- intersect(keep, rownames(datasets_pre[[ds]]$logcpm))
  }
  keep
}

# Build sample x gene matrix for PCA (samples as rows)
build_pca_matrix <- function(meta, logcpm, genes) {
  stopifnot(all(meta$Sample %in% colnames(logcpm)))
  genes_use <- intersect(genes, rownames(logcpm))
  if (length(genes_use) < 2) stop("Too few genes present for PCA.")

  X <- t(logcpm[genes_use, meta$Sample, drop = FALSE])  # samples x genes
  X <- scale(X)  # z-score each gene across samples
  X
}

# One PCA plot for one dataset
plot_pca_one_dataset <- function(dataset_name, meta, logcpm, genes,
                                 pc_pairs = list(c(1,2), c(3,4))) {
  meta <- align_meta_counts(meta, as.data.frame(logcpm))
  if (!"Sample_label" %in% colnames(meta)) meta$Sample_label <- meta$Sample

  meta$Genotype <- factor(toupper(as.character(meta$Genotype)), levels = c("WT","HET"))
  meta$Sex <- factor(toupper(as.character(meta$Sex)), levels = c("F","M"))

  X <- build_pca_matrix(meta, logcpm, genes)
  pca <- prcomp(X, center = FALSE, scale. = FALSE)
  pct <- (pca$sdev^2) / sum(pca$sdev^2) * 100

  # base df with all PCs
  scores <- as.data.frame(pca$x)
  df <- data.frame(
    Sample = meta$Sample,
    Sample_label = meta$Sample_label,
    Genotype = meta$Genotype,
    Sex = meta$Sex,
    scores,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  make_one <- function(i, j) {
    xi <- paste0("PC", i)
    yj <- paste0("PC", j)

    ggplot2::ggplot(df, ggplot2::aes_string(x = xi, y = yj)) +
      ggplot2::geom_point(ggplot2::aes(color = Genotype, shape = Sex), size = 4) +
      ggplot2::geom_text(ggplot2::aes(label = Sample_label, color = Genotype),
                         vjust = -0.8, size = 3.5, show.legend = FALSE) +
      ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = c(
        "WT" = "royalblue",
        "HET" = "olivedrab",
        "HOM" = "olivedrab"
      )) +
      ggplot2::scale_shape_manual(values = c("F" = 16, "M" = 17)) +
      ggplot2::labs(
        title = paste0(dataset_name, " PCA (Top 200 whole-tissue DEGs)"),
        x = paste0("PC", i, " (", round(pct[i], 1), "%)"),
        y = paste0("PC", j, " (", round(pct[j], 1), "%)")
      ) +
      ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = 0.12)) +
      ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = 0.16)) +
      ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size = 14)
  }

  plots <- lapply(pc_pairs, \(pair) make_one(pair[1], pair[2]))

  # stack within dataset: row1 then row2
  patchwork::wrap_plots(plots, ncol = 1)
}

## ----------------------------
## Run PCA for all datasets
## ----------------------------

# Precompute logCPM once per dataset
pre <- lapply(datasets, function(x) {
  meta <- align_meta_counts(x$meta, x$counts)
  lcpm <- logcpm_mat(x$counts)
  list(meta = meta, logcpm = lcpm)
})

# Use intersection across all datasets so PCA gene set is identical everywhere
core_genes <- core_genes_present(top200_genes, pre)
message("Top200 genes present in ALL datasets (intersection): ", length(core_genes))

# PCA PDF (two rows per dataset, so double the height)
pca_fp <- file.path(out_dir, "Top200WholeDE_PCA_all_datasets.pdf")
grDevices::pdf(pca_fp, width = 6.5 * length(pre), height = 12)

p_list <- lapply(names(pre), function(ds) {
  plot_pca_one_dataset(ds, pre[[ds]]$meta, pre[[ds]]$logcpm, core_genes,
                       pc_pairs = list(c(1,2), c(3,4)))  # <- PC1/2 on top, PC3/4 below
})

print(patchwork::wrap_plots(p_list, ncol = length(pre)))
grDevices::dev.off()
message("Saved: ", pca_fp)

```



## Using random forest trained on Chd8 signature to predict genotype - Cyt
```{r}

## ----------------------------
## Libraries
## ----------------------------
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(edgeR)
  library(randomForest)
})

## ----------------------------
## Helpers to standardize Cyt sample names
## ----------------------------
standardize_cyt_sample <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  id <- sub("_.*$", "", x)   # "425_MHET" -> "425", "M6_MWT" -> "M6"
  paste0(id, "_Cyt")         # -> "425_Cyt"
}

## ----------------------------
## Cyt corrections (IGV-based)
## ----------------------------
cyt_corrections <- data.frame(
  Sample = c("432_Cyt","431_Cyt","436_Cyt","5_Cyt","6_Cyt","430_Cyt","M6_Cyt","2_Cyt",
             "429_Cyt","425_Cyt","546_Cyt","532_Cyt","545_Cyt","480_Cyt","481_Cyt","435_Cyt"),
  Sex_corrected = c("F","F","F","F","F","M","F","F","M","M","F","F","F","M","M","M"),
  Genotype_corrected = c("WT","HET","HET","WT","WT","WT","HET","HET","WT","HET","WT","HET","HET","WT","HET","WT"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

## ----------------------------
## Standardize Cyt counts + meta Sample names so everything matches
## ----------------------------
colnames(counts_Const_cyt) <- standardize_cyt_sample(colnames(counts_Const_cyt))

meta_cyt <- meta_Const_cyt
meta_cyt$Sample <- standardize_cyt_sample(meta_cyt$Sample)

# basic sanity checks
stopifnot(all(meta_cyt$Sample %in% colnames(counts_Const_cyt)))
meta_cyt <- meta_cyt[match(colnames(counts_Const_cyt), meta_cyt$Sample), , drop = FALSE]
stopifnot(identical(meta_cyt$Sample, colnames(counts_Const_cyt)))

## ----------------------------
## Load whole-tissue DE table and get top200 genes by FDR
## ----------------------------
whole_tissue_DE <- read.csv("output/DE/DE_Ctx_full.csv")

gene_col <- dplyr::case_when(
  "gene" %in% colnames(whole_tissue_DE) ~ "gene",
  "Gene" %in% colnames(whole_tissue_DE) ~ "Gene",
  "symbol" %in% colnames(whole_tissue_DE) ~ "symbol",
  "SYMBOL" %in% colnames(whole_tissue_DE) ~ "SYMBOL",
  "gene_name" %in% colnames(whole_tissue_DE) ~ "gene_name",
  TRUE ~ NA_character_
)
if (is.na(gene_col)) stop("Couldn't find a gene symbol column in whole_tissue_DE.")

fdr_col <- dplyr::case_when(
  "FDR" %in% colnames(whole_tissue_DE) ~ "FDR",
  "padj" %in% colnames(whole_tissue_DE) ~ "padj",
  "adj.P.Val" %in% colnames(whole_tissue_DE) ~ "adj.P.Val",
  "qval" %in% colnames(whole_tissue_DE) ~ "qval",
  TRUE ~ NA_character_
)
if (is.na(fdr_col)) stop("Couldn't find an FDR/adjusted p-value column in whole_tissue_DE.")

top200_genes <- whole_tissue_DE %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[fdr_col]])) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(.data[[fdr_col]]) %>%
  dplyr::pull(.data[[gene_col]]) %>%
  as.character() %>%
  unique() %>%
  head(200)

## ----------------------------
## Compute Cyt logCPM and build ML feature matrix
## ----------------------------
y <- edgeR::DGEList(counts = counts_Const_cyt)
y <- edgeR::calcNormFactors(y)
lcpm <- edgeR::cpm(y, log = TRUE, prior.count = 2)   # genes x samples

genes_use <- intersect(top200_genes, rownames(lcpm))
if (length(genes_use) < 10) {
  stop("Too few of the top200 genes were found in Cyt logCPM. Found: ", length(genes_use))
}

X <- t(lcpm[genes_use, , drop = FALSE])  # samples x genes
X <- scale(X)                             # scale genes across samples (helps RF a bit)

## ----------------------------
## Build labels: og_genotype + igv_predicted
## ----------------------------
labels <- meta_cyt %>%
  dplyr::select(Sample, Genotype) %>%
  dplyr::rename(og_genotype = Genotype) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    cyt_corrections %>% dplyr::select(Sample, Genotype_corrected),
    by = "Sample"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(igv_predicted = Genotype_corrected)

if (any(is.na(labels$igv_predicted))) {
  stop("Missing IGV/corrected genotype for: ",
       paste(labels$Sample[is.na(labels$igv_predicted)], collapse = ", "))
}

# Make sure we’re only dealing with WT/HET for RF
labels$og_genotype    <- factor(toupper(as.character(labels$og_genotype)), levels = c("WT","HET"))
labels$igv_predicted  <- factor(toupper(as.character(labels$igv_predicted)), levels = c("WT","HET"))

## ----------------------------
## Fit Random Forest using IGV-corrected genotype as training label
## (and report OOB predictions/probabilities)
## ----------------------------
set.seed(1)

rf <- randomForest(
  x = X,
  y = labels$igv_predicted,
  ntree = 2000,
  importance = TRUE,
  keep.forest = TRUE
)

# OOB class probabilities: rf$votes (rows = samples, cols = classes)
votes <- rf$votes
prob_het <- if ("HET" %in% colnames(votes)) votes[, "HET"] else rep(NA_real_, nrow(votes))
rf_pred <- colnames(votes)[max.col(votes, ties.method = "first")]

out_tbl <- data.frame(
  Sample = labels$Sample,
  og_genotype = as.character(labels$og_genotype),
  igv_predicted = as.character(labels$igv_predicted),
  rf_predicted = rf_pred,
  prob_het = as.numeric(prob_het),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Optional: sort by “how HET-like” the RF thinks each sample is
out_tbl <- out_tbl %>% dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(prob_het))

print(out_tbl)

# If you want to save it:
write.csv(out_tbl, file = "output/QC/Cyt_RF_genotype_QC.csv", row.names = FALSE)


```

```{r}
## ----------------------------
meta_sn <- metadata_const_syn_nuc_cyt %>%
  dplyr::filter(Fraction %in% c("Syn", "Nuc"))

stopifnot(all(meta_sn$Sample %in% colnames(exp_data_const_syn_nuc_cyt)))

## ----------------------------

## (and report OOB predictions/probabilities)

  x = X,
  y = labels$og_genotype,
  ntree = 2000,
  importance = TRUE,
  keep.forest = TRUE
)

# OOB class probabilities: rf$votes (rows = samples, cols = classes)

prob_het <- if ("HET" %in% colnames(votes)) votes[, "HET"] else rep(NA_real_, nrow(votes))

  Fraction = meta_sn$Fraction,
  og_genotype = as.character(labels$og_genotype),
  rf_predicted = rf_pred,
  prob_het = as.numeric(prob_het),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

  dplyr::group_by(Fraction) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(prob_het), .by_group = TRUE) %>%

print(out_tbl)

write.csv(out_tbl, file = "output/QC/SynNuc_RF_genotype_QC.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}

#library(readxl)

#library(edgeR)

# ---- filter metadata first ----
metadata_filt <- metadata_const_syn_nuc_cyt %>%
  #dplyr::filter(!Sample %in% c("6F_Cyt", "2F_Cyt"))
  dplyr::filter(Outlier %in% c(FALSE))

# Counts are in exp_data_const_syn_nuc_cyt  (genes x samples; rownames = gene symbols)

GO <- read_xlsx("output/GO/final_DE/conc_Const_nuc_vs_cyt_down.xlsx")

mod_genes <- GO %>%
  dplyr::slice(1:15) %>%
  dplyr::pull(geneID) %>%
  as.character() %>%
  paste(collapse = "/") %>%
  strsplit("/", fixed = TRUE) %>%
  unlist() %>%
  unique()

mod_genes <- intersect(mod_genes, rownames(exp_data_const_syn_nuc_cyt))

y <- edgeR::DGEList(counts = exp_data_const_syn_nuc_cyt)
y <- edgeR::calcNormFactors(y, method = "TMM")
logcpm_all <- edgeR::cpm(y, log = TRUE, prior.count = 1)
module_score <- colMeans(logcpm_all[mod_genes, , drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)

df_plot <- data.frame(
  Sample = names(module_score),
  expr   = as.numeric(module_score),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(metadata_filt, by = "Sample") %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(Fraction), Fraction %in% c("Nuc", "Cyt", "Syn"),
                !is.na(Genotype), Genotype %in% c("WT","HET"),
                !is.na(Sex))

df_plot$Genotype <- factor(df_plot$Genotype, levels = c("WT","HET"))
df_plot$Fraction <- factor(df_plot$Fraction, levels = c("Nuc","Cyt","Syn"))

# p-values per Fraction (WT vs HET)
pvals <- df_plot %>%
  group_by(Fraction) %>%
  summarize(
    p = tryCatch(wilcox.test(expr ~ Genotype)$p.value, error = function(e) NA_real_),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(p_label = ifelse(is.na(p), "p = NA", paste0("p = ", signif(p, 3))))

# y position for p labels within each facet
y_annot <- df_plot %>%
  group_by(Fraction) %>%
  summarize(
    y = max(expr, na.rm = TRUE) + 0.08 * diff(range(expr, na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(pvals, by = "Fraction")

p <- ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = Genotype, y = expr, color = Genotype)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = NA, width = 0.5, size = 0.9, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(aes(shape = Sex), width = 0.12, size = 3) +
  #ggrepel::geom_text_repel(aes(label = Sample), size = 3, show.legend = FALSE, max.overlaps = Inf) +
  facet_wrap(~Fraction, nrow = 1, scales = "fixed") +
  geom_text(data = y_annot, aes(x = 1.5, y = y, label = p_label), inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("WT" = "steelblue3", "HET" = "firebrick2")) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("F" = 16, "M" = 17)) +
  labs(
    title = "Module score",
    x = "Genotype",
    y = "Average module expression (log2 CPM)"
  ) +
  theme_bw()

p
```

```{r}
module_score <- colMeans(logcpm_all[mod_genes, , drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)

df_plot <- data.frame(
  Sample = names(module_score),
  expr   = as.numeric(module_score),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(metadata_filt, by = "Sample") %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(Fraction), Fraction %in% c("Syn", "Cyt", "Nuc"),
                !is.na(Genotype), Genotype %in% c("WT","HET"),
                !is.na(Sex))

df_plot$Genotype <- factor(df_plot$Genotype, levels = c("WT","HET"))
df_plot$Fraction <- factor(df_plot$Fraction, levels = c("Syn","Cyt","Nuc"))

# p-values per Fraction (WT vs HET)
pvals <- df_plot %>%
  group_by(Fraction) %>%
  summarize(
    p = tryCatch(wilcox.test(expr ~ Genotype)$p.value, error = function(e) NA_real_),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(p_label = ifelse(is.na(p), "p = NA", paste0("p = ", signif(p, 3))))

# y position for p labels within each facet
y_annot <- df_plot %>%
  group_by(Fraction) %>%
  summarize(
    y = max(expr, na.rm = TRUE) + 0.08 * diff(range(expr, na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(pvals, by = "Fraction")

p <- ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = Genotype, y = expr, color = Genotype)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = NA, width = 0.5, size = 0.9, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(aes(shape = Sex), width = 0.12, size = 3) +
  #ggrepel::geom_text_repel(aes(label = Sample), size = 3, show.legend = FALSE, max.overlaps = Inf) +
  facet_wrap(~Fraction, nrow = 1, scales = "fixed") +
  geom_text(data = y_annot, aes(x = 1.5, y = y, label = p_label), inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("WT" = "steelblue3", "HET" = "firebrick2")) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("F" = 16, "M" = 17)) +
  labs(
    title = "Module score",
    x = "Genotype",
    y = "Average module expression (log2 CPM)"
  ) +
  theme_bw()

p

```

```{r}
# --------------------------

}

# --------------------------
# Whole CONST metadata (Batch != "Cond") and Whole COND metadata (Batch == "Cond")

meta_whole_const <- metadata_const_cond_whole %>%

  droplevels()

# --------------------------
# Robust sample alignment helper (handles trivial formatting issues)
# --------------------------
norm_sample <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(as.character(x))
  x <- gsub("\\.", "_", x)
  x <- sub("^X(?=\\d)", "", x, perl = TRUE)
  tolower(x)
}

subset_align_cols <- function(mat, samples) {
  stopifnot(!is.null(colnames(mat)))
  cn_raw <- colnames(mat)
  sm_raw <- as.character(samples)

  cn_norm <- norm_sample(cn_raw)
  sm_norm <- norm_sample(sm_raw)

  ov <- intersect(cn_norm, sm_norm)
  if (length(ov) == 0L) stop("No overlapping samples between matrix and requested sample list.")

  keep_cols <- cn_norm %in% ov
  mat2 <- mat[, keep_cols, drop = FALSE]

  cn2_norm <- norm_sample(colnames(mat2))
  want_norm <- sm_norm[sm_norm %in% ov]
  ord <- match(want_norm, cn2_norm)
  ord <- ord[!is.na(ord)]
  mat2[, ord, drop = FALSE]
}

# --------------------------
# Protein-coding gene list (ENS IDs)
# --------------------------
protein_coding_genes <- my_gene_map %>%
  dplyr::filter(gene_biotype == "protein_coding") %>%
  dplyr::pull(gene_id) %>%
  unique()

# --------------------------
# GO -> genes helper (EXACT TERM match; BP only; returns SYMBOLs)
# --------------------------
get_go_genes <- function(term_exact, ontology = "BP", use_goall = TRUE) {

  # (REMOVED per-term validity check; now validated once before loop)

  term2go <- suppressMessages(
    AnnotationDbi::select(
      x       = GO.db::GO.db,
      keys    = term_exact,
      keytype = "TERM",
      columns = c("GOID", "ONTOLOGY")
    )
  )
  if (is.null(term2go) || nrow(term2go) == 0) return(character())

  goids <- term2go[!is.na(term2go$GOID) & term2go$ONTOLOGY == ontology, "GOID", drop = TRUE]
  goids <- unique(as.character(goids))
  if (!length(goids)) return(character())

  go2sym <- suppressMessages(
    AnnotationDbi::select(
      x       = org.Mm.eg.db::org.Mm.eg.db,
      keys    = goids,
      keytype = if (isTRUE(use_goall)) "GOALL" else "GO",
      columns = "SYMBOL"
    )
  )
  if (is.null(go2sym) || nrow(go2sym) == 0) return(character())

  genes <- go2sym$SYMBOL
  genes <- genes[!is.na(genes) & genes != ""]
  unique(as.character(genes))
}

# --------------------------
# Build RPKM matrices for CONST + COND (fractions + whole)
#   - All are aligned to the sample order in their respective metadata
# --------------------------
# CONST fractions (Syn/Nuc/Cyt)
samples_const_frac <- metadata_filt$Sample
rpkm_const_frac <- subset_align_cols(rpkm_data_const_syn_nuc_cyt, samples_const_frac)

# CONST whole
rpkm_const_whole <- subset_align_cols(rpkm_data_const_cond_whole, meta_whole_const$Sample)

# COND fractions (Syn/Nuc)
samples_cond_frac <- metadata_cond_filt$Sample
rpkm_cond_frac <- subset_align_cols(rpkm_data_cond_syn_nuc, samples_cond_frac)

# COND whole (from the combined whole-tissue RPKM object)
rpkm_cond_whole <- subset_align_cols(rpkm_data_const_cond_whole, meta_whole_cond$Sample)

# --------------------------
# Expression plot helper: RPKM boxplots
#   - Top row: 4 CONST panels (Const - Nuc/Cyt/Syn/Whole)
#   - Bottom row: 5 COND panels (Cond - Syn - het, Cond - Syn - hom, Cond - Nuc - het, Cond - Nuc - hom, Cond - Whole)
#   - IMPORTANT:
#       * WT vs HET for ALL panels EXCEPT Syn-hom and Nuc-hom (WT vs HOM)
#       * Only 2 x-axis ticks per panel (accomplished via free_x + dropping unused levels)
#       * HOM is colored the same as HET (firebrick) as requested
# --------------------------
plot_set_expr_rpkm <- function(
  term_genes_ens,
  label,
  max_genes_per_panel = 100
) {

  pick_top_genes <- function(rpkm_mat, genes, samples, max_genes = 100) {
    genes <- intersect(genes, rownames(rpkm_mat))
    samples <- intersect(samples, colnames(rpkm_mat))
    if (length(genes) < 2 || length(samples) < 2) return(character())
    m <- rowMeans(rpkm_mat[genes, samples, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
    genes_sorted <- names(sort(m, decreasing = TRUE))
    head(genes_sorted, min(max_genes, length(genes_sorted)))
  }

  # helper: build a panel df with module score per sample
  make_panel_df <- function(rpkm_mat, genes_all, samples, panel_label, meta_df, geno_keep, max_genes) {
    samples <- intersect(samples, colnames(rpkm_mat))
    if (length(samples) < 2) return(NULL)

    genes_use <- intersect(genes_all, rownames(rpkm_mat))
    if (length(genes_use) < 2) return(NULL)

    if (length(genes_use) > max_genes) {
      genes_use <- pick_top_genes(rpkm_mat, genes_use, samples, max_genes)
    }
    if (length(genes_use) < 2) return(NULL)

    score <- colMeans(rpkm_mat[genes_use, samples, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)

    df <- data.frame(
      Sample = names(score),
      expr   = as.numeric(score),
      Panel  = panel_label,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ) %>%
      dplyr::left_join(meta_df %>% dplyr::select(Sample, Genotype, Sex), by = "Sample") %>%
      dplyr::filter(!is.na(Genotype), Genotype %in% geno_keep, !is.na(Sex))

    if (nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL)
    df
  }

  df_const_list <- list()
  df_cond_list  <- list()

  # CONST panels (WT vs HET)
  genes_const_all <- intersect(term_genes_ens, rownames(rpkm_const_frac))
  if (length(genes_const_all) >= 2) {
    for (fr in c("Nuc", "Cyt", "Syn")) {
      samps <- metadata_filt$Sample[metadata_filt$Fraction == fr]
      tmp <- make_panel_df(
        rpkm_mat   = rpkm_const_frac,
        genes_all  = genes_const_all,
        samples    = samps,
        panel_label= paste0("Const - ", fr),
        meta_df    = metadata_filt,
        geno_keep  = c("WT", "HET"),
        max_genes  = max_genes_per_panel
      )
      if (!is.null(tmp)) df_const_list[[fr]] <- tmp
    }

    # Const - Whole (WT vs HET)
    genes_wh <- intersect(term_genes_ens, rownames(rpkm_const_whole))
    samps_wh <- meta_whole_const$Sample
    tmp <- make_panel_df(
      rpkm_mat    = rpkm_const_whole,
      genes_all   = genes_wh,
      samples     = samps_wh,
      panel_label = "Const - Whole",
      meta_df     = meta_whole_const,
      geno_keep   = c("WT", "HET"),
      max_genes   = max_genes_per_panel
    )
    if (!is.null(tmp)) df_const_list[["Whole"]] <- tmp
  }

  # COND panels
  genes_cond_all <- intersect(term_genes_ens, rownames(rpkm_cond_frac))
  if (length(genes_cond_all) >= 2) {

    # Cond - Syn - het (WT vs HET)
    samps <- metadata_cond_filt$Sample[metadata_cond_filt$Fraction == "Syn"]
    tmp <- make_panel_df(
      rpkm_mat    = rpkm_cond_frac,
      genes_all   = genes_cond_all,
      samples     = samps,
      panel_label = "Cond - Syn - het",
      meta_df     = metadata_cond_filt,
      geno_keep   = c("WT", "HET"),
      max_genes   = max_genes_per_panel
    )
    if (!is.null(tmp)) df_cond_list[["Syn_het"]] <- tmp

    # Cond - Syn - hom (WT vs HOM)
    tmp <- make_panel_df(
      rpkm_mat    = rpkm_cond_frac,
      genes_all   = genes_cond_all,
      samples     = samps,
      panel_label = "Cond - Syn - hom",
      meta_df     = metadata_cond_filt,
      geno_keep   = c("WT", "HOM"),
      max_genes   = max_genes_per_panel
    )
    if (!is.null(tmp)) df_cond_list[["Syn_hom"]] <- tmp

    # Cond - Nuc - het (WT vs HET)
    samps <- metadata_cond_filt$Sample[metadata_cond_filt$Fraction == "Nuc"]
    tmp <- make_panel_df(
      rpkm_mat    = rpkm_cond_frac,
      genes_all   = genes_cond_all,
      samples     = samps,
      panel_label = "Cond - Nuc - het",
      meta_df     = metadata_cond_filt,
      geno_keep   = c("WT", "HET"),
      max_genes   = max_genes_per_panel
    )
    if (!is.null(tmp)) df_cond_list[["Nuc_het"]] <- tmp

    # Cond - Nuc - hom (WT vs HOM)
    tmp <- make_panel_df(
      rpkm_mat    = rpkm_cond_frac,
      genes_all   = genes_cond_all,
      samples     = samps,
      panel_label = "Cond - Nuc - hom",
      meta_df     = metadata_cond_filt,
      geno_keep   = c("WT", "HOM"),
      max_genes   = max_genes_per_panel
    )
    if (!is.null(tmp)) df_cond_list[["Nuc_hom"]] <- tmp
  }

  # Cond - Whole (WT vs HET)
  genes_cond_wh <- intersect(term_genes_ens, rownames(rpkm_cond_whole))
  if (length(genes_cond_wh) >= 2) {
    samps_wh <- meta_whole_cond$Sample
    tmp <- make_panel_df(
      rpkm_mat    = rpkm_cond_whole,
      genes_all   = genes_cond_wh,
      samples     = samps_wh,
      panel_label = "Cond - Whole",
      meta_df     = meta_whole_cond,
      geno_keep   = c("WT", "HET"),
      max_genes   = max_genes_per_panel
    )
    if (!is.null(tmp)) df_cond_list[["Whole"]] <- tmp
  }

  df_const <- dplyr::bind_rows(df_const_list)
  df_cond  <- dplyr::bind_rows(df_cond_list)

  if ((is.null(df_const) || nrow(df_const) == 0) && (is.null(df_cond) || nrow(df_cond) == 0)) {
    return(ggplot2::ggplot() + ggplot2::theme_void() +
             ggplot2::labs(title = label, subtitle = "No data to plot after filtering"))
  }

  # ensure consistent genotype ordering; per-facet will drop unused levels (gives 2 ticks per panel)
  if (!is.null(df_const) && nrow(df_const) > 0) {
    df_const$Genotype <- factor(as.character(df_const$Genotype), levels = c("WT", "HET", "HOM"))
    df_const$Panel <- factor(df_const$Panel, levels = c("Const - Nuc","Const - Cyt","Const - Syn","Const - Whole"))
  }
  if (!is.null(df_cond) && nrow(df_cond) > 0) {
    df_cond$Genotype <- factor(as.character(df_cond$Genotype), levels = c("WT", "HET", "HOM"))
    df_cond$Panel <- factor(df_cond$Panel, levels = c(
      "Cond - Syn - het","Cond - Syn - hom","Cond - Nuc - het","Cond - Nuc - hom","Cond - Whole"
    ))
  }

  # p-value annotation per panel (wilcox; only when exactly 2 genotype levels are present)
  add_pvals <- function(df) {
    if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) return(list(pvals = NULL, y_annot = NULL))
    pvals <- df %>%
      dplyr::group_by(Panel) %>%
      dplyr::summarize(
        n_geno = dplyr::n_distinct(Genotype[!is.na(Genotype)]),
        p = ifelse(
          n_geno == 2,
          tryCatch(stats::wilcox.test(expr ~ Genotype)$p.value, error = function(e) NA_real_),
          NA_real_
        ),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(p_label = ifelse(is.na(p), "p = NA", paste0("p = ", signif(p, 3))))

    y_annot <- df %>%
      dplyr::group_by(Panel) %>%
      dplyr::summarize(
        y = max(expr, na.rm = TRUE) + 0.08 * diff(range(expr, na.rm = TRUE)),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      dplyr::left_join(pvals, by = "Panel")

    list(pvals = pvals, y_annot = y_annot)
  }

  ann_const <- add_pvals(df_const)
  ann_cond  <- add_pvals(df_cond)

  subtitle_txt <- paste0(
    "total genes in GO set = ", length(term_genes_ens), "\n",
    "If > ", max_genes_per_panel,
    ", module score uses top ", max_genes_per_panel,
    " expressed genes within fraction (avg across samples)"
  )

  base_theme <- ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
    ggplot2::theme(plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold"))

  # CONST plot (4 panels in a single row)
  p_const <- NULL
  if (!is.null(df_const) && nrow(df_const) > 0) {
    p_const <- ggplot2::ggplot(df_const, ggplot2::aes(x = Genotype, y = expr, color = Genotype)) +
      ggplot2::geom_boxplot(fill = NA, width = 0.5, size = 0.9, outlier.shape = NA) +
      ggplot2::geom_jitter(ggplot2::aes(shape = Sex), width = 0.12, size = 2.8) +
      ggplot2::facet_wrap(~Panel, nrow = 1, scales = "free_x", drop = TRUE) +
      ggplot2::geom_text(
        data = ann_const$y_annot,
        ggplot2::aes(x = 1.5, y = y, label = p_label),
        inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 4.0
      ) +
      # HOM uses same color as HET (firebrick) as requested
      ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = c("WT" = "steelblue3", "HET" = "firebrick2", "HOM" = "firebrick2"), drop = TRUE) +
      ggplot2::scale_shape_manual(values = c("F" = 16, "M" = 17)) +
      ggplot2::labs(
        title = label,
        subtitle = subtitle_txt,
        x = "Genotype",
        y = "Mean expression (log2 RPKM)"
      ) +
      base_theme
  }

  # COND plot (5 panels in a single row)  <-- ensures Cond - Syn - het is in the bottom row
  p_cond <- NULL
  if (!is.null(df_cond) && nrow(df_cond) > 0) {
    p_cond <- ggplot2::ggplot(df_cond, ggplot2::aes(x = Genotype, y = expr, color = Genotype)) +
      ggplot2::geom_boxplot(fill = NA, width = 0.5, size = 0.9, outlier.shape = NA) +
      ggplot2::geom_jitter(ggplot2::aes(shape = Sex), width = 0.12, size = 2.8) +
      ggplot2::facet_wrap(~Panel, nrow = 1, scales = "free_x", drop = TRUE) +
      ggplot2::geom_text(
        data = ann_cond$y_annot,
        ggplot2::aes(x = 1.5, y = y, label = p_label),
        inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 4.0
      ) +
      ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = c("WT" = "steelblue3", "HET" = "firebrick2", "HOM" = "firebrick2"), drop = TRUE) +
      ggplot2::scale_shape_manual(values = c("F" = 16, "M" = 17)) +
      ggplot2::scale_x_discrete(drop = TRUE) +
      ggplot2::labs(
        title = NULL,
        subtitle = NULL,
        x = "Genotype",
        y = "Mean expression (log2 RPKM)"
      ) +
      base_theme +
      ggplot2::theme(
        plot.title = ggplot2::element_blank(),
        plot.subtitle = ggplot2::element_blank()
      )
  }

  # stack into 2 rows: 4 (top) + 5 (bottom)
  if (!is.null(p_const) && !is.null(p_cond)) {
    return(p_const / p_cond)
  } else if (!is.null(p_const)) {
    return(p_const)
  } else {
    return(p_cond)
  }
}

# --------------------------
# DE CSV IO helpers
# --------------------------
read_de <- function(fp) {
  readr::read_csv(fp, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(dplyr::everything(), ~ .x))
}

detect_cols <- function(de) {
  cols_low <- tolower(names(de))

  gene_col <- names(de)[match(TRUE, cols_low %in% c("gene_id","ens","ensembl","ensembl_id","gene"))]
  if (is.na(gene_col)) {
    gene_col <- names(de)[match(TRUE, cols_low %in% c("gene_name","symbol"))]
  }

  p_col   <- names(de)[match(TRUE, cols_low %in% c("pvalue","p_val","p.val","pvalue_wald","pvalue.lrt","pvalue_lrt","pvalue_wald"))]
  fdr_col <- names(de)[match(TRUE, cols_low %in% c("fdr","padj","p_adj","p.adjust","p_val_adj","qvalue"))]
  lfc_col <- names(de)[match(TRUE, cols_low %in% c("logfc","log2fc","log2foldchange","log_fc","log2foldchange_wald","log2foldchange.lrt"))]

  stopifnot(!is.na(gene_col), !is.na(p_col), !is.na(lfc_col))
  list(gene_col = gene_col, p_col = p_col, fdr_col = fdr_col, lfc_col = lfc_col)
}

prep_de_for_plot <- function(de, cols, genes) {
  de %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      gene_raw = as.character(.data[[cols$gene_col]]),
      gene = ifelse(
        grepl("^ENSMUSG", gene_raw),
        gene_raw,
        my_gene_map$gene_id[match(gene_raw, my_gene_map$gene_name)]
      ),
      pvalue = as.numeric(.data[[cols$p_col]]),
      logfc  = as.numeric(.data[[cols$lfc_col]]),
      fdr    = if (!is.na(cols$fdr_col)) as.numeric(.data[[cols$fdr_col]]) else NA_real_
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(gene), gene != "", gene %in% genes) %>%
    dplyr::select(gene, logfc, pvalue, fdr)
}

write_temp_de <- function(df, prefix, term_id) {
  dir.create(file.path(outdir, "tmp_de"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  fp <- file.path(outdir, "tmp_de", paste0(prefix, "__", term_id, ".csv"))
  write.csv(df, fp, row.names = FALSE)
  fp
}

safe_filename <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    stringr::str_to_lower() %>%
    stringr::str_replace_all("[^a-z0-9]+", "_") %>%
    stringr::str_replace_all("^_+|_+$", "") %>%
    substr(1, 140)
}

# Read DEs once
de_const_whole <- read_de(const_whole_DE); cols_const_whole <- detect_cols(de_const_whole)
de_const_nuc   <- read_de(const_nuc_DE);   cols_const_nuc   <- detect_cols(de_const_nuc)
de_const_syn   <- read_de(const_syn_DE);   cols_const_syn   <- detect_cols(de_const_syn)
de_const_cyt   <- read_de(const_cyt_DE);   cols_const_cyt   <- detect_cols(de_const_cyt)

de_cond_whole   <- read_de(cond_whole_DE);    cols_cond_whole   <- detect_cols(de_cond_whole)
de_cond_syn_het <- read_de(cond_syn_het_DE);  cols_cond_syn_het <- detect_cols(de_cond_syn_het)
de_cond_nuc_het <- read_de(cond_nuc_het_DE);  cols_cond_nuc_het <- detect_cols(de_cond_nuc_het)
de_cond_syn_hom <- read_de(cond_syn_hom_DE);  cols_cond_syn_hom <- detect_cols(de_cond_syn_hom)
de_cond_nuc_hom <- read_de(cond_nuc_hom_DE);  cols_cond_nuc_hom <- detect_cols(de_cond_nuc_hom)

# --------------------------
# PRE-FLIGHT: validate ALL GO terms up-front (fail fast)
# --------------------------
valid_terms <- AnnotationDbi::keys(GO.db::GO.db, keytype = "TERM")

bad_terms <- setdiff(go_terms, valid_terms)
if (length(bad_terms) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Invalid GO TERM(s) (keytype='TERM') detected BEFORE loop:\n  - ",
    paste(bad_terms, collapse = "\n  - "),
    "\n\nTERM matching is exact. Look up via:\n  keys(GO.db::GO.db, keytype='TERM')\n"
  )
}

# --------------------------
# Loop through GO terms
# --------------------------
for (term in go_terms) {

  cat("\nGO term: ", term, "\n", sep="")

  go_syms <- as.character(get_go_genes(term, ontology = "BP"))
  if (length(go_syms) == 0) {
    message("  No genes found for term ", term)
    next
  }

  go_ens <- sym_to_ens(go_syms)

  # protein-coding filter
  term_genes <- intersect(go_ens, protein_coding_genes)
  
  # Keep genes present in the constitutive DE tables
  all_de_genes <- unique(c(
    prep_de_for_plot(de_const_whole, cols_const_whole, go_ens)$gene,
    prep_de_for_plot(de_const_nuc,   cols_const_nuc,   go_ens)$gene,
    prep_de_for_plot(de_const_syn,   cols_const_syn,   go_ens)$gene,
    prep_de_for_plot(de_const_cyt,   cols_const_cyt,   go_ens)$gene
  ))
  
  term_genes <- intersect(term_genes, all_de_genes)

  if (length(term_genes) < 5) {
    message("  Skipping (too few genes after filters): n = ", length(term_genes))
    next
  }

  term_id <- safe_filename(term)

  p_expr <- plot_set_expr_rpkm(
    term_genes_ens = term_genes,
    label = term,
    max_genes_per_panel = 100
  )

  fp_const_whole <- write_temp_de(prep_de_for_plot(de_const_whole, cols_const_whole, term_genes), "const_whole", term_id)
  fp_const_nuc   <- write_temp_de(prep_de_for_plot(de_const_nuc,   cols_const_nuc,   term_genes), "const_nuc",   term_id)
  fp_const_syn   <- write_temp_de(prep_de_for_plot(de_const_syn,   cols_const_syn,   term_genes), "const_syn",   term_id)
  fp_const_cyt   <- write_temp_de(prep_de_for_plot(de_const_cyt,   cols_const_cyt,   term_genes), "const_cyt",   term_id)

  fp_cond_whole   <- write_temp_de(prep_de_for_plot(de_cond_whole,   cols_cond_whole,   term_genes), "cond_whole",   term_id)
  fp_cond_syn_het <- write_temp_de(prep_de_for_plot(de_cond_syn_het, cols_cond_syn_het, term_genes), "cond_het_syn", term_id)
  fp_cond_nuc_het <- write_temp_de(prep_de_for_plot(de_cond_nuc_het, cols_cond_nuc_het, term_genes), "cond_het_nuc", term_id)
  fp_cond_syn_hom <- write_temp_de(prep_de_for_plot(de_cond_syn_hom, cols_cond_syn_hom, term_genes), "cond_hom_syn", term_id)
  fp_cond_nuc_hom <- write_temp_de(prep_de_for_plot(de_cond_nuc_hom, cols_cond_nuc_hom, term_genes), "cond_hom_nuc", term_id)

  term_syms_for_scatter <- ens_to_sym(term_genes)

  p_sn <- compare_groups_plot(
    "const_syn", "const_nuc",
    const_syn_DE, const_nuc_DE,
    FDR_padj_xy = 0.05,
    plot_pval_only = TRUE,
    p_value = 0.05,
    filter_mode = "both",
    mode = "concordance",
    no_filt = TRUE,
    custom_genes = term_syms_for_scatter,
    max_bound = 1.0
  )$plot

  p_sc <- compare_groups_plot(
    "const_syn", "const_cyt",
    const_syn_DE, const_cyt_DE,
    FDR_padj_xy = 0.05,
    plot_pval_only = TRUE,
    p_value = 0.05,
    filter_mode = "both",
    mode = "concordance",
    no_filt = TRUE,
    custom_genes = term_syms_for_scatter,
    max_bound = 1.0
  )$plot

  p_nc <- compare_groups_plot(
    "const_nuc", "const_cyt",
    const_nuc_DE, const_cyt_DE,
    FDR_padj_xy = 0.05,
    plot_pval_only = TRUE,
    p_value = 0.05,
    filter_mode = "both",
    mode = "concordance", 
    no_filt = TRUE,
    custom_genes = term_syms_for_scatter,
    max_bound = 1.0
  )$plot

  p_wn <- compare_groups_plot(
    "const_whole", "const_nuc",
    const_whole_DE, const_nuc_DE,
    FDR_padj_xy = 0.05,
    plot_pval_only = TRUE,
    p_value = 0.05,
    filter_mode = "both",
    mode = "concordance",
    no_filt = TRUE,
    custom_genes = term_syms_for_scatter,
    max_bound = 1.0
  )$plot

  p_wc <- compare_groups_plot(
    "const_whole", "const_cyt",
    const_whole_DE, const_cyt_DE,
    FDR_padj_xy = 0.05,
    plot_pval_only = TRUE,
    p_value = 0.05,
    filter_mode = "both",
    mode = "concordance",
    no_filt = TRUE,
    custom_genes = term_syms_for_scatter,
    max_bound = 1.0
  )$plot

  p_ws <- compare_groups_plot(
    "const_whole", "const_syn",
    const_whole_DE, const_syn_DE,
    FDR_padj_xy = 0.05,
    plot_pval_only = TRUE,
    p_value = 0.05,
    filter_mode = "both",
    mode = "concordance",
    no_filt = TRUE,
    custom_genes = term_syms_for_scatter,
    max_bound = 1.0
  )$plot

  p_constwhole_condwhole <- compare_groups_plot(
    "const_whole", "cond_whole",
    const_whole_DE, cond_whole_DE,
    FDR_padj_xy = 0.05,
    plot_pval_only = TRUE,
    p_value = 0.05,
    filter_mode = "both",
    mode = "concordance",
    no_filt = TRUE,
    custom_genes = term_syms_for_scatter,
    max_bound = 1.0
  )$plot

  p_constsyn_condhetsyn <- compare_groups_plot(
    "const_syn", "cond_het_syn",
    const_syn_DE, cond_syn_het_DE,
    FDR_padj_xy = 0.05,
    plot_pval_only = TRUE,
    p_value = 0.05,
    filter_mode = "both",
    mode = "concordance",
    no_filt = TRUE,
    custom_genes = term_syms_for_scatter,
    max_bound = 1.0
  )$plot

  p_constsyn_condhomsyn <- compare_groups_plot(
    "const_syn", "cond_hom_syn",
    const_syn_DE, cond_syn_hom_DE,
    FDR_padj_xy = 0.05,
    plot_pval_only = TRUE,
    p_value = 0.05,
    filter_mode = "both",
    mode = "concordance",
    no_filt = TRUE,
    custom_genes = term_syms_for_scatter,
    max_bound = 1.0
  )$plot

  p_constnuc_condhetnuc <- compare_groups_plot(
    "const_nuc", "cond_het_nuc",
    const_nuc_DE, cond_nuc_het_DE,
    FDR_padj_xy = 0.05,
    plot_pval_only = TRUE,
    p_value = 0.05,
    filter_mode = "both",
    mode = "concordance",
    no_filt = TRUE,
    custom_genes = term_syms_for_scatter,
    max_bound = 1.0
  )$plot

  p_constnuc_condhomnuc <- compare_groups_plot(
    "const_nuc", "cond_hom_nuc",
    const_nuc_DE, cond_nuc_hom_DE,
    FDR_padj_xy = 0.05,
    plot_pval_only = TRUE,
    p_value = 0.05,
    filter_mode = "both",
    mode = "concordance",
    no_filt = TRUE,
    custom_genes = term_syms_for_scatter,
    max_bound = 1.0
  )$plot

  layout_plot <-
    (p_expr) /
    (p_sn | p_sc | p_nc) /
    (p_wn | p_wc | p_ws) /
    (p_constwhole_condwhole | p_constsyn_condhetsyn | p_constsyn_condhomsyn) /
    (p_constnuc_condhetnuc | p_constnuc_condhomnuc | patchwork::plot_spacer()) +
    patchwork::plot_annotation(
      title = paste0("GO: ", term),
      theme = ggplot2::theme(plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", size = 16))
    )

  pdf_fp <- file.path(outdir, paste0(term_id, ".pdf"))
  ggplot2::ggsave(pdf_fp, layout_plot, width = 16, height = 24, units = "in", device = "pdf")

  message("  wrote: ", pdf_fp)
}
```

```{r}
cond_nuc_hom_DE  <- "output/DE/Cond_nuc_HOMvsWT_NOPC.csv"

de_paths_fig <- list(
```
