```{r}
get_go_genes_fig <- function(term_exact) {
  term2go <- suppressMessages(
    AnnotationDbi::select(
      GO.db::GO.db,
      keys = term_exact,
      keytype = "TERM",
      columns = c("GOID", "ONTOLOGY")
    )
  )

  goids <- unique(as.character(term2go$GOID[!is.na(term2go$GOID) & term2go$ONTOLOGY == "BP"]))
  if (length(goids) == 0) return(character())

  go2sym <- suppressMessages(
    AnnotationDbi::select(
      org.Mm.eg.db::org.Mm.eg.db,
      keys = goids,
      keytype = "GOALL",
      columns = "SYMBOL"
    )
  )

  unique(as.character(go2sym$SYMBOL[!is.na(go2sym$SYMBOL) & go2sym$SYMBOL != ""]))
}

detect_gene_col_fig <- function(df) {
  nms <- tolower(names(df))
  idx <- match(TRUE, nms %in% c("gene_name", "gene", "symbol"))
  if (is.na(idx)) stop("Couldn't find a gene column in DE table.")
  names(df)[idx]
}

de_raw_fig <- lapply(de_paths_fig, readr::read_csv, show_col_types = FALSE)
de_gene_cols_fig <- lapply(de_raw_fig, detect_gene_col_fig)

term_gene_map_fig <- stats::setNames(lapply(go_terms_fig, get_go_genes_fig), go_terms_fig)

tmp_go_dir <- file.path(outdir_go_fig, "tmp_de")
dir.create(tmp_go_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

tmp_de_files_fig <- lapply(names(term_gene_map_fig), function(term_i) {
  genes_i <- term_gene_map_fig[[term_i]]
  fps_i <- lapply(names(de_raw_fig), function(ds_i) {
    df_i <- de_raw_fig[[ds_i]]
    gene_col_i <- de_gene_cols_fig[[ds_i]]
    fp_i <- file.path(
      tmp_go_dir,
      paste0(
        gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", term_i),
        "__",
        ds_i,
        ".csv"
      )
    )
    readr::write_csv(df_i %>% dplyr::filter(.data[[gene_col_i]] %in% genes_i), fp_i)
    fp_i
  })
  stats::setNames(fps_i, names(de_raw_fig))
})
tmp_de_files_fig <- stats::setNames(tmp_de_files_fig, names(term_gene_map_fig))

plot_go_concordance_fig <- function(term_exact, x_group, y_group, show_legend = FALSE) {
  term_genes <- term_gene_map_fig[[term_exact]]

  p <- compare_groups_plot(
    x_group = x_group,
    y_group = y_group,
    fp_x = tmp_de_files_fig[[term_exact]][[x_group]],
    fp_y = tmp_de_files_fig[[term_exact]][[y_group]],
    FDR_padj_xy = 0.05,
    plot_pval_only = TRUE,
    p_value = 0.05,
    filter_mode = "both",
    mode = "concordance",
    no_filt = TRUE,
    custom_genes = term_genes,
    max_bound = 1.0
  )$plot +
    ggplot2::ggtitle(paste0(x_group, " vs ", y_group)) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
      plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(18, 30, 24, 30)
    )

  if (!show_legend) {
    p <- p + ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "none")
  }

  p
}

go_term_rows_fig <- lapply(go_terms_fig, function(term_i) {
  p1 <- plot_go_concordance_fig(term_i, "const_whole", "const_syn")
  p2 <- plot_go_concordance_fig(term_i, "const_whole", "const_nuc")
  p3 <- plot_go_concordance_fig(term_i, "const_syn", "const_nuc")
  p4 <- plot_go_concordance_fig(term_i, "const_syn", "const_cyt")
  p5 <- plot_go_concordance_fig(term_i, "const_nuc", "const_cyt", show_legend = TRUE)
  title_plot <- patchwork::wrap_elements(
    full = grid::textGrob(
      term_i,
      x = 0,
      hjust = 0,
      gp = grid::gpar(fontface = "bold", cex = 1.4)
    )
  )

  title_plot / (p1 | p2 | p3 | p4 | p5) +
    patchwork::plot_layout(heights = c(0.06, 1))
})

p_go_term_const <- patchwork::wrap_plots(go_term_rows_fig, ncol = 1)

ggplot2::ggsave(
  file.path(outdir_go_fig, "GO_term_concordance_const_cond.pdf"),
  p_go_term_const,
  device = "pdf",
  width = 28,
  height = 84,
  limitsize = F
)
```

```{r}

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(readr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(tidyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(AnnotationDbi)
  library(GO.db)
  library(org.Mm.eg.db)
  library(scales)
  library(ggtext)
})

outdir <- "output/GO/GO_plots"
dir.create(outdir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Keep this mapping/helper local to this GO section so rerunning only this chunk
# still maps symbol-based PB DE tables onto the Ensembl IDs used by bulk DE tables.
go_gene_map <- my_gene %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_id, gene_name, gene_biotype) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(gene_id), gene_id != "", !is.na(gene_name), gene_name != "") %>%
  dplyr::distinct(gene_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

prep_de_for_plot <- function(de, cols, genes) {
  gene_raw <- as.character(de[[cols$gene_col]])
  gene_mapped <- ifelse(
    grepl("^ENSMUSG", gene_raw),
    gene_raw,
    go_gene_map$gene_id[match(gene_raw, go_gene_map$gene_name)]
  )

  de %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      gene = gene_mapped,
      pvalue = as.numeric(.data[[cols$p_col]]),
      logfc  = as.numeric(.data[[cols$lfc_col]]),
      fdr    = if (!is.na(cols$fdr_col)) as.numeric(.data[[cols$fdr_col]]) else NA_real_
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(gene), gene != "", gene %in% genes) %>%
    dplyr::select(gene, logfc, pvalue, fdr)
}

# --------------------------
# DE paths (constitutive only)
# --------------------------
const_whole_DE <- "output/DE/Const_whole_PC12.csv"
const_nuc_DE   <- "output/DE/Const_nuc_PC12.csv"
const_syn_DE   <- "output/DE/Const_syn_PC12.csv"
const_cyt_DE   <- "output/DE/Const_cyt_PC12.csv"

# --------------------------
# GO terms
# --------------------------
GO_terms <- c(
  "ATP synthesis coupled electron transport",
  "oxidative phosphorylation",
  "protein folding",
  "nucleoside triphosphate biosynthetic process",
  "methylation",
  "synapse assembly",
  "synaptic signaling",
  "synaptic vesicle cycle",
  "neurotransmitter secretion",
  "regulation of synaptic plasticity",
  "glycosylation",
  "neuronal action potential",
  "chromosome organization",
  "chromosome segregation",
  "centromere complex assembly",
  "DNA repair",
  "DNA replication",
  "DNA recombination",
  "neuropeptide signaling pathway",
  "potassium ion transport",
  "axon guidance",
  "vesicle-mediated transport in synapse",
  "learning or memory",
  "actin filament-based movement",
  "cilium organization",
  "circadian sleep/wake cycle",
  "cytoplasmic translation",
  "translation",
  "translation at synapse",
  "rRNA processing",
  "ribosome biogenesis",
  "RNA splicing",
  "mRNA processing",
  "microtubule cytoskeleton organization",
  "acute inflammatory response",
  "immune response",
  "cell killing",
  "chemotaxis",
  "cell adhesion",
  "cell-cell junction organization",
  "angiogenesis"
)

# --------------------------
# Dataset order (constitutive only)
# --------------------------
dataset_order <- c(
  "Const_whole",
  "Const_nuc",
  "Const_cyt",
  "Const_syn"
)

dataset_labels_pretty <- c(
  "Const_whole" = "Const Whole",
  "Const_nuc"   = "Const Nuc",
  "Const_syn"   = "Const Syn",
  "Const_cyt"   = "Const Cyt"
)

# --------------------------
# Read DEs
# --------------------------
de_const_whole <- read_de(const_whole_DE); cols_const_whole <- detect_cols(de_const_whole)
de_const_nuc   <- read_de(const_nuc_DE);   cols_const_nuc   <- detect_cols(de_const_nuc)
de_const_syn   <- read_de(const_syn_DE);   cols_const_syn   <- detect_cols(de_const_syn)
de_const_cyt   <- read_de(const_cyt_DE);   cols_const_cyt   <- detect_cols(de_const_cyt)

# --------------------------
# Bundle DE tables
# --------------------------
de_list_raw <- list(
  "Const_whole" = list(de = de_const_whole, cols = cols_const_whole),
  "Const_nuc"   = list(de = de_const_nuc,   cols = cols_const_nuc),
  "Const_syn"   = list(de = de_const_syn,   cols = cols_const_syn),
  "Const_cyt"   = list(de = de_const_cyt,   cols = cols_const_cyt)
)

# --------------------------
# Validate GO terms
# --------------------------
valid_terms <- AnnotationDbi::keys(GO.db::GO.db, keytype = "TERM")
bad_terms <- setdiff(GO_terms, valid_terms)

if (length(bad_terms) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Invalid GO TERM(s) (keytype='TERM') detected BEFORE loop:\n  - ",
    paste(bad_terms, collapse = "\n  - "),
    "\n\nTERM matching is exact."
  )
}

# --------------------------
# Prepare DE tables for one term
# --------------------------
prep_term_de_list <- function(term_genes) {
  out <- lapply(names(de_list_raw), function(nm) {
    x <- de_list_raw[[nm]]
    df <- prep_de_for_plot(x$de, x$cols, term_genes) %>%
      distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE)
    df$dataset <- nm
    df
  })
  names(out) <- names(de_list_raw)
  out
}

# --------------------------
# Bounded quadrant concordance + overlap n
# score = ((Q1 + Q3) - (Q2 + Q4)) / ((Q1 + Q3) + (Q2 + Q4))
# ranges from -1 to 1
# --------------------------
calc_pairwise_concordance <- function(df1, df2, min_overlap = 3, pval_filter = FALSE, p_cutoff = 0.05) {
  joined <- inner_join(
    df1 %>% select(gene, logfc, pvalue),
    df2 %>% select(gene, logfc, pvalue),
    by = "gene",
    suffix = c(".x", ".y")
  ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(logfc.x), !is.na(logfc.y))

  if (pval_filter) {
    joined <- joined %>%
      filter(
        (!is.na(pvalue.x) & pvalue.x < p_cutoff) |
          (!is.na(pvalue.y) & pvalue.y < p_cutoff)
      )
  }

  n_overlap <- nrow(joined)

  q13 <- sum(
    (joined$logfc.x > 0 & joined$logfc.y > 0) |
      (joined$logfc.x < 0 & joined$logfc.y < 0),
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  q24 <- sum(
    (joined$logfc.x > 0 & joined$logfc.y < 0) |
      (joined$logfc.x < 0 & joined$logfc.y > 0),
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  denom <- q13 + q24
  score <- if (denom == 0) NA_real_ else (q13 - q24) / denom

  list(score = score, n = n_overlap)
}

# --------------------------
# Signed weighted mean logFC
# --------------------------
calc_signed_weighted_mean_logfc <- function(df, p_cap = 10, pval_filter = FALSE, p_cutoff = 0.05) {
  df2 <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(logfc), !is.na(pvalue))

  if (pval_filter) {
    df2 <- df2 %>% filter(pvalue < p_cutoff)
  }

  if (nrow(df2) == 0) return(NA_real_)

  w <- -log10(pmax(df2$pvalue, 1e-300))
  w <- pmin(w, p_cap)

  if (sum(w, na.rm = TRUE) == 0) return(NA_real_)

  sum(df2$logfc * w, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(w, na.rm = TRUE)
}

# --------------------------
# Direction score
# score = (n_up - n_down) / n_total
# --------------------------
calc_direction_score <- function(df, pval_filter = FALSE, p_cutoff = 0.05) {
  df2 <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(logfc))

  if (pval_filter) {
    df2 <- df2 %>% filter(!is.na(pvalue) & pvalue < p_cutoff)
  }

  if (nrow(df2) == 0) return(NA_real_)

  n_up <- sum(df2$logfc > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  n_down <- sum(df2$logfc < 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  n_total <- nrow(df2)

  if (n_total == 0) return(NA_real_)

  (n_up - n_down) / n_total
}

# --------------------------
# Signed weighted mean logFC colors
# --------------------------
score_to_color <- function(score, lim) {
  if (is.na(score)) return("#7F7F7F")

  score <- max(min(score, lim), -lim)

  scales::col_numeric(
    palette = c(
      "#08306B",
      "#2CA25F",
      "#D9C93B",
      "#F28E2B",
      "#B30000"
    ),
    domain = c(-lim, lim)
  )(score)
}

# --------------------------
# Manual rich labels for axes
# --------------------------
make_axis_label_df <- function(summary_scores, score_lim, direction = TRUE) {

  label_vec <- sapply(dataset_order, function(nm) {

    col <- if (direction) {
      score_to_color(summary_scores[[nm]], score_lim)
    } else {
      "#2B2B2B"
    }

    paste0(
      "<span style='color:", col, "; font-weight:700;'>",
      dataset_labels_pretty[[nm]],
      "</span>"
    )
  }, USE.NAMES = TRUE)

  x_df <- data.frame(
    dataset = dataset_order,
    x = seq_along(dataset_order),
    y = 0.42,
    label = unname(label_vec),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  y_df <- data.frame(
    dataset = rev(dataset_order),
    x = 0.42,
    y = seq_along(dataset_order),
    label = unname(label_vec[rev(dataset_order)]),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  list(x_df = x_df, y_df = y_df)
}

# --------------------------
# Summary scale bar annotation data (vertical)
# --------------------------
make_summary_bar_df <- function(lim, xmin = 4.15, xmax = 4.50, ymin = -4.15, ymax = -2.75, n = 300) {
  vals <- seq(-lim, lim, length.out = n + 1)
  mids <- (vals[-length(vals)] + vals[-1]) / 2
  y_breaks <- seq(ymin, ymax, length.out = n + 1)

  data.frame(
    xmin = xmin,
    xmax = xmax,
    ymin = y_breaks[-length(y_breaks)],
    ymax = y_breaks[-1],
    score_mid = mids,
    fill = scales::col_numeric(
      palette = c(
        "#08306B",
        "#2CA25F",
        "#D9C93B",
        "#F28E2B",
        "#B30000"
      ),
      domain = c(-lim, lim)
    )(mids),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

# --------------------------
# Build concordance and n matrices
# --------------------------
build_concordance_mats <- function(
  term_de_list,
  dataset_order,
  min_overlap = 3,
  pval_filter = FALSE,
  p_cutoff = 0.05
) {
  k <- length(dataset_order)

  score_mat <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = k, ncol = k, dimnames = list(dataset_order, dataset_order))
  n_mat     <- matrix(NA_integer_, nrow = k, ncol = k, dimnames = list(dataset_order, dataset_order))

  for (i in seq_len(k)) {
    for (j in seq_len(k)) {
      nm_i <- dataset_order[i]
      nm_j <- dataset_order[j]

      df_i <- term_de_list[[nm_i]]
      df_j <- term_de_list[[nm_j]]

      if (i == j) {
        if (pval_filter) {
          df_i_use <- df_i %>% filter(!is.na(pvalue) & pvalue < p_cutoff)
          n_self <- sum(!is.na(df_i_use$logfc))
        } else {
          n_self <- sum(!is.na(df_i$logfc))
        }
        score_mat[i, j] <- 1
        n_mat[i, j] <- n_self
      } else {
        res <- calc_pairwise_concordance(
          df_i,
          df_j,
          min_overlap = min_overlap,
          pval_filter = pval_filter,
          p_cutoff = p_cutoff
        )
        score_mat[i, j] <- res$score
        n_mat[i, j] <- res$n
      }
    }
  }

  list(score_mat = score_mat, n_mat = n_mat)
}

# --------------------------
# Heatmap plot
# --------------------------
plot_concordance_heatmap <- function(
  score_mat,
  n_mat,
  term,
  n_term,
  summary_scores,
  subtitle_suffix = NULL,
  show_n_in_cells = FALSE,
  direction = TRUE,
  direction_cutoff = NULL,
  direction_lim = NULL,
  direction_caption = NULL
) {

  k <- length(dataset_order)

  score_lim <- direction_lim
  if (is.null(score_lim)) {
    score_lim <- max(abs(summary_scores), na.rm = TRUE)
    if (!is.finite(score_lim) || is.na(score_lim) || score_lim == 0) score_lim <- 0.25
  }

  label_dfs <- make_axis_label_df(summary_scores, score_lim, direction = FALSE)

  if (direction) {
    bar_df <- make_summary_bar_df(score_lim)
  }

  df_score <- as.data.frame(as.table(score_mat), stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
    rename(Row = Var1, Col = Var2, Score = Freq)

  df_n <- as.data.frame(as.table(n_mat), stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
    rename(Row = Var1, Col = Var2, N = Freq)

  plot_df <- left_join(df_score, df_n, by = c("Row", "Col")) %>%
    mutate(
      Row = factor(Row, levels = rev(dataset_order)),
      Col = factor(Col, levels = dataset_order),
      x = as.numeric(Col),
      y = as.numeric(Row),
      label = if (show_n_in_cells) {
        ifelse(
          is.na(Score),
          paste0("NA\nn=", N),
          paste0(sprintf("%.2f", Score), "\n", "n=", N)
        )
      } else {
        ifelse(is.na(Score), "NA", sprintf("%.2f", Score))
      }
    )

  subtitle_text <- paste0("n = ", n_term, " genes")
  if (!is.null(subtitle_suffix)) {
    subtitle_text <- paste0(subtitle_text, subtitle_suffix)
  }

  p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = x, y = y, fill = Score)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 1.0) +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = label),
      size = if (show_n_in_cells) 4.2 else 5.0,
      lineheight = 0.95,
      color = "black"
    ) +

    ggtext::geom_richtext(
      data = label_dfs$x_df,
      aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1,
      vjust = 0.5,
      size = 5.5,
      fill = NA,
      label.color = NA
    ) +
    ggtext::geom_richtext(
      data = label_dfs$y_df,
      aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      hjust = 1,
      vjust = 0.5,
      size = 5.5,
      fill = NA,
      label.color = NA
    ) +

    scale_fill_gradientn(
      colours = c("#6B4FD8", "white", "white", "#B89200"),  # rosy pink: "#C2496A"
      values = scales::rescale(c(-1, -0.05, 0.05, 1), from = c(-1, 1)),
      limits = c(-1, 1),
      na.value = "grey90",
      breaks = c(-1, -0.5, 0, 0.5, 1),
      name = "LogFC\nConcordance\n"
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      limits = c(0.15, 5.3),
      breaks = seq_len(k),
      labels = rep("", k),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(-4.5, k + 0.8),
      breaks = seq_len(k),
      labels = rep("", k),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    coord_fixed(clip = "off") +
    labs(
      title = paste0("GO: ", term),
      subtitle = subtitle_text,
      caption = direction_caption,
      x = NULL,
      y = NULL
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 15) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 24, margin = margin(b = 4)),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 19, margin = margin(b = 8)),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 13, hjust = 0, margin = margin(t = 8)),
      axis.text = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = element_blank(),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.title = element_text(size = 19),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 17),
      plot.margin = margin(20, 70, 110, 45)
    )

  if (direction) {
    p <- p +
      geom_rect(
        data = bar_df,
        inherit.aes = FALSE,
        aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
        fill = bar_df$fill,
        color = NA
      ) +
      annotate(
        "text",
        x = 4.325, y = -1.70,
        label = "Direction\nscore",
        size = 6.0,
        lineheight = 0.95,
        hjust = 0.5
      ) +
      annotate(
        "text",
        x = 4.58, y = -4.15,
        label = paste0("DOWN\n(< ", formatC(-direction_cutoff, format = "f", digits = 2), ")"),
        size = 4.8,
        hjust = 0
      ) +
      annotate(
        "text",
        x = 4.58, y = -3.45,
        label = paste0(
          "BALANCED\n(",
          formatC(-direction_cutoff, format = "f", digits = 2),
          " to ",
          formatC(direction_cutoff, format = "f", digits = 2),
          ")"
        ),
        size = 4.8,
        hjust = 0
      ) +
      annotate(
        "text",
        x = 4.58, y = -2.75,
        label = paste0("UP\n(> ", formatC(direction_cutoff, format = "f", digits = 2), ")"),
        size = 4.8,
        hjust = 0
      )
  }
  p
}

# --------------------------
# Settings
# --------------------------
min_genes_term   <- 5
min_overlap_pair <- 15
p_cutoff_use     <- 0.05

# --------------------------
# Function to write one PDF
# --------------------------
write_concordance_pdf <- function(pdf_fp, pval_filter = FALSE) {

  direction_cutoff_use <- if (pval_filter) 0.02 else 0.25
  direction_lim_use <- if (pval_filter) 0.03 else 0.30
  direction_caption_use <- if (pval_filter) {
    "Direction score cutoffs: DOWN < -0.02, BALANCED = -0.02 to 0.02, UP > 0.02. Scale caps at -0.03 and 0.03."
  } else {
    "Direction score cutoffs: DOWN < -0.25, BALANCED = -0.25 to 0.25, UP > 0.25. Scale caps at -0.30 and 0.30."
  }

  pdf(pdf_fp, width = 10.5, height = 10, onefile = TRUE)

  for (term in GO_terms) {

    cat("\nGO term: ", term, "\n", sep = "")

    go_syms <- as.character(get_go_genes(term, ontology = "BP"))
    if (length(go_syms) == 0) {
      message("  No genes found for term ", term)
      next
    }

    go_ens <- sym_to_ens(go_syms)

    term_genes <- intersect(go_ens, protein_coding_genes)

    all_de_genes <- unique(unlist(
      lapply(de_list_raw, function(x) {
        prep_de_for_plot(x$de, x$cols, go_ens)$gene
      }),
      use.names = FALSE
    ))

    term_genes <- intersect(term_genes, all_de_genes)

    if (length(term_genes) < min_genes_term) {
      message("  Skipping (too few genes after filters): n = ", length(term_genes))
      next
    }

    term_de_list <- prep_term_de_list(term_genes)

    summary_scores <- sapply(dataset_order, function(nm) {
      calc_direction_score(
        term_de_list[[nm]],
        pval_filter = pval_filter,
        p_cutoff = p_cutoff_use
      )
    })

    mats <- build_concordance_mats(
      term_de_list  = term_de_list,
      dataset_order = dataset_order,
      min_overlap   = min_overlap_pair,
      pval_filter   = pval_filter,
      p_cutoff      = p_cutoff_use
    )

    p <- plot_concordance_heatmap(
      score_mat       = mats$score_mat,
      n_mat           = mats$n_mat,
      term            = term,
      n_term          = length(term_genes),
      summary_scores  = summary_scores,
      direction       = TRUE,
      direction_cutoff = direction_cutoff_use,
      direction_lim = direction_lim_use,
      direction_caption = direction_caption_use,
      subtitle_suffix = if (pval_filter) " (cell n = genes with p < 0.05 in either dataset)" else NULL,
      show_n_in_cells = TRUE
    )

    print(p)
    message("  added heatmap to PDF")
  }

  dev.off()
  message("Wrote: ", pdf_fp)
}

# --------------------------
# Output PDFs
# --------------------------
pdf_fp_all <- file.path(outdir, "GO_concordance_heatmaps.pdf")
pdf_fp_p05 <- file.path(outdir, "GO_concordance_heatmaps_p05.pdf")

write_concordance_pdf(pdf_fp_all, pval_filter = FALSE)
write_concordance_pdf(pdf_fp_p05, pval_filter = TRUE)
```

```{r}
get_go_genes_colored <- function(term_exact, ontology = "BP") {
  term2go <- suppressMessages(
    AnnotationDbi::select(
      GO.db::GO.db,
      keys = term_exact,
      keytype = "TERM",
      columns = c("GOID", "ONTOLOGY")
    )
  )
  if (is.null(term2go) || nrow(term2go) == 0) return(character())

  goids <- unique(as.character(
    term2go$GOID[!is.na(term2go$GOID) & term2go$ONTOLOGY == ontology]
  ))
  if (length(goids) == 0) return(character())

  go2sym <- suppressMessages(
    AnnotationDbi::select(
      org.Mm.eg.db::org.Mm.eg.db,
      keys = goids,
      keytype = "GOALL",
      columns = "SYMBOL"
    )
  )
  if (is.null(go2sym) || nrow(go2sym) == 0) return(character())

  unique(as.character(stats::na.omit(go2sym$SYMBOL)))
}

remove_density_and_point_layers_go_colored <- function(plot_obj) {
  plot_obj$layers <- plot_obj$layers[
    !vapply(
      plot_obj$layers,
      function(layer) {
        inherits(layer$geom, "GeomTile") || inherits(layer$geom, "GeomPoint")
      },
      logical(1)
    )
  ]
  plot_obj$scales$scales <- plot_obj$scales$scales[
    !vapply(
      plot_obj$scales$scales,
      function(scale_obj) "fill" %in% scale_obj$aesthetics,
      logical(1)
    )
  ]
  plot_obj
}

restyle_annotation_text_go_colored <- function(plot_obj) {
  keep_layer <- rep(TRUE, length(plot_obj$layers))

  for (i in seq_along(plot_obj$layers)) {
    layer <- plot_obj$layers[[i]]
    if (!inherits(layer$geom, "GeomText")) next

    layer_color <- layer$aes_params$colour
    if (is.null(layer_color)) layer_color <- layer$aes_params$color

    if (identical(layer_color, "indianred2")) {
      keep_layer[i] <- FALSE
    } else if (identical(layer_color, "black")) {
      plot_obj$layers[[i]]$aes_params$colour <- "black"
      plot_obj$layers[[i]]$aes_params$color <- NULL
    }
  }

  plot_obj$layers <- plot_obj$layers[keep_layer]
  plot_obj
}

plot_fraction_comp_go_colored <- function(genes, x_group, y_group, title_text) {
  if (length(genes) == 0) {
    return(
      ggplot2::ggplot() +
        ggplot2::theme_void() +
        ggplot2::labs(title = title_text)
    )
  }

  res <- compare_groups_plot(
    x_group = x_group,
    y_group = y_group,
    fp_x = de_fp_go_colored[[x_group]],
    fp_y = de_fp_go_colored[[y_group]],
    FDR_padj_xy = 0.05,
    filter_mode = "both",
    max_bound = 1.0,
    plot_pval_only = TRUE,
    p_value = 0.1,
    no_filt = TRUE,
    custom_genes = genes,
    mode = "concordance"
  )

  x_logfc <- paste0("logfc_", x_group)
  y_logfc <- paste0("logfc_", y_group)
  x_pvalue <- paste0("pvalue_", x_group)
  y_pvalue <- paste0("pvalue_", y_group)

  point_data <- res$merged_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      gene %in% genes,
      is.finite(.data[[x_logfc]]),
      is.finite(.data[[y_logfc]])
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      sig_x = !is.na(.data[[x_pvalue]]) & .data[[x_pvalue]] < 0.1,
      sig_y = !is.na(.data[[y_pvalue]]) & .data[[y_pvalue]] < 0.1,
      significance = dplyr::case_when(
        sig_x & sig_y ~ "Both",
        sig_x ~ "X only",
        sig_y ~ "Y only",
        TRUE ~ "Neither"
      ),
      significance = factor(
        significance,
        levels = c("Neither", "X only", "Y only", "Both")
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(significance)

  p <- remove_density_and_point_layers_go_colored(res$plot)
  p <- restyle_annotation_text_go_colored(p)

  subtitle_text <- paste0(
    "p<0.1 in either dataset (n = ",
    sum(point_data$sig_x | point_data$sig_y),
    ")"
  )

  p +
    ggplot2::geom_point(
      data = point_data,
      ggplot2::aes(
        x = .data[[x_logfc]],
        y = .data[[y_logfc]],
        color = significance
      ),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      size = 1.5,
      alpha = 0.85
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_color_manual(
      name = "p < 0.1",
      values = point_colors_go_colored,
      drop = FALSE,
      guide = ggplot2::guide_legend(
        keywidth = grid::unit(0.55, "lines"),
        keyheight = grid::unit(0.7, "lines"),
        override.aes = list(size = 2.2, alpha = 1)
      )
    ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = title_text,
      subtitle = subtitle_text
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
      plot.subtitle = ggtext::element_markdown(color = "black", size = 12),
      axis.title.x = ggplot2::element_text(color = point_colors_go_colored[["X only"]]),
      axis.title.y = ggplot2::element_text(color = point_colors_go_colored[["Y only"]]),
      plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(8, 18, 8, 18),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 10),
      legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(
        size = 9,
        margin = ggplot2::margin(l = 2, r = 4)
      ),
      legend.spacing.x = grid::unit(2, "pt")
    )
}

make_fraction_row_go_colored <- function(gene_set_name, genes) {
  row_plots <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(comparison_info_go_colored)), function(i) {
    plot_fraction_comp_go_colored(
      genes = genes,
      x_group = comparison_info_go_colored$x_group[i],
      y_group = comparison_info_go_colored$y_group[i],
      title_text = comparison_info_go_colored$title[i]
    )
  })

  row_title <- ggplot2::ggplot() +
    ggplot2::annotate(
      "text",
      x = 0,
      y = 0.5,
      label = paste0(gene_set_name, " (n = ", length(genes), ")"),
      hjust = 0,
      vjust = 0.5,
      fontface = "bold",
      size = 5.5
    ) +
    ggplot2::coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1), clip = "off") +
    ggplot2::theme_void() +
    ggplot2::theme(plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(0, 0, 0, 8))

  row_title /
    patchwork::wrap_plots(row_plots, nrow = 1, guides = "keep") +
    patchwork::plot_layout(heights = c(0.12, 1))
}

plot_rows_go_colored <- lapply(names(GO_gene_sets_colored), function(gene_set_name) {
  make_fraction_row_go_colored(
    gene_set_name = gene_set_name,
    genes = GO_gene_sets_colored[[gene_set_name]]
  )
})
```

## Testing if PCs are predictive of genotype, testing for interactions between PCs and metadata 

```{r}

## PC–metadata scans (per fraction) MATCHING run_DE_with_optional_PCs PCA
## PCA definition (to match your heatmap / DE function):
##   - build edgeR y after subsetting fraction
##   - protein-coding only
##   - CPM>1 in >=4 samples
##   - (optional) TMM normalize (DEFAULT TRUE)
##   - PCA: prcomp(log(y$counts + 1), center=TRUE, scale.=TRUE)   # genes x samples
##   - Use sample loadings as "PC values per sample": pca$rotation[,k]
##
## Tests per fraction:
##   A) PCs_predict_Genotype: LRT of Genotype ~ 1 vs Genotype ~ PCs
##   B) PCs_x_Variable_interaction: LRT of
##        M0: Genotype ~ PCs + var
##        M1: Genotype ~ PCs * var
##


# suppressPackageStartupMessages({
#   library(dplyr)
#   library(edgeR)
#   library(purrr)
# })

outdir_int <- "output/PC_interactions"
dir.create(outdir_int, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# --------------------------
# Protein-coding ENS IDs
# --------------------------
protein_coding_ens <- my_gene %>%
  dplyr::filter(gene_biotype == "protein_coding") %>%
  dplyr::pull(gene_id) %>%
  unique()

# --------------------------
# PC combos (all 1-3 combos)
# --------------------------
pc_combos <- list(
  "PC1" = c("PC1"),
  "PC2" = c("PC2"),
  "PC3" = c("PC3"),
  "PC1+PC2" = c("PC1","PC2"),
  "PC1+PC3" = c("PC1","PC3"),
  "PC2+PC3" = c("PC2","PC3"),
  "PC1+PC2+PC3" = c("PC1","PC2","PC3")
)

# --------------------------
# Helper: prep subset -> y -> (TMM) -> PCA like your DE function -> md_pcs
# --------------------------
prep_pcs_for_subset_DEstyle <- function(counts_mat, md_df, protein_coding_ens,
                                        min_cpm = 1, min_samples = 4,
                                        do_tmm = TRUE,
                                        n_pcs = 3) {
  stopifnot(identical(colnames(counts_mat), md_df$Sample))

  # protein-coding
  keep_pc <- intersect(rownames(counts_mat), protein_coding_ens)
  counts_mat <- counts_mat[keep_pc, , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(counts_mat) < 50) stop("Too few protein-coding genes after filter: ", nrow(counts_mat))

  # edgeR object + expressed filter
  y <- edgeR::DGEList(counts = counts_mat)
  keep_expr <- rowSums(edgeR::cpm(y) > min_cpm) >= min_samples
  y <- y[keep_expr, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
  if (nrow(y$counts) < 50) stop("Too few expressed genes after CPM filter: ", nrow(y$counts))

  # TMM normalize (you asked: make sure counts get TMM normalized before PCA)
  if (isTRUE(do_tmm)) y <- edgeR::calcNormFactors(y, method = "TMM")

  # PCA EXACTLY like run_DE_with_optional_PCs (genes x samples; log(counts+1); scale=TRUE)
  pca <- stats::prcomp(log(y$counts + 1), center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)

  # Use SAMPLE loadings as PC values per sample
  # rotation rows are sample names (variables), columns are PCs
  samps <- rownames(pca$rotation)
  stopifnot(all(samps %in% md_df$Sample))

  md_pca <- md_df[match(samps, md_df$Sample), , drop = FALSE]
  stopifnot(identical(md_pca$Sample, samps))

  K <- min(n_pcs, ncol(pca$rotation))
  pcs <- as.data.frame(pca$rotation[, 1:K, drop = FALSE])
  colnames(pcs) <- paste0("PC", seq_len(K))
  pcs$Sample <- rownames(pcs)

  md_pcs <- md_pca %>% dplyr::left_join(pcs, by = "Sample")

  list(
    md_pcs = md_pcs,
    pca = pca,
    n_samples = nrow(md_pcs),
    n_genes_pca = nrow(y$counts)
  )
}

# --------------------------
# A) Main-effect test: are PCs predictive of Genotype?
# --------------------------
pc_predicts_genotype <- function(md_pcs, pc_combos, alpha = 0.05) {

  md_pcs <- md_pcs %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(Genotype)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Genotype = factor(as.character(Genotype), levels = c("WT","HET"))) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(PC1), !is.na(PC2), !is.na(PC3)) %>%
    droplevels()

  if (nlevels(md_pcs$Genotype) < 2) stop("Genotype has <2 levels after filtering.")

  out <- list()
  for (pc_name in names(pc_combos)) {
    pcs <- pc_combos[[pc_name]]

    df <- md_pcs %>%
      dplyr::select(Genotype, all_of(pcs)) %>%
      dplyr::filter(complete.cases(.)) %>%
      droplevels()

    if (nrow(df) < 12) next

    f0 <- stats::as.formula("Genotype ~ 1")
    f1 <- stats::as.formula(paste0("Genotype ~ ", paste(pcs, collapse = " + ")))

    fit0 <- tryCatch(stats::glm(f0, data = df, family = stats::binomial()), error = function(e) NULL)
    fit1 <- tryCatch(stats::glm(f1, data = df, family = stats::binomial()), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(fit0) || is.null(fit1)) next

    lrt <- tryCatch(stats::anova(fit0, fit1, test = "LRT"), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(lrt) || nrow(lrt) < 2) next

    LR  <- as.numeric(lrt$Deviance[2])
    dfD <- as.numeric(lrt$Df[2])
    p   <- as.numeric(lrt$`Pr(>Chi)`[2])

    strength <- dplyr::case_when(
      is.na(p) ~ NA_character_,
      p < 0.01 ~ "high",
      p < 0.05 ~ "med",
      p < 0.10 ~ "low",
      TRUE     ~ "no"
    )

    out[[length(out) + 1]] <- data.frame(
      variable = "Genotype",
      PCs = pc_name,
      n = nrow(df),
      LR = LR,
      df = dfD,
      p_value = p,
      strength = strength,
      Predictive = ifelse(!is.na(p) & p < alpha, "YES", "NO"),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }

  dplyr::bind_rows(out)
}

# --------------------------
# B) Interaction test: do PCs interact with other metadata vars in predicting Genotype?
# --------------------------
interaction_scan <- function(md_pcs, variables, pc_combos, alpha = 0.05) {

  md_pcs <- md_pcs %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(Genotype)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Genotype = factor(as.character(Genotype), levels = c("WT","HET"))) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(PC1), !is.na(PC2), !is.na(PC3)) %>%
    droplevels()

  if (nlevels(md_pcs$Genotype) < 2) stop("Genotype has <2 levels after filtering.")

  # factorize known categoricals if present
  if ("Sex" %in% names(md_pcs)) md_pcs$Sex <- factor(as.character(md_pcs$Sex))
  if ("Sequencing_batch" %in% names(md_pcs)) md_pcs$Sequencing_batch <- factor(as.character(md_pcs$Sequencing_batch))

  out <- list()

  for (v in variables) {
    if (!v %in% names(md_pcs)) next

    for (pc_name in names(pc_combos)) {
      pcs <- pc_combos[[pc_name]]

      df <- md_pcs %>%
        dplyr::select(Genotype, all_of(pcs), all_of(v)) %>%
        dplyr::filter(complete.cases(.)) %>%
        droplevels()

      if (nrow(df) < 12) next
      if (length(unique(df[[v]])) < 2) next

      f0 <- stats::as.formula(paste0("Genotype ~ ", paste(c(pcs, v), collapse = " + ")))
      f1 <- stats::as.formula(paste0("Genotype ~ (", paste(pcs, collapse = " + "), ") * ", v))

      fit0 <- tryCatch(stats::glm(f0, data = df, family = stats::binomial()), error = function(e) NULL)
      fit1 <- tryCatch(stats::glm(f1, data = df, family = stats::binomial()), error = function(e) NULL)
      if (is.null(fit0) || is.null(fit1)) next

      lrt <- tryCatch(stats::anova(fit0, fit1, test = "LRT"), error = function(e) NULL)
      if (is.null(lrt) || nrow(lrt) < 2) next

      LR  <- as.numeric(lrt$Deviance[2])
      dfD <- as.numeric(lrt$Df[2])
      p   <- as.numeric(lrt$`Pr(>Chi)`[2])

      strength <- dplyr::case_when(
        is.na(p) ~ NA_character_,
        p < 0.01 ~ "high",
        p < 0.05 ~ "med",
        p < 0.10 ~ "low",
        TRUE     ~ "no"
      )

      out[[length(out) + 1]] <- data.frame(
        variable = v,
        PCs = pc_name,
        n = nrow(df),
        LR = LR,
        df = dfD,
        p_value = p,
        strength = strength,
        Interaction = ifelse(!is.na(p) & p < alpha, "YES", "NO"),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }
  }

  dplyr::bind_rows(out)
}

# --------------------------
# Runner per fraction: writes TWO tables + combined
# --------------------------
run_fraction <- function(fraction_label,
                         counts_mat,
                         md_df,
                         keep_outliers = FALSE,
                         variables_to_test,        # exclude "Genotype"
                         protein_coding_ens,
                         outdir_int,
                         do_tmm = TRUE) {

  md_df <- md_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(Sample), Sample != "") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Sample = as.character(Sample))

  if (!keep_outliers && ("Outlier" %in% names(md_df))) {
    md_df <- md_df %>% dplyr::filter(!(Outlier %in% TRUE))
  }

  # align samples
  common <- intersect(colnames(counts_mat), md_df$Sample)
  stopifnot(length(common) > 0)

  counts_use <- counts_mat[, common, drop = FALSE]
  md_use <- md_df[match(common, md_df$Sample), , drop = FALSE]
  stopifnot(identical(colnames(counts_use), md_use$Sample))

  # PCA + metadata (DE-style)
  prep <- prep_pcs_for_subset_DEstyle(
    counts_use, md_use,
    protein_coding_ens = protein_coding_ens,
    do_tmm = do_tmm,
    n_pcs = 3
  )

  # A) main effect: PCs predict genotype?
  tab_pred <- pc_predicts_genotype(prep$md_pcs, pc_combos = pc_combos, alpha = 0.05) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      fraction = fraction_label,
      n_samples_total = prep$n_samples,
      n_genes_pca = prep$n_genes_pca,
      test_type = "PCs_predict_Genotype"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(fraction, test_type, variable, PCs, n, n_samples_total, n_genes_pca, LR, df, p_value, strength, Predictive)

  # B) interactions: PCs x (other vars)
  tab_int <- interaction_scan(prep$md_pcs, variables = variables_to_test, pc_combos = pc_combos, alpha = 0.05) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      fraction = fraction_label,
      n_samples_total = prep$n_samples,
      n_genes_pca = prep$n_genes_pca,
      test_type = "PCs_x_Variable_interaction"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(fraction, test_type, variable, PCs, n, n_samples_total, n_genes_pca, LR, df, p_value, strength, Interaction)

  # Save
  fp_pred <- file.path(outdir_int, paste0("PC_predicts_Genotype__", fraction_label, ".csv"))
  fp_int  <- file.path(outdir_int, paste0("PC_interactions__", fraction_label, ".csv"))
  write.csv(tab_pred, fp_pred, row.names = FALSE)
  write.csv(tab_int,  fp_int,  row.names = FALSE)
  message("wrote: ", fp_pred)
  message("wrote: ", fp_int)

  list(pred = tab_pred, inter = tab_int)
}

# --------------------------
# WHOLE (Const only): Batch != "Cond"; NO Splicing.rate
# --------------------------
meta_whole <- metadata_const_cond_whole %>%
  dplyr::filter(Batch != "Cond") %>%
  droplevels()

vars_whole <- c("Sex", "mt_CPM", "ribo_CPM", "Sequencing_batch")  # exclude Genotype; no Splicing.rate

res_whole <- run_fraction(
  fraction_label = "Whole",
  counts_mat = exp_data_const_cond_whole,
  md_df = meta_whole,
  keep_outliers = FALSE,
  variables_to_test = vars_whole,
  protein_coding_ens = protein_coding_ens,
  outdir_int = outdir_int,
  do_tmm = TRUE
)

# --------------------------
# SYN / NUC / CYT (subset BEFORE PCA; outlier rules)
# --------------------------
base_md <- metadata_const_syn_nuc_cyt %>% droplevels()

# Syn
md_syn <- base_md %>% dplyr::filter(Fraction %in% "Syn") %>% droplevels()
vars_syn <- c("Sex", "mt_CPM", "ribo_CPM", "Sequencing_batch", "Splicing.rate")

res_syn <- run_fraction(
  fraction_label = "Syn",
  counts_mat = exp_data_const_syn_nuc_cyt,
  md_df = md_syn,
  keep_outliers = FALSE,
  variables_to_test = vars_syn,
  protein_coding_ens = protein_coding_ens,
  outdir_int = outdir_int,
  do_tmm = TRUE
)

# Nuc
md_nuc <- base_md %>% dplyr::filter(Fraction %in% "Nuc") %>% droplevels()
vars_nuc <- c("Sex", "mt_CPM", "ribo_CPM", "Sequencing_batch", "Splicing.rate")

res_nuc <- run_fraction(
  fraction_label = "Nuc",
  counts_mat = exp_data_const_syn_nuc_cyt,
  md_df = md_nuc,
  keep_outliers = FALSE,
  variables_to_test = vars_nuc,
  protein_coding_ens = protein_coding_ens,

  do_tmm = TRUE
)

# Cyt (KEEP outliers; no Sequencing_batch)
md_cyt <- base_md %>% dplyr::filter(Fraction %in% "Cyt") %>% droplevels()
vars_cyt <- c("Sex", "mt_CPM", "ribo_CPM", "Splicing.rate")

res_cyt <- run_fraction(

# --------------------------
# Combined file
# --------------------------
all_tabs <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  res_whole$pred, res_whole$inter,

fp_all <- file.path(outdir_int, "PC_tests__ALL.csv")
write.csv(all_tabs, fp_all, row.names = FALSE)
```

## Checking for metadata confounding genotype

```{r}


# =========================================================
# PURPOSE: Make multi-panel QC boxplot PDFs (one PDF per covariate)
#   - One page per covariate (mt_CPM, ribo_CPM, Splicing.rate)
#   - Each page: one plot per dataset:
#       Const_whole, Const_syn, Const_nuc, Const_cyt,
#       Cond_whole,
#       Cond_syn (WT vs HET), Cond_syn (WT vs HOM),
#       Cond_nuc (WT vs HET), Cond_nuc (WT vs HOM)
#   - 3 columns of plots
#   - Splicing.rate page omits whole (Const_whole / Cond_whole)
#   - Box fill: WT = hotpink3; mutants (HET/HOM) = lightslategray
#   - Dots (jitter) stay black
#   - Titles:
#       Page title: "<covar> ~ Genotype"
#       Each subplot title: dataset name
#   - Stats labels: TOP-LEFT, smaller text
#   - Outlier == TRUE removed where Outlier column exists
#   - Saves: output/QC/Genotype_<covar>.pdf
# =========================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(patchwork)
})

dir.create("output/QC", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# ---- helpers ----

.is_not_outlier <- function(df) {
  if (!("Outlier" %in% colnames(df))) return(rep(TRUE, nrow(df)))
  out <- df$Outlier
  if (is.logical(out)) return(is.na(out) | out == FALSE)
  out_chr <- toupper(trimws(as.character(out)))
  return(is.na(out_chr) | out_chr == "FALSE" | out_chr == "F" | out_chr == "0" | out_chr == "")
}

.make_qc_plot <- function(df, covar_col, dataset_title) {
  stopifnot(covar_col %in% colnames(df), "Genotype" %in% colnames(df))

  plot_df <- df %>%
    dplyr::filter(.is_not_outlier(.)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Genotype = factor(as.character(Genotype), levels = c("WT", "HET", "HOM")),
      covar    = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(.data[[covar_col]])))
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(is.finite(covar), !is.na(Genotype)) %>%
    droplevels()

  if (nrow(plot_df) == 0 || nlevels(plot_df$Genotype) < 2) {
    return(
      ggplot() +
        theme_bw() +
        labs(title = dataset_title, x = NULL, y = covar_col) +
        annotate("text", x = 0, y = 0, label = "No data after filtering", size = 4) +
        theme(axis.text = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank())
    )
  }

  # ---- stats ----
  if (nlevels(plot_df$Genotype) == 2) {
    w      <- wilcox.test(covar ~ Genotype, data = plot_df, exact = FALSE)
    lm_fit <- summary(lm(covar ~ Genotype, data = plot_df))

    p_w  <- signif(w$p.value, 3)
    coef_row <- grep("^Genotype", rownames(lm_fit$coefficients), value = TRUE)[1]
    p_lm <- if (!is.na(coef_row)) signif(lm_fit$coefficients[coef_row, "Pr(>|t|)"], 3) else NA
    r2   <- signif(lm_fit$r.squared, 3)

    stat_label <- paste0(
      "Wilcox p = ", p_w,
      "\nLM p = ", p_lm,
      "\nR² = ", r2,
      "\n(n = ", nrow(plot_df), ")"
    )
  } else {
    # only used if you ever pass 3+ groups elsewhere
    k      <- kruskal.test(covar ~ Genotype, data = plot_df)
    lm_fit <- summary(lm(covar ~ Genotype, data = plot_df))

    p_k  <- signif(k$p.value, 3)
    p_lm <- signif(anova(lm(covar ~ Genotype, data = plot_df))$`Pr(>F)`[1], 3)
    r2   <- signif(lm_fit$r.squared, 3)

    stat_label <- paste0(
      "Kruskal p = ", p_k,
      "\nLM p = ", p_lm,
      "\nR² = ", r2,
      "\n(n = ", nrow(plot_df), ")"
    )
  }

    ggplot(plot_df, aes(Genotype, covar, fill = Genotype)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.6) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.12, size = 2, alpha = 0.85, color = "black") +
  
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = -Inf, y = Inf,
      label = stat_label,
      hjust = -0.05,
      vjust = 1.05,
      size  = 4
    ) +
  
    scale_y_continuous(
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.25))  
    ) +
  
    theme_bw() +
    labs(title = dataset_title, x = NULL, y = covar_col) +
    theme(legend.position = "none") +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(WT = "hotpink3",
                 HET = "mediumpurple2",
                 HOM = "mediumpurple2"),
      drop = FALSE
    )

}

# ---- dataset extractors (based on what you described) ----

.get_meta_const_whole <- function() {
  metadata_const_cond_whole %>%
    dplyr::filter(Batch != "Cond") %>%
    droplevels()
}
.get_meta_cond_whole <- function() {
  metadata_const_cond_whole %>%
    dplyr::filter(Batch == "Cond") %>%
    droplevels()
}
.get_meta_const_fraction <- function(frac) {

}

    dplyr::filter(Fraction == frac) %>%

}

# ---- main writer ----

write_qc_boxplot_pdf <- function(covar_col) {

  # Build datasets list (Cond_syn / Cond_nuc split into WTvsHET and WTvsHOM)
  datasets <- list(
    Const_whole    = list(meta = .get_meta_const_whole()),
    Const_syn      = list(meta = .get_meta_const_fraction("Syn")),
    Const_nuc      = list(meta = .get_meta_const_fraction("Nuc")),
    Const_cyt      = list(meta = .get_meta_const_fraction("Cyt")),
    Cond_whole     = list(meta = .get_meta_cond_whole()),
    Cond_syn_WTvsHET = list(meta = .get_meta_cond_fraction("Syn") %>% dplyr::filter(Genotype %in% c("WT","HET"))),
    Cond_syn_WTvsHOM = list(meta = .get_meta_cond_fraction("Syn") %>% dplyr::filter(Genotype %in% c("WT","HOM"))),
    Cond_nuc_WTvsHET = list(meta = .get_meta_cond_fraction("Nuc") %>% dplyr::filter(Genotype %in% c("WT","HET"))),
    Cond_nuc_WTvsHOM = list(meta = .get_meta_cond_fraction("Nuc") %>% dplyr::filter(Genotype %in% c("WT","HOM")))
  )

  # Splicing.rate: drop whole 
  if (identical(covar_col, "Splicing.rate")) {
    datasets <- datasets[setdiff(names(datasets), c("Const_whole", "Cond_whole"))]
  }

  plots <- lapply(names(datasets), function(nm) {
    df <- datasets[[nm]]$meta

    if (!(covar_col %in% colnames(df))) {
      return(
        ggplot() +
          theme_bw() +
          labs(title = nm, x = NULL, y = covar_col) +
          annotate("text", x = 0, y = 0, label = paste0("'", covar_col, "' not in metadata"), size = 4) +
          theme(axis.text = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank())
      )
    }

    .make_qc_plot(df, covar_col = covar_col, dataset_title = nm)
  })
  names(plots) <- names(datasets)

  page_title <- paste0(covar_col, " ~ Genotype")

  fig <- wrap_plots(plots, ncol = 3) +
    plot_annotation(title = page_title) &
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16, face = "bold"))

  out_fp <- file.path("output/QC", paste0("Genotype_", covar_col, ".pdf"))
  ggsave(out_fp, fig, width = 13, height = 9)
  message("Wrote: ", out_fp)
}

# ---- run the ones you care about ----
write_qc_boxplot_pdf("mt_CPM")
write_qc_boxplot_pdf("ribo_CPM")
write_qc_boxplot_pdf("Splicing.rate")
```

## Checking if mt_CPM is correlated with QC metrics or fraction markers

```{r}

# ============================================================
# Per-fraction QC + purity justification for mt_CPM covariate
# + ONE PDF PER METRIC (patchwork), containing ALL dataset/fraction/contrast plots
# + R (rho) + p shown on each subplot (top-left)
# + save qc/purity tables to output/QC/*.xlsx
# Handles mixed counts matrices and ENS rownames
# ============================================================

# ----------------------------
# 0) REQUIRED INPUTS
# ----------------------------
# metadata_cond_syn_nuc
# metadata_const_syn_nuc_cyt
# metadata_const_cond_whole
#
# exp_data_cond_syn_nuc
# exp_data_const_syn_nuc_cyt
# exp_data_const_cond_whole
#
# my_gene with columns: gene_id (ENSEMBL) and gene_name (SYMBOL)
stopifnot(exists("my_gene"))
stopifnot(all(c("gene_id","gene_name") %in% colnames(my_gene)))

# ----------------------------
# 1) Helpers
# ----------------------------
strip_ens_version <- function(x) sub("\\..*$", "", x)

make_ens_to_symbol <- function(my_gene) {
  map <- my_gene[, c("gene_id","gene_name")]
  map <- map[!is.na(map$gene_id) & map$gene_id != "", , drop = FALSE]
  map$gene_id <- strip_ens_version(as.character(map$gene_id))
  map <- map[!duplicated(map$gene_id), , drop = FALSE]
  rownames(map) <- map$gene_id
  map
}

subset_counts_to_meta <- function(counts, meta, sample_col = "Sample") {
  stopifnot(sample_col %in% names(meta))
  samps <- meta[[sample_col]]
  samps <- samps[samps %in% colnames(counts)]
  if (!length(samps)) stop("No overlapping samples between metadata and count matrix.")
  counts[, samps, drop = FALSE]
}

add_raw_libsize_to_meta <- function(meta, counts_subset, sample_col = "Sample", out_col = "raw_libsize") {
  lib <- colSums(counts_subset, na.rm = TRUE)
  lib_df <- data.frame(Sample = names(lib), Raw_libsize = as.numeric(lib), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  names(lib_df) <- c(sample_col, out_col)
  dplyr::left_join(meta, lib_df, by = sample_col) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(raw_libsize_mill = .data[[out_col]] / 1e6)
}

cor_test_df <- function(df, x, y, method = "spearman") {
  if (!(x %in% names(df)) || !(y %in% names(df))) {
    return(data.frame(x = x, y = y, n = 0, rho = NA_real_, p = NA_real_))
  }
  ok <- is.finite(df[[x]]) & is.finite(df[[y]])
  if (sum(ok) < 4) {
    return(data.frame(x = x, y = y, n = sum(ok), rho = NA_real_, p = NA_real_))
  }
  ct <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(df[[x]][ok], df[[y]][ok], method = method))
  data.frame(x = x, y = y, n = sum(ok), rho = unname(ct$estimate), p = as.numeric(ct$p.value))
}

# ----------------------------
# Marker scores
# ----------------------------
marker_scores_from_ens_counts <- function(counts_subset, ens2sym_map, gene_sets, prior_count = 2) {

  ens <- strip_ens_version(rownames(counts_subset))
  sym <- ens2sym_map[ens, "gene_name"]
  sym <- as.character(sym)
  sym[is.na(sym) | sym == ""] <- NA_character_

  lib <- colSums(counts_subset)
  cpm <- sweep(counts_subset, 2, lib / 1e6, "/")
  logcpm <- log2(cpm + prior_count)

  out <- lapply(names(gene_sets), function(set_name) {

    gs <- gene_sets[[set_name]]
    hit_rows <- which(sym %in% gs)
    new_name <- paste0(set_name, "_score")

    if (length(hit_rows) < 2) {
      return(data.frame(
        Sample = colnames(counts_subset),
        set = new_name,
        score = NA_real_
      ))
    }

    sc <- colMeans(logcpm[hit_rows, , drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)

    data.frame(
      Sample = names(sc),
      set = new_name,
      score = as.numeric(sc),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })

  bind_rows(out) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = set, values_from = score)
}

# drop outliers if column exists; otherwise leave alone
drop_outliers <- function(meta) {
  if ("Outlier" %in% names(meta)) {
    meta <- meta %>% dplyr::filter(is.na(Outlier) | Outlier == FALSE)
  }
  meta
}

# fraction tag for labels
frac_tag <- function(fr) {
  fr2 <- tolower(fr)
  fr2 <- gsub("^syn$", "syn", fr2)
  fr2 <- gsub("^nuc$", "nuc", fr2)
  fr2 <- gsub("^cyt$", "cyt", fr2)
  fr2 <- gsub("^whole$", "whole", fr2)
  fr2
}

safe_slug <- function(x) gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_\\-]+", "_", x)

# write xlsx helper (OVERWRITE always)
write_xlsx_safe <- function(df_list, fp) {
  dir.create(dirname(fp), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  if (file.exists(fp)) file.remove(fp)

  if (requireNamespace("openxlsx", quietly = TRUE)) {
    wb <- openxlsx::createWorkbook()
    for (nm in names(df_list)) {
      openxlsx::addWorksheet(wb, nm)
      openxlsx::writeData(wb, nm, df_list[[nm]])
    }
    openxlsx::saveWorkbook(wb, fp, overwrite = TRUE)
  } else if (requireNamespace("writexl", quietly = TRUE)) {
    writexl::write_xlsx(df_list, fp)
  } else {
    stop("Need either openxlsx or writexl installed to write .xlsx")
  }
}

# append plots into a named list-of-lists: plots_by_metric[[metric]] <- c(existing, list(newplot))
append_plot <- function(plots_by_metric, metric, plt) {
  if (is.null(plt)) return(plots_by_metric)
  if (is.null(plots_by_metric[[metric]])) {
    plots_by_metric[[metric]] <- list(plt)
  } else {
    plots_by_metric[[metric]] <- c(plots_by_metric[[metric]], list(plt))
  }
  plots_by_metric
}

# ----------------------------
# 2) QC candidates + purity markers
# ----------------------------
qc_candidates <- c(
  "Splicing.rate",
  "ribo_CPM",
  "mt_pct",
  "ribo_pct"
)

gene_sets <- list(
  synaptic  = c("Snap25","Syp","Dlg4","Rims1","Gria1","Gria2","Slc32a1"),
  astro     = c("Aldh1l1","Aqp4","Slc1a3","Glul","Gja1","Sox9"),
  microglia = c("P2ry12","Tmem119","Sall1","Csf1r","Hexb"),
  olig      = c("Mbp","Plp1","Mog","Mag","Mobp")
)

ens2sym_map <- make_ens_to_symbol(my_gene)

# ----------------------------
# 3) Main runner (collect plots; DO NOT save per-panel files)
#    Adds R (rho) and p as an annotation in top-left of each plot.
# ----------------------------
run_per_fraction_collect <- function(meta, counts,
                                     dataset_prefix,            # "Const" or "Cond"
                                     qc_candidates, gene_sets, ens2sym_map,
                                     fraction_col = "Fraction",
                                     sample_col = "Sample",
                                     genotype_col = "Genotype",
                                     contrasts = NULL,
                                     label_mode = c("default", "whole_no_contrast")) {

  label_mode <- match.arg(label_mode)

  stopifnot(sample_col %in% names(meta))
  stopifnot("mt_CPM" %in% names(meta))

  meta <- drop_outliers(meta)

  frac_levels <- if (fraction_col %in% names(meta)) sort(unique(meta[[fraction_col]])) else "ALL"

  sets <- list(All = meta)
  set_labels <- c(All = "")

  if (!is.null(contrasts)) {
    stopifnot(genotype_col %in% names(meta))
    sets <- list()
    set_labels <- c()
    for (nm in names(contrasts)) {
      keep <- contrasts[[nm]]
      meta_k <- meta %>% dplyr::filter(.data[[genotype_col]] %in% keep)
      if (nrow(meta_k) > 0) {
        sets[[nm]] <- meta_k
        set_labels[[nm]] <- nm
      }
    }
  }

  qc_all <- list()
  purity_all <- list()
  plots_by_metric <- list()

  for (set_nm in names(sets)) {
    meta_set <- sets[[set_nm]]
    contrast_tag <- set_labels[[set_nm]]  # "" or "HETvsWT"/"HOMvsWT"

    for (fr in frac_levels) {
      meta_fr <- if (fr == "ALL") meta_set else dplyr::filter(meta_set, .data[[fraction_col]] == fr)

      # subset counts to samples in this fraction+set
      counts_fr <- subset_counts_to_meta(counts, meta_fr, sample_col = sample_col)

      # add raw libsize
      meta_fr2 <- add_raw_libsize_to_meta(meta_fr, counts_fr, sample_col = sample_col)

      # add purity marker scores
      ms <- marker_scores_from_ens_counts(counts_fr, ens2sym_map, gene_sets)
      meta_fr3 <- dplyr::left_join(meta_fr2, ms, by = sample_col)

      # QC correlations
      qc_cols <- qc_candidates[qc_candidates %in% names(meta_fr3)]
      qc_cols <- unique(c(qc_cols, "raw_libsize", "raw_libsize_mill"))
      qc_block <- bind_rows(lapply(qc_cols, function(col) cor_test_df(meta_fr3, "mt_CPM", col))) %>%
        mutate(dataset = dataset_prefix,
               fraction = fr,
               contrast = ifelse(contrast_tag == "", NA_character_, contrast_tag),
               block = "QC")

      # Purity correlations (NOTE: *_score names)
      purity_cols <- paste0(names(gene_sets), "_score")
      purity_cols <- purity_cols[purity_cols %in% names(meta_fr3)]

      purity_block <- bind_rows(lapply(purity_cols, function(col) cor_test_df(meta_fr3, "mt_CPM", col))) %>%
        mutate(dataset = dataset_prefix,
               fraction = fr,
               contrast = ifelse(contrast_tag == "", NA_character_, contrast_tag),
               block = "PurityMarkers")

      qc_all[[paste(set_nm, fr, sep="__")]] <- qc_block
      purity_all[[paste(set_nm, fr, sep="__")]] <- purity_block

      # Dataset label for subplot title ONLY
      dataset_label <- paste0(dataset_prefix, "_", frac_tag(fr))

      if (label_mode == "default") {
        # include contrasts for Cond syn/nuc only
        if (dataset_prefix == "Cond" && contrast_tag != "") {
          dataset_label <- paste0(dataset_label, "_", contrast_tag)
        }
      } else if (label_mode == "whole_no_contrast") {
        # never append contrast tag (you asked specifically for Cond whole)
        # dataset_label remains "Cond_whole" / "Const_whole"
      }

      # helper: build the actual plot + add annotation from the right correlation row
      make_plot_with_stats <- function(df, metric, dataset_label, qc_block, purity_block) {
        if (!(metric %in% names(df))) return(NULL)
        ok <- is.finite(df[[metric]]) & is.finite(df$mt_CPM)
        if (sum(ok) < 4) return(NULL)

        # find the stat row for THIS metric (it's in y column)
        stat_row <- bind_rows(qc_block, purity_block) %>%
          dplyr::filter(.data$y == metric) %>%
          dplyr::slice_head(n = 1)

        ann <- NULL
        if (nrow(stat_row) == 1 && is.finite(stat_row$rho) && is.finite(stat_row$p)) {
          ann <- paste0("R=", sprintf("%.3f", stat_row$rho),
                        "\np=", formatC(stat_row$p, format = "g", digits = 3))
        }

        p <- ggplot(df[ok, , drop = FALSE], aes(x = .data[[metric]], y = mt_CPM)) +
          geom_point(aes(color = Genotype, shape = Sex), size = 2) +
          theme_bw() +
          labs(title = dataset_label, x = metric, y = "mt_CPM")

        if (!is.null(ann)) {
          p <- p + annotate("text",
                            x = -Inf, y = Inf,
                            label = ann,
                            hjust = -0.05, vjust = 1.1,
                            size = 3.2)
        }
        p
      }

      # Collect plots for ALL tested metrics
      all_metrics <- unique(c(qc_cols, purity_cols))
      for (metric in all_metrics) {
        plt <- make_plot_with_stats(meta_fr3, metric, dataset_label, qc_block, purity_block)
        plots_by_metric <- append_plot(plots_by_metric, metric, plt)
      }
    }
  }

  list(
    qc = bind_rows(qc_all),
    purity = bind_rows(purity_all),
    plots_by_metric = plots_by_metric
  )
}

# ----------------------------
# 4) RUN EVERYTHING
# ----------------------------

# 6) Build ONE PDF PER METRIC (patchwork)
# ----------------------------

# merge plots_by_metric across datasets
plots_by_metric_all <- list()
merge_metric_lists <- function(dst, src) {
  for (nm in names(src)) {
    if (is.null(dst[[nm]])) dst[[nm]] <- src[[nm]]
    else dst[[nm]] <- c(dst[[nm]], src[[nm]])
  }
  dst
}

plots_by_metric_all <- merge_metric_lists(plots_by_metric_all, res_cond_syn_nuc$plots_by_metric)

plots_by_metric_all <- merge_metric_lists(plots_by_metric_all, res_const_whole$plots_by_metric)

for (metric in sort(names(plots_by_metric_all))) {
  plts <- plots_by_metric_all[[metric]]
  plts <- plts[!vapply(plts, is.null, logical(1))]
  if (!length(plts)) next

  # reasonable layout: 2 cols if <=6, else 3 cols
  ncol <- if (length(plts) <= 6) 2 else 3

  combined <- wrap_plots(plts, ncol = ncol) +
    plot_annotation(title = paste0("mito_CPM vs ", metric))

  fp <- file.path(out_plot_dir, paste0("mito_vs_", safe_slug(metric), ".pdf"))
  if (file.exists(fp)) file.remove(fp)

  # Letter size-ish; bump height based on rows
  nrow <- ceiling(length(plts) / ncol)
  pdf(fp, width = 11, height = max(8.5, 3.2 * nrow))
  print(combined)
  dev.off()
}

# ----------------------------
# 7) Print top hits per dataset/fraction/contrast
# ----------------------------
qc_cor_results %>%
  filter(is.finite(.data$p)) %>%
  group_by(.data$dataset, .data$fraction, .data$contrast) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  print(n = 200)

purity_cor_results %>%
  filter(is.finite(.data$p)) %>%
  group_by(.data$dataset, .data$fraction, .data$contrast) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  print(n = 200)

message("Done.")
message("Metric PDFs saved under: output/QC/mito_CPM_scatterplots/  (one PDF per metric)")
message("Tables saved to: output/QC/qc_cor_results.xlsx and output/QC/purity_cor_results.xlsx (overwritten).")
```

## qPCR Validation

Remaking plots that Ethan made

```{r}


# ----------------------------
# Read sheet 2
# ----------------------------
qPCR_validation <- read_excel("qPCR_validation.xlsx", sheet = 2)

# ----------------------------
# Clean / format
# ----------------------------
qPCR_validation <- qPCR_validation %>%
  mutate(
    Tissue = trimws(Tissue),
    group = factor(group, levels = c("male", "female"))
  )

# ----------------------------
# Keep replicates separate and convert to qPCR log2FC
# ----------------------------
plot_df <- qPCR_validation %>%
  filter(
    Tissue == "Cortex",
    !gene %in% c("Ddo", "Dsn1", "Abca8a", "Prlr")
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(ddCt1, ddCt2),
    names_to = "rep",
    values_to = "ddCt"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(ddCt)) %>%
  mutate(
    log2FC_qPCR = -ddCt
  )

# ----------------------------
# Assign one qPCR-based direction per gene
# ----------------------------
dir_df <- qPCR_validation %>%
  filter(
    Tissue == "Cortex",
    !gene %in% c("Ddo", "Dsn1", "Abca8a", "Prlr")
  ) %>%
  group_by(gene) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_log2FC_qPCR = mean(-`cumulative ddCt`, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    direction = if_else(mean_log2FC_qPCR >= 0, "Up", "Down")
  ) %>%
  select(gene, direction)

plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  left_join(dir_df, by = "gene")

# ----------------------------
# Order genes by overall qPCR effect
# ----------------------------
gene_order <- qPCR_validation %>%
  filter(
    Tissue == "Cortex",
    !gene %in% c("Ddo", "Dsn1", "Abca8a", "Prlr")
  ) %>%
  group_by(gene) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_log2FC_qPCR = mean(-`cumulative ddCt`, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_log2FC_qPCR)) %>%
  pull(gene)

plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  mutate(gene = factor(gene, levels = gene_order))

# ----------------------------
# Plot
# ----------------------------
ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = gene, y = log2FC_qPCR)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "black") +
  geom_boxplot(
    color = "black",
    fill = NA,
    width = 0.65,
    outlier.shape = NA
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(color = direction, shape = group),
    position = position_jitter(width = 0.12, height = 0),
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Down" = "#00BFC4",
    "Up"   = "#F8766D"
  )) +
  labs(
    x = "Gene",
    y = expression(-Delta*Delta*C[t]),
    title = "qPCR validation"
  ) + 
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(min(plot_df$log2FC_qPCR), 4)) +
  labs(
    x = "Gene",
    y = expression(-Delta*Delta*C[t]),
    title = "qPCR validation"
  ) +
    theme_gray(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.title = element_blank()
  )


# ----------------------------
# Read sheet 1
# ----------------------------
qPCR_concord <- read_excel("qPCR_validation.xlsx", sheet = 1)

# Convert #N/A to numeric NA
qPCR_concord <- qPCR_concord %>%
  mutate(
    log2FC_RNAseq = as.numeric(log2FC_RNAseq),
    log2FC_qPCR   = as.numeric(log2FC_qPCR)
  )

# ----------------------------
# Filter data
# ----------------------------
plot_data <- qPCR_concord %>%
  filter(
    Tissue == "Cortex",
    !is.na(log2FC_qPCR),
    !is.na(log2FC_RNAseq),
    !gene %in% c("Ddo", "Dsn1", "Abca8a", "Prlr")
  )

# ----------------------------
# Fit linear model
# ----------------------------
fit <- lm(log2FC_qPCR ~ log2FC_RNAseq, data = plot_data)
r_val <- sign(coef(fit)[2]) * sqrt(summary(fit)$r.squared)

# ----------------------------
# PLOT 2: logFC concordance plot
# ----------------------------
ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = log2FC_RNAseq, y = log2FC_qPCR)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "black") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "black") +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = min(plot_data$log2FC_RNAseq, na.rm = TRUE),
    y = max(plot_data$log2FC_qPCR, na.rm = TRUE),
    label = paste0("R = ", round(r_val, 2)),
    hjust = 0,
    vjust = 1,
    size = 6
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
  labs(
    x = "RNA-seq log2FC",
    y = "qPCR log2FC",
    title = "qPCR vs RNA-seq"
  )
```

## GSEA dotplot for cyt only and Fraction vs all



```{r}

# -----------------------------
# Settings
# -----------------------------
gsea_dir <- "output/GSEA/final_DE"
max_term_chars <- 50
top_n <- 10
extra_pad <- 10

# Result set prefixes (without _up/_down.csv)
prefixes <- c(
  "Const_cyt_PC12",
  "simple_WT_syn_vs_all",
  "simple_WT_nuc_vs_all",
  "simple_WT_cyt_vs_all"
)

# Output PDF
pdf_file <- file.path(gsea_dir, "GSEA_dotplots_combined.pdf")

# -----------------------------
# Helpers
# -----------------------------
get_term_col <- function(df) {
  possible_cols <- c("Description", "pathway", "Pathway", "Term", "term")
  term_col <- possible_cols[possible_cols %in% colnames(df)][1]
  if (is.na(term_col)) stop("Couldn't find a term column in the GSEA table.")
  term_col
}

get_rank_col <- function(df) {
  possible_cols <- c("padj", "p.adjust", "FDR", "qvalue", "pval", "pvalue")
  rank_col <- possible_cols[possible_cols %in% colnames(df)][1]
  if (is.na(rank_col)) stop("Couldn't find a p-value / adjusted p-value column in the GSEA table.")
  rank_col
}

prep_gsea_df <- function(fp) {
  df <- read_csv(fp, show_col_types = FALSE)
  
  term_col <- get_term_col(df)
  
  df %>%
    mutate(term = gsub("_", " ", .data[[term_col]]))
}

# -----------------------------
# Compute one global max term length
# -----------------------------
all_terms <- c()

for (prefix in prefixes) {
  for (dir in c("up", "down")) {
    fp <- file.path(gsea_dir, paste0(prefix, "_", dir, ".csv"))
    
    if (file.exists(fp)) {
      df_tmp <- prep_gsea_df(fp) %>%
        filter(nchar(term) < max_term_chars)
      
      all_terms <- c(all_terms, df_tmp$term)
    }
  }
}

global_max_chars <- max(nchar(all_terms), na.rm = TRUE)

get_top_terms <- function(df, direction = c("up", "down"), top_n = 20,
                          max_term_chars = 75, pad_width = NULL) {
  direction <- match.arg(direction)
  rank_col <- get_rank_col(df)
  
  df_filt <- df %>%
    filter(nchar(term) < max_term_chars)
  
  if (direction == "up") {
    df_top <- df_filt %>%
      arrange(.data[[rank_col]], desc(NES)) %>%
      slice_head(n = top_n) %>%
      arrange(NES)
  } else {
    df_top <- df_filt %>%
      arrange(.data[[rank_col]], NES) %>%
      slice_head(n = top_n) %>%
      arrange(NES)
  }
  
  df_top %>%
    mutate(
      term = str_trunc(term, width = max_term_chars, side = "right", ellipsis = "..."),
      term = str_pad(term, width = pad_width, side = "right"),
      term = factor(term, levels = term)
    )
}

make_gsea_dotplot <- function(df, title_text, dot_color) {
  ggplot(df, aes(x = NES, y = term, size = setSize)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.95, color = dot_color) +
    scale_size_continuous(
      name = "Gene set size",
      breaks = c(10, 100, 1000),
      limits = c(10, 1500)
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = function(x) {
        rng <- range(x, na.rm = TRUE)
        pretty(seq(rng[1], rng[2], length.out = 100), n = 4)
      },
      labels = function(x) sprintf("%.1f", x)
    ) +
    scale_y_discrete(position = "right") +  
    labs(
      title = title_text,
      x = "Normalized Enrichment Score (NES)",
      y = NULL
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 18),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 14),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 12)
    )
}

# -----------------------------
# Build all plots and print to one PDF
# -----------------------------
pdf(pdf_file, width = 7.8, height = 2.8)

for (prefix in prefixes) {
  
  fp_up <- file.path(gsea_dir, paste0(prefix, "_up.csv"))
  fp_down <- file.path(gsea_dir, paste0(prefix, "_down.csv"))
  
  if (!file.exists(fp_up)) {
    warning("Missing file: ", fp_up)
    next
  }
  if (!file.exists(fp_down)) {
    warning("Missing file: ", fp_down)
    next
  }
  
  gsea_up <- prep_gsea_df(fp_up)
  gsea_down <- prep_gsea_df(fp_down)
  
  pad_up <- global_max_chars + 10
  
  if (prefix == "simple_WT_nuc_vs_all") {
    pad_down <- global_max_chars + 5
  } else {
    pad_down <- global_max_chars + 10
  }
  
  top_up <- get_top_terms(
    gsea_up,
    direction = "up",
    top_n = top_n,
    max_term_chars = max_term_chars,
    pad_width = pad_up
  )
  
  top_down <- get_top_terms(
    gsea_down,
    direction = "down",
    top_n = top_n,
    max_term_chars = max_term_chars,
    pad_width = pad_down
  )
  
  p_up <- make_gsea_dotplot(
    top_up,
    paste0(prefix, " GSEA Up"),
    dot_color = "red"
  )
  
  p_down <- make_gsea_dotplot(
    top_down,
    paste0(prefix, " GSEA Down"),
    dot_color = "blue"
  )
  
  print(p_up)
  print(p_down)
}

dev.off()

```


## Heatmap of Fraction vs All GSEA terms

```{r}



# -----------------------------
# Settings
# -----------------------------
gsea_dir <- "output/GSEA/final_DE"
max_term_chars <- 50
top_n <- 10

prefixes <- c(
  "simple_WT_nuc_vs_all",
  "simple_WT_cyt_vs_all",
  "simple_WT_syn_vs_all"
)

pretty_names <- c(
  simple_WT_nuc_vs_all = "Nuc vs All",
  simple_WT_cyt_vs_all = "Cyt vs All",
  simple_WT_syn_vs_all = "Syn vs All"
)

pdf_file <- file.path(gsea_dir, "GSEA_top_terms_heatmap.pdf")

# -----------------------------
# Helpers
# -----------------------------
get_term_col <- function(df) {
  possible_cols <- c("Description", "pathway", "Pathway", "Term", "term")
  term_col <- possible_cols[possible_cols %in% colnames(df)][1]
  if (is.na(term_col)) stop("Couldn't find a term column in the GSEA table.")
  term_col
}

get_rank_col <- function(df) {
  possible_cols <- c("padj", "p.adjust", "FDR", "qvalue", "pval", "pvalue")
  rank_col <- possible_cols[possible_cols %in% colnames(df)][1]
  if (is.na(rank_col)) stop("Couldn't find a p-value / adjusted p-value column in the GSEA table.")
  rank_col
}

prep_gsea_df <- function(fp, max_term_chars) {
  df <- read_csv(fp, show_col_types = FALSE)
  term_col <- get_term_col(df)
  
  df %>%
    mutate(
      term = gsub("_", " ", .data[[term_col]]),
      term = str_trunc(term, width = max_term_chars, side = "right", ellipsis = "...")
    ) %>%
    filter(nchar(term) < max_term_chars)
}

get_top_gsea_terms <- function(prefix, top_n, max_term_chars, gsea_dir, pretty_names) {
  fp_up   <- file.path(gsea_dir, paste0(prefix, "_up.csv"))
  fp_down <- file.path(gsea_dir, paste0(prefix, "_down.csv"))
  
  if (!file.exists(fp_up)) stop("Missing file: ", fp_up)
  if (!file.exists(fp_down)) stop("Missing file: ", fp_down)
  
  gsea_up <- prep_gsea_df(fp_up, max_term_chars)
  gsea_down <- prep_gsea_df(fp_down, max_term_chars)
  
  rank_col_up <- get_rank_col(gsea_up)
  rank_col_down <- get_rank_col(gsea_down)
  
  top_up <- gsea_up %>%
    arrange(.data[[rank_col_up]], desc(NES)) %>%
    slice_head(n = top_n) %>%
    select(term, NES) %>%
    distinct(term, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(direction = "Up")
  
  top_down <- gsea_down %>%
    arrange(.data[[rank_col_down]], NES) %>%
    slice_head(n = top_n) %>%
    select(term, NES) %>%
    distinct(term, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(direction = "Down")
  
  bind_rows(top_up, top_down) %>%
    distinct(term, direction, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(
      comparison = pretty_names[[prefix]],
      prefix = prefix
    )
}

# -----------------------------
# Collect top terms
# -----------------------------
plot_df <- bind_rows(lapply(
  prefixes,
  get_top_gsea_terms,
  top_n = top_n,
  max_term_chars = max_term_chars,
  gsea_dir = gsea_dir,
  pretty_names = pretty_names
))

if (nrow(plot_df) == 0) {
  stop("No terms passed the filters.")
}

# -----------------------------
# Set row order:
# Nuc up, Nuc down, Cyt up, Cyt down, Syn up, Syn down
# -----------------------------
ordered_terms <- plot_df %>%
  mutate(
    prefix = factor(
      prefix,
      levels = c("simple_WT_nuc_vs_all", "simple_WT_cyt_vs_all", "simple_WT_syn_vs_all")
    ),
    direction = factor(direction, levels = c("Up", "Down"))
  ) %>%
  arrange(prefix, direction, desc(NES)) %>%
  pull(term)

# keep first occurrence only, preserving order
ordered_terms <- ordered_terms[!duplicated(ordered_terms)]

# -----------------------------
# Make complete grid so missing terms show as blank tiles
# -----------------------------
heatmap_df <- expand.grid(
  term = ordered_terms,
  comparison = c("Nuc vs All", "Cyt vs All", "Syn vs All"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  left_join(
    plot_df %>% select(term, comparison, NES),
    by = c("term", "comparison")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    term = factor(term, levels = rev(ordered_terms)),
    comparison = factor(comparison, levels = c("Nuc vs All", "Cyt vs All", "Syn vs All"))
  )

# -----------------------------
# Symmetric fill scale around 0
# -----------------------------
max_abs_nes <- max(abs(plot_df$NES), na.rm = TRUE)

# -----------------------------
# Plot
# -----------------------------
p <- ggplot(heatmap_df, aes(x = comparison, y = term, fill = NES)) +
  geom_tile(color = "grey80", linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "blue",
    mid = "grey95",
    high = "red",
    midpoint = 0,
    limits = c(-max_abs_nes, max_abs_nes),
    na.value = "grey98",
    name = "NES"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Top GSEA terms across compartments",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10)
  )

print(p)

# -----------------------------
# Save
# -----------------------------
ggsave(
  filename = pdf_file,
  plot = p,
  width = 5.5,
  height = 7,
  units = "in"
)
```

```{r}
# -----------------------------

# -----------------------------
# Helper to suppress the known ggplot annotation warning
# -----------------------------
quiet_known_plot_warning <- function(expr) {
  withCallingHandlers(
    expr,
    warning = function(w) {
      msg <- conditionMessage(w)
      if (grepl("All aesthetics have length 1, but the data has", msg, fixed = TRUE)) {
        invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
      }
    }
  )
}

# -----------------------------
# Run syn vs nuc comparison for each gene set
# -----------------------------
gene_set_results <- lapply(names(gene_sets), function(gs_name) {

  res <- quiet_known_plot_warning(
    compare_groups_plot(
      x_group = "Const_syn",
      y_group = "Const_nuc",
      fp_x = "output/DE/Const_syn_PC12.csv",
      fp_y = "output/DE/Const_nuc_PC12.csv",
      FDR_padj_xy = 0.1,
      filter_mode = "both",
      max_bound = 1.0,
      p_value = 0.05,
      plot_pval_only = FALSE,
      no_filt = TRUE,
      custom_genes = gene_sets[[gs_name]],
      mode = "concordance"
    )
  )

  res$plot <- res$plot +
    labs(title = gs_name) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 14)
    )

  res
})

pdf_fp
```

## Dotplots for ChIP/ASD gene sets

```{r}


# --------------------------
# Load DE files and build Bulk_DE
# --------------------------

read_and_tag <- function(fp, model_name) {

  df <- read_csv(fp, show_col_types = FALSE)

  # --------------------------
  # gene column
  # --------------------------
  if ("gene_name" %in% colnames(df)) {
    gene_col <- "gene_name"
  } else if ("gene" %in% colnames(df)) {
    gene_col <- "gene"
  } else if ("Gene" %in% colnames(df)) {
    gene_col <- "Gene"
  } else {
    df$gene_name <- rownames(df)
    gene_col <- "gene_name"
  }

  # --------------------------
  # fold change column
  # --------------------------
  if ("logFC" %in% colnames(df)) {
    fc_col <- "logFC"
  } else if ("log2FoldChange" %in% colnames(df)) {
    fc_col <- "log2FoldChange"
  } else {
    stop(paste("No fold-change column found in:", fp))
  }

  # --------------------------
  # p-value column
  # --------------------------
  if ("PValue" %in% colnames(df)) {
    p_col <- "PValue"
  } else if ("pvalue" %in% colnames(df)) {
    p_col <- "pvalue"
  } else if ("p_val" %in% colnames(df)) {
    p_col <- "p_val"
  } else {
    stop(paste("No p-value column found in:", fp))
  }

  # --------------------------
  # OPTIONAL FILTER (snRNA ONLY)
  # --------------------------
  if (model_name %in% c("Glut", "L23_IT", "L45_IT")) {

    if ("logCPM" %in% colnames(df)) {
      df <- df %>% dplyr::filter(logCPM >= 1)
    }

    if ("baseMean" %in% colnames(df)) {
      df <- df %>% dplyr::filter(baseMean > 10)
    }
  }

  # --------------------------
  # build standardized df
  # --------------------------
  df %>%
    mutate(
      gene_name = .data[[gene_col]],
      Model = model_name,
      DE = ifelse(.data[[fc_col]] > 0, "up", "down"),
      PValue = .data[[p_col]]
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(gene_name, PValue, Model, DE)
}

Bulk_DE <- bind_rows(

  # ---- CONST ----
  read_and_tag("output/DE/Const_whole_PC12.csv", "const.whole.het"),
  read_and_tag("output/DE/Const_nuc_PC12.csv",   "const.nuc.het"),
  read_and_tag("output/DE/Const_syn_PC12.csv",   "const.syn.het"),
  read_and_tag("output/DE/Const_cyt_PC12.csv",   "const.cyt.het"),

  # ---- COND ----
  read_and_tag("output/DE/Cond_whole_NOPC.csv",       "cond.whole.het"),
  read_and_tag("output/DE/Cond_syn_HETvsWT_NOPC.csv", "cond.syn.het"),
  read_and_tag("output/DE/Cond_nuc_HETvsWT_NOPC.csv", "cond.nuc.het"),

  # ---- snRNA ----

  read_and_tag("output/DE/DE_L4_5 IT Glut.csv",  "L45_IT")
)

# --------------------------
# OverRepresentation Analysis (ORA)
# --------------------------

n_perm <- 1000
stats_df <- NULL

for(ct in unique(Bulk_DE$Model)){

  DE <- Bulk_DE %>% dplyr::filter(Model == ct)

  for(st in unique(DE$DE)){

    DEGs <- DE %>% dplyr::filter(PValue < 0.05 & DE == st) %>% pull(gene_name)

    results_df <- data.frame(
      Gene_set = character(),
      p_value = numeric(),
      observed_overlap = numeric(),
      n_DEGs = numeric(),
      bg_overlap = numeric(),
      n_Gene_set = numeric(),
      n_background = numeric(),
      geneRatio = numeric(),
      BgRatio = numeric(),
      RichFactor = numeric(),
      FoldEnrichment = numeric(),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )

    for (gene_set_name in names(gene_sets)) {

      Gene_set <- gene_sets[[gene_set_name]]

      n_DEGs <- length(DEGs)
      n_Gene_set <- length(Gene_set)

      observed <- length(intersect(Gene_set, DEGs))
      background <- DE$gene_name
      n_background <- length(background)

      bg_overlap <- length(intersect(Gene_set, background))
      BgRatio <- bg_overlap / n_background

      perm_overlaps <- replicate(n_perm, {
        random_DEGs <- sample(background, n_DEGs, replace = FALSE)
        length(intersect(Gene_set, random_DEGs))
      })

      p_val <- mean(perm_overlaps >= observed)

      geneRatio <- observed / n_Gene_set
      RichFactor <- observed / bg_overlap
      FoldEnrichment <- geneRatio / BgRatio

      results_df <- rbind(results_df, data.frame(
        Gene_set = gene_set_name,
        p_value = p_val,
        observed_overlap = observed,
        n_DEGs = n_DEGs,
        bg_overlap = bg_overlap,
        n_Gene_set = n_Gene_set,
        n_background = n_background,
        geneRatio = geneRatio,
        BgRatio = BgRatio,
        RichFactor = RichFactor,
        FoldEnrichment = FoldEnrichment
      ))
    }

    results_df$padj <- p.adjust(results_df$p_value, method = "BH")
    results_df$Model <- ct
    results_df$DE <- st

    if(is.null(stats_df)){
      stats_df <- results_df
    } else {
      stats_df <- bind_rows(stats_df, results_df)
    }
  }
}
```

## Dotplots for ChIP/ASD gene sets (for Fig)
