```{r}
# --------------------------
# Load DE files and build Bulk_DE
# --------------------------

read_and_tag <- function(fp, model_name) {

  df <- read_csv(fp, show_col_types = FALSE)

  # --------------------------
  # gene column
  # --------------------------
  if ("gene_name" %in% colnames(df)) {
    gene_col <- "gene_name"
  } else if ("gene" %in% colnames(df)) {
    gene_col <- "gene"
  } else if ("Gene" %in% colnames(df)) {
    gene_col <- "Gene"
  } else {
    df$gene_name <- rownames(df)
    gene_col <- "gene_name"
  }

  # --------------------------
  # fold change column
  # --------------------------
  if ("logFC" %in% colnames(df)) {
    fc_col <- "logFC"
  } else if ("log2FoldChange" %in% colnames(df)) {
    fc_col <- "log2FoldChange"
  } else {
    stop(paste("No fold-change column found in:", fp))
  }

  # --------------------------
  # p-value column
  # --------------------------
  if ("PValue" %in% colnames(df)) {
    p_col <- "PValue"
  } else if ("pvalue" %in% colnames(df)) {
    p_col <- "pvalue"
  } else if ("p_val" %in% colnames(df)) {
    p_col <- "p_val"
  } else {
    stop(paste("No p-value column found in:", fp))
  }

  # --------------------------
  # OPTIONAL FILTER (snRNA ONLY)
  # --------------------------
  if (model_name %in% c("Glut", "L23_IT", "L45_IT")) {

    if ("logCPM" %in% colnames(df)) {
      df <- df %>% dplyr::filter(logCPM >= 1)
    }

    if ("baseMean" %in% colnames(df)) {
      df <- df %>% dplyr::filter(baseMean > 10)
    }
  }

  # --------------------------
  # build standardized df
  # --------------------------
  df %>%
    mutate(
      gene_name = .data[[gene_col]],
      Model = model_name,
      DE = ifelse(.data[[fc_col]] > 0, "up", "down"),
      PValue = .data[[p_col]]
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(gene_name, PValue, Model, DE)
}
```

## Dotplots for percent DEGs in ChIP/ASD gene sets (for Fig)

```{r}


# --------------------------
# Percent of DEGs overlapping each gene set
# Significance: one-sided Fisher's exact test for enrichment
# --------------------------

deg_pct_stats_df <- NULL

for (ct in unique(Bulk_DE$Model)) {

  DE <- Bulk_DE %>%
    dplyr::filter(Model == ct) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(gene_name), gene_name != "") %>%
    dplyr::distinct(gene_name, .keep_all = TRUE)

  background <- unique(DE$gene_name)
  n_background <- length(background)

  for (st in c("down", "up")) {

    DEGs <- DE %>%
      dplyr::filter(PValue < 0.05, DE == st) %>%
      dplyr::pull(gene_name) %>%
      unique()

    n_DEGs <- length(DEGs)

    results_df <- data.frame(
      Gene_set = character(),
      p_value = numeric(),
      observed_overlap = numeric(),
      n_DEGs = numeric(),
      bg_overlap = numeric(),
      n_background = numeric(),
      pct_DEGs_in_set = numeric(),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )

    for (gene_set_name in names(gene_sets_use)) {

      Gene_set <- intersect(unique(gene_sets_use[[gene_set_name]]), background)

      observed <- length(intersect(Gene_set, DEGs))
      bg_overlap <- length(Gene_set)

      pct_DEGs_in_set <- if (n_DEGs == 0) NA_real_ else 100 * observed / n_DEGs

      # Fisher table:
      # rows = DEG / not DEG, columns = in gene set / not in gene set
      a <- observed
      b <- n_DEGs - observed
      c <- bg_overlap - observed
      d <- n_background - n_DEGs - c

      p_val <- if (n_DEGs == 0 || bg_overlap == 0 || any(c(a, b, c, d) < 0)) {
        NA_real_
      } else {
        fisher.test(
          matrix(c(a, b, c, d), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE),
          alternative = "greater"
        )$p.value
      }

      results_df <- rbind(results_df, data.frame(
        Gene_set = gene_set_name,
        p_value = p_val,
        observed_overlap = observed,
        n_DEGs = n_DEGs,
        bg_overlap = bg_overlap,
        n_background = n_background,
        pct_DEGs_in_set = pct_DEGs_in_set
      ))
    }

    results_df$padj <- p.adjust(results_df$p_value, method = "BH")
    results_df$Model <- ct
    results_df$DE <- st

    deg_pct_stats_df <- bind_rows(deg_pct_stats_df, results_df)
  }
}

# Clean + rename + order
# --------------------------
```

## Combined GSEA supp tables

```{r}

# A long/tidy table is the most standard multi-dataset GSEA supplement:
# one row per Dataset x Direction x GO term, preserving NES, p.adjust,
# qvalue, pvalue, setSize, leading edge/core genes, etc.
# Wide NES/padj matrices are also saved for quick cross-dataset scanning.

gsea_dir <- "output/GSEA/final_DE"
supp_dir <- "output/GSEA/final_DE/supp_tables"
dir.create(supp_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

gsea_files <- list.files(
  gsea_dir,
  pattern = "_(up|down)\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

read_gsea_result <- function(fp) {
  fn <- basename(fp)
  direction <- sub("^.*_(up|down)\\.csv$", "\\1", fn)
  dataset <- sub("_(up|down)\\.csv$", "", fn)

  readr::read_csv(fp, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Dataset = dataset,
      Direction = direction,
      Source_file = fn,
      Term = Description,
      Dataset_direction = paste(Dataset, Direction, sep = "__")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      Dataset,
      Direction,
      Dataset_direction,
      ID,
      Term,
      Description,
      NES,
      enrichmentScore,
      pvalue,
      p.adjust,
      qvalue,
      rank,
      setSize,
      Count,
      GeneRatio,
      leading_edge,
      core_enrichment,
      Source_file,
      dplyr::everything()
    )
}

gsea_supp_long <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(gsea_files, read_gsea_result)) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Dataset, Direction, p.adjust, dplyr::desc(abs(NES)))

gsea_supp_nes_wide <- gsea_supp_long %>%
  dplyr::select(ID, Term, Dataset_direction, NES) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Dataset_direction, values_from = NES)

gsea_supp_padj_wide <- gsea_supp_long %>%
  dplyr::select(ID, Term, Dataset_direction, p.adjust) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Dataset_direction, values_from = p.adjust)

gsea_supp_qvalue_wide <- gsea_supp_long %>%
  dplyr::select(ID, Term, Dataset_direction, qvalue) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Dataset_direction, values_from = qvalue)

readme <- data.frame(
  Field = c(
    "Dataset",
    "Direction",
    "NES",
    "p.adjust",
    "qvalue",
    "rank",
    "core_enrichment",
    "Ranking metric used for GSEA"
  ),
  Description = c(
    "DE comparison / dataset name parsed from the GSEA output file prefix.",
    "Direction split from GSEA output: up = NES > 0, down = NES < 0.",
    "Normalized enrichment score from clusterProfiler::gseGO.",
    "Multiple-testing adjusted GSEA p-value from clusterProfiler::gseGO.",
    "GSEA q-value from clusterProfiler::gseGO.",
    "Position of the term enrichment maximum/minimum in the ranked gene list.",
    "Slash-separated leading-edge/core genes returned by gseGO.",
    "Genes were ranked as -log10(PValue) * logFC before running gseGO."
  )
)

readr::write_csv(
  gsea_supp_long,
  file.path(supp_dir, "GSEA_all_datasets_long.csv")
)

readr::write_csv(
  gsea_supp_nes_wide,
  file.path(supp_dir, "GSEA_all_datasets_NES_wide.csv")
)

readr::write_csv(
  gsea_supp_padj_wide,
  file.path(supp_dir, "GSEA_all_datasets_padj_wide.csv")
)

readr::write_csv(
  gsea_supp_qvalue_wide,
  file.path(supp_dir, "GSEA_all_datasets_qvalue_wide.csv")
)

if (requireNamespace("writexl", quietly = TRUE)) {
  writexl::write_xlsx(
    list(
      README = readme,
      long_all_results = gsea_supp_long,
      NES_wide = gsea_supp_nes_wide,
      padj_wide = gsea_supp_padj_wide,
      qvalue_wide = gsea_supp_qvalue_wide
    ),
    path = file.path(supp_dir, "GSEA_all_datasets_supplement.xlsx")
  )
}

```

```{r}
  ~module, ~primary_cell_type, ~module_summary, ~hdwgcna_direction, ~GSEA_pathway,
  "M1", "Glutamatergic broadly", "Synaptic structure/function", "up", "Synaptic signaling",
  "M3", "L4/5 IT Glut", "Synaptic structure/function", "up", "Synaptic signaling",
  "M2", "L5 IT Glut", "Protein localization to synapse", "up", "protein localization to synapse",
  "M2", "L5 IT Glut", "Axonogenesis", "up", "axonogenesis",
  "M4", "L2/3 IT Glut", "Mitochondrial function/energetics", "up", "ATP synthesis/cellular respiration",
  "M4", "L2/3 IT Glut", "Translation/ribosome assembly", "up", "Translation",
  "M6", "L4/5 IT Glut", "Splicing", "down", "RNA processing/splicing",
  "M7", "Glutamatergic broadly", "Circadian rhythm", "up", "Circadian sleep/wake cycle",
  "M7", "Glutamatergic broadly", "Cognition/learning or memory", "up", "Learning or memory",
  "M7", "Glutamatergic broadly", "Synaptic signaling", "up", "Synaptic signaling",
  "M9", "L2/3 IT Glut", "Translation/ribosome assembly", "up", "Translation",
  "M10", "L4/5 IT Glut", "Cell adhesion", "up", "cell adhesion",
  "M10", "L4/5 IT Glut", "Synapse organization", "up", "Synaptic signaling"
) %>%
  mutate(
    hdwgcna_arrow = case_when(
      hdwgcna_direction == "up" ~ "↑",
      hdwgcna_direction == "down" ~ "↓",
      TRUE ~ ""
    ),
    module_label = paste0(module, "\n", primary_cell_type)
  )

read_gsea_nes <- function(fp, direction = c("up", "down")) {
  direction <- match.arg(direction)

  readr::read_csv(fp, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    transmute(
      GSEA_pathway_raw = as.character(Description),
      GSEA_pathway_key = stringr::str_to_lower(GSEA_pathway_raw),
      NES = as.numeric(NES)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      NES = if (direction == "down") -abs(NES) else abs(NES)
    )
}

const_nuc_schematic_nes <- readxl::read_excel(gsea_only_fp, sheet = "NES") %>%
  transmute(
    GSEA_pathway_key = stringr::str_to_lower(Pathway),
    schematic_GSEA_pathway = Pathway,
    schematic_NES = `Chd8+/- Nuc`
  )

const_nuc_gsea_terms <- bind_rows(
  read_gsea_nes(file.path(gsea_dir, "Const_nuc_PC12_up.csv"), "up"),
  read_gsea_nes(file.path(gsea_dir, "Const_nuc_PC12_down.csv"), "down")
) %>%
  filter(!is.na(GSEA_pathway_key), !is.na(NES)) %>%
  group_by(GSEA_pathway_key) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = abs(NES), n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  rename(
    direct_GSEA_pathway = GSEA_pathway_raw,
    direct_NES = NES
  )

const_nuc_mean_logfc <- readxl::read_excel(gsea_only_fp, sheet = "mean_logFC") %>%
  transmute(
    GSEA_pathway_key = stringr::str_to_lower(Pathway),
    const_nuc_mean_logFC = `Chd8+/- Nuc`
  )

hdwgcna_const_nuc_alignment <- hdwgcna_module_map %>%
  mutate(GSEA_pathway_key = stringr::str_to_lower(GSEA_pathway)) %>%
  left_join(const_nuc_schematic_nes, by = "GSEA_pathway_key") %>%
  left_join(const_nuc_gsea_terms, by = "GSEA_pathway_key") %>%
  left_join(const_nuc_mean_logfc, by = "GSEA_pathway_key") %>%
  mutate(
    GSEA_pathway_display = coalesce(schematic_GSEA_pathway, direct_GSEA_pathway, GSEA_pathway),
    NES_source = case_when(
      !is.na(schematic_NES) ~ "schematic_collapsed",
      !is.na(direct_NES) ~ "direct_GSEA_term",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    const_nuc_NES = coalesce(schematic_NES, direct_NES),
    const_nuc_direction = case_when(
      const_nuc_NES > 0 ~ "up",
      const_nuc_NES < 0 ~ "down",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    const_nuc_arrow = case_when(
      const_nuc_direction == "up" ~ "↑",
      const_nuc_direction == "down" ~ "↓",
      TRUE ~ ""
    ),
    alignment = case_when(
      is.na(const_nuc_direction) ~ "No Const_nuc NES",
      const_nuc_direction == hdwgcna_direction ~ "Agree",
      TRUE ~ "Disagree"
    ),
    plot_label = case_when(
      is.na(const_nuc_direction) ~ paste0(hdwgcna_arrow, " / no Nuc NES"),
      TRUE ~ paste0(hdwgcna_arrow, " / ", const_nuc_arrow, "\nNES=", round(const_nuc_NES, 2))
    ),
    GSEA_pathway_plot = GSEA_pathway_display
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    factor(module, levels = c("M1", "M3", "M2", "M4", "M6", "M7", "M9", "M10")),
    GSEA_pathway_plot
  )

hdwgcna_const_nuc_summary <- hdwgcna_const_nuc_alignment %>%
  count(module, primary_cell_type, alignment, name = "n_terms") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = alignment,
    values_from = n_terms,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  arrange(factor(module, levels = c("M1", "M3", "M2", "M4", "M6", "M7", "M9", "M10")))

writexl::write_xlsx(
  list(
    module_term_alignment = hdwgcna_const_nuc_alignment,
    module_summary = hdwgcna_const_nuc_summary
  ),
  file.path(outdir_hdwgcna_gsea, "hdWGCNA_module_Const_nuc_GSEA_alignment.xlsx")
)

alignment_colors <- c(
  "Agree" = "#2C7A3F",
  "Disagree" = "#C43C39",
  "No Const_nuc NES" = "#BDBDBD"
)

hdwgcna_const_nuc_alignment_plot <- ggplot(
  hdwgcna_const_nuc_alignment,
  aes(
    x = stringr::str_wrap(GSEA_pathway_plot, width = 18),
    y = factor(module_label, levels = rev(unique(module_label))),
    fill = alignment
  )
) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_text(aes(label = plot_label), size = 3.4, lineheight = 0.9) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = alignment_colors, drop = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Glutamatergic hdWGCNA module direction vs bulk Const_nuc GSEA",
    subtitle = "Alignment is based on the sign of Const_nuc NES, not schematic-arrow thresholds",
    x = "GSEA pathway",
    y = "hdWGCNA module",
    fill = "bulk GSEA vs\nhdWGCNA"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

ggsave(
  file.path(outdir_hdwgcna_gsea, "hdWGCNA_module_Const_nuc_GSEA_alignment.pdf"),
  hdwgcna_const_nuc_alignment_plot,
  width = 12,
  height = 6.5
)
```

```{r}
    down = readr::read_csv(file.path(gsea_outdir, "Const_nuc_PC12_down.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
  ),

  ),

  )

get_signed_nes <- function(term_of_interest, dataset_name) {
  up_df <- const_gsea_signed[[dataset_name]]$up
  down_df <- const_gsea_signed[[dataset_name]]$down

  nes_up <- up_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(Description == term_of_interest) %>%
    dplyr::pull(NES)

  nes_down <- down_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(Description == term_of_interest) %>%
    dplyr::pull(NES)

  if (length(nes_up) > 0) return(as.numeric(nes_up[[1]]))
  if (length(nes_down) > 0) return(-abs(as.numeric(nes_down[[1]])))
  NA_real_
}

calc_pval_weighted_mean_logfc <- function(df, p_cap = 10) {
  df2 <- df %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(logFC), !is.na(PValue))

  if (nrow(df2) == 0) return(NA_real_)

  w <- -log10(pmax(df2$PValue, 1e-300))
  w <- pmin(w, p_cap)

  if (sum(w, na.rm = TRUE) == 0) return(NA_real_)

  sum(df2$logFC * w, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(w, na.rm = TRUE)
}

make_go_gene_table <- function(term_of_interest) {
  term2go <- suppressMessages(
    AnnotationDbi::select(
      GO.db::GO.db,
      keys = term_of_interest,
      keytype = "TERM",
      columns = c("GOID", "ONTOLOGY")
    )
  )

  goids <- unique(as.character(term2go$GOID[!is.na(term2go$GOID) & term2go$ONTOLOGY == "BP"]))

  go2sym <- suppressMessages(
    AnnotationDbi::select(
      org.Mm.eg.db::org.Mm.eg.db,
      keys = goids,
      keytype = "GOALL",
      columns = "SYMBOL"
    )
  )

  term_symbols <- unique(as.character(go2sym$SYMBOL[!is.na(go2sym$SYMBOL) & go2sym$SYMBOL != ""]))

  wb <- openxlsx::createWorkbook()
  sheet_order <- c("Nuc", "Cyt", "Syn", "Whole")
  out_fp <- file.path(gene_table_outdir, paste0(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", term_of_interest), ".xlsx"))

  tables_out <- lapply(sheet_order, function(dataset_name) {
    de_df <- const_de_raw[[dataset_name]] %>%
      dplyr::filter(gene_name %in% term_symbols)

    nes_val <- get_signed_nes(term_of_interest, dataset_name)
    mean_logfc_val <- if (nrow(de_df) == 0) NA_real_ else mean(de_df$logFC, na.rm = TRUE)
    pval_mean_logfc_val <- calc_pval_weighted_mean_logfc(de_df)

    out_df <- de_df %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        NES = nes_val,
        mean_logFC = mean_logfc_val,
        pval_mean_logFC = pval_mean_logfc_val,
        gsea_rank_metric = -log10(PValue) * logFC,
        gsea_rank_position = dplyr::dense_rank(dplyr::desc(gsea_rank_metric))
      ) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(PValue, dplyr::desc(abs(logFC))) %>%
      dplyr::select(
        gene_id,
        gene_name,
        !!paste0("logFC_const_", tolower(dataset_name)) := logFC,
        !!paste0("pvalue_const_", tolower(dataset_name)) := PValue,
        NES,
        mean_logFC,
        pval_mean_logFC,
        gsea_rank_metric,
        gsea_rank_position
      )

    openxlsx::addWorksheet(wb, dataset_name)
    openxlsx::writeData(wb, sheet = dataset_name, x = out_df)
    out_df
  })

  names(tables_out) <- sheet_order
  openxlsx::saveWorkbook(wb, out_fp, overwrite = TRUE)
  tables_out
}

gene_tables <- stats::setNames(lapply(terms_of_interest, make_go_gene_table), terms_of_interest)

gene_tables
```

```{r}

interpretation_out_fp <- "output/plots/interpretation_dictionary.xlsx"
dir.create(dirname(interpretation_out_fp), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

make_interpretation_df <- function(pattern, interpretation, example = "") {
  data.frame(
    Pattern = pattern,
    Interpretation = interpretation,
    Example = example,
    check.names = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

interpretation_sheets <- list(
  "Const vs Cond" = make_interpretation_df(
    pattern = c(
      "Const + Cond HET shared",
      "Const + Cond HOM shared",
      "Cond HET + Cond HOM shared, with HOM stronger",
      "Const + Cond HET + Cond HOM all shared",
      "Const-only",
      "Cond-only",
      "Cond HOM-only"
    ),
    interpretation = c(
      "Likely neuron-autonomous or neuron-dominant effects of Chd8 loss. Stronger if also seen in Syn or Glut/L23/L45 pseudobulk.",
      "Also supports neuron-related Chd8 effects. If HOM is much stronger, the effect is likely dosage-sensitive and becomes clearer with stronger Chd8 loss.",
      "Best evidence for a dosage-dependent neuronal effect; this is the cleanest conditional-model logic.",
      "Strongest case for a robust Chd8-responsive program conserved across germline and neuron-targeted models.",
      "Could reflect non-neuronal effects, developmental/germline effects, secondary tissue or circuit effects, or effects compensated or diluted differently in the conditional model.",
      "Could reflect neuron-specific effects masked or diluted in the germline model, a stronger acute/adult neuronal response, Cre/model-specific effects, or loss-of-function severity effects.",
      "Could mean the pathway requires stronger Chd8 reduction to move, or that complete neuronal loss reveals changes not detectable in HET."
    )
  ),

  "Nuc Syn Cyt" = make_interpretation_df(
    pattern = c(
      "Nuc + Syn same direction",
      "Nuc-only",
      "Syn-only",
      "Nuc and Syn opposite",
      "Cyt"
    ),
    interpretation = c(
      "Transcriptional or nuclear changes are reflected in synaptosomal/localized RNA, suggesting the change propagates from nuclear abundance to synaptic RNA pools.",
      "Likely nuclear/transcriptional regulation, cell-type composition effects, non-neuronal signal, nuclear-retained or processing-related effects, or changes that do not reach the synaptic RNA pool.",
      "Suggests post-transcriptional or local RNA regulation, including altered trafficking, localization, stability, decay, local translation-associated RNA pools, or synapse-enriched biology.",
      "Suggests decoupling between transcriptional abundance and localized RNA abundance, potentially from altered transport or stability, compensatory redistribution, or different cell types driving each compartment.",
      "Cyt is a mixed intermediate. If Cyt tracks Nuc, it may reflect general cellular RNA abundance; if it tracks Syn, it may reflect post-nuclear RNA handling or transport; if distinct from both, it may reflect cytoplasm-biased cell types or RNA stability/processing effects."
    )
  ),

  "Bulk Nuc snRNA" = make_interpretation_df(
    pattern = c(
      "Bulk Nuc + snRNA-seq same direction",
      "snRNA-seq change but no bulk Nuc change",
      "Bulk Nuc change but no snRNA-seq neuronal change",
      "Opposite bulk Nuc vs snRNA-seq"
    ),
    interpretation = c(
      "Supports the idea that the bulk nuclear signal is at least partly driven by that neuronal cell type; strongest when also present across Cond HET/HOM.",
      "The effect may be cell-type-specific but diluted in bulk Nuc because bulk Nuc contains all cell types. It could also be too weak, too sparse, or offset by opposite changes in other cell types.",
      "Could reflect non-neuronal cells, another neuronal subtype not shown, developmental/germline effects, or fraction/bulk-specific technical or biological differences.",
      "The named neuronal subtype is probably not the main driver of the bulk Nuc direction. The bulk signal may be driven by other cell types, other neuronal populations, or opposing changes across cell types."
    )
  ),

  "hdWGCNA" = make_interpretation_df(
    pattern = c(
      "Module-level context",
      "Module genes change in snRNA-seq and bulk Nuc same direction",
      "Module genes change in snRNA-seq but not bulk Nuc",
      "Module genes change in bulk Nuc but not snRNA-seq",
      "Module genes opposite in snRNA-seq vs bulk Nuc",
      "M1",
      "M4",
      "M6",
      "M7"
    ),
    interpretation = c(
      "Because hdWGCNA was done only in Glut neurons, module-level changes should be interpreted as glutamatergic neuronal programs, not whole-tissue programs.",
      "Good evidence that the bulk nuclear signature reflects that glutamatergic module.",
      "The module may be real in Glut neurons but diluted in bulk Nuc, especially if only a subset such as L23 or L45 drives it.",
      "Could reflect non-Glut contribution, another cell type, another neuronal subtype, or a bulk/fraction-specific signal.",
      "Suggests the module's Glut-neuron behavior is not driving the bulk Nuc direction. Other cell types or opposing Glut subtypes may dominate the bulk signal.",
      "A robust glutamatergic neuronal program captured in bulk nuclear data; Cond HOM strength supports a neuron-linked and possibly dosage-sensitive Chd8 effect.",
      "The L23 module is not the main driver of the Const bulk nuclear direction; Cond Nuc agreeing more with L23 may indicate the L23 program is revealed when Chd8 loss is restricted to excitatory neurons.",
      "A conditional neuron-linked, dosage-sensitive module that may be diluted, compensated, or absent in the germline model.",
      "May not be a direct consequence of Camk2a-Cre neuronal Chd8 loss; could reflect germline/developmental effects, non-neuronal contribution, broader tissue-state changes, or compensation/circuit-level effects present only in the constitutive model."
    ),
    example = c(
      "",
      "",
      "",
      "",
      "",
      "Genes go up in Glut and up across Const/Cond HET/Cond HOM Nuc.",
      "Up in L23, down in Const Nuc, and up in Cond Nuc.",
      "Down in L45 pseudobulk and Cond HET, stronger down in Cond HOM, but weak/not clearly down in Const.",
      "Changing in Const but not Cond."
    )
  )
)

wb <- openxlsx::createWorkbook()

header_style <- openxlsx::createStyle(
  fontColour = "white",

  textDecoration = "bold",
  valign = "top",
  wrapText = TRUE
)

for (sheet_name in names(interpretation_sheets)) {
  openxlsx::addWorksheet(wb, sheet_name)
  openxlsx::writeData(wb, sheet = sheet_name, x = interpretation_sheets[[sheet_name]])
  openxlsx::addStyle(wb, sheet = sheet_name, style = header_style, rows = 1, cols = 1:3, gridExpand = TRUE)
  openxlsx::addStyle(
    wb, sheet = sheet_name, style = body_style,
    rows = 2:(nrow(interpretation_sheets[[sheet_name]]) + 1), cols = 1:3,
    gridExpand = TRUE
  )
  openxlsx::addStyle(
    wb, sheet = sheet_name, style = pattern_style,
    rows = 2:(nrow(interpretation_sheets[[sheet_name]]) + 1), cols = 1,
    gridExpand = TRUE, stack = TRUE
  )
  openxlsx::setColWidths(wb, sheet = sheet_name, cols = 1, widths = 36)
  openxlsx::setColWidths(wb, sheet = sheet_name, cols = 2, widths = 95)
  openxlsx::setColWidths(wb, sheet = sheet_name, cols = 3, widths = 70)
  openxlsx::setRowHeights(wb, sheet = sheet_name, rows = 1, heights = 28)
  openxlsx::setRowHeights(
    wb, sheet = sheet_name,
    rows = 2:(nrow(interpretation_sheets[[sheet_name]]) + 1),
    heights = 72
  )
  openxlsx::freezePane(wb, sheet = sheet_name, firstRow = TRUE)
  openxlsx::addFilter(wb, sheet = sheet_name, rows = 1, cols = 1:3)
}
```

## PC correlations with Rpl/Rps CPM across constitutive bulk datasets

```{r}
# Recalculate the original mt_CPM and ribo_CPM metrics plus rpls_CPM.
# rpls_CPM matches the DE model-testing definition: summed CPM across
# genes whose symbols begin with Rpl or Rps.
add_rpls_CPM_for_pc_screen <- function(counts, meta, my_gene) {
  samples <- colnames(counts)
  stopifnot(all(samples %in% meta$Sample))

  gene_map <- my_gene[, c("gene_id", "gene_name")]
  gene_map <- gene_map[!duplicated(gene_map$gene_id), , drop = FALSE]
  rownames(gene_map) <- gene_map$gene_id

  gene_symbols <- as.character(gene_map[rownames(counts), "gene_name"])
  gene_symbols[is.na(gene_symbols)] <- ""
  mt_idx <- grep("^mt-", gene_symbols, ignore.case = TRUE)
  rrna_ids <- my_gene$gene_id[my_gene$gene_biotype %in% "rRNA"]
  ribo_idx <- which(rownames(counts) %in% rrna_ids)
  rpls_idx <- grep("^(Rpl|Rps)", gene_symbols)

  dge <- edgeR::DGEList(
    counts = replace(as.matrix(counts), is.na(counts), 0)
  )
  cpm_mat <- edgeR::cpm(dge, log = FALSE)

  mt_CPM <- if (length(mt_idx) > 0) {
    colSums(cpm_mat[mt_idx, , drop = FALSE])
  } else {
    rep(NA_real_, ncol(cpm_mat))
  }

  ribo_CPM <- if (length(ribo_idx) > 0) {
    colSums(cpm_mat[ribo_idx, , drop = FALSE])
  } else {
    rep(NA_real_, ncol(cpm_mat))
  }

  rpls_CPM <- if (length(rpls_idx) > 0) {
    colSums(cpm_mat[rpls_idx, , drop = FALSE])
  } else {
    rep(NA_real_, ncol(cpm_mat))
  }

  rpls_df <- data.frame(
    Sample = samples,
    mt_CPM = as.numeric(mt_CPM),
    ribo_CPM = as.numeric(ribo_CPM),
    rpls_CPM = as.numeric(rpls_CPM),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  meta %>%
    dplyr::select(
      -dplyr::any_of(c("mt_CPM", "ribo_CPM", "rpls_CPM"))
    ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(rpls_df, by = "Sample")
}

# Use the exact count matrices and metadata used by the original
# "# Run once to check PCs" calls.
metadata_const_syn_nuc_cyt_rpls <- add_rpls_CPM_for_pc_screen(
  exp_data_const_syn_nuc_cyt,
  metadata_const_syn_nuc_cyt,
  my_gene
)

meta_const_rpls <- metadata_const_cond_whole %>%
  dplyr::filter(Batch != "Cond") %>%

counts_const_rpls <- exp_data_const_cond_whole[
  , meta_const_rpls$Sample,
  drop = FALSE
]

meta_const_rpls <- meta_const_rpls[
  match(colnames(counts_const_rpls), meta_const_rpls$Sample),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]
stopifnot(identical(colnames(counts_const_rpls), meta_const_rpls$Sample))

meta_const_rpls <- add_rpls_CPM_for_pc_screen(
  counts_const_rpls,
  meta_const_rpls,
  my_gene
)

run_pc_rpls_screen_tmm <- function(
    counts,
    meta,
    my_gene,
    fraction_keep = "Syn",
    genotypes_keep = c("WT", "HET"),
    n_pc_check = 10,
    show_heatmap = TRUE,
    sig_r = 0.4,
    sig_p = 0.05,
    include_batch = FALSE,
    include_sex = TRUE,
    drop_samples = "Outliers",
    genes_use = c("protein_coding", "all"),
    heatmap_label = NULL,
    ...
) {
  genes_use <- match.arg(genes_use)

  norm_frac <- function(x) {
    x <- trimws(tolower(as.character(x)))
    x <- ifelse(x %in% c("syn", "synaptic"), "syn", x)
    x <- ifelse(x %in% c("nuc", "nuclear", "nuclei"), "nuc", x)
    x <- ifelse(x %in% c("cyt", "cyto", "cytoplasm", "cytoplasmic", "cytoplasma"), "cyt", x)
    x <- ifelse(x %in% c("whole", "all"), "whole", x)
    x
  }

  meta_local <- meta
  meta_local$Fraction <- norm_frac(meta_local$Fraction)

  if (is.null(drop_samples)) drop_samples <- "Outliers"
  drop_none <- is.character(drop_samples) && length(drop_samples) == 1 && drop_samples == "None"
  drop_outliers <- is.character(drop_samples) && length(drop_samples) == 1 && drop_samples == "Outliers"

  sample_prefix <- sub("_.*$", "", as.character(meta_local$Sample))
  keep_mask <- rep(TRUE, nrow(meta_local))

  if (drop_outliers) {
    if (!"Outlier" %in% names(meta_local)) {
      message("drop_samples='Outliers' but no 'Outlier' column found; not dropping any outliers.")
    } else {
      ol <- meta_local$Outlier
      if (is.factor(ol)) ol <- as.character(ol)
      if (is.character(ol)) {
        ol <- trimws(tolower(ol)) %in% c("true", "t", "1", "yes", "y")
      } else if (is.numeric(ol)) {
        ol <- ol != 0
      } else if (!is.logical(ol)) {
        ol <- as.logical(ol)
      }
      keep_mask <- keep_mask & (!ol)
    }
  }

  if (!drop_none && !drop_outliers) {
    keep_mask <- keep_mask & !(sample_prefix %in% unique(drop_samples))
  }

  meta_local <- meta_local[keep_mask, , drop = FALSE]

  metadata_filt <- meta_local %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      Fraction == norm_frac(fraction_keep),
      Genotype %in% genotypes_keep
    ) %>%
    droplevels()

  if ("WT" %in% unique(metadata_filt$Genotype)) {
    metadata_filt$Genotype <- factor(
      metadata_filt$Genotype,
      levels = unique(c("WT", setdiff(genotypes_keep, "WT")))
    )
  } else {
    metadata_filt$Genotype <- factor(metadata_filt$Genotype, levels = genotypes_keep)
  }
  metadata_filt$Sex <- factor(metadata_filt$Sex)

  use.cols <- metadata_filt$Sample
  stopifnot(all(use.cols %in% colnames(counts)))
  test.data <- counts[, use.cols, drop = FALSE]
  rownames(test.data) <- as.character(rownames(test.data))
  test.data <- replace(as.matrix(test.data), is.na(test.data), 0)

  if (genes_use == "protein_coding") {
    pc_ids <- my_gene %>%
      dplyr::filter(gene_biotype == "protein_coding") %>%
      dplyr::pull(gene_id) %>%
      unique()
    test.data <- test.data[rownames(test.data) %in% pc_ids, , drop = FALSE]
  }

  md <- metadata_filt[match(colnames(test.data), metadata_filt$Sample), , drop = FALSE]
  stopifnot(identical(colnames(test.data), md$Sample))

  y <- edgeR::DGEList(
    counts = test.data,
    group = factor(as.character(md$Genotype), levels = levels(md$Genotype))
  )
  keep <- rowSums(edgeR::cpm(y) > 1) >= 4
  y <- y[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
  y <- edgeR::calcNormFactors(y)

  logcpm_tmm <- edgeR::cpm(y, log = TRUE, normalized.lib.sizes = TRUE)
  pca.results <- stats::prcomp(t(logcpm_tmm), center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)

  pc_scores <- as.data.frame(pca.results$x)
  pc_scores$Sample <- rownames(pc_scores)

  md_pca <- md[match(pc_scores$Sample, md$Sample), , drop = FALSE]
  stopifnot(identical(md_pca$Sample, pc_scores$Sample))
  md_pca <- dplyr::left_join(md_pca, pc_scores, by = "Sample")

  cand_vars <- c(
    "Genotype", "Sex", "Sequencing_batch", "Read_depth", "Splicing.rate",
    "mt_CPM", "ribo_CPM", "rpls_CPM"
  )
  covars <- intersect(cand_vars, colnames(md_pca))
  K <- min(n_pc_check, ncol(pca.results$x))

  to_num <- function(x) {
    if (is.factor(x) || is.character(x)) as.numeric(as.factor(x)) else suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
  }

  r_mat <- matrix(
    NA_real_,
    nrow = length(covars),
    ncol = K,
    dimnames = list(covars, paste0("PC", seq_len(K)))
  )
  p_mat <- r_mat

  for (i in seq_along(covars)) {
    xnum <- to_num(md_pca[[covars[i]]])
    for (k in seq_len(K)) {
      pc_name <- paste0("PC", k)
      r_mat[i, k] <- suppressWarnings(stats::cor(md_pca[[pc_name]], xnum, use = "pair"))
      p_mat[i, k] <- tryCatch(
        stats::cor.test(md_pca[[pc_name]], xnum)$p.value,
        error = function(e) NA_real_
      )
    }
  }

  sig_mask <- (abs(r_mat) >= sig_r) & (p_mat < sig_p)
  sig_mask[is.na(sig_mask)] <- FALSE

  if (isTRUE(show_heatmap) && length(covars) > 0 && K > 0) {
    num_r <- matrix(sprintf("%.2f", r_mat), nrow = nrow(r_mat), dimnames = dimnames(r_mat))
    num_r[sig_mask] <- paste0(num_r[sig_mask], "*")

    num_p <- matrix(sprintf("%.2e", p_mat), nrow = nrow(p_mat), dimnames = dimnames(p_mat))
    num_p[sig_mask] <- paste0(num_p[sig_mask], "*")

    pheatmap::pheatmap(
      r_mat,
      display_numbers = num_r,
      cluster_rows = FALSE,
      cluster_cols = FALSE,
      color = colorRampPalette(c("#4575b4", "#f7f7f7", "#d73027"))(200),
      number_color = "black",
      fontsize_number = 9,
      na_col = "grey90",
      main = paste0(
        if (!is.null(heatmap_label)) paste0(heatmap_label, ": ") else "",
        "TMM-logCPM PCA correlation (Pearson r) of PCs vs covariates"
      ),
      angle_col = 0
    )

    pheatmap::pheatmap(
      p_mat,
      display_numbers = num_p,
      cluster_rows = FALSE,
      cluster_cols = FALSE,
      color = colorRampPalette(c("#ffffcc", "#fdae61", "#d73027"))(200),
      number_color = "black",
      fontsize_number = 9,
      na_col = "grey90",
      main = paste0(
        if (!is.null(heatmap_label)) paste0(heatmap_label, ": ") else "",
        "TMM-logCPM PC-covariate correlation p values"
      ),
      angle_col = 0
    )
  }

  list(
    y = y,
    pca = pca.results,
    pc_scores = pc_scores,
    md_pca = md_pca,
    r_mat = r_mat,
    p_mat = p_mat
  )
}
```

## How much Rpl/Rps CPM is captured by PC1 and PC2?

```{r}
fit_rpls_pc12 <- function(pc_screen_result, dataset_label) {
  model_df <- pc_screen_result$md_pca %>%
    dplyr::select(Sample, Genotype, PC1, PC2, rpls_CPM) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      is.finite(rpls_CPM),
      is.finite(PC1),
      is.finite(PC2)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Genotype = stats::relevel(factor(Genotype), ref = "WT"))

  fit_pc <- stats::lm(rpls_CPM ~ PC1 + PC2, data = model_df)
  fit_pc_summary <- summary(fit_pc)

  model_p_pc <- stats::pf(
    fit_pc_summary$fstatistic[["value"]],
    fit_pc_summary$fstatistic[["numdf"]],
    fit_pc_summary$fstatistic[["dendf"]],
    lower.tail = FALSE
  )

  fit_genotype <- stats::lm(rpls_CPM ~ Genotype, data = model_df)
  fit_genotype_pc <- stats::lm(rpls_CPM ~ Genotype + PC1 + PC2, data = model_df)

  fit_pc_genotype <- stats::glm(
    Genotype ~ PC1 + PC2,
    data = model_df,
    family = stats::binomial()
  )
  pc_genotype_lrt <- stats::anova(
    stats::glm(Genotype ~ 1, data = model_df, family = stats::binomial()),
    fit_pc_genotype,
    test = "LRT"
  )

  model_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    data.frame(
      dataset = dataset_label,
      model = "rpls_CPM ~ PC1 + PC2",
      n = nrow(model_df),
      r_squared = fit_pc_summary$r.squared,
      adjusted_r_squared = fit_pc_summary$adj.r.squared,
      model_p_value = model_p_pc,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ),
    data.frame(
      dataset = dataset_label,
      model = "rpls_CPM ~ Genotype",
      n = nrow(model_df),
      r_squared = summary(fit_genotype)$r.squared,
      adjusted_r_squared = summary(fit_genotype)$adj.r.squared,
      model_p_value = stats::anova(fit_genotype)$`Pr(>F)`[1],
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ),
    data.frame(
      dataset = dataset_label,
      model = "rpls_CPM ~ Genotype + PC1 + PC2",
      n = nrow(model_df),
      r_squared = summary(fit_genotype_pc)$r.squared,
      adjusted_r_squared = summary(fit_genotype_pc)$adj.r.squared,
      model_p_value = stats::anova(fit_genotype_pc)$`Pr(>F)`[1],
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ),
    data.frame(
      dataset = dataset_label,
      model = "Genotype ~ PC1 + PC2",
      n = nrow(model_df),
      r_squared = NA_real_,
      adjusted_r_squared = NA_real_,
      model_p_value = pc_genotype_lrt$`Pr(>Chi)`[2],
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  )

  pc_coefs <- as.data.frame(fit_pc_summary$coefficients) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("term") %>%
    dplyr::rename(
      estimate = Estimate,
      std_error = `Std. Error`,
      statistic = `t value`,
      p_value = `Pr(>|t|)`
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      dataset = dataset_label,
      model = "rpls_CPM ~ PC1 + PC2",
      .before = 1
    )

  genotype_coefs <- as.data.frame(summary(fit_genotype)$coefficients) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("term") %>%
    dplyr::rename(
      estimate = Estimate,
      std_error = `Std. Error`,
      statistic = `t value`,
      p_value = `Pr(>|t|)`
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      dataset = dataset_label,
      model = "rpls_CPM ~ Genotype",
      .before = 1
    )

  genotype_pc_coefs <- as.data.frame(summary(fit_genotype_pc)$coefficients) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("term") %>%
    dplyr::rename(
      estimate = Estimate,
      std_error = `Std. Error`,
      statistic = `t value`,
      p_value = `Pr(>|t|)`
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      dataset = dataset_label,
      model = "rpls_CPM ~ Genotype + PC1 + PC2",
      .before = 1
    )

  pc_genotype_coefs <- as.data.frame(summary(fit_pc_genotype)$coefficients) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("term") %>%
    dplyr::rename(
      estimate = Estimate,
      std_error = `Std. Error`,
      statistic = `z value`,
      p_value = `Pr(>|z|)`
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      dataset = dataset_label,
      model = "Genotype ~ PC1 + PC2",
      .before = 1
    )

  coefficient_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    pc_coefs,
    genotype_coefs,
    genotype_pc_coefs,
    pc_genotype_coefs
  )

  genotype_term_unadj <- grep("^Genotype", names(stats::coef(fit_genotype)), value = TRUE)[1]
  genotype_term_adj <- grep("^Genotype", names(stats::coef(fit_genotype_pc)), value = TRUE)[1]

  confounding_summary <- data.frame(
    dataset = dataset_label,
    n = nrow(model_df),
    rpls_pc12_adjusted_r_squared = fit_pc_summary$adj.r.squared,
    genotype_rpls_estimate = stats::coef(fit_genotype)[[genotype_term_unadj]],
    genotype_rpls_p = summary(fit_genotype)$coefficients[genotype_term_unadj, "Pr(>|t|)"],
    genotype_rpls_after_pc12_estimate = stats::coef(fit_genotype_pc)[[genotype_term_adj]],
    genotype_rpls_after_pc12_p = summary(fit_genotype_pc)$coefficients[genotype_term_adj, "Pr(>|t|)"],
    pc12_predicts_genotype_p = pc_genotype_lrt$`Pr(>Chi)`[2],
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  cat("\n\n", dataset_label, "\n", sep = "")
  print(fit_pc_summary)
  print(summary(fit_genotype))
  print(summary(fit_genotype_pc))
  print(pc_genotype_lrt)

  list(
    fit_pc = fit_pc,
    fit_genotype = fit_genotype,
    fit_genotype_pc = fit_genotype_pc,
    fit_pc_genotype = fit_pc_genotype,
    data = model_df,
    model_summary = model_summary,
    coefficient_summary = coefficient_summary,
    confounding_summary = confounding_summary
  )
}

rpls_pc12_fits <- list(
  `Const Whole` = fit_rpls_pc12(tmp_pc_rpls_whole, "Const Whole"),
  `Const Syn` = fit_rpls_pc12(tmp_pc_rpls_syn, "Const Syn"),
  `Const Nuc` = fit_rpls_pc12(tmp_pc_rpls_nuc, "Const Nuc"),
  `Const Cyt` = fit_rpls_pc12(tmp_pc_rpls_cyt, "Const Cyt")
)

rpls_pc12_model_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  lapply(rpls_pc12_fits, `[[`, "model_summary")
)

rpls_pc12_coefficient_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(

)

rpls_pc12_confounding_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(

)

print(rpls_pc12_model_summary)
print(rpls_pc12_coefficient_summary)
print(rpls_pc12_confounding_summary)

readr::write_csv(

readr::write_csv(
```

# 1. Seurat Pipeline

## 1.1 Building the Seurat object


```{r}


# Load the filtered data 

#ctx1.nosoupx <- Read10X(data.dir = "POOL1_P60CTX_two_directories/outs/filtered_feature_bc_matrix/")
#ctx2.nosoupx <- Read10X(data.dir = "POOL2_P60CTX_two_directories/outs/filtered_feature_bc_matrix/")
#ctx3.nosoupx <- Read10X(data.dir = "POOL3_P60CTX_two_directories/outs/filtered_feature_bc_matrix/")
#ctx4.nosoupx <- Read10X(data.dir = "POOL4_P60CTX_two_directories/outs/filtered_feature_bc_matrix/")
#ctx5.nosoupx <- Read10X(data.dir = "POOL5_P60CTX_two_directories/outs/filtered_feature_bc_matrix/")
#ctx6.nosoupx <- Read10X(data.dir = "POOL6_P60CTX_two_directories/outs/filtered_feature_bc_matrix/")

# Load Soupx output matrices
ctx1 <- Read10X(data.dir = "soupX_ctx1_filt/")
ctx2 <- Read10X(data.dir = "soupX_ctx2_filt/")
ctx4 <- Read10X(data.dir = "soupX_ctx4_filt/")
ctx5 <- Read10X(data.dir = "soupX_ctx5_filt/")
ctx6 <- Read10X(data.dir = "soupX_ctx6_filt/")

pools <- c("ctx1", "ctx2", "ctx4", "ctx5", "ctx6")


# Initialize Seurat objects
for (pool in pools) {
  ctx.soupx.mtx <- get(pool)
  ctx.soupx <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = ctx.soupx.mtx, project = "Chd8_P60_ctx", min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)
  Idents(ctx.soupx) <- pool
  assign(pool, ctx.soupx)
}



# Remove extra objects from global env
all_objects <- ls()
objects_to_remove <- all_objects[grep("\\.nosoupx$|\\.soupx$", all_objects)]
rm(list = objects_to_remove)




```




## 1.2 Standard Pre-processing Workflow

### 1.2.1 QC and selecting cells for further analysis

Here, I'm using the percentage of reads that map to the mitochondrial genome as a QC metric.

Remember:
Low-quality / dying cells often exhibit extensive mitochondrial contamination

First I'm calculating mitochondrial and ribosomal QC metrics with the PercentageFeatureSet() function, which calculates the percentage of counts originating from a set of features
I'm using all genes starting with Mt- as a set of mitochondrial genes and all genes that start with rp- = ribosomal

```{r}

# Add %mt and %ribo to meta data
for (pool in pools) {
  ctx <- get(pool)
  ctx[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(ctx, pattern = "^mt-")
  ctx[["percent.ribo"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(ctx, pattern = "rp[sl]")
  assign(pool, ctx)
}
  

```

Seurat QC metric visualization - violin plots

(no longer using these for filtering, using Nick's QC plots below)

```{r}
VlnPlot(ctx5, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"), ncol = 3, pt.size = 0.001)
VlnPlot(ctx6, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"), ncol = 3, pt.size = 0.001)


```

Preliminary clustering in order to run preliminary filtering on each cluster individually

```{r}

for (pool in pools) {
  print(paste('Processing ', pool, '...', sep=''))
  so <- get(pool)
  print(paste('...running SCT...'))
  so <- SCTransform(so, verbose = F)
  print(paste('...running PCA...'))
  so <- RunPCA(so, verbose = F)
  print(paste('...clustering...'))
  so <- FindNeighbors(so, dims = 1:30, verbose = F)
  so <- FindClusters(so, verbose = T)
  print(paste('...generating UMAP...'))
  so <- RunUMAP(so, dims = 1:30, verbose = F)
  assign(paste(pool), so)
  }


```

```{r}
metadata.ctx1 <- ctx1@meta.data

pdf("output/QC/ctx1.pdf")

all.QC.Stat <- list()

for (i in 0:(length(unique(metadata.ctx1$seurat_clusters)) - 1)) {
   metadata <- dplyr::filter(metadata.ctx1, seurat_clusters == as.numeric(i))
  
  # Check if the mode of metadata$percent.mt is 0
    if (length(unique(metadata$percent.mt)) < 2) {
    print(paste("Warning: all of percent.mt for cluster ", i, " = 0, not filtering this cluster based on percent.mt"))
    
      Cell.QC.Stat <- metadata
    
    # Set thresholds on nFeatures and nCounts/UMIs
  min.Genes.thr <- median(log10(Cell.QC.Stat$nFeature_RNA)) - 2.75 * mad(log10(Cell.QC.Stat$nFeature_RNA))
  max.Genes.thr <- median(log10(Cell.QC.Stat$nFeature_RNA)) + 2 * mad(log10(Cell.QC.Stat$nFeature_RNA))
  min.nUMI.thr <- median(log10(Cell.QC.Stat$nCount_RNA)) - 2.75 * mad(log10(Cell.QC.Stat$nCount_RNA))
  max.nUMI.thr <- median(log10(Cell.QC.Stat$nCount_RNA)) + 2 * mad(log10(Cell.QC.Stat$nCount_RNA))
  
  
# Plot4: nFeature vs nCount/UMI scatter plot, log transformed, before filtering 
  plot4 <- ggplot(Cell.QC.Stat, aes(x = log10(nCount_RNA), y = log10(nFeature_RNA))) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm") +
    geom_hline(aes(yintercept = min.Genes.thr), colour = "green", linetype = 2) +
    geom_hline(aes(yintercept = max.Genes.thr), colour = "green", linetype = 2) +
    geom_vline(aes(xintercept = min.nUMI.thr), colour = "red", linetype = 2)  +
    geom_vline(aes(xintercept = max.nUMI.thr), colour = "red", linetype = 2)  +
    annotate(
      geom = "text", 
      label = paste(as.numeric(table(log10(Cell.QC.Stat$nCount_RNA) < min.nUMI.thr | log10(Cell.QC.Stat$nCount_RNA) > max.nUMI.thr | log10(Cell.QC.Stat$nFeature_RNA) < min.Genes.thr | log10(Cell.QC.Stat$nFeature_RNA) > max.Genes.thr)[2]), " cells removed\n", as.numeric(table(log10(Cell.QC.Stat$nCount_RNA) < min.nUMI.thr | log10(Cell.QC.Stat$nCount_RNA) > max.nUMI.thr | log10(Cell.QC.Stat$nFeature_RNA) < min.Genes.thr | log10(Cell.QC.Stat$nFeature_RNA) > max.Genes.thr)[1]), " cells remain"), x = (max.nUMI.thr - 0.42), y = (min.Genes.thr - 0.18))
  print(plot4)
  
  
# Filter cells based on both metrics
Cell.QC.Stat.filt <- Cell.QC.Stat %>%
  dplyr::filter(log10(nFeature_RNA) > min.Genes.thr) %>%
  dplyr::filter(log10(nFeature_RNA) < max.Genes.thr) %>%
  dplyr::filter(log10(nCount_RNA) > min.nUMI.thr) %>%
  dplyr::filter(log10(nCount_RNA) < max.nUMI.thr)

# Plot again after filtering
plot5 <- ggplot(Cell.QC.Stat.filt, aes(x = log10(nCount_RNA), y = log10(nFeature_RNA))) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm") +
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = min.Genes.thr), colour = "green", linetype = 2) +

  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = min.nUMI.thr), colour = "red", linetype = 2) +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = max.nUMI.thr), colour = "red", linetype = 2) +
  annotate(
    geom = "text",
    x = (max.nUMI.thr - 0.43),
    y = 3.15,
    label = paste("Total cells after filtering = ", nrow(Cell.QC.Stat.filt), sep = '')
  ) +
  annotate(
    geom = "text",
    x = (max.nUMI.thr - 0.36),
    y = 3.08,
    label = paste("(before filtering = ", nrow(Cell.QC.Stat), ")", sep = '')
  )
print(plot5)
    
    all.QC.Stat[[as.character(i)]] <- Cell.QC.Stat.filt

  }

}

dev.off()


# Add rowname column to each table in all.QC.Stat
all.QC.Stat_with_rowname <- lapply(all.QC.Stat, function(df) {
  df$rowname <- rownames(df)
  return(df)
})

# Merge all the dfs in all.QC.Stat into one df
combined_df <- do.call(rbind, all.QC.Stat_with_rowname)

# Reset rownames and remove the rowname column
rownames(combined_df) <- combined_df$rowname
combined_df$rowname <- NULL

# Finally, filter seurat object for cells captured in all.QC.Stat
ctx1.filt <- subset(ctx1, cells = rownames(combined_df))
```

```{r}
  print(plot4)

Cell.QC.Stat.filt <- Cell.QC.Stat %>%

  dplyr::filter(log10(nFeature_RNA) < max.Genes.thr) %>%
```

## 1.3 Add meta data

```{r}

# Adding metadata

for (pool in pools) {
  ctx.filt <- get(paste0(pool, '.filt'))
  
  if (pool %in% c("ctx1", "ctx2", "ctx5")) {
    male_genotype <- "het"
    female_genotype <- "wt"
  } else {
    male_genotype <- "wt"
    female_genotype <- "het"
  }
  
  ctx.metadata <- data.frame(male_genotype= rep(male_genotype, times=ncol(ctx.filt)), 
                             female_genotype= rep(female_genotype, times=ncol(ctx.filt)))
  
  ctx.filt[["male_genotype"]] <- ctx.metadata$male_genotype
  ctx.filt[["female_genotype"]] <- ctx.metadata$female_genotype
  
  assign(paste0(pool, '.filt'), ctx.filt)
}



```


## 1.4 Removing mt genes and Malat1 from matrices

```{r}


for (pool in pools) {
  ctx.filt <- get(paste0(pool, '.filt'))
  
  # Remove MT genes
  ctx.filt <- ctx.filt[!grepl("^mt-", rownames(ctx.filt)), ]
  
  # Remove Malat1
  ctx.filt <- ctx.filt[!grepl("Malat1", rownames(ctx.filt)), ]
  
  # Assign the filtered matrix back to the original object
  assign(paste0(pool, '.filt'), ctx.filt)
}


```

## 1.5 Normalizing and scaling the data with SCTransform

```{r}

pools <- c("ctx1", "ctx2", "ctx4", "ctx5", "ctx6")

for (pool in pools) {
  # Get the filtered object
  ctx.filt <- get(paste0(pool, '.filt'))
  
  # Perform SCTransform
  ctx.norm <- SCTransform(ctx.filt, method = "glmGamPoi", vars.to.regress = "nCount_RNA", vst.flavor = "v2", verbose = FALSE)
  
  # Assign the normalized object back to the global environment
  assign(paste0(pool, '.norm'), ctx.norm)
  
  # Remove the filtered object
  rm(list = paste0(pool, '.filt'))
}

```

### Normalize and scale RNA assay

```{r}
pools <- c("ctx1", "ctx2", "ctx4", "ctx5", "ctx6")

for (pool in pools) {
  print(paste(pool, '...', sep=''))
  
  norm <- get(paste(pool, '.norm', sep=''))
  
  norm <- NormalizeData(norm, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000, assay = "RNA")
  norm <- FindVariableFeatures(norm, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000, assay = "RNA")
   all.genes <- rownames(norm)
  norm<- ScaleData(norm, features = all.genes, assay = "RNA")
  
  assign(paste(pool, '.norm', sep=''), norm)
 
}


# Save objects
saveRDS(ctx1.norm, file = "output/saved_objects_v11/post-soupx/ctx.norm/ctx1.norm.rds")
saveRDS(ctx2.norm, file = "output/saved_objects_v11/post-soupx/ctx.norm/ctx2.norm.rds")
```

## 1.6 Detect and remove doublets

### Preliminary clustering **Skipping b/c did preliminary clustering before QC**

```{r}
pools <- c("ctx1", "ctx2", "ctx4", "ctx5", "ctx6")

for (pool in pools) {
  print(paste(pool, '...', sep=''))
  ctx <- get(paste(pool, '.norm', sep=''))
  ctx <- RunPCA(ctx, features = VariableFeatures(object = ctx), assay = "SCT")
  ctx <- FindNeighbors(ctx, dims = 1:40)
  ctx <- FindClusters(ctx, resolution = 1.2)
  ctx <- RunUMAP(ctx, dims = 1:40)
  DimPlot(ctx, reduction = "umap")
  assign(paste(pool, '.umap', sep=''), ctx)
}

rm(ctx1.norm, ctx2.norm, ctx4.norm, ctx5.norm, ctx6.norm)

# Save objects
saveRDS(ctx1.umap, file = "output/saved_objects_v11/post-soupx/ctx.umap/ctx1.umap.rds")
saveRDS(ctx2.umap, file = "output/saved_objects_v11/post-soupx/ctx.umap/ctx2.umap.rds")

saveRDS(ctx5.umap, file = "output/saved_objects_v11/post-soupx/ctx.umap/ctx5.umap.rds")
saveRDS(ctx6.umap, file = "output/saved_objects_v11/post-soupx/ctx.umap/ctx6.umap.rds")
```

### Assign DoubletFinder meta data and make summary plots
```{r}

pools <- c("ctx1", "ctx2", "ctx4", "ctx5", "ctx6")

for (pool in pools) {

ctx <- get(paste(pool, '.norm', sep=''))  

Idents(ctx) <- "seurat_clusters"
print(paste(pool, "...", sep=''))
sweep.res <- paramSweep(ctx, PCs = 1:30, sct = TRUE)
sweep.stats <- summarizeSweep(sweep.res, GT = FALSE)
bcmvn <- find.pK(sweep.stats)
print(paste("making plot1..."))
p1 <- ggplot(bcmvn, aes(y = BCmetric, x = pK)) + geom_bar(stat="identity") + ylim(0,10000)
p1

annotations <- ctx@meta.data$seurat_clusters
homotypic.prop <- modelHomotypic(annotations)
nExp <- round(ncol(ctx) * 0.1)  # expect 10% doublets
nExp.adj <- round(nExp*(1-homotypic.prop))
ctx <- doubletFinder(ctx, pN = 0.25, pK = 0.005, PCs = 1:30, nExp = nExp.adj, reuse.pANN = FALSE, sct = TRUE)

# Dynamic handling of DoubletFinder and pANN metadata columns
df_string <- grep("^DF\\.classifications", names(ctx@meta.data), value = TRUE)
pann_string <- grep("^pANN", names(ctx@meta.data), value = TRUE)
    
    
ctx$DoubletFinder <- ctx@meta.data[[df_string[1]]]
ctx@meta.data[[df_string[1]]] <- NULL
Idents(ctx) <- "DoubletFinder"

print(paste("making plot2..."))
p2 <- DimPlot(ctx, reduction = "umap") + annotation_custom(tableGrob(plyr::count(ctx$DoubletFinder)), xmin=20, xmax=20, ymin=15, ymax= 15)
p2

print(paste("making plot3..."))
p3 <- FeaturePlot(ctx, reduction = "umap", paste(pann_string))
p3

print(paste("making plot4..."))
metadata <- ctx@meta.data
p4 <- metadata %>% 
  	ggplot(aes(color=seurat_clusters, x=!!as.name(paste(pann_string)), fill= seurat_clusters)) + 
  	geom_density(alpha = 0.2) + 
  	theme_classic() +
  	ylab("Cell density")
p4

print(paste("making plot5..."))
p5 <- metadata %>% 
  	ggplot(aes(color=DoubletFinder, x=!!as.name(paste(pann_string)), fill= DoubletFinder)) +
```

## 1.7 Assigning sex and genotype with Nick's functions


### 1.7.1 Assign sex

```{r}

pools <- c("ctx1", "ctx2", "ctx4", "ctx5", "ctx6")

for (pool in pools) {
  
  ctx <- get(paste(pool))
  
# First function generates a df of probabilities of being male and female
# Calculates 3 probabilities: UniVariate (only Xist) MultiVariate(Xist + y genes), and MultinCount(Xist+ygenes+nCount_RNA )
# rownames are cell barcodes, column names are each of the probabilities
  DefaultAssay(ctx) <- 'RNA'
  Idents(ctx) <- 'seurat_clusters'
  Probabilities <- femaleProb(ctx, lognormalized = TRUE, ONLINE = FALSE )

# Second function assigns sex based on the probabilities you just generated and adds these sex assignments to a data frame.
  Probs.sex <- sexAssign(Probabilities, femalecut = 0.95, malecut = 0.05)

# Third and final function takes the dataframe you just generated and adds it to the metadata of your seurat object. It will label cells male, female, or soup. any cell with a probability of 95 or higher is female, 5 or lower is male, and everything in between is soup.
  ctx <- quickAdd(Probs.sex, ctx)

# Save object
saveRDS(ctx, file = paste("output/saved_objects_v11/post-soupx/ctx.sexgen/", pool, ".sexgen.rds", sep=''))
  
  assign(paste(pool), ctx)
}


```

### 1.7.3 Assign genotype based on SexMulti assignment

```{r}

pools <- c("ctx1", "ctx2", "ctx4", "ctx5", "ctx6")


for (pool in pools) {
  
  ctx <- get(paste(pool, ".noSoup", sep=''))
  
# Pull out meta data from Seurat object and make new data frame
  meta.data <- ctx@meta.data

# make empty vector of GenMulti and write for loop to populate it with genotype assignment
  GenMulti <- vector("character", nrow(meta.data))
  

  for (i in 1:nrow(meta.data)) {
    SexMulti <- as.character(meta.data[i, "SexMulti"])
    female.gen <- as.character(meta.data[i, "female_genotype"])
    male.gen <- as.character(meta.data[i, "male_genotype"])
  
   if (isTRUE(SexMulti == "female" && female.gen == "wt" )) {
     GenMulti[i] <- "wt"
   }
   else if (isTRUE(SexMulti == "female" && female.gen == "het" )) {
     GenMulti[i] <- "het"
   }
   else if (isTRUE(SexMulti == "male" && male.gen == "wt" )) {
     GenMulti[i] <- "wt"
   }
   else if (isTRUE(SexMulti == "male" && male.gen == "het" )) {
     GenMulti[i] <- "het"
   }
  
  }

  head(GenMulti, 50)

# Add GenMulti to ctx meta data
  ctx[["GenMulti"]] <- GenMulti

# Save object
  saveRDS(ctx, file = paste("output/saved_objects_v11/post-soupx/ctx.noSoup/", pool, ".noSoup.rds", sep=''))

# Reassign object
  assign(paste(pool, ".noSoup", sep=''), ctx)

}
```

## 1.8 Integrate pools

```{r}

# Integrate Seurat objects into one. 

# Note, this is different from merging. For details on when to merge and when to integrate, see https://www.biostars.org/p/9493216/ and https://github.com/satijalab/seurat/issues/3631 


pools <- c("ctx1", "ctx2", "ctx4", "ctx5", "ctx6")

for (pool in pools) {
  # Add 'dataset' metadata to identify dataset of origin
  assign(paste0(pool, ".noSoup")$dataset, pool)
  
  # Make sure default assay is set to SCT
  DefaultAssay(get(paste0(pool, ".noSoup"))) <- 'SCT'
}

# Create a list of objects to integrate
ctx.list <- list(ctx1.noSoup, ctx2.noSoup, ctx4.noSoup, ctx5.noSoup, ctx6.noSoup)

rm(ctx1.noSoup, ctx2.noSoup, ctx4.noSoup, ctx5.noSoup, ctx6.noSoup)

# Perform SCT nromalization on all objects individually (skip if already did this)
#for (i in 1:length(ctx.list)) {
#    ctx.list[[i]] <- SCTransform(ctx.list[[i]], verbose = FALSE)
#}


# This is to increase the max size of global variables. May need to adjust if you get an error in getGlobalsAndPackages(). Start with 10000 * 1024^2 and bring it up depending on desired max GB a global can be. Current setting corresponds to 100GB
options(future.globals.maxSize = 100000 * 1024^2)

# Select features for downstream integration, and run PrepSCTIntegration, which ensures that all necessary Pearson residuals have been calculated.
ctx.features <- SelectIntegrationFeatures(object.list = ctx.list, nfeatures = 3000)
ctx.list <- PrepSCTIntegration(ctx.list, anchor.features = ctx.features, verbose = FALSE)

# Identify anchors and integrate the datasets. Commands are identical to the standard workflow, but make sure to set normalization.method = 'SCT':
ctx.anchors <- FindIntegrationAnchors(object.list = ctx.list, normalization.method = "SCT", anchor.features = ctx.features, verbose = FALSE)

# Export object and run the next step in terminal
saveRDS(ctx.anchors, file = "output/saved_objects_v11/post-soupx/ctx.anchors.rds")

# Run in terminal:
all.ctx.int <- IntegrateData(anchorset = ctx.anchors, normalization.method = "SCT", verbose = FALSE)

# Import integrated object and run the last step
all.ctx.int <- readRDS("output/saved_objects_v11/post-soupx/all.ctx.int.rds")

# Run PrepSCTFindMarkers for future DE
all.ctx.int <- PrepSCTFindMarkers(all.ctx.int)

```

```{r}
all.ctx.clustered <- FindNeighbors(all.ctx.pca, dims = 1:40)
```

## 1.12 Find DE markers for assigning cell identity
```{r}

DefaultAssay(all.ctx.umap) <-'SCT'

# find markers for every cluster compared to all remaining cells, report only the positive ones
all.ctx.markers <- FindAllMarkers(all.ctx.umap, only.pos = TRUE, min.pct = 0.25, logfc.threshold = 0.25)
all.ctx.markers %>%
    group_by(cluster) %>%
    slice_max(n = 5, order_by = avg_log2FC)


# Run ROC test for differential expression of cluster 0 markers against all other clusters (returns classification power of all markers)

# Define the number of clusters
num_clusters <- 43

# Create an empty list to store marker results
marker_results <- list()

# Loop through each cluster
for (i in 0:(num_clusters - 1)) {
  # Run ROC test for differential expression of cluster markers
  markers <- FindMarkers(all.ctx.umap, ident.1 = i, logfc.threshold = 0.25, test.use = "roc", only.pos = TRUE)
  
  # Convert the result to a data table
  setDT(markers, keep.rownames = TRUE)
  
  # Store the result in the list
  marker_results[[paste0("cluster", i, ".markers")]] <- markers
  
  # Write the result to an Excel file
  write_xlsx(markers, paste0("output/markers_v11/cluster", i, "_markers.xlsx"))
}


```

## 1.13 Segregate clusters by sources of uninteresting variation

### 1.13.1 Assign cell cycle phase

*Use RNA Assay or SCT?

Cells are considered to be in G1 phase, if the G1 score is above 0.5 and the G2/M score is below 0.5;
    to be in G2/M phase, if the G2/M score is above 0.5 and the G1 score is below 0.5;
    to be in S phase, if both scores are below 0.5; and to be unknown, if both scores are above 0.5.
Despite the availability of a S score, it tends to be more accurate to assign cells based on the G1 and G2/M scores only.

Note that it is generally best practice to perform cell cycle phase assignment _before_ filtering out low-abundance genes.

```{r}

# Load cell cycle markers
mm.pairs <- readRDS("./mouse_cycle_markers.rds")

# Convert rownames to ENSEMBL IDs, Using biomaRt
ensembl<- useMart(biomart = "ensembl", dataset = "mmusculus_gene_ensembl")

# Convert to matrix for use in cycle
DefaultAssay(all.ctx.umap) <- "SCT"
mat <- as.matrix(GetAssayData(all.ctx.umap))
anno <- getBM( values=rownames(mat),
               attributes=c("mgi_symbol","ensembl_gene_id") ,
               filters= "mgi_symbol"  ,mart=ensembl)
ord <- match(rownames(mat), anno$mgi_symbol) # use anno$mgi_symbol if via biomaRt
rownames(mat) <- anno$ensembl_gene_id[ord] # use anno$ensembl_gene_id if via biomaRt
drop <- which(is.na(rownames(mat)))
mat <- mat[-drop,]
mat2 <- mat[,1:4000]
dim(mat2)

#cycles <- scran::cyclone(mat2, pairs=mm.pairs, BPPARAM = SnowParam(workers = 16))
cycles <- scran::cyclone(mat, pairs=mm.pairs, BPPARAM = SnowParam(workers = 16))

# Add to meta data
all.ctx.umap[["cell.cycle"]] <- cycles$phases
all.ctx.umap[["G1_score"]] <- cycles$scores$G1
all.ctx.umap[["S_score"]] <- cycles$scores$S
all.ctx.umap[["G2M_score"]] <- cycles$scores$G2M

# Visualize the PCA, grouping by cell cycle phase
DimPlot(all.ctx.umap,
        reduction = "pca",
        group.by = "cell.cycle",
        split.by = "cell.cycle",
        dims = 7:8,
        shuffle = T) 

# Re-save UMAP
saveRDS(all.ctx.umap, file = "output/saved_objects_v11/post-soupx/ctx.umap/all.ctx.umap.rds")

```

## Lasso out soupy cells
```{r}

# Store all.ctx.umap object into new object all.ctx to use for lassoing out cells, just so original object doesn't get messed uo
all.ctx <- all.ctx.umap


umapCoord <- as.data.frame(Embeddings(object = all.ctx[["umap"]]))



umap1_coords <- as.vector(umapCoord$UMAP_1)
umap2_coords <- as.vector(umapCoord$UMAP_2)

# Make vectors of UMAP_1 and UMAP_2 values

# Create empty vector of length n (where n= # cells or barcodes)
umap_soup <- vector("character", nrow(umapCoord))

#For each row in umapCoord, if UMAP_1 > __ and UMAP_1 < __ and UMAP_2 < __ and UMAP_2 > __
#OR if UMAP_1 > __ and UMAP_1 < __ and UMAP_2 < __ and UMAP_2 > __ insert "soup" into umap_soup vector. Else insert "not soup". Then add umap_soup vector to metadata.


for (i in 1:nrow(umapCoord)) {
  umap1 <- as.numeric(umap1_coords[i])
  umap2 <- as.numeric(umap2_coords[i])
  
  if ((umap1 > -2 && umap1 < 2.5 && umap2 > 0 && umap2 < 6.5) || 
      (umap1 > -8 && umap1 < 10 && umap2 > -5 && umap2 < 3) ||
      (umap1 > -12 && umap1 < -10 && umap2 > -7.5 && umap2 < -3) ||
      (umap1 > 0 && umap1 < 5 && umap2 > -20 && umap2 < -17)) {
    umap_soup[i] <- "soup"
  }
  else {
   umap_soup[i] <- "not soup"
  }
}

soup <- length(which(umap_soup == "soup"))
soup

# Insert umap_soup vector into all.ctx meta.data

all.ctx[["umap_soup"]] <- umap_soup

# Set Idents to umap_soup
Idents(all.ctx) <- 'umap_soup'

# Subset all.ctx so that "soup" cells are removed
all.ctx <- subset(all.ctx, idents = c('soup'), invert = TRUE)

# Redo UMAP
Idents(all.ctx) <- 'seurat_clusters'
DimPlot(all.ctx, reduction = "umap", label = T) 

# Set default assay to RNA
DefaultAssay(all.ctx) <- 'RNA'

# Re-normalize RNA assay of subset
all.ctx <- SCTransform(all.ctx, method = "glmGamPoi", vst.flavor = "v2", verbose = FALSE)

# Change assay to integrated

DefaultAssay(all.ctx) <- 'integrated'

# Recluster
all.ctx <- FindNeighbors(all.ctx, dims = 1:40)
all.ctx <- FindClusters(all.ctx, resolution = 0.95)

# Change assay back to SCT
DefaultAssay(all.ctx) <- 'SCT'

#Switch idents back to seurat_cluster
Idents(all.ctx) <- "seurat_clusters"

# Redo UMAP
DimPlot(all.ctx, reduction = "umap", label = T)

```

## 1.14 Find new markers
```{r}

all.ctx.umap <- all.ctx

DefaultAssay(all.ctx.umap) <-'SCT'

all.ctx.umap <- PrepSCTFindMarkers(all.ctx.umap)  # Run only once after re-normalizing and re-clustering

# find markers for every cluster compared to all remaining cells, report only the positive ones
all.ctx.markers <- FindAllMarkers(all.ctx.umap, only.pos = TRUE, min.pct = 0.25, logfc.threshold = 0.25)
all.ctx.markers %>%
    group_by(cluster) %>%
    slice_max(n = 5, order_by = avg_log2FC)

setDT(all.ctx.markers, keep.rownames = TRUE)
write_xlsx(all.ctx.markers,"output/markers_v11/all.ctx.markers.xlsx")

# Run ROC test for differential expression of cluster 0 markers against all other clusters (returns classification power of all markers)
# Define the number of clusters
num_clusters <- 26

# Create an empty list to store marker results
marker_results <- list()

# Loop through each cluster
for (i in 0:(num_clusters - 1)) {
  # Run ROC test for differential expression of cluster markers
  markers <- FindMarkers(all.ctx.umap, ident.1 = i, logfc.threshold = 0.25, test.use = "roc", only.pos = TRUE)
  
  # Convert the result to a data table
  setDT(markers, keep.rownames = TRUE)
  
  # Store the result in the list
  marker_results[[paste0("cluster", i, ".markers")]] <- markers
  
  # Write the result to an Excel file
  write_xlsx(markers, paste0("output/markers_v11/cluster", i, "_markers.xlsx"))
}






```

### 1.15.2 Cell_Type_2
```{r}

# Extract meta data 
meta.data <- all.ctx.umap@meta.data
cell_type_2 <- vector("character", nrow(meta.data))

for (i in 1:nrow(meta.data)) {
  cell_type_1 <- as.character(meta.data[i, "Cell_Type_1"])
  if (isTRUE(grepl("L2/3 IT Glut", cell_type_1, fixed=TRUE))) {
    cell_type_2[i] <- "L2/3 IT Glut"
  }
  else if (isTRUE(grepl("L4/5 IT Glut", cell_type_1, fixed=TRUE))) {
    cell_type_2[i] <- "L4/5 IT Glut"
  }
  else if (isTRUE(grepl("L6 CT Glut", cell_type_1, fixed=TRUE))) {
    cell_type_2[i] <- "L6 CT Glut"
  }
  else if (isTRUE(grepl("Astro", cell_type_1, fixed=TRUE))) {
    cell_type_2[i] <- "Astro"
  }
  else if (isTRUE(grepl("Oligo", cell_type_1, fixed=TRUE))) {
    cell_type_2[i] <- "Oligo"
  }
  else {
    cell_type_2[i] <- cell_type_1
  }
}

head(cell_type_2)

# Set object[[Cell_Type_2]] <- vector
all.ctx.umap[["Cell_Type_2"]] <- cell_type_2

Idents(all.ctx.umap) <- 'Cell_Type_2'
DimPlot(all.ctx.umap, reduction = "umap", label = FALSE, pt.size = 0.5) 


saveRDS(all.ctx.umap, file = "output/saved_objects_v11/post-soupx/ctx.umap/all.ctx.umap.noSoup.2.rds")

```

### 1.15.4 Cell_Type_3
```{r}

meta.data <- all.ctx.umap@meta.data
cell_type_3 <- vector("character", nrow(meta.data))

for (i in 1:nrow(meta.data)) {
  cell_type_1 <- as.character(meta.data[i, "Cell_Type_1"])
  if (isTRUE(grepl("Glut", cell_type_1, fixed=TRUE))) {
    cell_type_3[i] <- "Glutamatergic"
  }
  else if (isTRUE(grepl("Gaba", cell_type_1, fixed=TRUE))) {
    cell_type_3[i] <- "Gabaergic"
  }
  else if ((cell_type_1 == "Peri") || (cell_type_1 == "Endo") || (isTRUE(grepl("VLMC", cell_type_1, fixed=TRUE)))) {
    cell_type_3[i] <- "Vasculature-associated"
  }
  else if ((isTRUE(grepl("Oligo", cell_type_1, fixed=TRUE))) || (cell_type_1 == "OPC") || (isTRUE(grepl("Astro", cell_type_1, fixed=TRUE)))) {
    cell_type_3[i] <- "Glial"
  }
  else {
    cell_type_3[i] <- cell_type_1
  }
}

head(cell_type_3)

# Set object[[Cell_Type_3]] <- vector
all.ctx.umap[["Cell_Type_3"]] <- cell_type_3
```

Generate better pheatmap of top 5 markers from each cluster, columns sorted by seurat_clusters 

```{r}

# in order to sort by seurat cluster, need to extract matrix of scaled expression data from RNA assay for only genes in top5 list, remove 0s, then merge seurat_clusters metadata column with this matrix and arrange by seurat clusters before plotting. For some reason if you just use top5 matrix as input, the cells don't stay in order.

exp_matrix <- as.matrix(all.ctx.umap@assays$RNA@data)[top5$gene,]
exp_matrix[is.na(exp_matrix)] <- 0
metadata <- all.ctx.umap@meta.data
met <- as.data.frame(metadata[,"Cell_Type_1"])
colnames(met) <- 'Cell_Type_1'
rownames(met) <- colnames(exp_matrix)
exp_matrix_meta <- merge(as.matrix(met), t(exp_matrix), by = 0) %>% arrange(Cell_Type_1)
rownames(exp_matrix_meta) <- exp_matrix_meta$Row.names
exp_matrix_meta$Row.names <- NULL
exp_matrix_meta$Cell_Type_1 <- NULL
exp_matrix <- t(exp_matrix_meta)
#met$Cell_Type_1 <- NULL


pheatmap::pheatmap(exp_matrix,
         show_rownames = TRUE,
         fontsize = 7,
         fontsize_row = 3,
         clustering_distance_rows="euclidean",
         cex=1,
         #clustering_distance_cols="euclidean",
         clustering_method="complete",
         border_color=FALSE,
         #annotation_colors = CT1_colors,
         annotation_col = met,
         show_colnames = F,
         cluster_cols = F,
         cluster_rows = F)
``` 

## 1.18 Determining number of cells with each sex/genotype combo - 

### 1.18.1 Cluster composition

```{r}

# Want to determine the number of MHETs, MWTs, FHETs, FWTs. unequal representation could skew DE results.

# Pull out meta data from Seurat object and make new data frame
meta.data <- all.ctx.umap@meta.data

## Whole data set

# make vector of cluster names (or borrow from new.cluster.ids object)
clusters <- unique(all.ctx.umap$Cell_Type_2)

# Make df with rownames= vector of cluster names
all.ctx.sexgencomp <- data.frame(matrix(ncol = 1, nrow = length(clusters))) 
rownames(all.ctx.sexgencomp) <- clusters
all.ctx.sexgencomp <- setDT(all.ctx.sexgencomp, keep.rownames = TRUE)
all.ctx.sexgencomp <- subset (all.ctx.sexgencomp, select = -2)
colnames(all.ctx.sexgencomp) <- c("cluster")

# Make empty sex/gen vectors for M_HET, M_WT, F_HET, F_WT. Each position in vector corresponds to a cluster.
M_HET <- vector("integer", nrow(all.ctx.sexgencomp))
M_WT <- vector("integer", nrow(all.ctx.sexgencomp))
F_HET <- vector("integer", nrow(all.ctx.sexgencomp))
F_WT <- vector("integer", nrow(all.ctx.sexgencomp))
 
 
# Write for loop to 1. select a current cluster 2. filter rows from meta.data where Cell_Type_1= current clust,  sex == male, and gen == het (for each combo of sex/gen) 3. count the number of rows in that subset and paste into the ith position of corresponding sex/gen vector. remember that ith position of sex/gen vector corresponds to ith row of all.ctx.sexgencomp

for (i in 1:nrow(all.ctx.sexgencomp)) {
  current_clust <- paste(all.ctx.sexgencomp$cluster[i])
  m.het.subset <- dplyr::filter(meta.data, Cell_Type_1 == paste(current_clust) & SexMulti == "male" & GenMulti == "het")
  m.wt.subset <- dplyr::filter(meta.data, Cell_Type_1 == paste(current_clust) & SexMulti == "male" & GenMulti == "wt")
  f.het.subset <- dplyr::filter(meta.data, Cell_Type_1 == paste(current_clust) & SexMulti == "female" & GenMulti == "het")
  f.wt.subset <- dplyr::filter(meta.data, Cell_Type_1 == paste(current_clust) & SexMulti == "female" & GenMulti == "wt")

  M_HET[i] <- nrow(m.het.subset)
  M_WT[i] <- nrow(m.wt.subset)
  F_HET[i] <- nrow(f.het.subset)
  F_WT[i] <- nrow(f.wt.subset)
  
  }

# Insert sex/gen vectors into columns of all.ctx.sexgencomp
all.ctx.sexgencomp$M_HET <- M_HET
all.ctx.sexgencomp$M_WT <- M_WT
all.ctx.sexgencomp$F_HET <- F_HET
all.ctx.sexgencomp$F_WT <- F_WT

# Add totals

all.ctx.sexgencomp$Total <- vector("integer", nrow(all.ctx.sexgencomp))

for (i in 1:nrow(all.ctx.sexgencomp)) {
  all.ctx.sexgencomp$Total[i] <- sum(all.ctx.sexgencomp$M_HET[i], all.ctx.sexgencomp$M_WT[i], all.ctx.sexgencomp$F_HET[i], all.ctx.sexgencomp$F_WT[i]
                                   #  ,all.ctx.sexgencomp$U_HET, all.ctx.sexgencomp$U_WT)
  )
}

all.ctx.sexgencomp <- all.ctx.sexgencomp %>% adorn_totals("row")

# Export to Excel
write_xlsx(all.ctx.sexgencomp,"output/sex_gen_comp/all_ctx_sexgencomp_v11_final.xlsx")


```

## Pseudobulk function on single object - generates dds object then returns DE results
Need to subset cell types prior for comp by CT
```{r}
Do_Pseudobulk_res <- function(so, sample_labels) {
  GEM <- so@assays$RNA@counts %>% as.data.frame() %>% t()
  metadata <- so@meta.data
  metadata <- metadata %>% dplyr::select(GenoBatch)
  GEM_comb <- merge(GEM, metadata, by = 0)
  GEM_comb$Row.names <- NULL
  aggr <- aggregate(GEM_comb[ , 1:ncol(GEM)], by = list(GEM_comb$GenoBatch), FUN = sum)
  rownames(aggr) <- aggr$Group.1
  aggr$Group.1 <- NULL
  df <- t(aggr)
  cts <- as.matrix(df)
  sample_labels$condition <- factor(sample_labels$condition)
  dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = cts, colData = sample_labels, design = ~ batch + condition)
  dds <- DESeq(dds)
  res <- results(dds)
  res <- as.data.frame(res)
}
```

## Pseudobulk function on single object - returns raw, scaled, and normalized counts
Need to subset cell types prior for comp by CT
```{r}
Do_Pseudobulk_counts <- function(so, sample_labels, meta, transformation) {
  if(transformation == "rlog") {
  GEM <- so@assays$RNA@counts %>% as.data.frame() %>% t()
  metadata <- so@meta.data
  metadata <- metadata %>% dplyr::select(GenoBatch)
  GEM_comb <- merge(GEM, metadata, by = 0)
  GEM_comb$Row.names <- NULL
  aggr <- aggregate(GEM_comb[ , 1:ncol(GEM)], by = list(GEM_comb$GenoBatch), FUN = sum)
  rownames(aggr) <- aggr$Group.1
  aggr$Group.1 <- NULL
  df <- t(aggr)
  cts <- as.matrix(df)
  sample_labels$condition <- factor(sample_labels$condition)
  dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = cts, colData = sample_labels, design = ~ batch + condition)
  dds <- DESeq(dds)
  rld <- rlog(dds, blind = FALSE)
  rld.counts <- rld@assays@data@listData[[1]]
  rld.counts <- t(rld.counts)
  rld.counts <- merge(rld.counts, meta, by = 0)
  return(rld.counts)
  }
  if(transformation == "vst"){
  GEM <- so@assays$RNA@counts %>% as.data.frame() %>% t()
  metadata <- so@meta.data
  metadata <- metadata %>% dplyr::select(GenoBatch)
  GEM_comb <- merge(GEM, metadata, by = 0)
  GEM_comb$Row.names <- NULL
  aggr <- aggregate(GEM_comb[ , 1:ncol(GEM)], by = list(GEM_comb$GenoBatch), FUN = sum)
  rownames(aggr) <- aggr$Group.1
  aggr$Group.1 <- NULL
  df <- t(aggr)
  cts <- as.matrix(df)
  sample_labels$condition <- factor(sample_labels$condition)
  dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = cts, colData = sample_labels, design = ~ batch + condition)
  dds <- DESeq(dds)
  vst <- DESeq2::vst(dds, blind = TRUE)
  vst.counts <- vst@assays@data@listData[[1]]
  vst.counts <- t(vst.counts)
  vst.counts <- merge(vst.counts, meta, by = 0)
  return(vst.counts)
  }
  if(transformation == "scaled"){
  GEM <- so@assays$RNA@counts %>% as.data.frame() %>% t()
  metadata <- so@meta.data
  metadata <- metadata %>% dplyr::select(GenoBatch)
  GEM_comb <- merge(GEM, metadata, by = 0)
  GEM_comb$Row.names <- NULL
  aggr <- aggregate(GEM_comb[ , 1:ncol(GEM)], by = list(GEM_comb$GenoBatch), FUN = sum)
  rownames(aggr) <- aggr$Group.1
  aggr$Group.1 <- NULL
  df <- t(aggr)
  df <- as.data.frame(df)
  scaled <- scale(df)
  scaled.counts <- t(scaled)
  scaled.counts <- merge(scaled.counts, meta, by = 0)
  return(scaled.counts)
  }
  if(transformation == "none"){
  GEM <- so@assays$RNA@counts %>% as.data.frame() %>% t()
  metadata <- so@meta.data
  metadata <- metadata %>% dplyr::select(GenoBatch)
  GEM_comb <- merge(GEM, metadata, by = 0)
  GEM_comb$Row.names <- NULL
  aggr <- aggregate(GEM_comb[ , 1:ncol(GEM)], by = list(GEM_comb$GenoBatch), FUN = sum)
  rownames(aggr) <- aggr$Group.1
  aggr$Group.1 <- NULL
  df <- as.data.frame(aggr)
  counts <- merge(df, meta, by = 0)
  return(counts)
  }
  if(transformation == "normalized"){
  GEM <- so@assays$RNA@counts %>% as.data.frame() %>% t()
  metadata <- so@meta.data
  metadata <- metadata %>% dplyr::select(GenoBatch)
  GEM_comb <- merge(GEM, metadata, by = 0)
  GEM_comb$Row.names <- NULL
  aggr <- aggregate(GEM_comb[ , 1:ncol(GEM)], by = list(GEM_comb$GenoBatch), FUN = sum)
  rownames(aggr) <- aggr$Group.1
  aggr$Group.1 <- NULL
  df <- t(aggr)
  cts <- as.matrix(df)
  sample_labels$condition <- factor(sample_labels$condition)
  dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = cts, colData = sample_labels, design = ~ batch + condition)
  dds <- DESeq(dds)
  dds <- estimateSizeFactors(dds)
  normalized.counts <- counts(dds, normalized=TRUE)
  normalized.counts <- t(normalized.counts)
  normalized.counts <- merge(normalized.counts, meta, by = 0)
  return(normalized.counts)
  }
}


```

## Pseudobulk function on single object - only returns dds object
Need to subset cell types prior for comp by CT
```{r}
Do_Pseudobulk_dds <- function(so, sample_labels) {
  GEM <- so@assays$RNA@counts %>% as.data.frame() %>% t()
  metadata <- so@meta.data
  metadata <- metadata %>%  dplyr::select(GenoBatch)
  GEM_comb <- merge(GEM, metadata, by = 0)
  GEM_comb$Row.names <- NULL
  aggr <- aggregate(GEM_comb[ , 1:ncol(GEM)], by = list(GEM_comb$GenoBatch), FUN = sum)
  rownames(aggr) <- aggr$Group.1
  aggr$Group.1 <- NULL
  df <- t(aggr)
  cts <- as.matrix(df)
  sample_labels$condition <- factor(sample_labels$condition)
  dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = cts, colData = sample_labels, design = ~ batch + condition)
  dds <- DESeq(dds)
}
```

```{r}
## GENERATE DDS

## RUN DESEQ2, SAVE RESULTS

  res <- results(dds) # store results in res
  res <- as.data.frame(res)  # convert res to df

  res$gene <- rownames(res)   # add gene column using rownames
```

```{r}
  aggr <- aggregate(GEM_comb[ , 1:ncol(GEM)], by = list(GEM_comb$GenoBatch), FUN = sum)  # aggregate by GenoBatch
  
  ## This section is to deal with clusters that have no cells for a certain GenoBatch. i.e. VLMC1 contains no HET_ctx3 cells, so aggr df has no HET_ctx3 row. This adds back a row of zeroes for HET_ctx3

  df <- as.data.frame(aggr)  # make df

  rownames(sample.meta) <- coldata.temp$sample

  counts$row.names<- NULL
  rownames(counts) <- df$row.names
  df$row.names<- NULL
  cluster <- str_replace(cluster, '/', '_')
  write.csv(t(counts), paste("output/markers_v11/Pseudobulk/CT1/counts/raw.", cluster, ".csv", sep=''))
  cluster <- str_replace(cluster, '_', '/')

  cts <- t(aggr)
  cts <- as.matrix(cts)   # turn into matrix
  
  
 
  ## GENERATE DDS
  dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = cts, colData = coldata, design = ~ batch + condition)  # generate dds
  cluster <- str_replace(cluster, '/', '_')
  saveRDS(dds, paste("output/markers_v11/Pseudobulk/CT1/dds/", cluster, ".rds", sep=''))
```

```{r}
  meta <- so@meta.data    # extract and trim meta data
  meta <- meta %>% dplyr::select(orig.ident, GenMulti, SexMulti, GenoSex, GenoBatch, Cell_Type_2, dataset)
  Idents(all.ctx)<- "Cell_Type_2"
  
  ## GENERATE GEM, MERGE WITH GENOBATCH
  GEM <- so[['RNA']]@counts %>% as.data.frame() %>% t() # generate GEM
  GEM <- GEM[, colnames(GEM) %in% protein_coding_genes] # filter for protein-coding genes
  print(paste("GEM generated for ", cluster, sep = '' ))
  GenoBatchcol <- meta %>% dplyr::select(GenoBatch)  # get GenoBatch column from meta data to merge with GEM
  GEM_comb <- cbind(GEM, GenoBatchcol)    # merge GEM and GenoBatch column
  aggr <- aggregate(GEM_comb[ , 1:ncol(GEM)], by = list(GEM_comb$GenoBatch), FUN = sum)
 
  # Save
  cluster <- str_replace(cluster, '/', '_')
  write.csv(aggr, paste0("output/markers_v11/Pseudobulk/CT2/GEMs/", cluster, ".csv"))
}
```

```{r}
  print(paste("Saved dds for ", cluster, sep = '' ))
```

#### DE
##### Volcano plot of every cluster in one plot
```{r}
volcano_plot_all <- function(x, title) {
    
    plotDat <- x
    plotDat$log2FoldChange <- ifelse(plotDat$log2FoldChange > 2, 2, plotDat$log2FoldChange)
    plotDat$log2FoldChange <- ifelse(plotDat$log2FoldChange < -2, -2, plotDat$log2FoldChange)
    
    p <- ggplot(plotDat, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y=-log10(pvalue), fill=cluster, col = cluster)) +
        geom_point(aes(text=gene), size=1, pch=21, alpha=0.7, stroke = 0.5)+
        theme_light() +
        labs(title= title, y="-log10(PValue)", x="log2FC")+
        theme(plot.title = element_text(size = rel(2), hjust=0.5))+
        theme(legend.text=element_text(size=10))+
        theme(axis.text=element_text(size=14))+
        theme(legend.title=element_blank())+
        theme(axis.text=element_text(size=14))+
        theme(axis.title = element_text(size=14, face = "bold"))+
        theme(legend.position="bottom")+
        coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-2.2, 2.2))+
        geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype=2)+
        scale_x_continuous(breaks=c(-2, -1, 0, 1, 2), labels=c("<-2","-1", "0", "1", ">2"))+
        theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
              panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
    
    p
    
}
```

```{r}
dds <- readRDS(paste("output/markers_v11/Pseudobulk/CT1/dds/", cluster, ".rds", sep = ''))
cluster <- str_replace(cluster, '_', '/')
rownames(res) <- res$gene

# Filter out Riks, Gms, Rpls, Rpss
riks <- rownames(res)[which(grepl(pattern = "Rik", rownames(res)))]
rpls <- rownames(res)[which(grepl(pattern = "Rpl", rownames(res)))]
rpss <- rownames(res)[which(grepl(pattern = "Rps", rownames(res)))]
gms <- rownames(res)[which(grepl(pattern = "Gm", rownames(res)))]
res <- res[which(rownames(res) %ni% c(riks, rpls, rpss, gms)),]


# Volcano plot
volcano <- volcano_plot(res, paste("Pseudobulk DEGs in ", cluster, sep = ''))
print(volcano)

# Scatter plot for top 20 upregulated DEGs (by padj)
# Preprocessing for scatterplot
res_tbl <- res %>%
  data.frame() %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  arrange(padj)
res_tbl_up <- dplyr::filter(res_tbl, DE == "up") %>% drop_na()
# Set padj threshold
if (isTRUE(nrow(res_tbl_up[res_tbl_up$padj <= 0.05, ]) < 5)) {
    p_cutoff = 1
  } else {
    p_cutoff = 0.05
  }
# Subset the significant upregulated
if (isTRUE(nrow(res_tbl_up[res_tbl_up$padj <= 0.05, ]) < 5)) {
    sig_res <- dplyr::filter(res_tbl, DE == "up") %>% dplyr::filter(pvalue < p_cutoff) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(pvalue)
  } else {
    sig_res <- dplyr::filter(res_tbl, DE == "up") %>% dplyr::filter(padj < p_cutoff) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(padj)
  }

# Get normalized counts
dds <- estimateSizeFactors(dds)
normalized_counts <- counts(dds, normalized = TRUE)
cluster <- str_replace(cluster, '/', '_')
write.csv(normalized_counts, paste("output/markers_v11/Pseudobulk/CT1/counts/norm.", cluster, ".csv", sep=''))
cluster <- str_replace(cluster, '_', '/')

## Extract top 20 DEGs from res (make sure to order by pval)
if (isTRUE(nrow(res_tbl_up[res_tbl_up$padj <= 0.05, ]) < 5)) {
top20_sig_genes <- sig_res %>%
  dplyr::arrange(pvalue) %>%
  dplyr::pull(gene) %>%
  head(n = 20) 
} else {
  top20_sig_genes <- sig_res %>%
  dplyr::arrange(padj) %>%
  dplyr::pull(gene) %>%
  head(n = 20) 
  
}

## Extract matching normalized count values from matrix
```
