```{r}
## Convert wide matrix to long data frame for ggplot2
top20_sig_df <- data.frame(top20_sig_counts)
top20_sig_df$gene <- rownames(top20_sig_counts)
# before making long df, lock in factor level order
top20_sig_df$gene <- factor(top20_sig_df$gene, levels = top20_sig_df$gene)
top20_sig_df <- reshape2::melt(setDT(top20_sig_df), id.vars = c("gene"), variable.name = "sample") %>% data.frame()
## Replace "." by " " in cluster_sample_id variable (melt() introduced the ".")
top20_sig_df$sample <- gsub("\\.", " ", top20_sig_df$sample)
## Join counts data frame with metadata, add sex column

sex <- vector("character", nrow(top20_sig_df))
```

```{r}
# Scatter plot for top 20 upregulated DEGs (by padj)

    p_cutoff = 1
  } else {
    p_cutoff = 0.05
  }
# Subset the significant upregulated
if (isTRUE(nrow(res_tbl_up[res_tbl_up$padj <= 0.05, ]) < 5)) {
    sig_res <- dplyr::filter(res_tbl, DE == "up") %>% dplyr::filter(pvalue < p_cutoff) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(pvalue)
  } else {
    sig_res <- dplyr::filter(res_tbl, DE == "up") %>% dplyr::filter(padj < p_cutoff) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(padj)
  }

# Get normalized counts

normalized_counts <- counts(dds, normalized = TRUE)
cluster <- str_replace(cluster, '/', '_')
write.csv(normalized_counts, paste("output/markers_v11/Pseudobulk/CT2/counts/norm.", cluster, ".csv", sep=''))
cluster <- str_replace(cluster, '_', '/')
## Extract top 20 DEG from res (make sure to order by pval)

  dplyr::arrange(pvalue) %>%
  dplyr::pull(gene) %>%
  head(n = 20) 
} else {
  top20_sig_genes <- sig_res %>%
  dplyr::arrange(padj) %>%
  dplyr::pull(gene) %>%
  head(n = 20) 
  
}

## Replace "." by " " in cluster_sample_id variable (melt() introduced the ".")
top20_sig_df$sample <- gsub("\\.", " ", top20_sig_df$sample)
## Join counts data frame with metadata, add sex column

sex <- vector("character", nrow(top20_sig_df))
for (i in 1:nrow(top20_sig_df)) {
  sample <- as.character(top20_sig_df$sample[i])
  if (isTRUE(sample == 'HET_ctx1') || isTRUE(sample == 'HET_ctx2') || isTRUE(sample == 'HET_ctx5')) {

  }
  else if (isTRUE(sample == 'WT_ctx4') || isTRUE(sample == 'WT_ctx6')) {
```

```{r}


pdf("output/hdWGCNA_v11_glut_only/plots/Glutamatergic_v2/module_logFC_boxplot.pdf", width = 16 , height = 8)


CTs <- "Glutamatergic"

# Create an empty character vector to store module names with padj < 0.05
significant_modules_CT3 <- c()

# Create empty character vector to store all module names
all_modules_CT3 <- c()

for (CT in CTs) {

# Import list of modules for CT, trim df to only be gene_name and module
CT <- str_replace(CT, '/', '_')  
CT_modules <- read_excel(paste("output/hdWGCNA_v11_glut_only/plots/Glutamatergic_v2/modules.xlsx", sep = '')) %>% dplyr::select(c('gene_name', 'module')) #%>% dplyr::filter(module != 'grey')
rownames(CT_modules) <- CT_modules$gene_name

# Add all modules to all_modules vector
all_modules_CT3 <- c(all_modules_CT3, setdiff(unique(CT_modules$module), "grey"))

# Import pseudobulk results for CT
CT_DEGs <- read.csv(paste("output/markers_v11/Pseudobulk/CT3/results/DE_", CT, ".csv", sep = ''))
CT <- str_replace(CT, '_', '/')
CT_DEGs <- CT_DEGs[which(CT_DEGs$gene %in% rownames(CT_modules)),] %>%
  dplyr::filter(lfcSE <= 0.25)
row.names(CT_DEGs) <- CT_DEGs$gene
CT_DEGs$X.1 <- NULL
CT_DEGs$X <- NULL

# Filter module list for genes in DEGs list, then rename gene_name col to match DEGs df
CT_modules <- CT_modules[which(CT_modules$gene_name %in% rownames(CT_DEGs)),]
CT_modules$gene <- CT_modules$gene_name
CT_modules$gene_name <- NULL

# Merge dfs by rownames and select only log2FoldChange and modules cols
CT_modules_DEGs <- merge(CT_modules, CT_DEGs, by = 'gene', all = TRUE) 

# Save df
CT <- str_replace(CT, '/', '_')
write_xlsx(CT_modules_DEGs,paste("output/hdWGCNA_v11_glut_only/plots/module_logFC_tables/Glutamatergic_v2.xlsx", sep = ''))
CT <- str_replace(CT, '_', '/')

# Select gene, log2FC, and module cols
CT_modules_DEGs <- CT_modules_DEGs %>% dplyr::select(gene, log2FoldChange, module)

# Add mod_number col
CT_modules_DEGs <- mutate(CT_modules_DEGs, mod_number = as.numeric(gsub("\\D", "", CT_modules_DEGs$module))
) 
CT_modules_DEGs$mod_number <- as.character(CT_modules_DEGs$mod_number) %>% replace_na('0')
CT_modules_DEGs$mod_number <- as.numeric(CT_modules_DEGs$mod_number)

# Arrange by mod_number
CT_modules_DEGs <- CT_modules_DEGs %>% arrange(mod_number)

# Prep x axis labels
xlabs <- unique(CT_modules_DEGs$module)
n_genes <- dplyr::count(CT_modules_DEGs, module)
n_genes <- mutate(n_genes, n_module = paste(module, '\n(n = ', n, ')', sep = ''))
xlabs <- n_genes$n_module

# Generate list of comparisons (i.e. comparing each mod to grey mod)
# First generate df with comparisons
comps_df <- data.frame(matrix(ncol = 3, nrow = length(unique(CT_modules_DEGs$module))))
rownames(comps_df) <- unique(CT_modules_DEGs$module)
colnames(comps_df) <- c('grey', 'full_mod_name', 'mod_number')
comps_df <- comps_df[which(rownames(comps_df) != "grey"), ]

for (i in 1:nrow(comps_df)) {
  # first set grey col = 'grey'
  comps_df[i, "grey"] <- 'grey'
  # Next populate full_mod_name col with rowname
  comps_df[i, "full_mod_name"] <- rownames(comps_df[i, ])
  # Next populate mod_number col
  comps_df[i, "mod_number"] <- as.numeric(gsub("\\D", "", comps_df[i, "full_mod_name"]))
}

# Arrange df by mod_number, then remove mod_number col
comps_df <- comps_df %>% arrange(mod_number)
comps_df$mod_number <- NULL

# Turn rows of df into items of list using lapply
comps_list <- lapply(1:nrow(comps_df), function(i) {
  vector <- c(comps_df[i, "grey"], comps_df[i, "full_mod_name"])
  return(vector)
})

# See all pair-wise comparisons of mod logFC to grey logFC
comparison <- compare_means(log2FoldChange~module, CT_modules_DEGs, method = "t.test")

# Apply Bonferroni correction to the p-values
comparison$p.adj <- p.adjust(comparison$p, method = "bonferroni")

# Create a new significance column based on adjusted p-values
comparison$p.adj.signif <- symnum(comparison$p.adj, 
                                  cutpoints = c(0, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 1), 
                                  symbols = c("***", "**", "*", "ns"))

# Filter comparisons where group1 is "grey"
grey_comparisons <- comparison[comparison$group1 == "grey", ]

# Save grey comparisons
CT <- str_replace(CT, '/', '_')
write_xlsx(grey_comparisons, paste("output/hdWGCNA_v11_glut_only/plots/Glutamatergic_v2/module_logFC_comp_table.xlsx", sep = ''))
CT <- str_replace(CT, '_', '/')

 # Filter significant comparisons where adjusted p-value is less than 0.05
significant_comparisons <- grey_comparisons$p.adj < 0.05

# Save sig_mods
filtered_comparisons <- grey_comparisons[grey_comparisons$p.adj < 0.05, ]
sig_mods <- as.vector(filtered_comparisons$group2)
CT <- str_replace(CT, '/', '_')
saveRDS(sig_mods, paste("output/hdWGCNA_v11_glut_only/plots/Glutamatergic_v2/sig_mods_pbLFC.rds", sep = ''))
CT <- str_replace(CT, '_', '/')

# Extract module names with adjusted p-values < 0.05 and append to significant_modules_CT3
significant_modules_CT3 <- c(significant_modules_CT3, unique(grey_comparisons$group2[significant_comparisons]))

# Reorder the 'module' column based on the 'mod_number' column
CT_modules_DEGs$mod_number <- as.numeric(CT_modules_DEGs$mod_number)
CT_modules_DEGs$module <- fct_reorder(CT_modules_DEGs$module, CT_modules_DEGs$mod_number, .fun = median)

# Prep x axis labels
xlabs <- unique(CT_modules_DEGs$module)
n_genes <- dplyr::count(CT_modules_DEGs, module)
n_genes <- mutate(n_genes, n_module = paste(module, '\n(n = ', n, ')', sep = ''))
xlabs <- n_genes$n_module


# Generate boxplot
p <- ggplot(CT_modules_DEGs, aes(x = module, y = log2FoldChange, fill = module)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.01) +
  geom_jitter(position = position_jitter(0.2), size = 0.001) +
  ggtitle(paste('logFC of genes in ', CT, ' modules', sep = '')) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = xlabs) +
  NoLegend() +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90", color = NA),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "white", size = 0.5),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "white", size = 0.5)
  )

# Manually add lines and significance labels for adjusted p-values
base_y <- max(CT_modules_DEGs$log2FoldChange, na.rm = TRUE) + 0.5
increment <- 0.4  # Increase this increment value for more vertical space

for (i in 2:length(xlabs)) {
  curr_mod <- gsub("\n\\(n = .+\\)", "", xlabs[i]) # Extract module name
  p.adj <- grey_comparisons$p.adj[grey_comparisons$group2 == curr_mod]
  signif_label <- grey_comparisons$p.adj.signif[grey_comparisons$group2 == curr_mod] # change this to grey_comparisons$p.adj if want padj values as labels. will need to add something to round. could also do paste0(p.adj, p.signif) for both.
  
  # Determine y position for annotation
  if (!is.na(p.adj)) {
    y_position <- base_y + (i-1) * increment - 0.1
  } else {
    y_position <- base_y + (i-1) * increment - 0.1  # can lower this if want ns label position to be closer to line
  }
  
  if (!is.na(p.adj)) {
    p <- p +
      annotate("segment", x = 1, xend = i, y = y_position, yend = y_position) +
      annotate("text", x = (1 + i) / 2, y = y_position + 0.05, label = signif_label, vjust = 0)
  }
}

print(p)
  



}

dev.off()

print(significant_modules_CT3)

# saveRDS(significant_modules_CT3, 
saveRDS(significant_modules_CT3, "output/hdWGCNA_v11_glut_only/plots/all_sig_mods_pbLFC_CT3_v2.rds")

print(all_modules_CT3)

saveRDS(all_modules_CT3, "output/hdWGCNA_v11_glut_only/plots/all_mods_CT3_v2.rds")
```

Glut only for poster
```{r}


# Import CT_modules_DEGs
CT_modules_DEGs <- read_excel("output/hdWGCNA_v11_glut_only/plots/module_logFC_tables/Glutamatergic_v2.xlsx")

# Extract the number after "M" and use it to reorder
CT_modules_DEGs <- CT_modules_DEGs %>%
  mutate(
    mod_number = as.numeric(gsub(".*M(\\d+)$", "\\1", module)), # Extract numeric part after "M"
    module = fct_reorder(module, mod_number)                    # Reorder numerically
  )

# Manually move "grey" to the beginning by setting its level first
CT_modules_DEGs$module <- factor(CT_modules_DEGs$module, levels = c("grey", setdiff(levels(CT_modules_DEGs$module), "grey")))

# Define a custom color palette
custom_palette <- c(
  "grey" = "grey",
  "Glut-M1" = "turquoise",
  "Glut-M2" = "red4",
  "Glut-M3" = "blue",
  "Glut-M4" = "gray30",
  "Glut-M5" = "green",
  "Glut-M6" = "lightpink",
  "Glut-M7" = "magenta",
  "Glut-M8" = "yellow",
  "Glut-M9" = "purple",
  "Glut-M10" = "red"
)


# Prep x-axis labels with gene counts
n_genes <- CT_modules_DEGs %>%
  dplyr::count(module) %>%
  mutate(n_module = paste(module, '\n(n = ', n, ')', sep = ''))

xlabs <- n_genes$n_module

# Generate boxplot
p <- ggplot(CT_modules_DEGs, aes(x = module, y = log2FoldChange, fill = module)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.01) +
  geom_jitter(position = position_jitter(0.2), size = 0.1) +
  ggtitle('logFC of genes in Glutamatergic modules') +
  scale_fill_manual(values = custom_palette) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = xlabs) +
  ylim(-0.75, 1) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90", color = NA),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "white", size = 0.5),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "white", size = 0.5)
  )

# Add significance labels only for significant p-values
grey_comparisons <- read_excel("output/hdWGCNA_v11_glut_only/plots/Glutamatergic_v2/module_logFC_comp_table.xlsx")

for (i in 1:nrow(grey_comparisons)) {
  curr_mod <- grey_comparisons$group2[i]
  p.adj.signif <- grey_comparisons$p.adj.signif[i]
  
  # Skip if p.adj.signif is "ns"
  if (p.adj.signif != "ns") {
    x_pos <- which(levels(CT_modules_DEGs$module) == curr_mod) # Get x-axis position for the module
    if (!is.na(x_pos)) {
      p <- p + 
        annotate("text", x = x_pos, y = 0.75, label = p.adj.signif, size = 5, vjust = -0.5)
    }
  }
}


# Save the plot
pdf("output/hdWGCNA_v11_glut_only/plots/Glutamatergic_v2/module_logFC_boxplot_Glut_poster.pdf", width = 16, height = 8)
print(p)
dev.off()
```

#### --- Glut only DEMs in each Glutamatergic CT2


```{r}

# Get DEMs
#DEMs <- readRDS("output/hdWGCNA_v11_glut_only/plots/Glutamatergic_v2/sig_mods_pbLFC.rds")

DEMs <- c("Glut-M1", "Glut-M3", "Glut-M4", "Glut-M7")

# Extract Glut cell types
glut_cell_types <- c("Glutamatergic", "L2/3 IT Glut", "L4/5 IT Glut", "L5 IT Glut", "L5 ET Glut", "L6 IT Glut", "L6 CT Glut", "L6b Glut")

# Initialize master Glut mod logfc table
mod_logfc <- data.frame() 

# Get mod logFC table for only Glut cell types
for (CT in glut_cell_types) {

  CT <- str_replace(CT, '/', '_')
  
  # Read in mod logFC table
    if (CT == "Glutamatergic") {
      mod_logfc_CT <- read_excel(paste0("output/hdWGCNA_v11_glut_only/plots/module_logFC_tables/Glutamatergic_v2.xlsx")) %>% dplyr::filter(module != 'grey')
    } else {
      mod_logfc_CT <- read_excel(paste0("output/hdWGCNA_v11_glut_only/plots/module_logFC_tables/Glutamatergic_v2_", CT, ".xlsx")) %>% dplyr::filter(module != 'grey')
    }
  
  # Rename the 'cluster' column to 'CT'
  mod_logfc_CT <- mod_logfc_CT %>% dplyr::rename(CT = cluster)
  
  # Append mod_logFC_CT to master table/ mod_logfc  
  mod_logfc <- rbind(mod_logfc, mod_logfc_CT)  
  }


# Make boxplot for each module
for (mod in DEMs) {
  print(paste0("Processing ", mod, "..."))
  
  # Filter mod_logfc for the current module
  mod_logfc_mod <- mod_logfc %>% dplyr::filter(module == mod)
  
  # Create a PDF to save plots
  pdf(paste0("output/hdWGCNA_v11_glut_only/plots/Glutamatergic_v2/module_logFC_boxplot_", mod, ".pdf"), width = 9, height = 4)

  # Generate boxplot with CT on x axis, log2FoldChange on y-axis, and each point as a gene
  p <- ggplot(mod_logfc_mod, aes(x = CT, y = log2FoldChange, fill = CT)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.01) + 
    geom_jitter(position = position_jitter(0.2), size = 0.01) + 
    ggtitle(paste0("log2FC of ", mod, " genes across Glut cell types")) + 
    scale_x_discrete() + 
    NoLegend() + 
    theme(
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90", color = NA),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "white", size = 0.5),
      panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "white", size = 0.5)
    )
  
  # Print the plot to the PDF
  print(p)
  
  # Close the PDF file
  dev.off()  

}
```

```{r}
        mod_logfc_CT <- read_excel(paste0("output/hdWGCNA_v11_glut_only/plots/module_logFC_tables/Glutamatergic_v2_", CT, ".xlsx")) %>% dplyr::filter(module != 'grey')
    }

    # Rename the 'cluster' column to 'CT'
    mod_logfc_CT <- mod_logfc_CT %>% dplyr::rename(CT = cluster)

    # Append mod_logFC_CT to master table mod_logfc
    mod_logfc <- rbind(mod_logfc, mod_logfc_CT)
}

# Make boxplot for each module
for (mod in DEMs) {
    print(paste0("Processing ", mod, "..."))

    # Filter mod_logfc for the current module
    mod_logfc_mod <- mod_logfc %>% dplyr::filter(module == mod)

    # Create a PDF to save plots
    pdf(paste0("output/hdWGCNA_v11_glut_only/plots/Glutamatergic_v2/module_logFC_boxplot_", mod, ".pdf"), width = 9, height = 5)

    # Generate boxplot with CT on x axis, log2FoldChange on y-axis, and each point as a gene
    p <- ggplot(mod_logfc_mod, aes(x = factor(CT, levels = glut_cell_types), y = log2FoldChange, fill = CT)) +
        geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.01) +
        geom_jitter(position = position_jitter(0.2), size = 0.5) +
        ggtitle(paste0("log2FC of ", mod, " genes across Glut cell types")) +
        scale_x_discrete(name = "Cell_Type_2") +
        scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-0.5, 0.5)) +
        scale_fill_manual(values = c("#F8766D", "#FCBD49", "#7CAE00", "#00BFC4", "#C77CFF", "#FF61CC", "#619CFF", "#00BA38")) +
        NoLegend() +
        theme(
            panel.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90", color = NA),
            panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "white", size = 0.5),
            panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "white", size = 0.5),

            axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16),
            axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20),
            axis.title.y = element_text(size = 18)
        )

    # Print the plot to the PDF
    print(p)

    # Close the PDF file
    dev.off()
}
```

```{r}
mods <- paste0("Glut-M", 1:10)

glut_cell_types <- c(
  "Glutamatergic", "L2/3 IT Glut", "L4/5 IT Glut", "L5 IT Glut",
  "L5 ET Glut", "L6 IT Glut", "L6 CT Glut", "L6b Glut"
)

color_map <- c(
  "Glutamatergic" = "#F8766D",
  "L2/3 IT Glut" = "#FCBD49",
  "L4/5 IT Glut" = "#7CAE00",
  "L5 IT Glut" = "#C77CFF",
  "L5 ET Glut" = "#00BFC4",
  "L6 IT Glut" = "#FF61CC",
  "L6 CT Glut" = "#619CFF",
  "L6b Glut" = "#00BA38"
)

mod_logfc <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(glut_cell_types, function(CT) {
  CT_clean <- stringr::str_replace(CT, "/", "_")
  fp <- if (CT == "Glutamatergic") {
    "output/hdWGCNA_v11_glut_only/plots/module_logFC_tables/Glutamatergic_v2.xlsx"
  } else {
    paste0("output/hdWGCNA_v11_glut_only/plots/module_logFC_tables/Glutamatergic_v2_", CT_clean, ".xlsx")
  }

  readxl::read_excel(fp) %>%
    dplyr::filter(module %in% mods) %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      gene = as.character(gene),
      module = as.character(module),
      log2FoldChange = as.numeric(log2FoldChange),
      CT = CT
    )
}))

v5_stats <- readxl::read_excel(
  "output/hdWGCNA_v11_glut_only/plots/Glutamatergic_v2/mod_logFC_boxplot_testing/P60_module_logFC_boxplot_testing_v1-6_BH_stats.xlsx"
) %>%
  dplyr::filter(method == "v5") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(v5_sig = !is.na(signif) & signif != "") %>%
  dplyr::select(module, CT, v5_sig)

plot_module_logfc <- function(mod) {
  plot_df <- mod_logfc %>%
    dplyr::filter(module == mod) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(v5_stats, by = c("module", "CT")) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      CT = factor(CT, levels = glut_cell_types),
      alpha = ifelse(dplyr::coalesce(v5_sig, FALSE), 1, 0.2)
    )

  plot_df_faint <- plot_df %>% dplyr::filter(alpha == 0.2)
  plot_df_dark <- plot_df %>% dplyr::filter(alpha == 1)

  ggplot() +
    geom_boxplot(
      data = plot_df_faint,
      aes(x = CT, y = log2FoldChange, fill = CT),
      alpha = 0.2,
      outlier.size = 0.01
    ) +
    geom_boxplot(
      data = plot_df_dark,
      aes(x = CT, y = log2FoldChange, fill = CT),
      alpha = 1,
      outlier.size = 0.01
    ) +
    geom_jitter(
      data = plot_df_faint,
      aes(x = CT, y = log2FoldChange),
      color = "black",
      alpha = 0.2,
      size = 0.5,
      position = position_jitter(0.2)
    ) +
    geom_jitter(
      data = plot_df_dark,
      aes(x = CT, y = log2FoldChange),
      color = "black",
      alpha = 1,
      size = 0.5,
      position = position_jitter(0.2)
    ) +
    ggtitle(paste0("log2FC of ", mod, " genes across Glut cell types")) +
    scale_x_discrete(name = "Cell_Type_2", limits = glut_cell_types, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-0.5, 0.5)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = color_map, drop = FALSE) +
    theme(
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90", color = NA),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "white", size = 0.5),
      panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "white", size = 0.5),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16, angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 18),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
}

pdf(
  "output/hdWGCNA_v11_glut_only/plots/Glutamatergic_v2/module_logFC_boxplots_all_mods_v5_BH.pdf",
  width = 8.5,
  height = 4.5
)
for (mod in mods) {
  print(plot_module_logfc(mod))
}
dev.off()
```

```{r}

DEMs <- readRDS("output/hdWGCNA_v11_glut_only/plots/Glutamatergic_v2/sig_mods_pbLFC.rds")


# Initialize empty lists to store unfiltered and filtered GO term tables
GO_tables_unfiltered <- list()
GO_tables_filtered <- list()

   
   # Read GO term tables for all DEMs and save in GO_tables
for (mod in DEMs) {
   GO_table <- read_excel(paste("output/hdWGCNA_v11_glut_only/plots/Glutamatergic_v2/", mod, "_GOterms.xlsx", sep = ''))
    GO_table <- GO_table[order(GO_table$p.adjust), ]
    GO_table_unfilt <- GO_table  # Save unfiltered table
    GO_table_unfilt$module <- mod
    GO_table_filt <- head(GO_table, 50)     # Filter top 25 terms with lowest p.adjust
    GO_table_filt$module <- mod
    GO_tables_unfiltered[[mod]] <- GO_table_unfilt
    GO_tables_filtered[[mod]] <- GO_table_filt
  }


# Merge all tables in GO_tables_filtered and _unfiltered
GO_table_filtered <- bind_rows(GO_tables_filtered)
GO_table_unfiltered <- bind_rows(GO_tables_unfiltered)

# Get unique Descriptions and modules for GO_table_filtered
unique_descriptions <- unique(GO_table_filtered$Description)
unique_modules <- unique(GO_table_filtered$module)

# Create matrix for filtered data
GO_matrix_filtered <- matrix(NA, nrow = length(unique_descriptions), 
                                ncol = length(unique_modules),
                                dimnames = list(unique_descriptions, 
                                                unique_modules))


# Populate the matrix with p.adjust values from GO_table_filtered
for (i in 1:length(unique_descriptions)) {
  for (j in 1:length(unique_modules)) {
    p_adjust_value <- GO_table_filtered$p.adjust[GO_table_filtered$Description == unique_descriptions[i] & GO_table_filtered$module == unique_modules[j]]
    if (length(p_adjust_value) > 0) {
      GO_matrix_filtered[i, j] <- p_adjust_value
    }
  }
}


# Replace NAs in matrix with p.adjust from unfiltered 

# Loop through each cell of GO_matrix_filtered
for (i in 1:nrow(GO_matrix_filtered)) {
  for (j in 1:ncol(GO_matrix_filtered)) {
    print(paste("Processing cell [", i, ",", j, "]"))
    # Check if the cell is NA
    if (is.na(GO_matrix_filtered[i, j])) {
      # Find corresponding Description and module in the unfiltered matrix
      corresponding_row <- which(GO_table_unfiltered$Description == rownames(GO_matrix_filtered)[i] & GO_table_unfiltered$module == colnames(GO_matrix_filtered)[j])
      # If corresponding row is found, fill with p.adjust value
      if (any(corresponding_row)) {
        GO_matrix_filtered[i, j] <- GO_table_unfiltered$p.adjust[corresponding_row]
      } else {
        # If no corresponding row is found, fill with 1
        GO_matrix_filtered[i, j] <- 1
      }
    }
  }
}


# Convert the matrix to a data frame and add the "Term" column
GO_matrix_filtered_df <- as.data.frame(GO_matrix_filtered)
GO_matrix_filtered_df <- GO_matrix_filtered_df %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "Term")


# Save GO term matrix
write_xlsx(GO_matrix_filtered_df, "output/hdWGCNA_v11_glut_only/plots/Glutamatergic_v2/DEM_GO_mtx_top50.xlsx", col_names = TRUE)


# Create heatmap
plot <- Heatmap(
  GO_matrix_filtered,
  col = viridis(100, direction = -1),  # Reverse the viridis color paletteviridis(100),
  name = "p.adjust",
  cluster_rows = T,
  cluster_columns = F,
  row_names_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 8),
  column_names_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 8),
  show_column_names = TRUE,
  show_row_names = TRUE
)

print(plot)





pdf("output/hdWGCNA_v11_glut_only/plots/Glutamatergic_v2/DEM_GO_heatmap_top50.pdf", width = 6, height = 35 )

print(plot)

dev.off()
```

```{r}
GO_matrix_filtered <- GO_matrix_filtered[rownames(GO_matrix_filtered) %in% GO_filt_df$Description, ]

# Cluster rows by hierarchical clustering
row_order <- hclust(dist(GO_matrix_filtered))$order
GO_filt_df$Description <- factor(GO_filt_df$Description, levels = unique(GO_filt_df$Description)[row_order])


# Create the heatmap with y-axis labels on the right
heatmap <- ggplot(GO_filt_df, aes(x = module, y = Description)) +
  geom_tile(aes(fill = log_p_adjust)) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(limits = c(0, cap_value), breaks = c(0, 1, 2, 3), 
                       labels = c("0", "1", "2", ">3")) + # Change label for max value
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90", color = NA),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 9, margin = margin(t = 2, b = 0), angle = 90, vjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11, hjust = 1),  
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    legend.key.height = unit(0.6, "cm"),
    legend.key.width = unit(0.4, "cm")
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(position = "right")  # Moves y-axis labels to the right

# Print heatmap
print(heatmap)



# Save the heatmap as a PDF
pdf("output/hdWGCNA_v11_glut_only/plots/Glutamatergic_v2/DEM_GO_heatmap_filt.pdf", width = 6, height = 2)
print(heatmap)
dev.off()

# Save the heatmap as a PDF
pdf("output/hdWGCNA_v11_glut_only/plots/Glutamatergic_v2/DEM_GO_heatmap.pdf", width = 6.75, height = 6.75)
print(heatmap)
dev.off()
```

### -- Glut only

```{r}

# Initialize the final mod_DEG_content data frame
mod_DEG_content <- data.frame(
    module = character(),
    Cell_Type = character(),
    hdWGCNA_DE = character(),
    num_genes_up_p0.05 = integer(),
    num_genes_down_p0.05 = integer(),
    genes_up_p0.05 = character(),
    genes_down_p0.05 = character(),
    num_genes_up_p0.1 = integer(),
    num_genes_down_p0.1 = integer(),
    genes_up_p0.1 = character(),
    genes_down_p0.1 = character(),
    num_genes_up_padj0.05 = integer(),
    num_genes_down_padj0.05 = integer(),
    genes_up_padj0.05 = character(),
    genes_down_padj0.05 = character(),
    num_genes_up_padj0.1 = integer(),
    num_genes_down_padj0.1 = integer(),
    genes_up_padj0.1 = character(),
    genes_down_padj0.1 = character(),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

mod_DEG_content_list <- list()

CTs <- c("L2/3 IT Glut", "L4/5 IT Glut", "L5 IT Glut", "L5 ET Glut", "L6 IT Glut", "L6 CT Glut", "L6b Glut")

# Loop through all unique cell types
for (CT in CTs) {
  print(paste0("Processing ", CT, "..."))
  
  CT <- str_replace(CT, '/', '_')
  
  # Import sig up and sig down modules
  up_mods <- c("Glut-M1", "Glut-M2", "Glut-M3", "Glut-M4", "Glut-M7", "Glut-M9", "Glut-M10")
  down_mods <- c("Glut-M6")
  
  # Load the module-logFC table based on the cell type
    mod_logFC <- read_excel(paste0("output/hdWGCNA_v11_glut_only/plots/module_logFC_tables/Glutamatergic_v2_", CT, ".xlsx")) %>%
      dplyr::filter(cluster == str_replace(CT, '_', '/'))

  
   # Loop through unique modules in mod_logFC
    for (mod in unique(mod_logFC$module)) {
        
        # Initialize variables to store the count of up/down genes based on different p-value and padj thresholds
        num_genes_up_p0.05 <- sum(mod_logFC$module == mod & mod_logFC$log2FoldChange > 0 & mod_logFC$pvalue < 0.05)
        num_genes_down_p0.05 <- sum(mod_logFC$module == mod & mod_logFC$log2FoldChange < 0 & mod_logFC$pvalue < 0.05)
        num_genes_up_p0.1 <- sum(mod_logFC$module == mod & mod_logFC$log2FoldChange > 0 & mod_logFC$pvalue < 0.1)
        num_genes_down_p0.1 <- sum(mod_logFC$module == mod & mod_logFC$log2FoldChange < 0 & mod_logFC$pvalue < 0.1)
        num_genes_up_padj0.05 <- sum(mod_logFC$module == mod & mod_logFC$log2FoldChange > 0 & mod_logFC$padj < 0.05)
        num_genes_down_padj0.05 <- sum(mod_logFC$module == mod & mod_logFC$log2FoldChange < 0 & mod_logFC$padj < 0.05)
        num_genes_up_padj0.1 <- sum(mod_logFC$module == mod & mod_logFC$log2FoldChange > 0 & mod_logFC$padj < 0.1)
        num_genes_down_padj0.1 <- sum(mod_logFC$module == mod & mod_logFC$log2FoldChange < 0 & mod_logFC$padj < 0.1)
        
        # Extract gene names passing the p-value and padj cutoffs
        genes_up_p0.05 <- paste(mod_logFC$gene[mod_logFC$module == mod & mod_logFC$log2FoldChange > 0 & mod_logFC$pvalue < 0.05], collapse = "/")
        genes_down_p0.05 <- paste(mod_logFC$gene[mod_logFC$module == mod & mod_logFC$log2FoldChange < 0 & mod_logFC$pvalue < 0.05], collapse = "/")
        genes_up_p0.1 <- paste(mod_logFC$gene[mod_logFC$module == mod & mod_logFC$log2FoldChange > 0 & mod_logFC$pvalue < 0.1], collapse = "/")
        genes_down_p0.1 <- paste(mod_logFC$gene[mod_logFC$module == mod & mod_logFC$log2FoldChange < 0 & mod_logFC$pvalue < 0.1], collapse = "/")
        genes_up_padj0.05 <- paste(mod_logFC$gene[mod_logFC$module == mod & mod_logFC$log2FoldChange > 0 & mod_logFC$padj < 0.05], collapse = "/")
        genes_down_padj0.05 <- paste(mod_logFC$gene[mod_logFC$module == mod & mod_logFC$log2FoldChange < 0 & mod_logFC$padj < 0.05], collapse = "/")
        genes_up_padj0.1 <- paste(mod_logFC$gene[mod_logFC$module == mod & mod_logFC$log2FoldChange > 0 & mod_logFC$padj < 0.1], collapse = "/")
        genes_down_padj0.1 <- paste(mod_logFC$gene[mod_logFC$module == mod & mod_logFC$log2FoldChange < 0 & mod_logFC$padj < 0.1], collapse = "/")
        
        # Determine if the module is in the up or down mods list
        if (mod %in% up_mods) {
            hdWGCNA_DE <- "up"
        } else if (mod %in% down_mods) {
            hdWGCNA_DE <- "down"
        } else {
            hdWGCNA_DE <- "not DE"
        }

        # Append the information to the mod_DEG_content table 
        new_row <- data.frame(
        Cell_Type = str_replace(CT, '_', '/'),
        module = mod,
        hdWGCNA_DE = hdWGCNA_DE,
        num_genes_up_p0.05 = num_genes_up_p0.05,
        num_genes_down_p0.05 = num_genes_down_p0.05,
        genes_up_p0.05 = genes_up_p0.05,
        genes_down_p0.05 = genes_down_p0.05,
        num_genes_up_p0.1 = num_genes_up_p0.1,
        num_genes_down_p0.1 = num_genes_down_p0.1,
        genes_up_p0.1 = genes_up_p0.1,
        genes_down_p0.1 = genes_down_p0.1,
        num_genes_up_padj0.05 = num_genes_up_padj0.05,
        num_genes_down_padj0.05 = num_genes_down_padj0.05,
        genes_up_padj0.05 = genes_up_padj0.05,
        genes_down_padj0.05 = genes_down_padj0.05,
        num_genes_up_padj0.1 = num_genes_up_padj0.1,
        num_genes_down_padj0.1 = num_genes_down_padj0.1,
        genes_up_padj0.1 = genes_up_padj0.1,
        genes_down_padj0.1 = genes_down_padj0.1,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
      
      mod_DEG_content_list[[length(mod_DEG_content_list) + 1]] <- new_row
    }
}

# Combine all collected rows into the final data frame
mod_DEG_content <- do.call(rbind, mod_DEG_content_list)


# Second loop - use mod_DEG_content to update mod_logFC
for (CT in CTs) {
  print(paste0("Processing ", CT, "..."))
  
  CT_file <- str_replace(CT, '/', '_')
  
  # Load the module-logFC table based on the cell type
  mod_logFC <- read_excel(paste0("output/hdWGCNA_v11_glut_only/plots/module_logFC_tables/Glutamatergic_v2_", CT_file, ".xlsx")) %>%
    dplyr::filter(cluster == CT)
  
  # Prepare new columns initialized as NA
  new_cols <- c("num_genes_up_p0.05", "num_genes_down_p0.05", "num_genes_up_p0.1", "num_genes_down_p0.1","num_genes_up_padj0.05", "num_genes_down_padj0.05", "num_genes_up_padj0.1", "num_genes_down_padj0.1", "hdWGCNA_DE")
  
  mod_logFC[new_cols] <- NA
  
  # Filter mod_DEG_content for CT
  mod_DEG_content_CT <- mod_DEG_content %>% dplyr::filter(Cell_Type == CT)
  
  # Match rows in mod_logFC to mod_DEG_content by module name
  match_idx <- match(mod_logFC$module, mod_DEG_content_CT$module)
  
  # For rows with a match, assign values from mod_DEG_content
  matched_rows <- which(!is.na(match_idx))
  
  for (colname in new_cols) {
    mod_logFC[matched_rows, colname] <- mod_DEG_content_CT[match_idx[matched_rows], colname]
  }
  
  # Remove temporary adjusted module column
  mod_logFC$module_adj <- NULL
  
  # Save the updated mod_logFC as Excel
  write_xlsx(mod_logFC, paste0("output/hdWGCNA_v11_glut_only/plots/module_logFC_tables/Glutamatergic_v2_", CT_file, "_updated.xlsx"))
}



# Reorder 'hdWGCNA_DE' factor 
mod_DEG_content$hdWGCNA_DE <- factor(mod_DEG_content$hdWGCNA_DE, levels = c("up", "down", "not DE"))

# Create a data frame for module labels and their corresponding colors
label_colors <- data.frame(
  module = mod_DEG_content$module,
  color = ifelse(mod_DEG_content$hdWGCNA_DE == "up", "blue",
                 ifelse(mod_DEG_content$hdWGCNA_DE == "down", "red", "black"))
)

# Get unique modules in the factor order
unique_modules <- c("Glut-M1", "Glut-M2", "Glut-M3", "Glut-M4", "Glut-M5",
                    "Glut-M6", "Glut-M7", "Glut-M8", "Glut-M9", "Glut-M10")

# Make sure to get distinct colors per module
label_colors_unique <- label_colors %>%
  dplyr::distinct(module, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(factor(module, levels = unique_modules))

# Create named vector of labels with colors
custom_labels <- setNames(
  paste0("<span style='color:", label_colors_unique$color, "'>", label_colors_unique$module, "</span>"),
  label_colors_unique$module
)


# For each module Glut-M1 thru M10 in mod_DEG_content$module (excluding grey), count the number of unique genes p < 0.05 and p < 0.1 that are up in at least one CT (mod_DEG_conent$cell_type) (count_up_05, count_up_1) and down in at least one cell type (count_down_05, count_down_1)


unique_DEG_counts <- mod_DEG_content %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("genes_"),
    names_to = "direction_pval",
    values_to = "genes"
  ) %>%
  separate_rows(genes, sep = "/") %>%
  dplyr::filter(genes != "") %>%
  mutate(
    stat = case_when(
      grepl("up", direction_pval) ~ "up",
      grepl("down", direction_pval) ~ "down"
    ),
    threshold = case_when(
      grepl("p0.05", direction_pval) ~ "p0.05",
      grepl("p0.1", direction_pval) ~ "p0.1",
      grepl("padj0.05", direction_pval) ~ "padj0.05",
      grepl("padj0.1", direction_pval) ~ "padj0.1"
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(module, stat, threshold) %>%
  summarize(unique_genes = n_distinct(genes), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = c(stat, threshold),
    values_from = unique_genes,
    names_glue = "count_{stat}_{threshold}"
  )


unique_DEG_counts <- unique_DEG_counts %>%
  dplyr::filter(module != "grey") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(across(-module, ~replace_na(.x, 0)))


# Convert wide to long
unique_DEG_counts_long <- unique_DEG_counts %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -module,
    names_to = c("direction", "pval_thresh"),
    names_pattern = "count_(up|down)_(p.*)",
    values_to = "num_genes"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    pval_thresh = case_when(
      pval_thresh == "p0.05"     ~ "p < 0.05",
      pval_thresh == "p0.1"      ~ "p < 0.1",
      pval_thresh == "padj0.05"  ~ "padj < 0.05",
      pval_thresh == "padj0.1"   ~ "padj < 0.1",
      TRUE ~ pval_thresh
    ),
    direction = factor(direction, levels = c("up", "down"))
  )

# Split into 0.1 and 0.05
unique_DEG_counts_long05 <- unique_DEG_counts_long %>% dplyr::filter(pval_thresh == "p < 0.05")
unique_DEG_counts_long1  <- unique_DEG_counts_long %>% dplyr::filter(pval_thresh == "p < 0.1")

# Make 'module' a factor with levels matching custom_labels names
unique_DEG_counts_long05$module <- factor(unique_DEG_counts_long05$module, levels = names(custom_labels))
unique_DEG_counts_long1$module <- factor(unique_DEG_counts_long1$module, levels = names(custom_labels))


# 1. Plot for p < 0.05
plot_p05 <- ggplot(unique_DEG_counts_long05, aes(x = module, y = num_genes, fill = direction)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge", width = 0.4) + 
  labs(title = "DEG distribution across modules (p < 0.05)", 
       x = "Module", 
       y = "Number of DEGs", 
       fill = "DEG Direction") + 
  scale_x_discrete(labels = custom_labels) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("up" = "blue", "down" = "red")) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_markdown(size = 20, angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_markdown(size = 20),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 22, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 22, face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 20),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 22)
  )




# 2. Plot for p < 0.1
plot_p1 <- ggplot(unique_DEG_counts_long1, aes(x = module, y = num_genes, fill = direction)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge", width = 0.4) + 
  labs(title = "DEG distribution across modules (p < 0.1)", 
       x = "Module", 
       y = "Number of DEGs", 
       fill = "DEG Direction") + 
  scale_x_discrete(labels = custom_labels) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("up" = "blue", "down" = "red")) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_markdown(size = 20, angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_markdown(size = 20),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 22, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 22, face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 20),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 22)
  )



# Save plots to a PDF
pdf("output/hdWGCNA_v11_glut_only/plots/module_DEG_content.pdf", width = 28, height = 9)
print(plot_p1)
dev.off()



# Save the final mod_DEG_content to a file
write_xlsx(mod_DEG_content, "output/hdWGCNA_v11_glut_only/plots/mod_DEG_content.xlsx")


# Perform Fisher’s test: up vs down DEGs within each module
run_fisher_up_vs_down <- function(df, pval_col_up, pval_col_down) {
  modules <- df$module
  results <- lapply(seq_along(modules), function(i) {
    mod <- modules[i]
    up_count   <- df[[pval_col_up]][i]
    down_count <- df[[pval_col_down]][i]

    other_up   <- sum(df[[pval_col_up]]) - up_count
    other_down <- sum(df[[pval_col_down]]) - down_count

    contingency <- matrix(
      c(up_count, down_count, other_up, other_down),
      nrow = 2,
      byrow = TRUE,
      dimnames = list(c("ThisModule", "OtherModules"), c("Up", "Down"))
    )

    ft <- fisher.test(contingency)

    tibble(
      module = mod,
      odds_ratio = ft$estimate,
      p_value = ft$p.value,
      contingency = list(contingency)
    )
  })

  bind_rows(results) %>%
    mutate(
      p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"),
      signif = case_when(
        p_adj < 0.001 ~ "***",
        p_adj < 0.01  ~ "**",
        p_adj < 0.05  ~ "*",
        TRUE          ~ "ns"
      )
    ) %>%
    arrange(p_adj)
}

# Run test on the p < 0.05 threshold table
results_mod_fisher_p05 <- run_fisher_up_vs_down(
  df = unique_DEG_counts,
  pval_col_up = "count_up_p0.05",
  pval_col_down = "count_down_p0.05"
)

# Optionally run for p < 0.1 as well
results_mod_fisher_p1 <- run_fisher_up_vs_down(
  df = unique_DEG_counts,
  pval_col_up = "count_up_p0.1",
  pval_col_down = "count_down_p0.1"
)

# View the results
print(results_mod_fisher_p05)
print(results_mod_fisher_p1)
```

```{r}
# Get all modules for Glutamatergic_v2
mods <- readRDS("output/hdWGCNA_v11_glut_only/plots/all_mods_CT3_v2.rds")
mods <- mods[order(as.numeric(sub("Glut-M", "", mods)))]
mods <- c(mods, "grey")

# Get vector of glut cell types
metadata <- all.ctx@meta.data
glut_metadata <- metadata[metadata$Cell_Type_3 == "Glutamatergic", ]
glut_cell_types <- unique(glut_metadata$Cell_Type_2)
glut_cell_types <- c("Glutamatergic", glut_cell_types)

# Make empty matrix with nrow = length(mods) and ncol = length(glut_cell_types)
matrix <- matrix(NA, nrow = length(mods), ncol = length(glut_cell_types),
                 dimnames = list(mods, glut_cell_types))

# Populate matrix
for (mod in mods) {
  for (CT in glut_cell_types) {
    
    print(paste0("Processing ", mod, ", ", CT, "..."))
    
    # Filter the Seurat object for the current cell type and genotype
    if (CT == "Glutamatergic") {
      so <- subset(all.ctx, subset = Cell_Type_3 == CT & GenMulti == "wt")
      } else {
        so <- subset(all.ctx, subset = Cell_Type_2 == CT & GenMulti == "wt")
      }
    
    # Get module genes
    mod_genes <- read_excel("output/hdWGCNA_v11_glut_only/plots/Glutamatergic_v2/modules.xlsx") %>% dplyr::filter(module == mod) %>% pull(gene_name)
    
    # Use AddModuleScore to compute module scores
    so <- AddModuleScore(
      object = so,
      features = list(mod_genes),
      name = paste0("ModuleScore_", mod)
    )
    
    # Extract the module score column
    mod_score_col <- make.names(paste0("ModuleScore_", mod, "1"))
    
    # Compute the median module score
    if (mod_score_col %in% colnames(so@meta.data)) {
      print("Found modscore col in metadata")
      median_modscore <- median(so@meta.data[[mod_score_col]], na.rm = TRUE)
    } else {
      print("Modscore col not found in metadata, inserting NA")
      median_modscore <- NA
    }
    
    # Insert the median module score into the matrix
    matrix[mod, CT] <- median_modscore
  }
}

# Desired column order
desired_order <- c("Glutamatergic", "L2/3 IT Glut", "L4/5 IT Glut", "L5 IT Glut", 
                   "L5 ET Glut", "L6 IT Glut", "L6 CT Glut", "L6b Glut")

# Reorder the columns of the matrix
```

## - logFC boxplots of Glut module genes in bulk data

```{r}

# Get master table with genes, module, and logFC in each bulk 

# Get Glut modules/genes
mod_genes <- read_excel("output/hdWGCNA_v11_glut_only/plots/Glutamatergic_v2/modules.xlsx") %>% dplyr::rename(gene = gene_name) %>% dplyr::select(gene, module)

# Import DE tables with logFCs
load_DE_results <- function(file, dataset_name, logfc_col = "logFC", pval_col = "PValue") {
  read.csv(file) %>%
    dplyr::select(gene_name, all_of(logfc_col), all_of(pval_col)) %>%
    dplyr::rename(gene = gene_name, logFC = all_of(logfc_col), pvalue = all_of(pval_col)) %>%
    #dplyr::filter(pvalue < 0.05) %>%
    distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(dataset = dataset_name)
}

# Load datasets
Const_DE <- load_DE_results("DE_Ctx_full.csv", "bulk_const")
Cond_DE <- load_DE_results("DE_simple_conditional.csv", "bulk_cond")
Nuc_DE <- load_DE_results("WT_vs_HET_Nuc_DE_genotype_corrected_v2.csv", "bulk_nuc")
Syn_DE <- load_DE_results("WT_vs_HET_Syn_DE_genotype_corrected_v2.csv", "bulk_syn")

# Join logFCs into mod_genes
mod_genes <- mod_genes %>%
  left_join(Const_DE %>% dplyr::select(gene, logFC) %>% dplyr::rename(Const = logFC), by = c("gene" = "gene")) %>%
  left_join(Cond_DE  %>% dplyr::select(gene, logFC) %>% dplyr::rename(Cond  = logFC), by = c("gene" = "gene")) %>%
  left_join(Nuc_DE  %>% dplyr::select(gene, logFC) %>% dplyr::rename(Nuc   = logFC), by = c("gene" = "gene")) %>%
  left_join(Syn_DE  %>% dplyr::select(gene, logFC) %>% dplyr::rename(Syn   = logFC), by = c("gene" = "gene"))


# Make boxplots

# Open a PDF to save the plots
pdf("output/hdWGCNA_v11_glut_only/plots/Glutamatergic_v2/bulk_logFC_by_module_boxplots.pdf", width = 8, height = 6)

# Define the bulk datasets
bulk_datasets <- c("Const", "Cond", "Nuc", "Syn")

# Loop over each dataset
for (dataset in bulk_datasets) {
  
  # Subset mod_genes for the current dataset (filter columns representing datasets)
  mod_genes_subset <- mod_genes[, c("module", dataset)]  # Get the logFC values for the current dataset
  
  # Generate list of comparisons (i.e., comparing each module to grey module)
  # First generate df with comparisons
  comps_df <- data.frame(matrix(ncol = 3, nrow = length(unique(mod_genes_subset$module))))
  rownames(comps_df) <- unique(mod_genes_subset$module)
  colnames(comps_df) <- c('grey', 'full_mod_name', 'mod_number')
  comps_df <- comps_df[which(rownames(comps_df) != "grey"), ]

  for (i in 1:nrow(comps_df)) {
    # First set grey col = 'grey'
    comps_df[i, "grey"] <- 'grey'
    # Next populate full_mod_name col with rowname
    comps_df[i, "full_mod_name"] <- rownames(comps_df[i, ])
    # Next populate mod_number col
    comps_df[i, "mod_number"] <- as.numeric(gsub("\\D", "", comps_df[i, "full_mod_name"]))
  }

  # Arrange df by mod_number, then remove mod_number col
  comps_df <- comps_df %>% arrange(mod_number)
  comps_df$mod_number <- NULL

  # Turn rows of df into items of list using lapply
  comps_list <- lapply(1:nrow(comps_df), function(i) {
    vector <- c(comps_df[i, "grey"], comps_df[i, "full_mod_name"])
    return(vector)
  })

  # Perform t-test comparisons between modules and grey module for the current dataset
  comparison <- compare_means(as.formula(paste(dataset, "~ module")), mod_genes_subset, method = "t.test")

  # Apply Bonferroni correction to the p-values
  comparison$p.adj <- p.adjust(comparison$p, method = "bonferroni")

  # Create a new significance column based on adjusted p-values
  comparison$p.adj.signif <- symnum(comparison$p.adj, 
                                    cutpoints = c(0, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 1), 
                                    symbols = c("***", "**", "*", "ns"))

  # Filter comparisons where group1 is "grey" or where group1 is "Glut-M1" and group2 is "grey"
  grey_comparisons <- comparison[comparison$group1 == "grey" | (comparison$group1 == "Glut-M1" & comparison$group2 == "grey"), ]

  # Swap group1 and group2 for the row where group2 was "grey"
  grey_comparisons[grey_comparisons$group2 == "grey", c("group1", "group2")] <- 
  grey_comparisons[grey_comparisons$group2 == "grey", c("group2", "group1")]
  
  # Filter significant comparisons where adjusted p-value is less than 0.05
  significant_comparisons <- grey_comparisons$p.adj < 0.05
  
  # Add mod_number to mod_genes_subset
  mod_genes_subset$mod_number <- as.numeric(gsub("\\D", "", mod_genes_subset$module))  # Extract numeric part of 'module'
  mod_genes_subset$mod_number[is.na(mod_genes_subset$mod_number)] <- 0

  # Reorder the 'module' column based on the 'mod_number' column
  mod_genes_subset$mod_number <- as.numeric(mod_genes_subset$mod_number)
  mod_genes_subset$module <- fct_reorder(mod_genes_subset$module, mod_genes_subset$mod_number, .fun = median)

  # Prep x axis labels
  xlabs <- unique(mod_genes_subset$module)
  n_genes <- dplyr::count(mod_genes_subset, module)
  n_genes <- mutate(n_genes, n_module = paste(module, '\n(n = ', n, ')', sep = ''))
  xlabs <- n_genes$n_module

  # Generate boxplot for the current dataset
  p <- ggplot(mod_genes_subset, aes(x = module, y = get(dataset), fill = module)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.01) +
    geom_jitter(position = position_jitter(0.2), size = 0.001) +
    ggtitle(paste('logFC of genes in Glut modules - ', dataset, sep = '')) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = xlabs) +
    NoLegend() +
    ylab(paste0("logFC_", dataset)) +  
    theme(
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90", color = NA),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "white", size = 0.5),
      panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "white", size = 0.5)
    )

  # Manually add lines and significance labels for adjusted p-values
  base_y <- max(mod_genes_subset[[dataset]], na.rm = TRUE) + 0.5
  increment <- 0.4  # Increase this increment value for more vertical space

  for (i in 2:length(xlabs)) {
    curr_mod <- gsub("\n\\(n = .+\\)", "", xlabs[i]) # Extract module name
    p.adj <- grey_comparisons$p.adj[grey_comparisons$group2 == curr_mod]
    signif_label <- grey_comparisons$p.adj.signif[grey_comparisons$group2 == curr_mod] # change this to grey_comparisons$p.adj if want padj values as labels. will need to add something to round. could also do paste0(p.adj, p.signif) for both.
    
    # Determine y position for annotation
    if (!is.na(p.adj)) {
      y_position <- base_y + (i-1) * increment - 0.1
    } else {
      y_position <- base_y + (i-1) * increment - 0.1  # can lower this if want ns label position to be closer to line
    }
    
    if (!is.na(p.adj)) {
      p <- p +
        annotate("segment", x = 1, xend = i, y = y_position, yend = y_position) +
        annotate("text", x = (1 + i) / 2, y = y_position + 0.05, label = signif_label, vjust = 0)
    }
  }

  # Print the boxplot for the current dataset
  print(p)
}

dev.off()

```



## - Matrix and heatmap of median logFC of Glut modules (v2) in glutamatergic cell types

```{r}

# Get all modules for Glutamatergic_v2
mods <- readRDS("output/hdWGCNA_v11_glut_only/plots/all_mods_CT3_v2.rds")
mods <- mods[order(as.numeric(sub("Glut-M", "", mods)))]
mods <- c(mods, "grey")

# Get vector of glut cell types
metadata <- all.ctx@meta.data
glut_metadata <- metadata[metadata$Cell_Type_3 == "Glutamatergic", ]
glut_cell_types <- unique(glut_metadata$Cell_Type_2)
glut_cell_types <- c("Glutamatergic", glut_cell_types)

# Make empty matrix with nrow = length(mods) and ncol = length(glut_cell_types)
matrix <- matrix(NA, nrow = length(mods), ncol = length(glut_cell_types),
                 dimnames = list(mods, glut_cell_types))

# Populate matrix
for (mod in mods) {
  for (CT in glut_cell_types) {
    
    CT <- str_replace(CT, '/', '_')
    
    # Read in mod logFC table
    if (CT == "Glutamatergic") {
      mod_logfc <- read_excel(paste0("output/hdWGCNA_v11_glut_only/plots/module_logFC_tables/Glutamatergic_v2.xlsx"))
    } else {
      mod_logfc <- read_excel(paste0("output/hdWGCNA_v11_glut_only/plots/module_logFC_tables/Glutamatergic_v2_", CT, ".xlsx"))
    }
    
    CT <- str_replace(CT, '_', '/')
    
    # Filter for the current module
    filtered_logfc <- mod_logfc[mod_logfc$module == mod, ]
  
    
    # Compute the median log2 fold change
    if (nrow(filtered_logfc) > 0) {
      median_logfc <- median((filtered_logfc$log2FoldChange* (1/filtered_logfc$pvalue)), na.rm = TRUE)
    } else {
      median_logfc <- 0
    }
    
    
    # Insert the value into the matrix
    matrix[mod, CT] <- median_logfc
  }
}


# Desired column order
desired_order <- c("Glutamatergic", "L2/3 IT Glut", "L4/5 IT Glut", "L5 IT Glut", 
                   "L5 ET Glut", "L6 IT Glut", "L6 CT Glut", "L6b Glut")

# Reorder the columns of the matrix
matrix <- matrix[, match(desired_order, colnames(matrix))]

# Save matrix
df_matrix <- as.data.frame(matrix)
df_matrix$module <- rownames(matrix)
write_xlsx(df_matrix, "output/hdWGCNA_v11_glut_only/plots/Glutamatergic_v2/median_logFC_mtx.xlsx")

# Reorder the columns of the matrix

# Define bounds
adjusted_min <- -0.1
adjusted_max <- 0.1

# Cap values in the matrix to -0.1 and 0.1
matrix <- apply(matrix, c(1, 2), function(x) max(min(x, adjusted_max), adjusted_min))

# Define color palette with capped range

)

)
```

```{r}
# Make empty matrix with nrow = length(mods) and ncol = length(glut_cell_types)
matrix <- matrix(NA, nrow = length(mods), ncol = length(glut_cell_types),
                 dimnames = list(mods, glut_cell_types))

# Populate matrix
for (mod in mods) {
  for (CT in glut_cell_types) {
    
    CT <- str_replace(CT, '/', '_')
    
    # Read in mod logFC table
    if (CT == "Glutamatergic") {
      mod_logfc <- read_excel(paste0("output/hdWGCNA_v11_glut_only/plots/module_logFC_tables/Glutamatergic_v2.xlsx"))
    } else {
      mod_logfc <- read_excel(paste0("output/hdWGCNA_v11_glut_only/plots/module_logFC_tables/Glutamatergic_v2_", CT, ".xlsx"))
    }
    
    CT <- str_replace(CT, '_', '/')
```

```{r}

Cell_Types <- c("Cell_Type_1", "Cell_Type_2", "Cell_Type_3")

for (cell_type in Cell_Types) {
  
  # Get CT from cell_type (extract the number at the end)
  CT <- paste0("CT", str_extract(cell_type, "\\d+"))
  
  # Get list of unique clusters at this level
  clusters <- unique(all.ctx@meta.data[[cell_type]])
  
  # Initialize list to store DE tables
  Cell_Type_DE_list <- list()
  
  i <- 0
  
  for (cluster in clusters) {
    
    i <- i + 1 
    
    print(paste0("Working on ", cell_type, ", cluster ", i, " of ", length(clusters), "..."))
    
    # Replace slashes with underscores in cluster name
    cluster_fp <- str_replace_all(cluster, "/", "_")
    
    # Construct file path to DE table
    file_path <- paste0("output/markers_v11/Pseudobulk/", CT, "/results/DE_", cluster_fp, ".csv")
    
    # Check if the file exists before reading
    if (file.exists(file_path)) {
      
      # Read the DE table
      DE_table_cluster <- read_csv(file_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
      DE_table_cluster <- DE_table_cluster %>% dplyr::select(-`...1`) %>% dplyr::select(gene, everything()) %>% dplyr::rename(!!cell_type := cluster) 
      
      # Append to list
      Cell_Type_DE_list[[cluster]] <- DE_table_cluster
    } else {
      message(paste("Missing file:", file_path))
    }
  }
  
  # Combine all DE tables into a master table
  master_DE_table <- bind_rows(Cell_Type_DE_list)
  
  # Write to file
  write_csv(master_DE_table, paste0("output/markers_v11/Pseudobulk/", CT, "/results/DE_All.csv"))
}
```

```{r}

# analysis of Yi Zuo sleep EEG/EMG data

# read in data
my.data <- read.csv("ZuoSleepData.csv", header = TRUE) 
my.metadata <- read.csv("Zuo_Metadata.csv", header = TRUE)

# initiate objects and set row/columns for splitting
wt.values <- list(NA,NA,NA,NA,NA,NA)
het.values <- list(NA,NA,NA,NA,NA,NA)
names(wt.values) <- c("REM.light", "REM.dark", "NREM.light", "NREM.dark", "Wake.light", "Wake.dark")
names(het.values) <- c("REM.light", "REM.dark", "NREM.light", "NREM.dark", "Wake.light", "Wake.dark")
wt.cols <- c(3:10)
het.cols <- c(11:21)
light.rows <- c(1:12)
dark.rows <- c(13:24)
start.row <- c(1,25,49)
element.index <- c(1,3,5)

# compare subject total time in each stage in wake and sleep cycle
wt.total.light <- rep(NA, length(wt.values))
wt.total.dark <- rep(NA, length(wt.values))
het.total.light <- rep(NA, length(wt.values))
het.total.dark <- rep(NA, length(wt.values))
# loop over each wt and generate summmary value
for (stage.index in 1:3) {
  for (index in 1:length(wt.cols)) {
    wt.total.light[index] <- sum(my.data[light.rows+(start.row[stage.index]-1),wt.cols[index]])
  }
  for (index in 1:length(het.cols)) {
    het.total.light[index] <- sum(my.data[light.rows+(start.row[stage.index]-1),het.cols[index]])
  }
  for (index in 1:length(wt.cols)) {
    wt.total.dark[index] <- sum(my.data[dark.rows+(start.row[stage.index]-1),wt.cols[index]])
  }
  for (index in 1:length(het.cols)) {
    het.total.dark[index] <- sum(my.data[dark.rows+(start.row[stage.index]-1),het.cols[index]])
  }
  wt.values[[(element.index[stage.index])]] <- wt.total.light
  wt.values[[(element.index[stage.index]+1)]] <- wt.total.dark
  het.values[[(element.index[stage.index])]] <- het.total.light
  het.values[[(element.index[stage.index]+1)]] <- het.total.dark
}

# run t.test on each contrast
for (index in 1:6) {
  print(names(wt.values)[index])
  print(t.test(wt.values[[index]], het.values[[index]]))
}

# generate basic boxplot
boxplot(c(wt.values, het.values))

#save values in list object
time.total <- list(wt.values, het.values)
```

```{r}

# ----------------------------
# Fisher enrichment tests per module
# ----------------------------

modules <- paste0("M", 1:10)

results <- lapply(modules, function(m) {

  a <- sum(Nuc_DE_annot$module == m & Nuc_DE_annot$logFC_nuc > 0)
  b <- sum(Nuc_DE_annot$module != m & Nuc_DE_annot$logFC_nuc > 0)

  c <- sum(Nuc_DE_annot$module == m & Nuc_DE_annot$logFC_nuc < 0)
  d <- sum(Nuc_DE_annot$module != m & Nuc_DE_annot$logFC_nuc < 0)

  mat <- matrix(c(a,b,c,d), nrow = 2,
                dimnames = list(
                  c("Up","Down"),
                  c("Module","Other")
                ))

  ft <- fisher.test(mat)

  data.frame(
    module = m,
    up_in_module = a,
    up_other = b,
    down_in_module = c,
    down_other = d,
    odds_ratio = ft$estimate,
    pvalue = ft$p.value
  )
})

results_df <- bind_rows(results)

# BH correction
results_df$padj <- p.adjust(results_df$pvalue, method = "BH")

# Add significance symbols
results_df <- results_df %>%
  mutate(
    sig = case_when(
      padj < 0.001 ~ "***",
      padj < 0.01  ~ "**",
      padj < 0.05  ~ "*",
      padj < 0.1   ~ ".",
      TRUE         ~ ""
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(padj)

print(results_df)

# Any module with odds ratio less than one is enriched in downreg genes, any modue with odds ratio greater than 1 is enriched in upreg genes. =1 means no bias

```



## Looking for enrichment of ASD risk genes in DEGs


```{r}


# Initialize empty lists
All_DEGs <- list()
All_DE_results <- list()

# ASD risk genes list
ASD_risk_genes <- c(
  'Adnp', 'Ank2', 'Arid1b', 'Arid2', 'Ash1l', 'Bcl11a', 'Chd8', 'Cntnap2',
  'Cul3', 'Dscam', 'Dyrk1a', 'Dync1h1', 'Grin2b', 'Katnal2', 'Kdm5b',
  'Kmt2a', 'Kmt2c', 'Med13l', 'Nckap1', 'Nrnx1', 'Pogz', 'Pten', 'Scn2a',
  'Setd5', 'Shank3', 'Slc6a1', 'Stxbp1', 'Syngap1', 'Tbr1', 'Tcf4',
  'Tnrc6b', 'Trip12', 'Wac'
)

# Iterate over CTs
for (CT in unique(all.ctx$Cell_Type_2)) {
  CT_fp <- str_replace(CT, '/', '_')
  DE_path <- paste0("output/markers_v11/Pseudobulk/CT2/results/DE_", CT_fp, ".csv")
  DEGs <- read.csv(DE_path)

  # Store full DE result (all tested genes)
  All_DE_results[[CT]] <- DE_table

  # Filter for DEGs (p < 0.1)
  DEGs_filtered <- DE_table %>% filter(pvalue < 0.1)
  All_DEGs[[CT]] <- DEGs_filtered
}

# Create list of all tested genes across all CTs
all_tested_genes <- unique(unlist(map(All_DE_results, ~.$gene)))

# Enrichment analysis
enrichment_df <- map_dfr(names(All_DEGs), function(CT) {
  degs <- All_DEGs[[CT]]
  all_genes <- All_DE_results[[CT]]$gene  # All tested genes for this CT

  deg_genes <- degs$gene
  n_total <- length(deg_genes)
  n_asd <- sum(deg_genes %in% ASD_risk_genes)
  percent_asd <- (n_asd / n_total) * 100

  # Background = genes tested but not DEG in this CT
  background_genes <- setdiff(all_genes, deg_genes)
  n_bg_asd <- sum(background_genes %in% ASD_risk_genes)
  n_bg_non_asd <- length(background_genes) - n_bg_asd
  n_non_asd <- n_total - n_asd

  fisher_mat <- matrix(c(n_asd, n_non_asd, n_bg_asd, n_bg_non_asd), nrow = 2)
  fisher_p <- fisher.test(fisher_mat, alternative = "greater")$p.value

  tibble(CellType = CT, Total_DEGs = n_total, ASD_DEGs = n_asd,
         Percent_ASD = percent_asd, P_value = fisher_p)
})

# Adjust p-values for multiple testing
enrichment_df$P_adj <- p.adjust(enrichment_df$P_value, method = "BH")

# Bar plot
ggplot(enrichment_df, aes(x = reorder(CellType, -Percent_ASD), y = Percent_ASD)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "steelblue") +
  geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(P_adj < 0.05, "*", "")), vjust = -0.5) +
  labs(x = "Cell Type", y = "% ASD Risk Genes", 
       title = "ASD Risk Gene Enrichment in DEGs by Cell Type") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

```

```{r}


library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)


# Build all_DEGs_CT2 directly from .csv files
all_DEGs_CT2 <- map_dfr(unique(all.ctx$Cell_Type_2), function(CT) {
  CT_fp <- str_replace(CT, '/', '_')
  DE_path <- paste0("output/markers_v11/Pseudobulk/CT2/results/DE_", CT_fp, ".csv")
  if (file.exists(DE_path)) {
    df <- read.csv(DE_path)
    df$cluster <- CT
    return(df)
  } else {
    warning(paste("Missing DE file for", CT))
    return(NULL)
  }
})

# ASD gene list 
ASD_risk_genes <- c(
  "Adnp", "Ank2", "Arid1b", "Arid2", "Ash1l", "Bcl11a", "Chd8", "Cntnap2",
  "Cul3", "Dscam", "Dyrk1a", "Dync1h1", "Grin2b", "Katnal2", "Kdm5b",
  "Kmt2a", "Kmt2c", "Med13l", "Nckap1", "Nrxn1", "Pogz", "Pten", "Scn2a",
  "Setd5", "Shank3", "Slc6a1", "Stxbp1", "Syngap1", "Tbr1", "Tcf4",
  "Tnrc6b", "Trip12", "Wac"
)

# Calculate min_exp for each CT based on DEGs
min_exp <- tapply(
  dplyr::filter(all_DEGs_CT2, pvalue < 0.05)$baseMean,
  dplyr::filter(all_DEGs_CT2, pvalue < 0.05)$cluster,
  min
) %>% as.data.frame()
colnames(min_exp) <- c("min_exp")
min_exp$cluster <- rownames(min_exp)

# Merge to get expression and DE info
comb <- merge(min_exp, all_DEGs_CT2, by = "cluster")
comb$threshold <- comb$baseMean > comb$min_exp
comb$sig <- comb$pvalue < 0.1 & abs(comb$log2FoldChange) > 0.1

# Table of ASD risk genes that are DEGs in each CT
ASD_DEG_hits <- comb %>%
  filter(threshold, sig, gene %in% ASD_risk_genes) %>%
  select(cluster, gene, log2FoldChange, pvalue) %>%
  arrange(cluster, gene)
print(ASD_DEG_hits)

# Get DEGs per CT that pass threshold
observed_enrichment <- comb %>%
  filter(threshold) %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  summarise(
    n_DEGs = sum(sig),
    n_ASD_DEGs = sum(sig & gene %in% ASD_risk_genes),
    ASD_enrichment = n_ASD_DEGs / n_DEGs * 100
  )

# Permutation test
set.seed(12345)
n_permutations <- 1000
perm_results <- list()

for (i in 1:n_permutations) {
  perm <- comb %>%
    filter(threshold) %>%
    group_by(cluster) %>%
    group_map(~{
      n_DEGs <- sum(.x$sig)
      sampled_genes <- sample(.x$gene, n_DEGs)
      n_ASD <- sum(sampled_genes %in% ASD_risk_genes)
      tibble(cluster = as.character(.y), n_ASD_perm = n_ASD)
    }) %>%
    bind_rows()
  perm_results[[i]] <- perm
}


# Combine permuted results
perm_df <- bind_rows(perm_results, .id = "perm_id")

perm_summary <- perm_df %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  summarise(ASD_null = list(n_ASD_perm), .groups = "drop")

# Join to observed
final <- observed_enrichment %>%
  left_join(perm_summary, by = "cluster") %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    p_perm = mean(unlist(ASD_null) >= n_ASD_DEGs),
    significance = case_when(
      p_perm < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p_perm < 0.01 ~ "**",
      p_perm < 0.05 ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )


# Set order for plotting
CT2s <- c("Sst Gaba", "Vip Gaba", "Pvalb Gaba", "Lamp5 Gaba", "L2/3 IT Glut", 
          "L4/5 IT Glut", "L5 IT Glut", "L5 ET Glut", "L6 IT Glut", "L6 CT Glut", "L6b Glut", "OPC", "Oligo", "Astro", "Microglia", "Endo", "Peri", "VLMC")

final$cluster <- factor(final$cluster, levels = CT2s)

ggplot(final, aes(x = cluster, y = ASD_enrichment)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = 'steelblue') + 
  geom_text(aes(label = significance), vjust = -0.3, size = 5, na.rm = TRUE) +
  labs(x = "Cell Type", y = "% ASD risk genes",
       title = "Enrichment of ASD Genes Among DEGs") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, size = 14),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90", color = NA),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "white"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "white")
  ) +
  ylim(0, max(final$ASD_enrichment) * 1.2)
```

```{r}
logFC_thresh <- 0.4

# Import bulk constitutive data (now also keep logCPM if present)
Bulk_DE <- read.csv("DE_Ctx_full.csv") %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_name, logFC, PValue, dplyr::any_of("logCPM")) %>%
  dplyr::rename(gene = gene_name,
                logFC_bulk  = logFC,
                PValue_bulk = PValue,
                logCPM_bulk = logCPM) %>%
  dplyr::filter(PValue_bulk < 0.3) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Import Pseudobulk data (now also keep baseMean)
Pb_DE <- read.csv("output/markers_v11/Pseudobulk/whole_dataset/results/DE_all.csv") %>%
  dplyr::select(gene, log2FoldChange, pvalue, dplyr::any_of("baseMean")) %>%
  dplyr::rename(logFC_psB  = log2FoldChange,
                PValue_psB = pvalue,
                baseMean_psB = baseMean) %>%
  dplyr::filter(PValue_psB < 0.3) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE)

# ---- Merge + Concordance filter ----
Concordant_DE <- Bulk_DE %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(Pb_DE, by = "gene") %>%
  dplyr::filter(sign(logFC_bulk) == sign(logFC_psB)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(abs(logFC_bulk) >= logFC_thresh & abs(logFC_psB) >= logFC_thresh) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(abs(logFC_psB) + abs(logFC_bulk)))   # optional: rank by combined effect

Concordant_DE$gene

# Create output directory if it doesn't already exist
dir.create("output/validation", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Save to Excel (includes logCPM_bulk and baseMean_psB if present)
write_xlsx(Concordant_DE, "output/validation/Conc_bulk_vs_psB.xlsx")
```

```{r}

# Set logFC threshold 
logFC_thresh <- 0.25

# Import bulk constitutive data (keep logCPM if present)
Bulk_DE <- read.csv("DE_Ctx_full.csv") %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_name, logFC, PValue, dplyr::any_of(c("logCPM","AveExpr","log.cpm"))) %>%
  dplyr::rename(gene = gene_name,
         logFC_bulk  = logFC,
         PValue_bulk = PValue,
         logCPM_bulk = dplyr::any_of("logCPM")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(PValue_bulk < 0.3) %>%        
  dplyr::distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE) 

# Import Pseudobulk Glut data (keep baseMean if present)
Glut_DE <- read.csv("output/markers_v11/Pseudobulk/CT3/results/DE_Glutamatergic.csv") %>%
  dplyr::select(gene, log2FoldChange, pvalue, dplyr::any_of("baseMean")) %>%
  dplyr::rename(logFC_Glut   = log2FoldChange,
         PValue_Glut  = pvalue,
         baseMean_Glut = baseMean) %>%
  dplyr::filter(PValue_Glut < 0.3) %>%
  dplyr::filter(is.na(baseMean_Glut) | baseMean_Glut >= 100) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Import Syn data (filter, rename logFC col)
Syn_DE <- read.csv("simple_Const_syn_NOPC.csv") %>%
  dplyr::select(gene, logFC, PValue) %>%
  dplyr::rename(logFC_syn = logFC,
         PValue_syn = PValue) %>%
  dplyr::filter(PValue_syn < 0.3) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE)

# ---- Merge + Concordance filter ----
Concordant_DE <- Bulk_DE %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(Glut_DE, by = "gene") %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(Syn_DE,  by = "gene") %>%
```

```{r}

# Import Syn data 
Syn_DE <- read.csv("simple_Const_syn_NOPC.csv") %>%
  dplyr::select(gene, logFC, FDR, dplyr::any_of("logCPM")) %>%
  dplyr::rename(logFC_syn = logFC,
                FDR_syn   = FDR,
                logCPM_syn = logCPM) %>%
  dplyr::filter(FDR_syn < 0.4) %>%
  dplyr::filter(abs(logFC_syn) > 0.1) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Import Nuc data 
Nuc_DE <- read.csv("simple_Const_nuc_NOPC.csv") %>%
  dplyr::select(gene, logFC, FDR) %>%
  dplyr::rename(logFC_nuc = logFC,
                FDR_nuc   = FDR) %>%
  dplyr::filter(FDR_nuc < 0.5) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Keep genes that satisfy syn criteria; allow "absent in nuc"; exclude same-direction only when nuc present
Syn_specific <- Syn_DE %>%
  dplyr::left_join(Nuc_DE, by = "gene") %>%
  dplyr::filter(is.na(FDR_nuc) | FDR_nuc < 0.5) %>%    # allow missing nuc, or nuc FDR < 0.5
  dplyr::filter(is.na(logFC_nuc) | sign(logFC_syn) != sign(logFC_nuc)) %>%  # if nuc present, directions must differ
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(abs(logFC_syn)), abs(logFC_nuc))
```

### Identifying which hdWGCNA modules Syn specific genes are expressed in
```{r}

# 1) Load syn-specific table, sort by FDR_syn, take top 110 genes
syn_tbl <- read_xlsx("output/validation/Syn_specific_vs_Nuc_synaptic.xlsx")

syn_top110_genes <- syn_tbl %>%
  dplyr::arrange(FDR_syn) %>%              # sort by FDR_syn (ascending)
  dplyr::slice_head(n = 110) %>%           # take first 110 rows
  dplyr::pull(gene) %>%                    # extract gene column
  unique()

# 2) Load CT modules (gene_name, module)
CT_modules <- read_excel("output/hdWGCNA_v11_glut_only/plots/Glutamatergic_v2/modules.xlsx") %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_name, module)

# 3) Filter modules to those genes (same way as before)
CT_modules_sel <- CT_modules %>%
  dplyr::filter(gene_name %in% syn_top110_genes) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(gene_name, module) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(module, gene_name)

# 4) Missing genes (present in top 110 list but not in module table)
missing_genes <- base::setdiff(syn_top110_genes, CT_modules_sel$gene_name)

# 5) Per-module counts
module_counts <- CT_modules_sel %>%
  dplyr::count(module, name = "n_genes") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(n_genes), module)

# 6) Save to Excel (three sheets, same style)
dir.create("output/validation", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
write_xlsx(
  list(
    genes_in_modules = CT_modules_sel,
    module_counts    = module_counts,
    missing_genes    = data.frame(gene = missing_genes)
  ),
  path = "output/validation/qPCR_synTop110_modules.xlsx"
)

# (Optional) quick peek in console
CT_modules_sel
module_counts
missing_genes

```

```{r}
## Make sure the metadata columns exist
stopifnot(all(c("Cell_Type_2", "GenoBatch", "dataset", "SexMulti") %in% colnames(all.ctx@meta.data)))

## Set sex factor order and colors (ggplot pink + purple)
all.ctx$SexMulti <- factor(all.ctx$SexMulti, levels = c("female", "male"))

sex_cols <- c("female" = "#F8766D",   
              "male"   = "#C77CFF")   

## Optional: order CT2 nicely
all.ctx$Cell_Type_2 <- factor(all.ctx$Cell_Type_2, levels = sort(unique(all.ctx$Cell_Type_2)))
all.ctx$dataset     <- factor(all.ctx$dataset)
all.ctx$GenoBatch   <- factor(all.ctx$GenoBatch)

all.ctx.male <- all.ctx %>% subset(SexMulti == "male")
```

Each row is a gene, each column is a dataset

```{r}
## 1) Strong P60 ChIP targets

p60_cols <- c("Platt.Somat_Ctx_WT_Platt_1-vs.Input",
              "Platt.Somat_Ctx_WT_Platt_2-vs.Input")

p60_targets <- df %>%
  dplyr::filter(if_all(all_of(p60_cols), ~ .x > 0.50)) %>%
  dplyr::select(NearestTSS, all_of(p60_cols)) %>%
  mutate(
    NearestTSS = ifelse(
      is.na(NearestTSS),
      NA_character_,
      paste0(
        toupper(substr(as.character(NearestTSS), 1, 1)),
        tolower(substr(as.character(NearestTSS), 2, nchar(as.character(NearestTSS))))
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(NearestTSS)) %>%
  dplyr::rename(gene = NearestTSS) %>%
  distinct(gene)

genes_of_interest <- p60_targets$gene

## 2) Helper to read & standardize any DE file to gene/logFC/pval
read_de <- function(path, gene_col = c("gene","gene_name"),
                    logfc_col = c("log2FoldChange","logFC"),
                    p_col = c("pvalue","PValue","pvalue_to_significance")) {
  stopifnot(file.exists(path))
  raw <- suppressMessages(read.csv(path, check.names = FALSE))
  gcol <- base::intersect(gene_col, colnames(raw))[1]
  lcol <- base::intersect(logfc_col, colnames(raw))[1]
  pcol <- base::intersect(p_col, colnames(raw))[1]

  out <- raw %>%
    dplyr::select(all_of(c(gcol, lcol, pcol))) %>%
    dplyr::rename(gene = !!gcol, logFC = !!lcol, pval = !!pcol) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(gene = as.character(gene))

  # ensure numeric p; fall back to 1 when not available/parseable
  out$pval <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(out$pval))
  out$pval[is.na(out$pval) | out$pval <= 0] <- 1

  dplyr::distinct(out, gene, .keep_all = TRUE)
}
```

## Heatmaps showing chance of single DEG being a strong ChIP peak

```{r}

## ===== CHiP-LIKELIHOOD HEATMAPS (UP / DOWN) =====
## Gene × dataset, per-gene variation via rank-based logistic residuals.
## Red = more ChIP than expected at that rank; Blue = less.

set.seed(123)
top_n  <- 25
cap_at <- 2

dir.create("output/plots", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

## --- 1) Read ChIP peak gene set (P60 strong) ---
chip_tbl <- readxl::read_excel("Table_4.xlsx", sheet = "ChIP Genes")
p60_cols <- c("Platt.Somat_Ctx_WT_Platt_1-vs.Input",
              "Platt.Somat_Ctx_WT_Platt_2-vs.Input")

chip_genes <- chip_tbl %>%
  dplyr::filter(dplyr::if_all(dplyr::all_of(p60_cols), ~ .x > 0.5)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(NearestTSS = ifelse(
    is.na(NearestTSS), NA_character_,
    paste0(toupper(substr(as.character(NearestTSS), 1, 1)),
           tolower(substr(as.character(NearestTSS), 2, nchar(as.character(NearestTSS)))))
  )) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(NearestTSS)) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(NearestTSS) %>%
  dplyr::pull(NearestTSS)

## --- 2) Minimal DE reader (no padj) ---
read_de <- function(path) {
  stopifnot(file.exists(path))
  x <- suppressMessages(read.csv(path, check.names = FALSE))
  gcol <- base::intersect(c("gene","gene_name","rn"), colnames(x))[1]
  lcol <- base::intersect(c("log2FoldChange","logFC"), colnames(x))[1]
  pcol <- base::intersect(c("pvalue","PValue","pvalue_to_significance"), colnames(x))[1]
  stopifnot(!is.na(gcol), !is.na(lcol), !is.na(pcol))
  x <- x[, c(gcol, lcol, pcol)]
  colnames(x) <- c("gene","logFC","pval")
  x$pval <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x$pval))
  x$pval[is.na(x$pval) | x$pval <= 0] <- 1
  x$gene <- as.character(x$gene)
  dplyr::distinct(x, gene, .keep_all = TRUE)
}

## --- 3) Dataset paths ---
de_sources <- c(
  "Bulk_const"   = "DE_Ctx_full.csv",
  "Glut"         = "output/markers_v11/Pseudobulk/CT3/results/DE_Glutamatergic.csv",
  "L23 IT"       = "output/markers_v11/Pseudobulk/CT2/results/DE_L2_3 IT Glut.csv",
  "L45 IT"       = "output/markers_v11/Pseudobulk/CT2/results/DE_L4_5 IT Glut.csv",
  "L5 ET"        = "output/markers_v11/Pseudobulk/CT2/results/DE_L5 ET Glut.csv",
  "L5 IT"        = "output/markers_v11/Pseudobulk/CT2/results/DE_L5 IT Glut.csv",
  "L6 CT"        = "output/markers_v11/Pseudobulk/CT2/results/DE_L6 CT Glut.csv",
  "L6 IT"        = "output/markers_v11/Pseudobulk/CT2/results/DE_L6 IT Glut.csv",
  "L6b"          = "output/markers_v11/Pseudobulk/CT2/results/DE_L6b Glut.csv",
  "Syn_Const"    = "simple_Const_syn_NOPC.csv",
  "Nuc_Const"    = "simple_Const_nuc_NOPC.csv",
  "Syn_HETvsWT"  = "simple_HETvsWT_syn.csv",
  "Nuc_HETvsWT"  = "simple_HETvsWT_nuc.csv",
  "Syn_HOMvsWT"  = "simple_HOMvsWT_syn.csv",
  "Nuc_HOMvsWT"  = "simple_HOMvsWT_nuc.csv"
)

## --- 4) Per-dataset residual scorer (binomial GLM baseline on rank) ---
residual_scores <- function(de, chip_set, top_n, direction = c("up","down")) {
  direction <- match.arg(direction)
  de <- de %>%
    dplyr::mutate(rank_p = rank(pval, ties.method = "average"),
                  chip   = as.integer(gene %in% chip_set))
  # Fit baseline: chip ~ standardized rank over the full universe
  de <- de %>% dplyr::mutate(rank_z = scale(rank_p)[,1])
  fit <- try(glm(chip ~ rank_z, family = binomial(), data = de), silent = TRUE)
  if (inherits(fit, "try-error")) return(list(genes = character(0), scores = numeric(0)))

  # Pearson residuals for genes we will plot (top-N by p in the chosen direction)
  sel <- if (direction == "up") {
    de %>% dplyr::filter(logFC > 0) %>% dplyr::arrange(pval) %>% dplyr::slice_head(n = top_n)
  } else {
    de %>% dplyr::filter(logFC < 0) %>% dplyr::arrange(pval) %>% dplyr::slice_head(n = top_n)
  }
  if (nrow(sel) == 0) return(list(genes = character(0), scores = numeric(0)))

  p_hat <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(predict(fit, newdata = sel, type = "response")))
  # Pearson residuals: (y - p) / sqrt(p(1-p))
  y     <- sel$chip
  eps   <- 1e-6
  r     <- (y - p_hat) / sqrt(pmax(p_hat * (1 - p_hat), eps))

  # cap residuals for stability and return
  r[is.infinite(r) | is.nan(r)] <- 0
  list(genes = sel$gene, scores = as.numeric(r))
}

## --- 5) Build gene × dataset matrices for UP and DOWN ---
up_rows <- character(0)
down_rows <- character(0)
up_cols  <- list()
down_cols<- list()

for (lab in names(de_sources)) {
  fp <- de_sources[[lab]]
  if (!file.exists(fp)) {
    warning("Missing file for ", lab, ": ", fp); next
  }
  de <- read_de(fp)

  # UP
  sc_up <- residual_scores(de, chip_genes, top_n = top_n, direction = "up")
  if (length(sc_up$genes)) {
    up_rows <- base::union(up_rows, sc_up$genes)
    colvec <- rep(NA_real_, length(up_rows)); names(colvec) <- up_rows
    colvec[sc_up$genes] <- sc_up$scores
    up_cols[[lab]] <- colvec
  } else {
    up_cols[[lab]] <- rep(NA_real_, length(up_rows))
  }

  # DOWN
  sc_dn <- residual_scores(de, chip_genes, top_n = top_n, direction = "down")
  if (length(sc_dn$genes)) {
    down_rows <- base::union(down_rows, sc_dn$genes)
    colvec <- rep(NA_real_, length(down_rows)); names(colvec) <- down_rows
    colvec[sc_dn$genes] <- sc_dn$scores
    down_cols[[lab]] <- colvec
  } else {
    down_cols[[lab]] <- rep(NA_real_, length(down_rows))
  }
}

# bind cols (align by names)
bind_mat <- function(cols_list) {
  if (!length(cols_list)) return(matrix(0,0,0))
  all_rows <- unique(unlist(lapply(cols_list, names)))
  if (is.null(all_rows)) return(matrix(0,0,0))
  m <- sapply(cols_list, function(v){
    vv <- v
    names(vv) <- names(v)
    out <- rep(NA_real_, length(all_rows)); names(out) <- all_rows
    out[names(vv)] <- vv
    out
  })
  m <- as.matrix(m)
  rownames(m) <- all_rows
  m
}

mat_up   <- bind_mat(up_cols)
mat_down <- bind_mat(down_cols)

## --- 6) Cap values & order rows (strongest first) ---
capper <- function(m) {
  if (!is.matrix(m)) return(m)
  m[m >  cap_at] <-  cap_at
  m[m < -cap_at] <- -cap_at
  m
}
mat_up_cap   <- capper(mat_up)
mat_down_cap <- capper(mat_down)

# order rows by max |score| across datasets
ord_up   <- order(apply(abs(mat_up_cap),   1, function(x) max(x, na.rm = TRUE)), decreasing = TRUE)
ord_down <- order(apply(abs(mat_down_cap), 1, function(x) max(x, na.rm = TRUE)), decreasing = TRUE)
if (length(ord_up))   mat_up_cap   <- mat_up_cap[ord_up, , drop = FALSE]
if (length(ord_down)) mat_down_cap <- mat_down_cap[ord_down, , drop = FALSE]

## --- 7) Plot (no clustering; NA white) ---
cols <- colorRampPalette(c("#2166AC","#F7F7F7","#B2182B"))(100)
brks <- seq(-cap_at, cap_at, length.out = 102)

if (ncol(mat_up_cap) > 0 && nrow(mat_up_cap) > 0) {
  pheatmap::pheatmap(
    mat_up_cap,
    color = cols, breaks = brks,
    cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_cols = FALSE,
    show_rownames = TRUE, show_colnames = TRUE,
    na_col = "white",
    main = "UP genes: red = more ChIP than expected at that rank; blue = less",
    filename = "output/plots/ChIP_likelihood_UP.pdf",
    width = 9, height = 12
  )
}

if (ncol(mat_down_cap) > 0 && nrow(mat_down_cap) > 0) {
  pheatmap::pheatmap(
    mat_down_cap,
    color = cols, breaks = brks,
    cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_cols = FALSE,
    show_rownames = TRUE, show_colnames = TRUE,
    na_col = "white",
    main = "DOWN genes: red = more ChIP than expected at that rank; blue = less",
    filename = "output/plots/ChIP_likelihood_DOWN.pdf",
    width = 9, height = 12
  )
}

message("✅ Done:\n  output/plots/ChIP_likelihood_UP.pdf\n  output/plots/ChIP_likelihood_DOWN.pdf")
```

```{r}
# ---- Minimal DE reader (gene, logFC, pval) ----
read_de <- function(path) {
  stopifnot(file.exists(path))
  x <- suppressMessages(read.csv(path, check.names = FALSE))
  gcol <- base::intersect(c("gene","gene_name","rn"), colnames(x))[1]
  lcol <- base::intersect(c("log2FoldChange","logFC"), colnames(x))[1]
  pcol <- base::intersect(c("pvalue","PValue","pvalue_to_significance"), colnames(x))[1]
  stopifnot(!is.na(gcol), !is.na(lcol), !is.na(pcol))
  x <- x[, c(gcol,lcol,pcol)]
  colnames(x) <- c("gene","logFC","pval")
  x$gene <- as.character(x$gene)
  x$pval <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x$pval))

  dplyr::distinct(x, gene, .keep_all = TRUE)

p_thresh <- 0.1   # DE threshold by nominal p-value

fisher_one <- function(de_df, chip_set, direction = c("up","down"), p_thresh = 0.1) {
  direction <- match.arg(direction)
  stopifnot(all(c("gene","logFC","pval") %in% colnames(de_df)))
  universe <- de_df$gene
  chipU <- base::intersect(chip_set, universe)

  if (direction == "up") {
    deg <- de_df %>% dplyr::filter(logFC > 0, pval < p_thresh) %>% dplyr::pull(gene)
  } else {
    deg <- de_df %>% dplyr::filter(logFC < 0, pval < p_thresh) %>% dplyr::pull(gene)
  }

  nondeg <- base::setdiff(universe, deg)

  k11 <- sum(deg    %in% chipU)            # ChIP ∩ DEG
  k12 <- sum(deg    %in% base::setdiff(universe, chipU))   # nonChIP ∩ DEG
  k21 <- sum(nondeg %in% chipU)            # ChIP ∩ nonDEG
  k22 <- sum(nondeg %in% base::setdiff(universe, chipU))   # nonChIP ∩ nonDEG

  mat <- matrix(c(k11,k12,k21,k22), nrow = 2,
                dimnames = list(ChIP=c("ChIP","nonChIP"), DE=c("DE","nonDE")))
  ft <- suppressWarnings(stats::fisher.test(mat))
  tibble::tibble(
    k11 = k11, k12 = k12, k21 = k21, k22 = k22,
    or  = base::unname(ft$estimate),       # odds ratio
    lo  = ft$conf.int[1],            # 95% CI
    hi  = ft$conf.int[2],
    p   = ft$p.value
  )
}

fisher_all <- purrr::imap_dfr(de_sources, function(fp, lab) {
```
