## GSEA using ChIP peaks as input set

Rank genes by signed significance: rank_stat = sign(logFC) * -log10(pval)
Run fgsea with pathways = list(CHD8 = chip_genes) for each dataset
Collect NES and padj, plot all datasets together (one bar per dataset)
positive = ChIP genes skewed upregulated, negative = downregulated

Example: 
In your DE_Glutamatergic.csv, maybe you have 18,000 genes.
You compute rstat = sign(logFC) * -log10(pval) for all 18,000.
fgsea tests whether the subset of those genes that are in your chip_genes are skewed toward the top (positive) or bottom (negative) of that ranking — against permutations of the same 18,000.

```{r}

# ---- CHiP targets (P60 strong) ----
chip_tbl <- readxl::read_excel("Table_4.xlsx", sheet = "ChIP Genes")
p60_cols <- c("Platt.Somat_Ctx_WT_Platt_1-vs.Input",
              "Platt.Somat_Ctx_WT_Platt_2-vs.Input")

chip_genes <- chip_tbl %>%
  dplyr::filter(dplyr::if_all(dplyr::all_of(p60_cols), ~ .x > 0.5)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(NearestTSS = ifelse(
    is.na(NearestTSS), NA_character_,
    paste0(toupper(substr(as.character(NearestTSS), 1, 1)),
           tolower(substr(as.character(NearestTSS), 2, nchar(as.character(NearestTSS)))))
  )) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(NearestTSS)) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(NearestTSS) %>%
  dplyr::pull(NearestTSS)

# ---- DE file list (edit paths if needed) ----
de_sources <- c(
  "Bulk_Const"   = "DE_Ctx_full.csv",
  "Glut"         = "output/markers_v11/Pseudobulk/CT3/results/DE_Glutamatergic.csv",
  "L23 IT"       = "output/markers_v11/Pseudobulk/CT2/results/DE_L2_3 IT Glut.csv",
  "L45 IT"       = "output/markers_v11/Pseudobulk/CT2/results/DE_L4_5 IT Glut.csv",
  "L5 ET"        = "output/markers_v11/Pseudobulk/CT2/results/DE_L5 ET Glut.csv",
  "L5 IT"        = "output/markers_v11/Pseudobulk/CT2/results/DE_L5 IT Glut.csv",
  "L6 CT"        = "output/markers_v11/Pseudobulk/CT2/results/DE_L6 CT Glut.csv",
  "L6 IT"        = "output/markers_v11/Pseudobulk/CT2/results/DE_L6 IT Glut.csv",
  "L6b"          = "output/markers_v11/Pseudobulk/CT2/results/DE_L6b Glut.csv",
  "Syn_Const"    = "simple_Const_syn_NOPC.csv",
  "Nuc_Const"    = "simple_Const_nuc_NOPC.csv",
  "Syn_Cond_HETvsWT"  = "simple_HETvsWT_syn.csv",
  "Nuc_Cond_HETvsWT"  = "simple_HETvsWT_nuc.csv",
  "Syn_Cond_HOMvsWT"  = "simple_HOMvsWT_syn.csv",
  "Nuc_Cond_HOMvsWT"  = "simple_HOMvsWT_nuc.csv"
)

# ---- Minimal DE reader (gene, logFC, pval) ----
read_de <- function(path) {
  stopifnot(file.exists(path))
  x <- suppressMessages(read.csv(path, check.names = FALSE))
  gcol <- base::intersect(c("gene","gene_name","rn"), colnames(x))[1]
  lcol <- base::intersect(c("log2FoldChange","logFC"), colnames(x))[1]
  pcol <- base::intersect(c("pvalue","PValue","pvalue_to_significance"), colnames(x))[1]
  stopifnot(!is.na(gcol), !is.na(lcol), !is.na(pcol))
  x <- x[, c(gcol,lcol,pcol)]
  colnames(x) <- c("gene","logFC","pval")
  x$gene <- as.character(x$gene)
  x$pval <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x$pval))
  x$pval[is.na(x$pval) | x$pval <= 0] <- 1
  dplyr::distinct(x, gene, .keep_all = TRUE)
}



# If needed: install.packages("fgsea")
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(fgsea))

gsea_one <- function(de_df, chip_set) {
  # ranking: signed -log10(p)
  rstat <- with(de_df, sign(logFC) * -log10(pval))
  names(rstat) <- de_df$gene
  rstat <- rstat[is.finite(rstat)]
  rstat <- sort(rstat, decreasing = TRUE)

  # restrict pathway to genes present in ranking
  set_here <- base::intersect(chip_set, names(rstat))
  if (length(set_here) < 5) {
    return(tibble::tibble(pathway = "CHD8", NES = NA_real_, pval = NA_real_, padj = NA_real_))
  }

  res <- suppressWarnings(
    fgsea::fgsea(pathways = list(CHD8 = set_here), stats = rstat, nperm = 5000)
  )
  as_tibble(res) %>%
    dplyr::select(pathway, NES, pval, padj)
}

gsea_all <- purrr::imap_dfr(de_sources, function(fp, lab) {
  if (!file.exists(fp)) return(NULL)
  de <- read_de(fp)
  out <- gsea_one(de, chip_genes)
  out$dataset <- lab
  out
})

gsea_plot_df <- gsea_all %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    sig = dplyr::case_when(padj < 0.001 ~ "***",
                           padj < 0.01  ~ "**",
                           padj < 0.05  ~ "*",
                           TRUE ~ ""),
    fill_col = dplyr::if_else(NES >= 0, "firebrick3", "royalblue3")
  )

pdf("output/plots/CHIP_gsea_NES_all_datasets.pdf", width = 9, height = 5)
ggplot(gsea_plot_df, aes(x = dataset, y = NES, fill = fill_col)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sig, y = NES + 0.08 * sign(NES)), size = 4) +
  scale_fill_identity() +
  labs(title = "GSEA NES for Chd8 ChIP targets across datasets",
       y = "Normalized Enrichment Score (NES)",
       x = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
dev.off()



```

```{r}
  "Nuc_HOMvsWT"  = "simple_HOMvsWT_nuc.csv"

# ---- Minimal DE reader (gene, logFC, pval) ----
read_de <- function(path) {
  stopifnot(file.exists(path))
  x <- suppressMessages(read.csv(path, check.names = FALSE))
  gcol <- base::intersect(c("gene","gene_name","rn"), colnames(x))[1]
  lcol <- base::intersect(c("log2FoldChange","logFC"), colnames(x))[1]
  pcol <- base::intersect(c("pvalue","PValue","pvalue_to_significance"), colnames(x))[1]
  stopifnot(!is.na(gcol), !is.na(lcol), !is.na(pcol))
  x <- x[, c(gcol,lcol,pcol)]
  colnames(x) <- c("gene","logFC","pval")
  x$gene <- as.character(x$gene)
  x$pval <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x$pval))
  x$pval[is.na(x$pval) | x$pval <= 0] <- 1
  dplyr::distinct(x, gene, .keep_all = TRUE)
}



p_thresh <- 0.2   # DE threshold by nominal p-value

fisher_one <- function(de_df, asd_set, direction = c("up","down"), p_thresh = 0.2) {
  direction <- match.arg(direction)
  stopifnot(all(c("gene","logFC","pval") %in% colnames(de_df)))
  universe <- de_df$gene
  asdU <- base::intersect(asd_set, universe)

  if (direction == "up") {
    deg <- de_df %>% dplyr::filter(logFC > 0, pval < p_thresh) %>% dplyr::pull(gene)
  } else {
    deg <- de_df %>% dplyr::filter(logFC < 0, pval < p_thresh) %>% dplyr::pull(gene)
  }

  nondeg <- base::setdiff(universe, deg)

  k11 <- sum(deg    %in% asdU)            # ASD ∩ DEG
  k12 <- sum(deg    %in% base::setdiff(universe, asdU))   # nonASD ∩ DEG
  k21 <- sum(nondeg %in% asdU)            # ASD ∩ nonDEG
  k22 <- sum(nondeg %in% base::setdiff(universe, asdU))   # nonASD ∩ nonDEG

  mat <- matrix(c(k11,k12,k21,k22), nrow = 2,
                dimnames = list(ASD=c("ASD","nonASD"), DE=c("DE","nonDE")))
  ft <- suppressWarnings(stats::fisher.test(mat))
  tibble::tibble(
    k11 = k11, k12 = k12, k21 = k21, k22 = k22,
    or  = base::unname(ft$estimate),       # odds ratio
    lo  = ft$conf.int[1],            # 95% CI
    hi  = ft$conf.int[2],
    p   = ft$p.value
  )
}

fisher_all <- purrr::imap_dfr(de_sources, function(fp, lab) {
  if (!file.exists(fp)) return(NULL)
  de <- read_de(fp)
  up  <- fisher_one(de, asd_genes, "up",   p_thresh)
  dn  <- fisher_one(de, asd_genes, "down", p_thresh)
  dplyr::bind_rows(
    up %>% dplyr::mutate(dataset = lab, direction = "UP"),
    dn %>% dplyr::mutate(dataset = lab, direction = "DOWN")
  )
})

# Log2(OR) + CI, colored by enrichment direction
fisher_plot_df <- fisher_all %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    log2OR   = log2(or),
    lo_log2 = log2(lo),

    sig = dplyr::case_when(
      p < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    ),

    sig_y = dplyr::if_else(log2OR > 0, hi_log2 + 0.15, lo_log2 - 0.15),
    sig_vjust = dplyr::if_else(log2OR > 0, 0, 1)
  )

pdf("output/plots/ASD_enrichment_Fisher_up_down.pdf", width = 10, height = 6)

) +
```

## Pb-style plots for sleep genes
```{r}


# ---- inputs ----
glut_CTs <- c("Glutamatergic","L2/3 IT Glut","L4/5 IT Glut","L5 IT Glut",
              "L5 ET Glut","L6 IT Glut","L6 CT Glut","L6b Glut")

sleep_genes <- c("Per1","Per2","Per3","Bmal1","Clock","Cry1","Cry2",
                 "Nr1d1","Nr1d2","Dbp","Hlf","Tef","Npas2", "Ntrk2", "Bdnf", "Sik1", "Ntrk1") 

de_path_for <- function(CT) {
  if (CT == "Glutamatergic") "output/markers_v11/Pseudobulk/CT3/results/DE_Glutamatergic.csv"
  else paste0("output/markers_v11/Pseudobulk/CT2/results/DE_", CT, ".csv")
}
dds_path_for <- function(CT) {
  if (CT == "Glutamatergic") "output/markers_v11/Pseudobulk/CT3/dds/Glutamatergic.rds"
  else paste0("output/markers_v11/Pseudobulk/CT2/dds/", CT, ".rds")
}


pdf("output/plots/sleep_gene_pb_plots.pdf", width = 11, height = 8.5)

for (CT in glut_CTs) {
  message("Processing ", CT, " ...")
  de_fp  <- de_path_for(CT)
  dds_fp <- dds_path_for(CT)
  if (!file.exists(de_fp) || !file.exists(dds_fp)) {
    warning("Missing file(s) for ", CT); next
  }

  res <- read.csv(de_fp, check.names = FALSE)
  dds <- readRDS(dds_fp)

  gene_col <- base::intersect(c("gene","gene_name","rn"), colnames(res))[1]
  stopifnot(!is.na(gene_col))
  rownames(res) <- res[[gene_col]]

  genes_here <- base::intersect(rownames(res), sleep_genes)
  if (length(genes_here) == 0) { warning("No sleep genes in ", CT); next }

  dds <- estimateSizeFactors(dds)
  norm_counts <- counts(dds, normalized = TRUE)
  keep <- base::intersect(rownames(norm_counts), genes_here)
  if (length(keep) == 0) { warning("Sleep genes absent from counts for ", CT); next }

  top_df <- as.data.frame(norm_counts[keep, , drop = FALSE])
  top_df$gene <- rownames(top_df)
  top_df$gene <- factor(top_df$gene, levels = top_df$gene)

  top_long <- reshape2::melt(data.table::setDT(top_df), id.vars = "gene",
                             variable.name = "sample") %>% as.data.frame()
  top_long$sample <- gsub("\\.", " ", top_long$sample)

  meta_df <- as.data.frame(colData(dds)); meta_df$sample <- rownames(meta_df)
  top_long <- plyr::join(top_long, meta_df, by = "sample")

  # ---------- ADD SEX (from sample name) ----------
  # Adjust mapping to your sample IDs as needed
  sex_map <- c(
    "HET_ctx1"="male","HET_ctx2"="male","HET_ctx5"="male",
    "HET_ctx4"="female","HET_ctx6"="female",
    "WT_ctx1"="female","WT_ctx2"="female","WT_ctx5"="female",
    "WT_ctx4"="male","WT_ctx6"="male"
  )
  # If your sample ids in 'sample' don’t match exactly, normalize them here first.
  top_long$sex <- base::unname(sex_map[as.character(top_long$sample)])
  top_long$sex[is.na(top_long$sex)] <- "unknown"  # fallback if any unmapped
  top_long$sex <- factor(top_long$sex, levels = c("female","male","unknown"))
  # -----------------------------------------------

  if ("condition" %in% colnames(top_long)) {
    top_long$condition <- factor(top_long$condition, levels = c("wt","het"))
  }

  # ---- PLOT ----
  p <- ggplot(top_long, aes(y = value,
                            x = factor(condition, level = c('wt','het')),
                            col = sample, shape = sex, group = batch)) +
    geom_line(col = "gray30", size = 0.5) +
    scale_y_continuous(trans = 'log10') +
    ylab("log10 of normalized expression level") +
    xlab("condition") +
    ggtitle(paste("Sleep genes in ", CT, sep = '')) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +
    theme_grey() +
    geom_line(aes(group = batch), color = "black", size = 0.5) +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    facet_wrap(~ gene, scales = "free_y")

  print(p)
}

dev.off()

```


## Checking if syn-specific DEGs are consistently changing across brain regions

```{r}

## ---- Toggle which syn gene set to use ----
use_concordant_only <- FALSE   # TRUE = current behavior; FALSE = include all syn-specific

## ---- Get genes changing in syn, not in nuc ----

# Import Syn data 
Syn_DE <- read.csv("simple_Const_syn_NOPC.csv") %>%
  dplyr::select(gene, logFC, FDR, dplyr::any_of("logCPM")) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    logFC_syn  = logFC,
    FDR_syn    = FDR,
    logCPM_syn = logCPM
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(FDR_syn < 0.4) %>%
  dplyr::filter(abs(logFC_syn) > 0.1) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Import Nuc data 
Nuc_DE <- read.csv("simple_Const_nuc_NOPC.csv") %>%
  dplyr::select(gene, logFC, FDR) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    logFC_nuc = logFC,
    FDR_nuc   = FDR
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(FDR_nuc < 0.5) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Base syn set: genes that satisfy syn criteria, and exist in nuc table (or not), with optional discordance vs nuc
# If use_concordant_only = TRUE, we keep your original behavior (discordant vs nuc if nuc present).
# If FALSE, we keep ALL syn DEGs that pass Syn_DE thresholds (and allow nuc info if present, but do not filter by direction).
if (use_concordant_only) {
  Syn_specific <- Syn_DE %>%
    dplyr::left_join(Nuc_DE, by = "gene") %>%
    dplyr::filter(is.na(FDR_nuc) | FDR_nuc < 0.5) %>%    # allow missing nuc, or nuc FDR < 0.5
    dplyr::filter(is.na(logFC_nuc) | sign(logFC_syn) != sign(logFC_nuc)) %>%  # if nuc present, directions must differ
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(abs(logFC_syn)), abs(logFC_nuc))
} else {
  Syn_specific <- Syn_DE %>%
    dplyr::left_join(Nuc_DE, by = "gene") %>%
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(abs(logFC_syn)))
}

## ---- Filter Syn_specific to match whole-tissue cortex (bulk) direction ----

# Read in whole tissue bulk (Ctx)
Bulk_DE <- read.csv("DE_Ctx_full.csv") %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_name, logFC, FDR) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    gene     = gene_name,
    logFC_ctx = logFC,
    FDR_ctx   = FDR
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(FDR_ctx < 0.5) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Join bulk; optionally keep only bulk-direction-matching genes (your current behavior)
Syn_specific_ctx <- Syn_specific %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(Bulk_DE, by = "gene") %>%
  dplyr::select(gene, logFC_syn, FDR_syn, logCPM_syn, logFC_ctx, FDR_ctx)

if (use_concordant_only) {
  Syn_specific_ctx <- Syn_specific_ctx %>%
    dplyr::filter(sign(logFC_syn) == sign(logFC_ctx))
}

## ---- Load Hipp and Cb bulk tables ----
Hipp_DE <- read.csv("DE_Hip_full.csv") %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_name, logFC, FDR) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    gene      = gene_name,
    logFC_hipp = logFC,
    FDR_hipp   = FDR
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(FDR_hipp < 0.5) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE)

Cb_DE <- read.csv("DE_Cb_full.csv") %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_name, logFC, FDR) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    gene    = gene_name,
    logFC_cb = logFC,
    FDR_cb   = FDR
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(FDR_cb < 0.5) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE)

## ---- Make simple scatterplots for Syn_specific genes ----

syn_scatter_plot <- function(df, x_col, y_col, title, max_bound = 0.8) {
  stopifnot(all(c(x_col, y_col) %in% colnames(df)))
  
  dd <- df %>%
    dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(c(x_col, y_col))) %>%
    stats::na.omit()
  
  if (nrow(dd) == 0) {
    warning("No overlapping genes to plot for: ", title)
    return(
      ggplot2::ggplot() +
        ggplot2::theme_void() +
        ggplot2::labs(title = title, subtitle = "No genes to plot")
    )
  }
  
  # correlation
  Rval <- round(stats::cor(dd[[x_col]], dd[[y_col]]), 2)
  
  # quadrant counts
  q1 <- sum(dd[[x_col]] > 0 & dd[[y_col]] > 0)
  q2 <- sum(dd[[x_col]] < 0 & dd[[y_col]] > 0)
  q3 <- sum(dd[[x_col]] < 0 & dd[[y_col]] < 0)
  q4 <- sum(dd[[x_col]] > 0 & dd[[y_col]] < 0)
  
  # offsets relative to max_bound
  inner1 <- max_bound - 0.10
  inner2 <- max_bound - 0.15
  annot1 <- max_bound - 0.12
  annot2 <- max_bound - 0.23
  annot3 <- max_bound - 0.01
  
  ggplot2::ggplot(dd, ggplot2::aes_string(x = x_col, y = y_col)) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(size = 1.2, alpha = 0.8, color = "black") +
    
    # dashed inner guides
    ggplot2::geom_segment(
      ggplot2::aes(x = -max_bound, xend =  max_bound, y = -inner2, yend = -inner2),
      linetype = "dashed", color = "black"
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_segment(
      ggplot2::aes(x = -max_bound, xend =  max_bound, y =  inner2, yend =  inner2),
      linetype = "dashed", color = "black"
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_segment(
      ggplot2::aes(x = -inner1, xend = -inner1, y = -max_bound, yend =  max_bound),
      linetype = "dashed", color = "black"
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_segment(
      ggplot2::aes(x =  inner1, xend =  inner1, y = -max_bound, yend =  max_bound),
      linetype = "dashed", color = "black"
    ) +
    
    # axes at 0
    ggplot2::geom_segment(
      ggplot2::aes(x = -max_bound, xend = max_bound, y = 0, yend = 0),
      color = "black"
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_segment(
      ggplot2::aes(x = 0, xend = 0, y = -max_bound, yend = max_bound),
      color = "black"
    ) +
    
    # outer box
    ggplot2::geom_rect(
      xmin = -max_bound, xmax = max_bound,
      ymin = -max_bound, ymax = max_bound,
      color = "black", fill = NA
    ) +
    
    # y = x line
    ggplot2::geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
    
    # regression line
    ggplot2::geom_smooth(
      method = "lm", se = TRUE,
      color = "black", fill = "black",
      alpha = 0.15
    ) +
    
    # R annotation
    ggplot2::annotate(
      "text", x = -annot1, y = annot2,
      label = paste0("R = ", Rval),
      size = 4.5, hjust = 0, color = "black"
    ) +
    
    # quadrant counts
    ggplot2::annotate("text", x =  annot1, y =  annot3, label = paste("n =", q1),
                      hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 4, color = "black") +
    ggplot2::annotate("text", x = -annot1, y =  annot3, label = paste("n =", q2),
                      hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 4, color = "black") +
    ggplot2::annotate("text", x = -annot1, y = -annot3, label = paste("n =", q3),
                      hjust = 0, vjust = 0, size = 4, color = "black") +
    ggplot2::annotate("text", x =  annot1, y = -annot3, label = paste("n =", q4),
                      hjust = 1, vjust = 0, size = 4, color = "black") +
    
    ggplot2::labs(title = title, x = x_col, y = y_col) +
    ggplot2::theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(color = "black"),
      axis.text  = ggplot2::element_text(color = "black"),
      axis.title = ggplot2::element_text(color = "black")
    ) +
    ggplot2::coord_cartesian(
      xlim = c(-max_bound, max_bound),
      ylim = c(-max_bound, max_bound),
      expand = FALSE
    )
}

## ---- Ctx (x) vs Hipp (y) ----

df_ctx_hipp <- Syn_specific_ctx %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(Hipp_DE, by = "gene") %>%
  dplyr::select(gene, logFC_ctx, logFC_hipp)

plot_ctx_hipp <- syn_scatter_plot(
  df        = df_ctx_hipp,
  x_col     = "logFC_ctx",
  y_col     = "logFC_hipp",
  title     = paste("Syn-specific genes (n=", nrow(df_ctx_hipp), ")"),
  max_bound = 0.8
)
print(plot_ctx_hipp)

## ---- Ctx (x) vs Cb (y) ----

df_ctx_cb <- Syn_specific_ctx %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(Cb_DE, by = "gene") %>%
  dplyr::select(gene, logFC_ctx, logFC_cb)

plot_ctx_cb <- syn_scatter_plot(
  df        = df_ctx_cb,
  x_col     = "logFC_ctx",
  y_col     = "logFC_cb",
  title     = paste("Syn-specific genes (n=", nrow(df_ctx_cb), ")"),
  max_bound = 0.8
)
print(plot_ctx_cb)

pdf("output/plots/SynSpecific_Ctx_vs_Hipp.pdf", width = 7, height = 6)
print(plot_ctx_hipp)
dev.off()

pdf("output/plots/SynSpecific_Ctx_vs_Cb.pdf", width = 7, height = 6)
print(plot_ctx_cb)
dev.off()
```

```{r}
## ---- helper to standardize DE tables ----
std_de <- function(df) {
  logfc_col <- intersect(c("logFC", "log2FoldChange"), colnames(df))[1]
  p_col     <- intersect(c("PValue", "pvalue", "pvalue_to_significance"), colnames(df))[1]
  fdr_col   <- intersect(c("FDR", "FDR_syn", "FDR_nuc", "padj"), colnames(df))[1]

  df2 <- df[, c(logfc_col, p_col, fdr_col)]
  colnames(df2) <- c("logFC", "PValue", "FDR")
  df2
}

## ---- put your DE tables in a named list ----
de_list <- list(
  "Chd8+/- (whole)"   = DE_Const_whole,
  "Chd8+/- (Syn)"     = DE_Const_syn,
  "Chd8+/- (Nuc)"     = DE_Const_nuc,
 # "Chd8+/- (Cyt)"     = DE_Const_cyt,
  "Chd8+/flox (whole)" = DE_Cond_whole,
  "Chd8+/flox (Syn)"   = DE_Cond_syn_het,
  "Chd8+/flox (Nuc)"   = DE_Cond_nuc_het,
  "Chd8 flox/flox (Syn)"   = DE_Cond_syn_hom,
  "Chd8 flox/flox (Nuc)"   = DE_Cond_nuc_hom
)

## ---- count up/down DEGs at P<0.05 and FDR<0.1 ----
summ_df <- lapply(names(de_list), function(lbl) {
  de <- std_de(de_list[[lbl]])

  up_p    <- sum(de$logFC > 0 & de$PValue < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
  up_fdr  <- sum(de$logFC > 0 & de$FDR    < 0.10, na.rm = TRUE)
  dn_p    <- sum(de$logFC < 0 & de$PValue < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
  dn_fdr  <- sum(de$logFC < 0 & de$FDR    < 0.10, na.rm = TRUE)

  data.frame(
    Dataset = lbl,
    Direction = c("Down", "Up"),
    n_p05 = c(dn_p, up_p),
    n_fdr = c(dn_fdr, up_fdr),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}) %>% dplyr::bind_rows()

## y-axis labels: dataset + (Down/Up)
ds_levels <- c("Chd8+/- (whole)", "Chd8+/- (Syn)", "Chd8+/- (Nuc)", #"Chd8+/- (Cyt)",  
               "Chd8+/flox (whole)", "Chd8+/flox (Syn)", "Chd8+/flox (Nuc)", "Chd8 flox/flox (Syn)", "Chd8 flox/flox (Nuc)")

ylab_levels <- unlist(lapply(ds_levels, function(d)
  c(paste0(d, " (Down)"), paste0(d, " (Up)"))))

## first level at top, like your example
summ_df$Ylab <- factor(
  paste0(summ_df$Dataset, " (", summ_df$Direction, ")"),
  levels = rev(ylab_levels)
)

## base (P<0.05) layer and inner (FDR<0.1) layer
df_base <- summ_df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(FillGroup = ifelse(Direction == "Down",
                                   "Down, P < 0.05",
                                   "Up, P < 0.05"))

df_fdr <- summ_df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    FillGroup = ifelse(Direction == "Down",
                       "Down, FDR < 0.1",
                       "Up, FDR < 0.1"),
    max_n = pmax(n_fdr)          # max per row for FDR label position (== n_fdr)
  )

# FDR labels just beyond FDR bar
df_label_fdr <- df_fdr %>%
  dplyr::filter(n_fdr > 0) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(xpos = max_n + 10)

# P<0.05 labels: just *inside* the P bar, except for Chd8+flox (whole),
# where the label goes just beyond the max
df_label_p05 <- df_base %>%
  dplyr::filter(n_p05 > 0) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    xpos = ifelse(
      Dataset %in% c("Chd8+/flox (whole)" #, "Chd8+/- (Cyt)"
                     ),
      n_p05 + 10,   # just beyond the max for flox
      n_p05 - 170    # just below the max (inside the bar) for all others
    )
  )

cols <- c(
  "Down, FDR < 0.1" = "#2078B4",  # dark blue
  "Down, P < 0.05"  = "#8BC3E4",  # light blue
  "Up, FDR < 0.1"   = "#960305",  # dark red
  "Up, P < 0.05"    = "#D86567"   # light red
)

## ---- plot with overlaid bars ----
ggplot(NULL, aes(y = Ylab)) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  # light P<0.05 bar (full length)
  geom_col(
    data = df_base,
    aes(x = n_p05, fill = FillGroup),
    color = "black",
    width = 0.8,
    position = "identity"
  ) +
  # dark FDR<0.1 bar (same thickness, shorter length)
  geom_col(
    data = df_fdr,
    aes(x = n_fdr, fill = FillGroup),
    color = "black",
    width = 0.8,
    position = "identity"
  ) +
  # labels: P<0.05 count (just beyond P bar)
  geom_text(
    data = df_label_p05,
    aes(x = xpos, label = n_p05),
    size = 6,
    vjust = 0.5,
    hjust = 0
  ) +
  # labels: FDR<0.1 count (just beyond FDR bar)
  geom_text(
    data = df_label_fdr,
    aes(x = xpos, label = n_fdr),
    size = 6,
    vjust = 0.5,
    hjust = 0
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cols, name = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = "Number of DE genes", y = NULL) +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "italic"),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
```

```{r}
  geom_text(
    data = df_label_fdr,
    aes(x = xpos, label = n_fdr),
    size = 6,
    vjust = 0.5,
    hjust = 0
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cols, name = NULL) +
  scale_y_discrete(breaks = y_breaks, labels = y_labels) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = "Number of DE genes", y = NULL) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )


```

```{r}
## Add PC1 to const cyt metadata

add_PC1_to_meta <- function(counts, meta,
                            sample_col = "Sample",
                            n_features = 2000,
                            center = TRUE,
                            scale. = TRUE) {
  stopifnot(sample_col %in% colnames(meta))

   # Standardize counts rownames ONLY if gene IDs are provided as a column
  if (is.data.frame(counts) && "gene_id" %in% colnames(counts)) {
    rownames(counts) <- as.character(counts$gene_id)
    counts <- counts[, colnames(counts) != "gene_id", drop = FALSE]
  } else if (is.data.frame(counts) && "gene" %in% colnames(counts)) {
    rownames(counts) <- as.character(counts$gene)
    counts <- counts[, colnames(counts) != "gene", drop = FALSE]
  }

  # Align samples
  samples_in_both <- intersect(colnames(counts), meta[[sample_col]])
  if (length(samples_in_both) < 3) stop("Too few overlapping samples to compute PCA.")

  counts <- counts[, samples_in_both, drop = FALSE]
  meta2  <- meta[meta[[sample_col]] %in% samples_in_both, , drop = FALSE]
  meta2  <- meta2[match(samples_in_both, meta2[[sample_col]]), , drop = FALSE]

  # logCPM
  logcpm_all <- edgeR::cpm(counts, log = TRUE, prior.count = 1)

  # choose features (top variable genes)
  if (!is.null(n_features) && n_features < nrow(logcpm_all)) {
    vars <- matrixStats::rowVars(as.matrix(logcpm_all))
    top_genes <- names(sort(vars, decreasing = TRUE))[seq_len(n_features)]
    mat <- t(logcpm_all[top_genes, , drop = FALSE])  # samples x genes
  } else {
    mat <- t(logcpm_all)  # samples x genes
  }

  # PCA
  pca <- stats::prcomp(mat, center = center, scale. = scale.)
  pc1 <- pca$x[, 1]

  pc_df <- data.frame(
    Sample = rownames(pca$x),
    PC1 = as.numeric(pc1),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  # Join back
  meta_out <- dplyr::left_join(
    meta2,
    pc_df,
    by = setNames("Sample", sample_col)
  )

  return(meta_out)
}

meta_Const_cyt <- add_PC1_to_meta(counts_Const_cyt, meta_Const_cyt, sample_col = "Sample", n_features = 2000)
```

#### Boxplot Function


```{r}


plot_gene_box <- function(counts, meta, de,
                          gene,
                          dataset_label = "",
                          mode = c("res_exp", "rpkm"),
                          covariates = c("Sex"),
                          meta_sample_col = "Sample",
                          meta_genotype_col = "Genotype",
                          meta_sex_col = "Sex",
                          compute_pc1 = FALSE,
                          pc1_n_features = 2000,

                          # ---- REQUIRED for mode = "rpkm" ----
                          rpkm_mat = NULL,
                          rpkm_is_log2 = TRUE,
                          rpkm_prior_label = 2,

                          # ---- mapping + ENSEMBL version handling ----
                          gene_map = NULL,                 # data.frame with gene_id, gene_name
                          map_id_col = "gene_id",
                          map_symbol_col = "gene_name",
                          strip_ens_version = TRUE,

                          test = c("welch", "student", "wilcox"),

                          # ---- take pvalue from DE table instead of running stats ----
                          p_from_DE = FALSE,

                          # ---- show or suppress p-value annotation ----
                          show_p_value = TRUE,

                          # ---- label points with Sample ----
                          label_points = TRUE,
                          label_size = 2.6
) {

  mode <- match.arg(mode)
  if (!isTRUE(p_from_DE)) {
    test <- match.arg(test)
  }

  stopifnot(meta_sample_col %in% colnames(meta))
  stopifnot(meta_genotype_col %in% colnames(meta))
  stopifnot(meta_sex_col %in% colnames(meta))

  # ============================================================
  # guardrails
  # ============================================================
  if (mode == "rpkm") {
    if (is.null(rpkm_mat)) stop("mode='rpkm' requires `rpkm_mat=`.")
    if (!is.matrix(rpkm_mat) && !is.data.frame(rpkm_mat)) stop("`rpkm_mat` must be a matrix or data.frame.")
    rpkm_mat <- as.matrix(rpkm_mat)
    if (is.null(rownames(rpkm_mat)) || any(!nzchar(rownames(rpkm_mat)))) stop("`rpkm_mat` must have non-empty rownames.")
    if (is.null(colnames(rpkm_mat)) || any(!nzchar(colnames(rpkm_mat)))) stop("`rpkm_mat` must have non-empty colnames.")
  }

  if (isTRUE(label_points) && !requireNamespace("ggrepel", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("label_points=TRUE requires ggrepel. Install with: install.packages('ggrepel')")
  }

  # ============================================================
  # helper: strip ENS version
  # ============================================================
  strip_ver <- function(x) {
    if (!strip_ens_version) return(x)
    sub("\\.[0-9]+$", "", x)
  }

  # ============================================================
  # helper: make a robust sample key
  # ============================================================
  norm_sample_key <- function(x) {
    x <- as.character(x)
    x <- trimws(x)
    x <- gsub("\u00A0", " ", x, fixed = TRUE)
    x <- trimws(x)
    x <- gsub("\\.", "_", x)
    x <- sub("^X(?=\\d)", "", x, perl = TRUE)
    tolower(x)
  }

  # ============================================================
  # helper: resolve gene input (SYMBOL or ENSEMBL) to rowname key
  # ============================================================
  resolve_gene_key <- function(gene_in, rn, gene_map = NULL) {
    rn0 <- rn
    rn_stripped <- strip_ver(rn0)
    g0 <- as.character(gene_in)
    g_stripped <- strip_ver(g0)

    if (g0 %in% rn0) {
      return(list(key = g0, label = g0))
    }

    if (g_stripped %in% rn_stripped) {
      idx <- match(g_stripped, rn_stripped)
      return(list(key = rn0[idx], label = g_stripped))
    }

    if (!is.null(gene_map)) {
      stopifnot(is.data.frame(gene_map))
      stopifnot(all(c(map_id_col, map_symbol_col) %in% colnames(gene_map)))

      gm <- gene_map[, c(map_id_col, map_symbol_col)]
      gm <- gm[!is.na(gm[[map_id_col]]) & nzchar(gm[[map_id_col]]), , drop = FALSE]
      gm[[map_id_col]] <- as.character(gm[[map_id_col]])
      gm[[map_symbol_col]] <- as.character(gm[[map_symbol_col]])

      gm_id_stripped <- strip_ver(gm[[map_id_col]])

      hit_sym <- which(!is.na(gm[[map_symbol_col]]) & gm[[map_symbol_col]] == g0)
      if (length(hit_sym) == 0 && g0 != g_stripped) {
        hit_sym <- which(!is.na(gm[[map_symbol_col]]) & gm[[map_symbol_col]] == g_stripped)
      }

      if (length(hit_sym) > 0) {
        ens_candidates <- gm[[map_id_col]][hit_sym]
        ens_candidates_stripped <- gm_id_stripped[hit_sym]

        exact_idx <- match(ens_candidates, rn0)
        if (any(!is.na(exact_idx))) {
          use <- exact_idx[which(!is.na(exact_idx))[1]]
          return(list(key = rn0[use], label = g0))
        }

        idx2 <- match(ens_candidates_stripped, rn_stripped)
        if (any(!is.na(idx2))) {
          use <- idx2[which(!is.na(idx2))[1]]
          return(list(key = rn0[use], label = g0))
        }

        return(list(key = NA_character_, label = g0))
      }

      hit_id <- which(strip_ver(gm[[map_id_col]]) == g_stripped)
      if (length(hit_id) > 0) {
        sym <- gm[[map_symbol_col]][hit_id[1]]
        if (!is.na(sym) && nzchar(sym)) {
          if (g0 %in% rn0) return(list(key = g0, label = sym))
          if (g_stripped %in% rn_stripped) {
            idx <- match(g_stripped, rn_stripped)
            return(list(key = rn0[idx], label = sym))
          }
        }
      }
    }

    list(key = NA_character_, label = g0)
  }

  # ============================================================
  # helper: pull PValue from DE table for this gene
  # ============================================================
  get_de_p <- function(de, gene_key, gene_label, gene_in) {
    pval <- NA_real_
    if (is.null(de) || !is.data.frame(de)) return(pval)
    if (!("PValue" %in% colnames(de))) return(pval)

    possible_gene_cols <- c("gene", "gene_id", "geneID", "Gene", "GeneID", "ENSEMBL", "Ensembl", "ens_id", "id", "gene_name")
    gene_col <- possible_gene_cols[possible_gene_cols %in% colnames(de)][1]
    if (is.na(gene_col) || !nzchar(gene_col)) return(pval)

    ids <- as.character(de[[gene_col]])
    ids_str <- strip_ver(ids)

    hit <- which(ids_str == strip_ver(gene_key))
    if (length(hit) == 0) hit <- which(ids == gene_key)
    if (length(hit) == 0) hit <- which(ids == as.character(gene_label))
    if (length(hit) == 0) hit <- which(ids_str == strip_ver(as.character(gene_label)))
    if (length(hit) == 0) hit <- which(ids == as.character(gene_in))
    if (length(hit) == 0) hit <- which(ids_str == strip_ver(as.character(gene_in)))

    if (length(hit) > 0) {
      pval <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(de$PValue[hit[1]]))
    }
    pval
  }

  # ============================================================
  # standardize counts rownames IF they were provided as a column
  # ============================================================
  if (is.data.frame(counts) && "gene" %in% colnames(counts)) {
    rownames(counts) <- as.character(counts$gene)
    counts <- counts[, colnames(counts) != "gene", drop = FALSE]
  } else if (is.data.frame(counts) && "gene_name" %in% colnames(counts)) {
    rownames(counts) <- as.character(counts$gene_name)
    counts <- counts[, colnames(counts) != "gene_name", drop = FALSE]
  }

  counts <- as.matrix(counts)

  # ============================================================
  # align samples (counts <-> meta) using NORMALIZED KEYS
  # ============================================================
  colnames(counts) <- trimws(as.character(colnames(counts)))
  meta[[meta_sample_col]] <- trimws(as.character(meta[[meta_sample_col]]))

  cn_raw <- colnames(counts)
  ms_raw <- meta[[meta_sample_col]]

  cn_key <- norm_sample_key(cn_raw)
  ms_key <- norm_sample_key(ms_raw)

  keep_key <- intersect(cn_key, ms_key)
  if (length(keep_key) == 0L) {
    warning("No overlapping samples between counts and metadata for ", dataset_label)
    return(NULL)
  }

  keep_cols <- cn_key %in% keep_key
  counts <- counts[, keep_cols, drop = FALSE]
  cn_raw <- colnames(counts)
  cn_key <- norm_sample_key(cn_raw)

  meta <- meta[ms_key %in% keep_key, , drop = FALSE]
  ms_key2 <- norm_sample_key(meta[[meta_sample_col]])
  meta <- meta[match(cn_key, ms_key2), , drop = FALSE]

  if (any(is.na(meta[[meta_sample_col]]))) {
    warning("Sample alignment produced NA rows in metadata for ", dataset_label,
            ". This usually means DUPLICATE sample IDs after normalization.")
    return(NULL)
  }

  # ============================================================
  # resolve gene key against counts/rpkm rownames (ENSEMBL-safe)
  # ============================================================
  if (mode == "res_exp") {
    gg <- resolve_gene_key(gene, rownames(counts), gene_map = gene_map)
  } else {
    gg <- resolve_gene_key(gene, rownames(as.matrix(rpkm_mat)), gene_map = gene_map)
  }

  gene_key   <- gg$key
  gene_label <- gg$label

  if (is.na(gene_key) || !nzchar(gene_key)) {
    warning(gene, " not found (after mapping) in ", mode, " matrix for ", dataset_label)
    return(NULL)
  }

  # ============================================================
  # build df_plot (mode-specific)
  # ============================================================
  if (mode == "res_exp") {

    logcpm_all <- edgeR::cpm(counts, log = TRUE, prior.count = 1)

    rn0 <- rownames(logcpm_all)
    idx <- match(gene_key, rn0)
    if (is.na(idx)) idx <- match(strip_ver(gene_key), strip_ver(rn0))
    if (is.na(idx)) {
      warning(gene, " resolved to ", gene_key, " but still not found in logCPM for ", dataset_label)
      return(NULL)
    }

    expr_vec <- as.numeric(logcpm_all[idx, , drop = TRUE])

    df_plot <- data.frame(
      Sample = colnames(counts),
      expr   = expr_vec,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    df_plot <- dplyr::left_join(df_plot, meta, by = setNames(meta_sample_col, "Sample"))

    if (compute_pc1) {
      if (!"PC1" %in% colnames(df_plot)) {
        if (!requireNamespace("matrixStats", quietly = TRUE)) {
          stop("Please install/load matrixStats for PC1 computation: install.packages('matrixStats')")
        }
        vars <- matrixStats::rowVars(as.matrix(logcpm_all))
        top_genes <- names(sort(vars, decreasing = TRUE))[seq_len(min(pc1_n_features, length(vars)))]
        mat <- t(logcpm_all[top_genes, , drop = FALSE])
        pca <- stats::prcomp(mat, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
        df_plot$PC1 <- as.numeric(pca$x[, 1])
      }
    }

    y_axis_label <- paste0(gene_label, " residualized (log2 CPM)")
    plot_title   <- paste0(gene_label, " residualized expression - ", dataset_label)

  } else {

    rpkm_mat <- as.matrix(rpkm_mat)

    colnames(rpkm_mat) <- trimws(as.character(colnames(rpkm_mat)))
    meta[[meta_sample_col]] <- trimws(as.character(meta[[meta_sample_col]]))

    rk_raw <- colnames(rpkm_mat)
    ms_raw3 <- meta[[meta_sample_col]]

    rk_key <- norm_sample_key(rk_raw)
    ms_key3 <- norm_sample_key(ms_raw3)

    keep_key2 <- intersect(rk_key, ms_key3)
    if (length(keep_key2) == 0L) {
      warning("No overlapping samples between rpkm_mat and metadata for ", dataset_label)
      return(NULL)
    }

    rpkm_mat2 <- rpkm_mat[, rk_key %in% keep_key2, drop = FALSE]
    rk_raw2 <- colnames(rpkm_mat2)
    rk_key2 <- norm_sample_key(rk_raw2)

    meta2 <- meta[ms_key3 %in% keep_key2, , drop = FALSE]
    ms_key4 <- norm_sample_key(meta2[[meta_sample_col]])
    meta2 <- meta2[match(rk_key2, ms_key4), , drop = FALSE]

    if (any(is.na(meta2[[meta_sample_col]]))) {
      warning("RPKM sample alignment produced NA rows in metadata for ", dataset_label,
              ". This usually means DUPLICATE sample IDs after normalization.")
      return(NULL)
    }

    rn0 <- rownames(rpkm_mat2)
    idx <- match(gene_key, rn0)
    if (is.na(idx)) idx <- match(strip_ver(gene_key), strip_ver(rn0))
    if (is.na(idx)) {
      warning(gene, " resolved to ", gene_key, " but still not found in rpkm_mat for ", dataset_label)
      return(NULL)
    }

    expr_vec <- as.numeric(rpkm_mat2[idx, , drop = TRUE])

    df_plot <- data.frame(
      Sample = colnames(rpkm_mat2),
      expr   = expr_vec,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    df_plot <- dplyr::left_join(df_plot, meta2, by = setNames(meta_sample_col, "Sample"))

    y_axis_label <- if (rpkm_is_log2) {
      paste0(gene_label, " log2(RPKM+", rpkm_prior_label, ")")
    } else {
      paste0(gene_label, " RPKM")
    }
    plot_title <- paste0(gene_label, " - ", dataset_label)
  }

  # ============================================================
  # genotype factor order
  # ============================================================
  gt <- df_plot[[meta_genotype_col]]
  if (any(gt == "HET", na.rm = TRUE)) {
    df_plot[[meta_genotype_col]] <- factor(gt, levels = c("WT", "HET"))
  } else if (any(gt == "HOM", na.rm = TRUE)) {
    df_plot[[meta_genotype_col]] <- factor(gt, levels = c("WT", "HOM"))
  } else {
    lv <- unique(as.character(gt))
    if ("WT" %in% lv) lv <- c("WT", setdiff(lv, "WT"))
    df_plot[[meta_genotype_col]] <- factor(gt, levels = lv)
  }

  # ============================================================
  # stats + plotting values
  # ============================================================
  pval <- NA_real_

  if (mode == "res_exp") {

    covariates <- unique(covariates)
    missing_covars <- setdiff(covariates, colnames(df_plot))
    if (length(missing_covars) > 0) {
      stop("Missing covariates in ", dataset_label, ": ", paste(missing_covars, collapse = ", "))
    }

    model_terms <- c(meta_genotype_col, covariates)
    fml <- as.formula(paste("expr ~", paste(model_terms, collapse = " + ")))

    keep <- stats::complete.cases(df_plot[, c("expr", model_terms), drop = FALSE])
    df_plot <- df_plot[keep, , drop = FALSE]
    df_plot[[meta_genotype_col]] <- droplevels(df_plot[[meta_genotype_col]])

    if (nrow(df_plot) < 3) {
      warning("Too few samples after filtering for model in ", dataset_label)
      return(NULL)
    }

    fit <- stats::lm(fml, data = df_plot)
    df_plot$y_plot <- stats::residuals(fit) + stats::coef(fit)[1]

    if (isTRUE(p_from_DE)) {
      pval <- get_de_p(de = de, gene_key = gene_key, gene_label = gene_label, gene_in = gene)
    } else {
      sm <- summary(fit)
      if (nlevels(df_plot[[meta_genotype_col]]) == 2) {
        coef_name <- grep(paste0("^", meta_genotype_col), rownames(sm$coefficients), value = TRUE)
        pval <- if (length(coef_name) >= 1) sm$coefficients[coef_name[1], "Pr(>|t|)"] else NA_real_
      } else {
        an <- stats::anova(fit)
        pval <- if (meta_genotype_col %in% rownames(an)) an[meta_genotype_col, "Pr(>F)"] else NA_real_
      }
    }

    cov_txt <- paste(covariates, collapse = ", ")
    plot_subtitle <- paste0("Model: expr ~ ", meta_genotype_col, " + ", cov_txt)

  } else {

    keep <- stats::complete.cases(df_plot[, c("expr", meta_genotype_col), drop = FALSE])
    df_plot <- df_plot[keep, , drop = FALSE]
    df_plot[[meta_genotype_col]] <- droplevels(df_plot[[meta_genotype_col]])
    df_plot$y_plot <- df_plot$expr

    if (nrow(df_plot) < 3) {
      warning("Too few samples after filtering for test in ", dataset_label)
      return(NULL)
    }

    if (isTRUE(p_from_DE)) {
      pval <- get_de_p(de = de, gene_key = gene_key, gene_label = gene_label, gene_in = gene)
    } else {
      if (nlevels(df_plot[[meta_genotype_col]]) == 2) {
        grp_counts <- table(df_plot[[meta_genotype_col]])
        ok_groups <- all(grp_counts > 0)
        ok_ttest  <- all(grp_counts >= 2)

        if (test %in% c("welch", "student") && !ok_ttest) {
          pval <- NA_real_
        } else if (test == "wilcox" && !ok_groups) {
          pval <- NA_real_
        } else {
          pval <- tryCatch({
            if (test == "welch") {
              stats::t.test(df_plot$y_plot ~ df_plot[[meta_genotype_col]], var.equal = FALSE)$p.value
            } else if (test == "student") {
              stats::t.test(df_plot$y_plot ~ df_plot[[meta_genotype_col]], var.equal = TRUE)$p.value
            } else {
              stats::wilcox.test(df_plot$y_plot ~ df_plot[[meta_genotype_col]], exact = FALSE)$p.value
            }
          }, error = function(e) NA_real_)
        }
      }
    }

    plot_subtitle <- NULL
  }

  p_label <- if (is.na(pval)) "p = NA" else paste0("p = ", signif(pval, 3))

  y_max <- max(df_plot$y_plot, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_min <- min(df_plot$y_plot, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_rng <- y_max - y_min

  p <- ggplot2::ggplot(
    df_plot,
    ggplot2::aes(x = .data[[meta_genotype_col]], y = y_plot, color = .data[[meta_genotype_col]])
  ) +
    ggplot2::geom_boxplot(fill = NA, width = 0.5, size = 0.9, outlier.shape = NA) +
    ggplot2::geom_jitter(ggplot2::aes(shape = .data[[meta_sex_col]]), width = 0.12, size = 3) +
    { if (isTRUE(label_points))
        ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
          ggplot2::aes(label = Sample),
          position = ggplot2::position_jitter(width = 0.12, height = 0),
          size = label_size,
          color = "black",
          show.legend = FALSE,
          box.padding = 0.35,
          point.padding = 0.20,
          max.overlaps = Inf,
          min.segment.length = 0,
          seed = 1
        )
      else NULL
    } +
    ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = c("WT" = "steelblue3", "HET" = "firebrick2", "HOM" = "firebrick2")) +
    ggplot2::scale_shape_manual(values = c("F" = 17, "M" = 16)) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = plot_title,
      subtitle = plot_subtitle,
      x = "Genotype",
      y = y_axis_label
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_bw()

  if (isTRUE(show_p_value)) {
    if (isTRUE(p_from_DE)) {
      p <- p +
        ggplot2::annotate("text",
                          x = 1.5, y = -Inf,
                          label = p_label,
                          size = 5,
                          vjust = -0.4)
    } else {
      y_pos_top <- y_max + 0.08 * y_rng
      p <- p +
        ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = y_pos_top, label = p_label, size = 5)
    }
  }

  return(p)
}
```

#### PDF boxplot helper
```{r}

# ============================================================
# Make boxplots for a given gene (ONE pdf per mode)
# - uses your `datasets` list
# - uses your `plot_gene_box()` exactly as defined above
# ============================================================

make_mode_pdf_one_gene <- function(gene_to_plot,
                                  mode_name = c("res_exp", "rpkm"),
                                  outfile,
                                  ncol = 3,
                                  preflight = TRUE,          # <-- prints overlap stats per dataset
                                  preflight_show = 12,       # <-- how many IDs to print if mismatch
                                  p_mode = c("test", "de", "none")) {

  mode_name <- match.arg(mode_name)
  p_mode <- match.arg(p_mode)

  norm <- function(x) {
    x <- as.character(x)
    x <- trimws(x)
    x <- gsub("\u00A0", " ", x, fixed = TRUE)
    x <- trimws(x)
    x <- gsub("\\.", "_", x)
    x <- sub("^X(?=\\d)", "", x, perl = TRUE)
    tolower(x)
  }

  if (isTRUE(preflight)) {
    cat("\n==============================\n")
    cat("PREFLIGHT SAMPLE OVERLAP | gene =", gene_to_plot, "| mode =", mode_name, "\n")
    cat("==============================\n")
  }

  plots <- lapply(names(datasets), function(nm) {

    d <- datasets[[nm]]

    # --- preflight check  ---
    if (isTRUE(preflight)) {

      # counts-vs-meta overlap
      cn <- colnames(d$counts)
      ms <- d$meta$Sample

      cn2 <- norm(cn)
      ms2 <- norm(ms)

      inter_n <- length(intersect(cn2, ms2))

      cat("\n[", nm, "] ", d$label, "\n", sep = "")
      cat("  counts ncol:", length(cn), "\n")
      cat("  meta   nrow:", nrow(d$meta), "\n")
      cat("  intersect(norm) n:", inter_n, "\n")

      if (inter_n == 0) {
        cat("  !!! NO OVERLAP. Showing heads (raw):\n")
        cat("  counts head:\n"); print(head(sprintf("'%s'", cn), preflight_show))
        cat("  meta   head:\n"); print(head(sprintf("'%s'", ms), preflight_show))
        cat("  setdiff(counts, meta) [norm] head:\n"); print(head(sprintf("'%s'", setdiff(cn2, ms2)), preflight_show))
        cat("  setdiff(meta, counts) [norm] head:\n"); print(head(sprintf("'%s'", setdiff(ms2, cn2)), preflight_show))
      }

      # rpkm-vs-meta overlap (only when plotting rpkm)
      if (mode_name == "rpkm") {
        rk <- colnames(as.matrix(d$rpkm))
        rk2 <- norm(rk)
        inter_r <- length(intersect(rk2, ms2))
        cat("  rpkm   ncol:", length(rk), "\n")
        cat("  rpkm intersect(norm) n:", inter_r, "\n")
        if (inter_r == 0) {
          cat("  !!! NO RPKM OVERLAP. rpkm head:\n")
          print(head(sprintf("'%s'", rk), preflight_show))
        }
      }
    }

    use_p_from_DE <- (p_mode == "de")
    show_p_value  <- (p_mode != "none")

    # --- now make the plot ---
    if (mode_name == "rpkm") {

      plot_gene_box(
        counts = d$counts,
        meta   = d$meta,
        de     = d$de,
        gene   = gene_to_plot,
        dataset_label = d$label,
        mode = "rpkm",
        covariates = d$covars,
        compute_pc1 = d$compute_pc1,
        rpkm_mat = d$rpkm,
        rpkm_is_log2 = TRUE,
        rpkm_prior_label = 2,
        test = "student",
        p_from_DE = use_p_from_DE,
        show_p_value = show_p_value,
        label_points = FALSE,
        gene_map = my_gene,
        map_id_col = "gene_id",
        map_symbol_col = "gene_name",
        strip_ens_version = TRUE
      )

    } else {

      plot_gene_box(
        counts = d$counts,
        meta   = d$meta,
        de     = d$de,
        gene   = gene_to_plot,
        dataset_label = d$label,
        mode = "res_exp",
        covariates = d$covars,
        compute_pc1 = d$compute_pc1,
        test = "student",
        p_from_DE = use_p_from_DE,
        show_p_value = show_p_value,
        label_points = FALSE,
        gene_map = my_gene,
        map_id_col = "gene_id",
        map_symbol_col = "gene_name",
        strip_ens_version = TRUE
      )
    }
  })

  plots <- plots[!vapply(plots, is.null, logical(1))]

  if (length(plots) == 0) {
    warning("No plots produced for gene ", gene_to_plot, " (mode=", mode_name, "). Nothing to write: ", outfile)
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  combined_plot <- patchwork::wrap_plots(plots, ncol = ncol)

  grDevices::pdf(outfile, width = 10, height = 10) # 14 and 10 for standard
  print(combined_plot)
  grDevices::dev.off()
}


```

#### Compile syn/nuc only datasets
```{r}

# ============================================================
# Compile syn/nuc datasets ONLY
#   - datasets_syn_nuc      = YOUR stuff (outliers already filtered in meta_Const_syn/meta_Const_nuc)
#   - datasets_syn_nuc_kc   = KAROL stuff (NO outlier filtering unless you add it)
# ============================================================

datasets_syn_nuc <- list(
  Const_nuc = list(
    counts = counts_Const_nuc,
    meta   = meta_Const_nuc,
    de     = DE_Const_nuc,
    label  = "Const nuc (mine)",
    covars = c("Sex","Sequencing_batch"),
    compute_pc1 = FALSE,
    rpkm   = rpkm_data_const_syn_nuc_cyt
  ),
  Const_syn = list(
    counts = counts_Const_syn,
    meta   = meta_Const_syn,
    de     = DE_Const_syn,
    label  = "Const syn (mine)",
    covars = c("Sex","Sequencing_batch"),
    compute_pc1 = FALSE,
    rpkm   = rpkm_data_const_syn_nuc_cyt
  )
)

# Karol:
# rpkm.data = his syn/nuc matrix
# metadata_s = his Sample/Genotype/Sex (contains BOTH Syn and Nuc samples)
# exp.data   = counts matrix (Karol) with columns matching metadata$Sample (usually)
#
# We'll build "counts" by subsetting exp.data to Syn or Nuc samples, so plot_gene_box can do its usual alignment.
# (Even in mode="rpkm", the function still expects counts to exist for alignment.)

kc_syn_samples <- metadata_s$Sample[grepl("Syn$", metadata_s$Sample)]
kc_nuc_samples <- metadata_s$Sample[grepl("Nuc$", metadata_s$Sample)]

counts_kc_syn <- exp.data[, colnames(exp.data) %in% kc_syn_samples, drop = FALSE]
counts_kc_nuc <- exp.data[, colnames(exp.data) %in% kc_nuc_samples, drop = FALSE]

meta_kc_syn <- metadata_s %>% dplyr::filter(Sample %in% colnames(counts_kc_syn))
meta_kc_nuc <- metadata_s %>% dplyr::filter(Sample %in% colnames(counts_kc_nuc))

datasets_syn_nuc_kc <- list(
  KC_nuc = list(
    counts = counts_kc_nuc,
    meta   = meta_kc_nuc,
    de     = NULL,
    label  = "Const nuc (Karol)",
    covars = c("Sex"),
    compute_pc1 = FALSE,
    rpkm   = rpkm.data
  ),
  KC_syn = list(
    counts = counts_kc_syn,
    meta   = meta_kc_syn,
    de     = NULL,
    label  = "Const syn (Karol)",
    covars = c("Sex"),
    compute_pc1 = FALSE,
    rpkm   = rpkm.data
  )
)
```

#### Make with shared y axis

```{r}

# ============================================================
# ONE stitched PDF (8 panels) with SHARED y-axis ticks/limits
# Order:
#   Const whole, Const syn, Const nuc,
#   Cond whole,  Cond syn het, Cond nuc het, Cond syn hom, Cond nuc hom
# ============================================================

outpdf <- "output/plots/Chd8_rpkm_all_SHAREDY.pdf"
dir.create(dirname(outpdf), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

gene_to_plot <- "Chd8"
mode_name    <- "rpkm"   
ymin         <- 0        # set NA if you want auto lower bound
ymax         <- 3.25
by_tick      <- 1.0
breaks_vec   <- seq(ifelse(is.na(ymin), 0, ymin), ymax, by = by_tick)

# exact order 
order_keys <- c(
  "Const_whole",
  "Const_syn",
  "Const_nuc",
  "Cond_whole",
  "Cond_syn_het",
  "Cond_nuc_het",
  "Cond_syn_hom",
  "Cond_nuc_hom"
)

plots <- vector("list", length(order_keys))
names(plots) <- order_keys

for (nm in order_keys) {
  d <- datasets[[nm]]

  p <- plot_gene_box(
    counts = d$counts,
    meta   = d$meta,
    de     = d$de,
    gene   = gene_to_plot,
    dataset_label = d$label,
    mode = mode_name,
    covariates = d$covars,
    compute_pc1 = d$compute_pc1,
    rpkm_mat = d$rpkm,
    rpkm_is_log2 = TRUE,
    rpkm_prior_label = 2,
    p_from_DE = TRUE,
    label_points = FALSE,
    gene_map = my_gene
  )

  if (is.null(p)) {
    warning("NULL plot for: ", nm)
    next
  }

  # enforce shared y scale + identical ticks across all panels
  p <- p +
    ggplot2::coord_cartesian(ylim = c(ymin, ymax), clip = "off") +
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(breaks = breaks_vec, limits = c(ymin, ymax), expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.10))) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      axis.title.x = ggplot2::element_blank()
    )

  plots[[nm]] <- p
}

plots <- plots[!vapply(plots, is.null, logical(1))]

combined <- patchwork::wrap_plots(plots, ncol = 8, guides = "collect") &
  ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "right")

grDevices::pdf(outpdf, width = 15, height = 4)  
print(combined)
grDevices::dev.off()

message("Wrote: ", outpdf)
```

#### Malat1 with shared Y axis

```{r}


outpdf <- "output/plots/Malat1_rpkm_all_SHAREDY.pdf"
dir.create(dirname(outpdf), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

gene_to_plot <- "Malat1"
ymin         <- NA        # set NA if you want auto lower bound
ymax         <- 10.8
by_tick      <- 1.0
breaks_vec   <- seq(ifelse(is.na(ymin), 0, ymin), 10, by = by_tick)

# For Malat1, the key QC question is fraction enrichment, not genotype.
# Compare non-nuclear fractions to Nuc with Welch t-tests.
malat1_sets <- data.frame(
  dataset_key = c(
    "Const_nuc", "Const_cyt", "Const_syn",
    "Cond_nuc_het", "Cond_syn_het",
    "Cond_nuc_hom", "Cond_syn_hom"
  ),
  Panel = c(
    "Constitutive", "Constitutive", "Constitutive",
    "Conditional HET", "Conditional HET",
    "Conditional HOM", "Conditional HOM"
  ),
  Fraction = c("Nuc", "Cyt", "Syn", "Nuc", "Syn", "Nuc", "Syn"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

norm_sample_key <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- trimws(x)
  x <- gsub("\u00A0", " ", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- trimws(x)
  x <- gsub("\\.", "_", x)
  x <- sub("^X(?=\\d)", "", x, perl = TRUE)
  tolower(x)
}

strip_ens_version <- function(x) sub("\\.[0-9]+$", "", x)

get_rpkm_gene_key <- function(gene, rpkm_mat, gene_map) {
  rn <- rownames(rpkm_mat)
  if (gene %in% rn) return(gene)
  if (strip_ens_version(gene) %in% strip_ens_version(rn)) {
    return(rn[match(strip_ens_version(gene), strip_ens_version(rn))])
  }

  ens_candidates <- gene_map$gene_id[gene_map$gene_name == gene]
  ens_candidates <- ens_candidates[!is.na(ens_candidates) & ens_candidates != ""]
  hit <- match(strip_ens_version(ens_candidates), strip_ens_version(rn))
  hit <- hit[!is.na(hit)]
  if (length(hit) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  rn[hit[1]]
}

malat1_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(malat1_sets)), function(i) {
  cfg <- malat1_sets[i, ]
  d <- datasets[[cfg$dataset_key]]
  rpkm_mat <- as.matrix(d$rpkm)

  gene_key <- get_rpkm_gene_key(gene_to_plot, rpkm_mat, my_gene)
  if (is.na(gene_key)) {
    warning(gene_to_plot, " not found in RPKM matrix for ", cfg$dataset_key)
    return(NULL)
  }

  rk_key <- norm_sample_key(colnames(rpkm_mat))
  ms_key <- norm_sample_key(d$meta$Sample)
  keep_key <- intersect(rk_key, ms_key)

  if (length(keep_key) == 0) {
    warning("No overlapping RPKM/meta samples for ", cfg$dataset_key)
    return(NULL)
  }

  rpkm_sub <- rpkm_mat[, rk_key %in% keep_key, drop = FALSE]
  meta_sub <- d$meta[ms_key %in% keep_key, , drop = FALSE]
  meta_sub <- meta_sub[match(norm_sample_key(colnames(rpkm_sub)), norm_sample_key(meta_sub$Sample)), , drop = FALSE]

  data.frame(
    Sample = colnames(rpkm_sub),
    Expression = as.numeric(rpkm_sub[gene_key, , drop = TRUE]),
    Panel = cfg$Panel,
    Fraction = cfg$Fraction,
    Genotype = meta_sub$Genotype,
    Sex = meta_sub$Sex,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}))

malat1_df <- malat1_df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Panel = factor(Panel, levels = c("Constitutive", "Conditional HET", "Conditional HOM")),
    Fraction = factor(Fraction, levels = c("Nuc", "Cyt", "Syn"))
  )

test_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(split(malat1_df, malat1_df$Panel), function(df) {
  frac_levels_panel <- levels(droplevels(df$Fraction))

  dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(c("Cyt", "Syn"), function(fr) {
    if (!all(c("Nuc", fr) %in% df$Fraction)) return(NULL)

    nuc_vals <- df$Expression[df$Fraction == "Nuc"]
    fr_vals  <- df$Expression[df$Fraction == fr]

    if (length(nuc_vals) < 2 || length(fr_vals) < 2) {
      pval <- NA_real_
    } else {
      pval <- tryCatch(
        stats::t.test(fr_vals, nuc_vals, var.equal = FALSE)$p.value,
        error = function(e) NA_real_
      )
    }

    data.frame(
      Panel = unique(as.character(df$Panel)),
      Fraction = fr,
      x_start = "Nuc",
      x_end = fr,
      label_x = mean(c(match("Nuc", frac_levels_panel), match(fr, frac_levels_panel))),
      y = ifelse(fr == "Cyt", 9.35, 10.10),
      label_y = ifelse(fr == "Cyt", 9.65, 10.45),
      label = ifelse(is.na(pval), "p = NA", paste0("p = ", signif(pval, 3))),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }))
}))

test_df <- test_df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Panel = factor(Panel, levels = levels(malat1_df$Panel)),
    Fraction = factor(Fraction, levels = levels(malat1_df$Fraction))
  )

combined <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  malat1_df,
  ggplot2::aes(x = Fraction, y = Expression, color = Fraction)
) +
  ggplot2::geom_boxplot(fill = NA, width = 0.55, size = 0.9, outlier.shape = NA) +
  ggplot2::geom_jitter(ggplot2::aes(shape = Genotype), width = 0.12, size = 2.8, alpha = 0.9) +
  ggplot2::geom_segment(
    data = test_df,
    ggplot2::aes(x = x_start, xend = x_end, y = y, yend = y),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.25
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_text(
    data = test_df,
    ggplot2::aes(x = label_x, y = label_y, label = label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 5.0,
    lineheight = 0.9
  ) +
  ggplot2::facet_grid(. ~ Panel, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = c("Nuc" = "#619CFF", "Cyt" = "#00BA38", "Syn" = "#F8766D")) +
  ggplot2::scale_shape_manual(values = c("WT" = 16, "HET" = 17, "HOM" = 15)) +
  ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = breaks_vec,
    limits = c(ymin, ymax),
    expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.10))
  ) +
  ggplot2::coord_cartesian(ylim = c(ymin, ymax), clip = "off") +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = paste0(gene_to_plot, " nuclear enrichment"),
    x = "Fraction",
    y = expression(italic("Malat1")~expression)
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size = 16) +
  ggplot2::theme(
    plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 22),
    plot.subtitle = ggplot2::element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 17),
    strip.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 16),
    axis.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 18),
    axis.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 15),
    legend.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 17),
    legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 15),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

grDevices::pdf(outpdf, width = 11, height = 4.8)
print(combined)
grDevices::dev.off()

message("Wrote: ", outpdf)


```

```{r}
# Up in a fraction’s const and cond datasets
	"synaptic vesicle cycle",   # up in syn const/cond
	"neurotransmitter secretion",  # up in syn const/cond
	"regulation of synaptic plasticity",  # up in syn const/cond
	"glycosylation",  # up in syn const/cond (ALSO mostly syn specific)
  "neuronal action potential",

	"translation at synapse",
  "cytoplasmic translation",

# -----------------------------
# BUILD term x dataset matrix (one direction at a time):
# match Description -> NES; missing -> 0
# -----------------------------
make_gsea_mat_one_dir <- function(gsea_list, terms) {
  stopifnot(length(gsea_list) > 0)

  mat <- sapply(names(gsea_list), function(nm) {
    df <- gsea_list[[nm]]
    stopifnot(all(c("Description", "NES") %in% names(df)))

    df2 <- df %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        Description = as.character(Description),
        NES = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(NES))
      ) %>%
      dplyr::distinct(Description, .keep_all = TRUE)

    i <- match(terms, df2$Description)
    v <- df2$NES[i]
    v[is.na(v)] <- 0
    setNames(v, terms)
  })

  mat
}
```

### Get top up and down terms
```{r}


# -----------------------------
# TOP N  TERMS per table (UP + DOWN) and merge across datasets
# Assumes you already have: gsea_up (named list of dataframes), gsea_down (named list)
# Each df has at least: Description, NES
# -----------------------------

get_top_n_terms <- function(df, dataset, direction = c("up","down"), n = 50) {
  direction <- match.arg(direction)

  stopifnot(all(c("Description", "NES") %in% names(df)))

  # find p-value column if present (optional)
  pcol <- intersect(names(df), c("pvalue", "p.value", "PValue", "pval", "p_val"))
  pcol <- if (length(pcol) > 0) pcol[1] else NULL

  df2 <- df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Description = as.character(Description),
      NES = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(NES))
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(NES)) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(Description, .keep_all = TRUE)

  # prefer sorting by p-value when available; otherwise by |NES|
  if (!is.null(pcol)) {
    df2 <- df2 %>%
      dplyr::mutate(p = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data[[pcol]]))) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(p, dplyr::desc(abs(NES)))
  } else {
    df2 <- df2 %>%
      dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(abs(NES)))
  }

  df2 %>%
    dplyr::slice_head(n = n) %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      Dataset = dataset,
      Direction = direction,
      Term = Description,
      NES = NES,
      PValue = if (!is.null(pcol)) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data[[pcol]])) else NA_real_
    )
}

topn_up_long <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(gsea_up), function(nm) {
  get_top_n_terms(gsea_up[[nm]], dataset = nm, direction = "up", n = 50)
}))

topn_down_long <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(gsea_down), function(nm) {
  get_top_n_terms(gsea_down[[nm]], dataset = nm, direction = "down", n = 50)
}))

# Optional: also make wide "heatmap-like" tables (terms x dataset) for NES
topn_up_wide <- topn_up_long %>%
  dplyr::select(Dataset, Term, NES) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Dataset, values_from = NES)

topn_down_wide <- topn_down_long %>%
  dplyr::select(Dataset, Term, NES) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Dataset, values_from = NES)

# objects:
# - topn_up_long, topn_down_long  (stacked/long)
# - topn_up_wide, topn_down_wide  (wide)


```

```{r}
read_de <- function(fp) {
  readr::read_csv(fp, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(dplyr::everything(), ~ .x))
}

detect_cols <- function(de) {
  cols_low <- tolower(names(de))

  gene_col <- names(de)[match(TRUE, cols_low %in% c("gene_id","ens","ensembl","ensembl_id","gene"))]
  if (is.na(gene_col)) {
    gene_col <- names(de)[match(TRUE, cols_low %in% c("gene_name","symbol"))]
  }

  p_col   <- names(de)[match(TRUE, cols_low %in% c("pvalue","p_val","p.val","pvalue_wald","pvalue.lrt","pvalue_lrt"))]
  fdr_col <- names(de)[match(TRUE, cols_low %in% c("fdr","padj","p_adj","p.adjust","p_val_adj","qvalue"))]
  lfc_col <- names(de)[match(TRUE, cols_low %in% c("logfc","log2fc","log2foldchange","log_fc","log2foldchange_wald","log2foldchange.lrt"))]

  stopifnot(!is.na(gene_col), !is.na(p_col), !is.na(lfc_col))
  list(gene_col = gene_col, p_col = p_col, fdr_col = fdr_col, lfc_col = lfc_col)
}

prep_de_for_plot <- function(de, cols, genes) {
  de %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      gene   = as.character(.data[[cols$gene_col]]),
      pvalue = as.numeric(.data[[cols$p_col]]),
      logfc  = as.numeric(.data[[cols$lfc_col]]),
      fdr    = if (!is.na(cols$fdr_col)) as.numeric(.data[[cols$fdr_col]]) else NA_real_
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(gene), gene != "", gene %in% genes) %>%
    dplyr::select(gene, logfc, pvalue, fdr)
}

get_go_genes <- function(term_exact, ontology = "BP", use_goall = TRUE) {
  term2go <- suppressMessages(
    AnnotationDbi::select(
      x       = GO.db::GO.db,
      keys    = term_exact,
      keytype = "TERM",
      columns = c("GOID", "ONTOLOGY")
    )
  )
  if (is.null(term2go) || nrow(term2go) == 0) return(character())

  goids <- term2go[!is.na(term2go$GOID) & term2go$ONTOLOGY == ontology, "GOID", drop = TRUE]
  goids <- unique(as.character(goids))
  if (!length(goids)) return(character())

  go2sym <- suppressMessages(
    AnnotationDbi::select(
      x       = org.Mm.eg.db::org.Mm.eg.db,
      keys    = goids,
      keytype = if (isTRUE(use_goall)) "GOALL" else "GO",
      columns = "SYMBOL"
    )
  )
  if (is.null(go2sym) || nrow(go2sym) == 0) return(character())

  genes <- go2sym$SYMBOL
  genes <- genes[!is.na(genes) & genes != ""]
  unique(as.character(genes))
}

stack_gsea <- function(gsea_list, direction = c("up", "down")) {
  direction <- match.arg(direction)

  bind_rows(lapply(names(gsea_list), function(nm) {
    df <- gsea_list[[nm]] %>%
      mutate(
        dataset = nm,
        Description = as.character(Description),
        NES = as.numeric(NES)
      ) %>%
      select(dataset, Description, NES)

    if (direction == "down") {
      df <- df %>% mutate(NES = -abs(NES))
    } else {
      df <- df %>% mutate(NES = abs(NES))
    }

    df
  }))
}

  stack_gsea(gsea_down, "down")
) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Description), !is.na(NES)) %>%
  distinct(dataset, Description, .keep_all = TRUE)

  "Cilium/cytoskeleton org", "cilium assembly",

  "Cilium/cytoskeleton org", "actin filament organization",

bad_terms <- setdiff(unique(row_map$Description), valid_terms)
if (length(bad_terms) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Invalid GO TERM(s) in row_map:\n  - ",

# =========================================================
# 9) Dataset metadata
# =========================================================
dataset_meta <- tribble(
  ~dataset,       ~block,         ~fraction,
  "Const_nuc",    "Chd8+/-",      "Nuc",
  "Const_cyt",    "Chd8+/-",      "Cyt",
  "Const_syn",    "Chd8+/-",      "Syn",
  "Const_whole",  "Chd8+/-",      "Whole",

  "Cond_HET_nuc", "Chd8+/flox",   "Nuc",
  NA_character_,  "Chd8+/flox",   "Cyt",
  "Cond_HET_syn", "Chd8+/flox",   "Syn",
  "Cond_whole",   "Chd8+/flox",   "Whole"
)

dataset_meta_complete <- dataset_meta %>%
  filter(!is.na(fraction)) %>%
  mutate(dataset = as.character(dataset))

row_order <- c(
  "Cell cycle/chromosome org",
  "DNA replication/repair",
  "RNA processing/splicing",
  "Angiogenesis",
  "Immune response",
  "Cell migration/chemotaxis",

  "Learning or memory",

  "Synaptic signaling",
  "Axon guidance/axonogenesis",
  "Neuropeptide signaling",

  "Translation",

  "Cilium/cytoskeleton org",
  "Dopamine biosynthesis",
  "Methylation"
)

# =========================================================
# 10) Score helpers
# =========================================================
collapse_terms <- function(x, summary_fun = "max_abs") {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0) return(0)

  if (summary_fun == "mean") {
    return(mean(x))
  }

  x[which.max(abs(x))]
}

calc_signed_weighted_mean_logfc <- function(df, p_cap = 10) {
  df2 <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(logfc), !is.na(pvalue))

  if (nrow(df2) == 0) return(NA_real_)

  w <- -log10(pmax(df2$pvalue, 1e-300))
  w <- pmin(w, p_cap)

  if (sum(w, na.rm = TRUE) == 0) return(NA_real_)

  sum(df2$logfc * w, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(w, na.rm = TRUE)
}

score_to_arrows <- function(x,
                            cut1 = 0.40,
                            cut2 = 0.55,
                            cut3 = 0.70) {
  if (is.na(x) || abs(x) < cut1) return("")
  if (x >= cut1 && x < cut2) return("↑")
  if (x >= cut2 && x < cut3) return("↑↑")
  if (x >= cut3) return("↑↑↑")
  if (x <= -cut1 && x > -cut2) return("↓")
  if (x <= -cut2 && x > -cut3) return("↓↓")
  if (x <= -cut3) return("↓↓↓")
  ""
}

# =========================================================
# 11) Build GSEA row-level score
# =========================================================
schematic_gsea <- row_map %>%
  left_join(gsea_signed, by = "Description") %>%
  left_join(dataset_meta_complete, by = "dataset") %>%
  filter(!is.na(block), !is.na(fraction)) %>%
  group_by(block, fraction, row_label) %>%
  summarise(
    gsea_score = collapse_terms(NES, summary_fun = "max_abs"),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# =========================================================
# 12) Precompute GO term genes once
# =========================================================
term_gene_map <- tibble(
  Description = unique(row_map$Description)
) %>%
  mutate(
    term_genes = purrr::map(Description, function(term_desc) {
      go_syms <- as.character(get_go_genes(term_desc, ontology = "BP"))
      go_ens  <- sym_to_ens(go_syms)
      intersect(go_ens, protein_coding_genes)
    })
  )

# =========================================================
# 13) Precompute cleaned DE tables once
# =========================================================
de_prepped <- lapply(names(de_list_raw), function(nm) {
  de_info <- de_list_raw[[nm]]

  de_info$de %>%
    mutate(
      gene   = as.character(.data[[de_info$cols$gene_col]]),
      pvalue = as.numeric(.data[[de_info$cols$p_col]]),
      logfc  = as.numeric(.data[[de_info$cols$lfc_col]]),
      fdr    = if (!is.na(de_info$cols$fdr_col)) as.numeric(.data[[de_info$cols$fdr_col]]) else NA_real_
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(gene), gene != "") %>%
    select(gene, logfc, pvalue, fdr) %>%
    distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE)
})
names(de_prepped) <- names(de_list_raw)

# =========================================================
# 14) Build weighted mean logFC row-level score
# =========================================================
term_dataset_scores <- tidyr::expand_grid(
  term_gene_map,
  dataset = names(de_prepped)
) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    wm_logfc = {
      de_term <- de_prepped[[dataset]] %>%
        filter(gene %in% term_genes)
      calc_signed_weighted_mean_logfc(de_term)
    }
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  left_join(row_map, by = "Description")

schematic_logfc <- term_dataset_scores %>%
  left_join(dataset_meta_complete, by = "dataset") %>%
  filter(!is.na(block), !is.na(fraction)) %>%
  group_by(block, fraction, row_label) %>%
  summarise(
    wm_logfc_score = collapse_terms(wm_logfc, summary_fun = "max_abs"),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# =========================================================
# 15) Scale the two score types to comparable ranges
# =========================================================
gsea_scale <- max(abs(schematic_gsea$gsea_score), na.rm = TRUE)
if (!is.finite(gsea_scale) || is.na(gsea_scale) || gsea_scale == 0) gsea_scale <- 1

logfc_scale <- max(abs(schematic_logfc$wm_logfc_score), na.rm = TRUE)
if (!is.finite(logfc_scale) || is.na(logfc_scale) || logfc_scale == 0) logfc_scale <- 1

schematic_gsea <- schematic_gsea %>%
  mutate(gsea_scaled = gsea_score / gsea_scale)

schematic_logfc <- schematic_logfc %>%
  mutate(wm_logfc_scaled = wm_logfc_score / logfc_scale)

# =========================================================
# 16) Combine into one hybrid score
# =========================================================
gsea_weight  <- 0.5
logfc_weight <- 0.5

schematic_scores <- dataset_meta_complete %>%
  select(block, fraction) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  tidyr::expand_grid(row_label = row_order) %>%
  left_join(schematic_gsea,  by = c("block", "fraction", "row_label")) %>%
  left_join(schematic_logfc, by = c("block", "fraction", "row_label")) %>%
  mutate(
    gsea_score      = replace_na(gsea_score, 0),
    gsea_scaled     = replace_na(gsea_scaled, 0),
    wm_logfc_score  = replace_na(wm_logfc_score, 0),
    wm_logfc_scaled = replace_na(wm_logfc_scaled, 0),
    hybrid_score    = gsea_weight * gsea_scaled + logfc_weight * wm_logfc_scaled,
    arrows          = vapply(hybrid_score, score_to_arrows, character(1))
  )

# =========================================================
# 17) Wide tables
# =========================================================
make_block_table <- function(block_name) {
  schematic_scores %>%
    filter(block == block_name) %>%
    mutate(
      row_label = factor(row_label, levels = row_order),
      fraction  = factor(fraction, levels = c("Nuc", "Cyt", "Syn", "Whole"))
    ) %>%
    arrange(row_label, fraction) %>%
    select(row_label, fraction, gsea_score, wm_logfc_score, hybrid_score, arrows) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = fraction,
      values_from = c(gsea_score, wm_logfc_score, hybrid_score, arrows),
      names_vary = "slowest"
    )
}

const_table <- make_block_table("Chd8+/-")
cond_table  <- make_block_table("Chd8+/flox")

const_table
cond_table
```
