### Convert hybrid score direction to simple arrow table

```{r}

# Uses schematic_scores from the previous chunk for the arrow table.
# The hybrid score is: 0.5 * scaled GSEA NES + 0.5 * scaled pvalue-weighted mean logFC.
# One arrow is assigned from the sign of the hybrid score when
# abs(hybrid_score) >= 0.35 and either:
#   1) significant GSEA NES agrees with that sign, OR
#   2) pvalue-weighted mean logFC and median logFC both agree with that sign.
# The GSEA NES table is saved as a reference sheet, without p-value filtering.

gsea_direction_pvalue_cutoff <- 0.05
hybrid_arrow_cutoff <- 0.35

direction_row_lookup <- tibble::tribble(
  ~row_label, ~display_row,
  "Cell cycle/chromosome org", "Cell cycle/ chromosome organization",
  "DNA replication/repair", "DNA replication/repair",
  "RNA processing/splicing", "RNA processing/splicing",
  "Cilium/cytoskeleton org", "Cilium/cytoskeleton organization",
  "Angiogenesis", "Angiogenesis",
  "Cell migration/chemotaxis", "Cell migration/ chemotaxis",
  "Learning or memory", "Learning or memory",
  "Circadian sleep/wake cycle", "Circadian sleep/wake cycle",
  "Methylation", "Methylation",
  "ATP synthesis/cellular respiration", "ATP synthesis/cellular respiration",
  "Protein folding", "Protein folding",
  "Synaptic signaling", "Synaptic signaling",
  "Neuropeptide signaling", "Neuropeptide signaling",
  "ER signaling/protein localization", "ER signaling/protein localization",
  "Translation", "Translation"
)

direction_row_order <- direction_row_lookup$display_row

direction_dataset_layout <- tibble::tribble(
  ~dataset,       ~block,       ~fraction, ~col_name,
  "Const_nuc",    "Chd8+/-",    "Nuc",     "Chd8+/- Nuc",
  "Const_cyt",    "Chd8+/-",    "Cyt",     "Chd8+/- Cyt",
  "Const_syn",    "Chd8+/-",    "Syn",     "Chd8+/- Syn",
  "Const_whole",  "Chd8+/-",    "Whole",   "Chd8+/- Whole",
  "Cond_HET_nuc", "Chd8+/flox", "Nuc",     "Chd8+/flox Nuc",
  "Cond_HET_syn", "Chd8+/flox", "Syn",     "Chd8+/flox Syn",
  "Cond_whole",   "Chd8+/flox", "Whole",   "Chd8+/flox Whole"
)

direction_col_order <- direction_dataset_layout$col_name

stack_gsea_direction <- function(gsea_list, direction = c("up", "down")) {
  direction <- match.arg(direction)

  bind_rows(lapply(names(gsea_list), function(nm) {
    df <- gsea_list[[nm]] %>%
      mutate(
        dataset = nm,
        Description = as.character(Description),
        NES = as.numeric(NES),
        pvalue = as.numeric(pvalue)
      ) %>%
      select(dataset, Description, NES, pvalue)

    if (direction == "down") {
      df <- df %>% mutate(NES = -abs(NES))
    } else {
      df <- df %>% mutate(NES = abs(NES))
    }

    df
  }))
}

gsea_direction_signed <- bind_rows(
  stack_gsea_direction(gsea_up, "up"),
  stack_gsea_direction(gsea_down, "down")
) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Description),
    !is.na(NES),
    !is.na(pvalue),
    pvalue < gsea_direction_pvalue_cutoff
  ) %>%
  distinct(dataset, Description, .keep_all = TRUE)

gsea_direction_all <- bind_rows(
  stack_gsea_direction(gsea_up, "up"),
  stack_gsea_direction(gsea_down, "down")
) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Description),
    !is.na(NES)
  ) %>%
  distinct(dataset, Description, .keep_all = TRUE)

gsea_direction_scores <- row_map %>%
  inner_join(direction_row_lookup, by = "row_label") %>%
  left_join(gsea_direction_signed, by = "Description") %>%
  filter(!is.na(dataset)) %>%
  group_by(dataset, row_label, display_row) %>%
  summarise(
    gsea_score = collapse_terms(NES, summary_fun = "max_abs"),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

gsea_nes_scores <- row_map %>%
  inner_join(direction_row_lookup, by = "row_label") %>%
  left_join(gsea_direction_all, by = "Description") %>%
  filter(!is.na(dataset)) %>%
  group_by(dataset, row_label, display_row) %>%
  summarise(
    NES = collapse_terms(NES, summary_fun = "max_abs"),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

gsea_arrow_long <- tidyr::expand_grid(
  direction_row_lookup,
  direction_dataset_layout
) %>%
  left_join(
    gsea_direction_scores,
    by = c("dataset", "row_label", "display_row")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    display_row = factor(display_row, levels = direction_row_order),
    col_name = factor(col_name, levels = direction_col_order),
    arrow = case_when(
      is.na(gsea_score) ~ "",
      gsea_score > 0 ~ "↑",
      gsea_score < 0 ~ "↓",
      TRUE ~ ""
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(display_row, col_name)

gsea_arrow_score_table <- gsea_arrow_long %>%
  select(display_row, col_name, gsea_score) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = col_name,
    values_from = gsea_score
  ) %>%
  arrange(factor(display_row, levels = direction_row_order)) %>%
  rename(Pathway = display_row)

gsea_nes_table <- tidyr::expand_grid(
  direction_row_lookup,
  direction_dataset_layout
) %>%
  left_join(
    gsea_nes_scores,
    by = c("dataset", "row_label", "display_row")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    display_row = factor(display_row, levels = direction_row_order),
    col_name = factor(col_name, levels = direction_col_order)
  ) %>%
  arrange(display_row, col_name) %>%
  select(display_row, col_name, NES) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = col_name,
    values_from = NES
  ) %>%
  arrange(factor(display_row, levels = direction_row_order)) %>%
  rename(Pathway = display_row)

direction_row_genes <- row_map %>%
  inner_join(direction_row_lookup, by = "row_label") %>%
  left_join(term_gene_map, by = "Description") %>%
  select(row_label, display_row, term_genes) %>%
  tidyr::unnest(term_genes) %>%
  rename(gene = term_genes) %>%
  filter(!is.na(gene), gene != "") %>%
  distinct(row_label, display_row, gene)

direction_logfc_coherence <- bind_rows(lapply(direction_dataset_layout$dataset, function(ds) {
  de_df <- de_prepped[[ds]] %>%
    select(gene, logfc)

  direction_row_genes %>%
    left_join(de_df, by = "gene") %>%
    filter(!is.na(logfc)) %>%
    group_by(row_label, display_row) %>%
    summarise(
      dataset = ds,
      median_logfc = median(logfc, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_logfc_genes = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}))

hybrid_arrow_long <- tidyr::expand_grid(
  direction_row_lookup,
  direction_dataset_layout
) %>%
  left_join(
    schematic_scores,
    by = c("block", "fraction", "row_label")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    gsea_direction_scores %>%
      rename(gsea_support_score = gsea_score),
    by = c("dataset", "row_label", "display_row")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    direction_logfc_coherence,
    by = c("dataset", "row_label", "display_row")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    display_row = factor(display_row, levels = direction_row_order),
    col_name = factor(col_name, levels = direction_col_order),
    gsea_agrees = !is.na(gsea_support_score) & sign(hybrid_score) == sign(gsea_support_score),
    weighted_logfc_agrees = !is.na(wm_logfc_score) & sign(hybrid_score) == sign(wm_logfc_score),
    median_logfc_agrees = !is.na(median_logfc) & sign(hybrid_score) == sign(median_logfc),
    arrow = case_when(
      is.na(hybrid_score) ~ "",
      abs(hybrid_score) < hybrid_arrow_cutoff ~ "",
      !(gsea_agrees | (weighted_logfc_agrees & median_logfc_agrees)) ~ "",
      hybrid_score > 0 ~ "↑",
      hybrid_score < 0 ~ "↓",
      TRUE ~ ""
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(display_row, col_name)

hybrid_arrow_table <- hybrid_arrow_long %>%
  select(display_row, col_name, arrow) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = col_name,
    values_from = arrow
  ) %>%
  arrange(factor(display_row, levels = direction_row_order)) %>%
  rename(Pathway = display_row)

hybrid_score_table <- hybrid_arrow_long %>%
  select(display_row, col_name, hybrid_score) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = col_name,
    values_from = hybrid_score
  ) %>%
  arrange(factor(display_row, levels = direction_row_order)) %>%
  rename(Pathway = display_row)

outdir_gsea_arrow <- file.path(gsea_dir, "schematic_tables")
dir.create(outdir_gsea_arrow, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

writexl::write_xlsx(

    hybrid_score = hybrid_score_table,
    NES = gsea_nes_table
  ),
  path = file.path(outdir_gsea_arrow, "GSEA_direction_arrow_table.xlsx")
)
```

```{r}
  stop("Invalid GO TERM(s):\n  - ", paste(bad_terms, collapse = "\n  - "))
}

collapse_terms <- function(x, summary_fun = "max_abs") {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  if (summary_fun == "mean") return(mean(x))
  x[which.max(abs(x))]
}

stack_gsea_direction <- function(gsea_list, direction = c("up", "down")) {
  direction <- match.arg(direction)

  bind_rows(lapply(names(gsea_list), function(nm) {
    df <- gsea_list[[nm]] %>%
      mutate(dataset = nm)

    if (direction == "down") {
      df <- df %>% mutate(NES = -abs(NES))
    } else {
      df <- df %>% mutate(NES = abs(NES))
    }

    df
  }))
}

get_go_symbols <- function(term_exact, ontology = "BP", use_goall = TRUE) {
  term2go <- suppressMessages(
    AnnotationDbi::select(
      x = GO.db::GO.db,
      keys = term_exact,
      keytype = "TERM",
      columns = c("GOID", "ONTOLOGY")
    )
  )
  if (is.null(term2go) || nrow(term2go) == 0) return(character())

  goids <- term2go[!is.na(term2go$GOID) & term2go$ONTOLOGY == ontology, "GOID", drop = TRUE]
  goids <- unique(as.character(goids))
  if (!length(goids)) return(character())

  go2sym <- suppressMessages(
    AnnotationDbi::select(
      x = org.Mm.eg.db::org.Mm.eg.db,
      keys = goids,
      keytype = if (isTRUE(use_goall)) "GOALL" else "GO",
      columns = "SYMBOL"
    )
  )
  if (is.null(go2sym) || nrow(go2sym) == 0) return(character())

  unique(go2sym$SYMBOL[!is.na(go2sym$SYMBOL) & go2sym$SYMBOL != ""])
}

read_de_for_logfc <- function(fp) {
  de <- readr::read_csv(fp, show_col_types = FALSE)
  cols_low <- tolower(names(de))

  pick_col <- function(candidates) {
    idx <- match(candidates, cols_low)
    idx <- idx[!is.na(idx)]
    if (length(idx) == 0) return(NA_character_)
    names(de)[idx[1]]
  }

  gene_col <- pick_col(c("gene_name", "symbol", "gene", "gene_id"))
  lfc_col <- pick_col(c("logfc", "log2fc", "log2foldchange", "log_fc"))

  stopifnot(!is.na(gene_col), !is.na(lfc_col))

  de %>%
    mutate(
      gene = as.character(.data[[gene_col]]),
      logfc = as.numeric(.data[[lfc_col]])
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(gene), gene != "", !is.na(logfc)) %>%
    group_by(gene) %>%
    summarise(logfc = mean(logfc, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
}

gsea_only_nes_scores <- row_map %>%

gsea_only_row_genes <- row_map %>%

gsea_only_mean_logfc <- bind_rows(lapply(direction_dataset_layout$dataset, function(ds) {

)
```

```{r}
  stop("Invalid GO TERM(s):\n  - ", paste(bad_terms, collapse = "\n  - "))
}

get_go_symbols <- function(term_exact, ontology = "BP", use_goall = TRUE) {
  term2go <- suppressMessages(
    AnnotationDbi::select(
      x = GO.db::GO.db,
      keys = term_exact,
      keytype = "TERM",
      columns = c("GOID", "ONTOLOGY")
    )
  )
  if (is.null(term2go) || nrow(term2go) == 0) return(character())

  goids <- term2go[!is.na(term2go$GOID) & term2go$ONTOLOGY == ontology, "GOID", drop = TRUE]
  goids <- unique(as.character(goids))
  if (!length(goids)) return(character())

  go2sym <- suppressMessages(
    AnnotationDbi::select(
      x = org.Mm.eg.db::org.Mm.eg.db,
      keys = goids,
      keytype = if (isTRUE(use_goall)) "GOALL" else "GO",
      columns = "SYMBOL"
    )
  )
  if (is.null(go2sym) || nrow(go2sym) == 0) return(character())

  unique(go2sym$SYMBOL[!is.na(go2sym$SYMBOL) & go2sym$SYMBOL != ""])
}

read_de_for_direction <- function(fp) {
  de <- readr::read_csv(fp, show_col_types = FALSE)
  cols_low <- tolower(names(de))

  pick_col <- function(candidates) {
    idx <- match(candidates, cols_low)
    idx <- idx[!is.na(idx)]
    if (length(idx) == 0) return(NA_character_)
    names(de)[idx[1]]
  }

  gene_col <- pick_col(c("gene_name", "symbol", "gene", "gene_id"))
  p_col    <- pick_col(c("pvalue", "p_val", "p.val", "pvalue_wald", "pvalue.lrt", "pvalue_lrt"))
  lfc_col  <- pick_col(c("logfc", "log2fc", "log2foldchange", "log_fc"))

  stopifnot(!is.na(gene_col), !is.na(p_col), !is.na(lfc_col))

  de %>%
    mutate(
      gene = as.character(.data[[gene_col]]),
      pvalue = as.numeric(.data[[p_col]]),
      logfc = as.numeric(.data[[lfc_col]])
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(gene), gene != "", !is.na(logfc), !is.na(pvalue)) %>%
    group_by(gene) %>%
    summarise(
      logfc = mean(logfc, na.rm = TRUE),
      pvalue = min(pvalue, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

score_to_arrow <- function(score, cutoff = dirscore_mid_cutoff, bidir_arrow = dirscore_bidir_arrow) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(score) ~ "",
    score <= -cutoff ~ "↓",
    score >= cutoff ~ "↑",
    TRUE ~ bidir_arrow
  )
}

de_prepped <- list(
  Const_whole  = read_de_for_direction(file.path(de_dir, "Const_whole_PC12.csv")),
  Const_nuc    = read_de_for_direction(file.path(de_dir, "Const_nuc_PC12.csv")),
  Const_cyt    = read_de_for_direction(file.path(de_dir, "Const_cyt_PC12.csv")),
  Const_syn    = read_de_for_direction(file.path(de_dir, "Const_syn_PC12.csv")),
  Cond_whole   = read_de_for_direction(file.path(de_dir, "Cond_whole_NOPC.csv")),
  Cond_HET_nuc = read_de_for_direction(file.path(de_dir, "Cond_nuc_HETvsWT_NOPC.csv")),
  Cond_HET_syn = read_de_for_direction(file.path(de_dir, "Cond_syn_HETvsWT_NOPC.csv"))
)

row_genes <- row_map %>%
  inner_join(direction_row_lookup, by = "row_label") %>%
  distinct(row_label, display_row, Description) %>%
  mutate(gene = lapply(Description, get_go_symbols)) %>%
  tidyr::unnest(gene) %>%
  filter(!is.na(gene), gene != "") %>%
  distinct(row_label, display_row, gene)

direction_score_long <- bind_rows(lapply(direction_dataset_layout$dataset, function(ds) {
  row_genes %>%
    left_join(de_prepped[[ds]], by = "gene") %>%
    filter(!is.na(logfc)) %>%
    mutate(sig_p05 = pvalue < 0.05) %>%
    group_by(row_label, display_row) %>%
    summarise(
      dataset = ds,
      n_total_all = n(),
      n_pos_all = sum(logfc > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_neg_all = sum(logfc < 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_zero_all = sum(logfc == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_pval05 = sum(sig_p05, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_pos_pval05 = sum(sig_p05 & logfc > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_neg_pval05 = sum(sig_p05 & logfc < 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_zero_pval05 = sum(sig_p05 & logfc == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      dir_score_all = ifelse(
        n_total_all > 0,
        (n_pos_all - n_neg_all) / n_total_all,
        NA_real_
      ),
      dir_score_pval05 = ifelse(
        n_total_all > 0 & n_pval05 > 0,
        (n_pos_pval05 - n_neg_pval05) / n_total_all,
        NA_real_
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}))

direction_score_support_long <- tidyr::expand_grid(
  direction_row_lookup,
  direction_dataset_layout
) %>%
  left_join(
    direction_score_long,
    by = c("dataset", "row_label", "display_row")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    display_row = factor(display_row, levels = direction_row_order),
    col_name = factor(col_name, levels = direction_col_order)
  ) %>%
  arrange(display_row, col_name)

  rename(Pathway = display_row)
```

### Convert direction score to arrow table
```{r}

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(readxl)
  library(writexl)
})

project_dir <- "/Users/salozano/Library/Mobile Documents/com~apple~CloudDocs/Documents/Data Analysis/2025/Const_Cond_syn_nuc_cyt"
schematic_dir <- file.path(project_dir, "output/GSEA/final_DE/schematic_tables")
dirscore_fp <- file.path(schematic_dir, "logFC_direction_score_arrow_table.xlsx")
gsea_fp <- file.path(schematic_dir, "GSEA_direction_arrow_table_GSEA_only_v2.xlsx")

dirscore_mid_cutoff <- 0.25
dirscore_mid_cutoff_pval05 <- 0.02

score_bin_sign <- function(score, cutoff) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(score) ~ NA_real_,
    score < -cutoff ~ -1,
    score > cutoff ~ 1,
    TRUE ~ 0
  )
}

score_to_arrow <- function(score, cutoff) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(score) ~ "",
    score < -cutoff ~ "↓",
    score > cutoff ~ "↑",
    TRUE ~ "↑↓"
  )
}

gate_dirscore_arrow <- function(dir_sign, nes_sign, mean_sign) {
  if (is.na(dir_sign)) return("")

  if (dir_sign == 0) {
    return("↑↓")
  }

  agree_n <- sum(c(dir_sign, nes_sign, mean_sign) == dir_sign, na.rm = TRUE)

  if (agree_n >= 2) {
    if (dir_sign > 0) return("↑")
    if (dir_sign < 0) return("↓")
  }

  ""
}

    dir_score_all, dir_score_pval05
  )

direction_score_pval05_table <- readxl::read_xlsx(dirscore_fp, sheet = "dir_score_pval05")
gsea_support_table <- readxl::read_xlsx(gsea_fp, sheet = "support_long")

direction_score_arrow_long <- direction_score_support_table %>%
  left_join(
    gsea_support_table %>%
      select(Pathway, Dataset, NES, mean_logfc),
    by = c("Pathway", "Dataset")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sign_nes = sign(NES),
    sign_mean_logfc = sign(mean_logfc),
    sign_dir_all = score_bin_sign(dir_score_all, cutoff = dirscore_mid_cutoff),
    sign_dir_pval05 = score_bin_sign(dir_score_pval05, cutoff = dirscore_mid_cutoff_pval05),
    arrow_all = mapply(gate_dirscore_arrow, sign_dir_all, sign_nes, sign_mean_logfc),
    arrow_pval05 = mapply(gate_dirscore_arrow, sign_dir_pval05, sign_nes, sign_mean_logfc)
  )

direction_score_arrow_all_table <- direction_score_arrow_long %>%
  select(Pathway, Dataset, arrow_all) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Dataset, values_from = arrow_all)

direction_score_arrow_pval05_table <- direction_score_arrow_long %>%
  select(Pathway, Dataset, arrow_pval05) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Dataset, values_from = arrow_pval05)

direction_score_binned_all_table <- direction_score_arrow_long %>%
  select(Pathway, Dataset, sign_dir_all) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Dataset, values_from = sign_dir_all)

direction_score_binned_pval05_table <- direction_score_arrow_long %>%
  select(Pathway, Dataset, sign_dir_pval05) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Dataset, values_from = sign_dir_pval05)

writexl::write_xlsx(
  list(
    arrows_all = direction_score_arrow_all_table,
    arrows_pval05 = direction_score_arrow_pval05_table,
    dir_score_all = direction_score_all_table,

    dir_score_binned_all = direction_score_binned_all_table,
    dir_score_binned_pval05 = direction_score_binned_pval05_table,
    support_long = direction_score_arrow_long
  ),
  path = dirscore_fp
)
```

```{r}
project_dir <- "/Users/salozano/Library/Mobile Documents/com~apple~CloudDocs/Documents/Data Analysis/2025/Const_Cond_syn_nuc_cyt"

col_order <- c(
  "Chd8+/- Nuc",
  "Chd8+/- Cyt",
  "Chd8+/- Syn",
  "Chd8+/- Whole",
  "Chd8+/flox Nuc",
  "Chd8+/flox Syn",
  "Chd8+/flox Whole"
)

make_dirscore_matrix <- function(sheet_name) {
  df <- readxl::read_xlsx(dirscore_fp, sheet = sheet_name)
  mat <- as.data.frame(df)
  rownames(mat) <- mat$Pathway
  mat$Pathway <- NULL
  mat <- mat[, col_order, drop = FALSE]
  as.matrix(mat)
}

draw_dirscore_heatmap_with_caption <- function(ph, caption_txt) {
  grid::grid.newpage()
  grid::pushViewport(grid::viewport(layout = grid::grid.layout(
    nrow = 2, ncol = 1,
    heights = grid::unit(c(0.93, 0.07), "npc")
  )))
  grid::pushViewport(grid::viewport(layout.pos.row = 1, layout.pos.col = 1))
  grid::grid.draw(ph$gtable)
  grid::upViewport()
  grid::grid.text(
    caption_txt,
    x = 0.5, y = 0.5,
    gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 10),
    vp = grid::viewport(layout.pos.row = 2, layout.pos.col = 1)
  )
}

plot_dirscore_heatmap <- function(mat, title_txt, cutoff, lim, caption_txt) {
  mat[is.na(mat)] <- 0
  ph <- pheatmap::pheatmap(
    mat,
    cluster_rows = TRUE,
    cluster_cols = FALSE,
    color = colorRampPalette(c("#08306B", "#2CA25F", "#D9C93B", "#F28E2B", "#B30000"))(200),
    breaks = seq(-lim, lim, length.out = 201),
    legend_breaks = c(-cutoff, 0, cutoff),
    legend_labels = c("DOWN", "BALANCED", "UP"),
    na_col = "grey90",
    border_color = NA,
    angle_col = 45,
    fontsize_row = 11,
    fontsize_col = 11,
    main = title_txt,
    silent = TRUE
  )
  draw_dirscore_heatmap_with_caption(ph, caption_txt)
}

mat_all <- make_dirscore_matrix("dir_score_all")
mat_pval05 <- make_dirscore_matrix("dir_score_pval05")

pdf(pdf_fp, width = 9, height = 10)
plot_dirscore_heatmap(
  mat_all,
  "Direction score heatmap: all genes",
  cutoff = 0.25,
  lim = 0.30,
  "Direction score cutoffs: DOWN < -0.25, BALANCED = -0.25 to 0.25, UP > 0.25. Heatmap scale caps at -0.30 and 0.30."
)
plot_dirscore_heatmap(
  mat_pval05,
  "Direction score heatmap: p < 0.05 genes",
  cutoff = 0.02,
  lim = 0.03,
  "Direction score cutoffs: DOWN < -0.02, BALANCED = -0.02 to 0.02, UP > 0.02. Heatmap scale caps at -0.03 and 0.03."
)
dev.off()
```

```{r}
median_to_sign <- function(x, cutoff) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(x) ~ NA_real_,
    x < -cutoff ~ -1,
    x > cutoff ~ 1,
    TRUE ~ 0
  )
}

median_to_arrow <- function(x, cutoff) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(x) ~ "",
    x < -cutoff ~ "↓",
    x > cutoff ~ "↑",
    TRUE ~ "↑↓"
  )
}

gate_median_arrow <- function(median_sign, nes_sign) {
  if (is.na(median_sign)) return("")
  if (median_sign == 0) return("↑↓")
  if (is.na(nes_sign)) return("")
  if (median_sign == nes_sign) {
    if (median_sign > 0) return("↑")
    if (median_sign < 0) return("↓")
  }
  ""
}

compare_arrow_to_manual <- function(table_arrow, manual_arrow) {
  if (is.na(table_arrow)) table_arrow <- ""
  if (is.na(manual_arrow)) manual_arrow <- ""

  dplyr::case_when(
    table_arrow == manual_arrow ~ "same",
    table_arrow == "↑↓" & manual_arrow %in% c("↑", "↓") ~ "single to double",
    table_arrow == "↑↓" & manual_arrow == "" ~ "no arrow to double",
    table_arrow %in% c("↑", "↓") & manual_arrow %in% c("↑", "↓") & table_arrow != manual_arrow ~ "opposite",
    TRUE ~ ""
  )
}

get_go_symbols <- function(term_exact, ontology = "BP", use_goall = TRUE) {
  term2go <- suppressMessages(
    AnnotationDbi::select(
      x = GO.db::GO.db,
      keys = term_exact,
      keytype = "TERM",
      columns = c("GOID", "ONTOLOGY")
    )
  )
  if (is.null(term2go) || nrow(term2go) == 0) return(character())

  goids <- term2go[!is.na(term2go$GOID) & term2go$ONTOLOGY == ontology, "GOID", drop = TRUE]
  goids <- unique(as.character(goids))
  if (!length(goids)) return(character())

  go2sym <- suppressMessages(
    AnnotationDbi::select(
      x = org.Mm.eg.db::org.Mm.eg.db,
      keys = goids,
      keytype = if (isTRUE(use_goall)) "GOALL" else "GO",
      columns = "SYMBOL"
    )
  )
  if (is.null(go2sym) || nrow(go2sym) == 0) return(character())

  unique(go2sym$SYMBOL[!is.na(go2sym$SYMBOL) & go2sym$SYMBOL != ""])
}

read_de_for_median <- function(fp) {
  de <- readr::read_csv(fp, show_col_types = FALSE)
  cols_low <- tolower(names(de))

  pick_col <- function(candidates) {
    idx <- match(candidates, cols_low)
    idx <- idx[!is.na(idx)]
    if (length(idx) == 0) return(NA_character_)
    names(de)[idx[1]]
  }

  gene_col <- pick_col(c("gene_name", "symbol", "gene", "gene_id"))
  p_col    <- pick_col(c("pvalue", "p_val", "p.val", "pvalue_wald", "pvalue.lrt", "pvalue_lrt"))
  lfc_col  <- pick_col(c("logfc", "log2fc", "log2foldchange", "log_fc"))

  stopifnot(!is.na(gene_col), !is.na(p_col), !is.na(lfc_col))

  de %>%
    mutate(
      gene = as.character(.data[[gene_col]]),
      pvalue = as.numeric(.data[[p_col]]),
      logfc = as.numeric(.data[[lfc_col]])
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(gene), gene != "", !is.na(logfc), !is.na(pvalue)) %>%
    group_by(gene) %>%
    summarise(
      logfc = median(logfc, na.rm = TRUE),
      pvalue = min(pvalue, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

de_prepped <- list(

    left_join(de_prepped[[ds]], by = "gene") %>%

    mutate(sig_p05 = pvalue < 0.05) %>%
    group_by(row_label, display_row) %>%
    summarise(
      dataset = ds,
      n_total_all = n(),
      n_pval05 = sum(sig_p05, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_logfc_all = median(logfc, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_logfc_pval05 = ifelse(
        sum(sig_p05, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
        median(logfc[sig_p05], na.rm = TRUE),
        NA_real_
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}))
```

### Convert median logFC to arrow table - v2
```{r}

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(readxl)
  library(writexl)
})

project_dir <- "/Users/salozano/Library/Mobile Documents/com~apple~CloudDocs/Documents/Data Analysis/2025/Const_Cond_syn_nuc_cyt"
schematic_dir <- file.path(project_dir, "output/GSEA/final_DE/schematic_tables")
median_fp <- file.path(schematic_dir, "median_logFC_arrow_table.xlsx")
gsea_fp <- file.path(schematic_dir, "GSEA_direction_arrow_table_GSEA_only_v2.xlsx")
out_fp <- file.path(schematic_dir, "median_logFC_arrow_table_v2.xlsx")

median_logfc_cutoff_all <- 0.02
median_logfc_cutoff_pval05 <- 0.30

median_to_sign <- function(x, cutoff) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(x) ~ NA_real_,
    x < -cutoff ~ -1,
    x > cutoff ~ 1,
    TRUE ~ 0
  )
}

median_to_arrow <- function(x, cutoff) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(x) ~ "",
    x < -cutoff ~ "↓",
    x > cutoff ~ "↑",
    TRUE ~ "↑↓"
  )
}

gate_median_arrow <- function(median_sign, nes_sign) {
  if (is.na(median_sign)) return("")
  if (median_sign == 0) return("↑↓")
  if (is.na(nes_sign)) return("")
  if (median_sign == nes_sign) {
    if (median_sign > 0) return("↑")
    if (median_sign < 0) return("↓")
  }
  ""
}

median_support <- readxl::read_xlsx(median_fp, sheet = "support_long") %>%

  )

  mutate(
    sign_nes = sign(NES),
    sign_median_all = median_to_sign(median_logfc_all, cutoff = median_logfc_cutoff_all),
    sign_median_pval05 = median_to_sign(median_logfc_pval05, cutoff = median_logfc_cutoff_pval05),
    base_arrow_all = median_to_arrow(median_logfc_all, cutoff = median_logfc_cutoff_all),
    base_arrow_pval05 = median_to_arrow(median_logfc_pval05, cutoff = median_logfc_cutoff_pval05),
    arrow_all = mapply(gate_median_arrow, sign_median_all, sign_nes),
    arrow_pval05 = mapply(gate_median_arrow, sign_median_pval05, sign_nes)
  )

median_v2_base_arrow_all <- median_v2_long %>%
  select(Pathway, Dataset, base_arrow_all) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Dataset, values_from = base_arrow_all)

median_v2_base_arrow_pval05 <- median_v2_long %>%
```

### Median logFC heatmap
```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readxl)
  library(pheatmap)
  library(grid)
})

project_dir <- "/Users/salozano/Library/Mobile Documents/com~apple~CloudDocs/Documents/Data Analysis/2025/Const_Cond_syn_nuc_cyt"
schematic_dir <- file.path(project_dir, "output/GSEA/final_DE/schematic_tables")
median_fp <- file.path(schematic_dir, "median_logFC_arrow_table.xlsx")
pdf_fp <- file.path(schematic_dir, "median_logFC_heatmaps.pdf")

col_order <- c(
  "Chd8+/- Nuc",
  "Chd8+/- Cyt",
  "Chd8+/- Syn",
  "Chd8+/- Whole",
  "Chd8+/flox Nuc",
  "Chd8+/flox Syn",
  "Chd8+/flox Whole"
)

make_heatmap_matrix <- function(sheet_name) {
  df <- readxl::read_xlsx(median_fp, sheet = sheet_name)
  mat <- as.data.frame(df)
  rownames(mat) <- mat$Pathway
  mat$Pathway <- NULL
  mat <- mat[, col_order, drop = FALSE]
  as.matrix(mat)
}

draw_pheatmap_with_caption <- function(ph, caption_txt) {
  grid::grid.newpage()
  grid::pushViewport(grid::viewport(layout = grid::grid.layout(
    nrow = 2, ncol = 1,
    heights = grid::unit(c(0.93, 0.07), "npc")
  )))
  grid::pushViewport(grid::viewport(layout.pos.row = 1, layout.pos.col = 1))
  grid::grid.draw(ph$gtable)
  grid::upViewport()
  grid::grid.text(
    caption_txt,
    x = 0.5, y = 0.5,
    gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 10),
    vp = grid::viewport(layout.pos.row = 2, layout.pos.col = 1)
  )
}

plot_median_heatmap <- function(mat, title_txt, lim, cutoff, caption_txt) {
  mat[is.na(mat)] <- 0
  ph <- pheatmap::pheatmap(
    mat,
    cluster_rows = TRUE,
    cluster_cols = FALSE,
    color = colorRampPalette(c("#08306B", "#2CA25F", "#D9C93B", "#F28E2B", "#B30000"))(200),
    breaks = seq(-lim, lim, length.out = 201),
    legend_breaks = c(-cutoff, 0, cutoff),
    legend_labels = c("DOWN", "BALANCED", "UP"),
    na_col = "grey90",
    border_color = NA,
    angle_col = 45,
    fontsize_row = 11,
    fontsize_col = 11,
    main = title_txt,
    silent = TRUE
  )
  draw_pheatmap_with_caption(ph, caption_txt)
}

mat_all <- make_heatmap_matrix("median_logfc_all")
mat_pval05 <- make_heatmap_matrix("median_logfc_pval05")

pdf(pdf_fp, width = 9, height = 10)
plot_median_heatmap(
  mat_all,
  "Median logFC heatmap: all genes",
  lim = 0.03,
  cutoff = 0.01,
  caption_txt = "Median logFC cutoffs: DOWN < -0.01, BALANCED = -0.01 to 0.01, UP > 0.01. Heatmap scale caps at -0.03 and 0.03."
)
plot_median_heatmap(
  mat_pval05,
  "Median logFC heatmap: p < 0.05 genes",
  lim = 0.5,
  cutoff = 0.10,
  caption_txt = "Median logFC cutoffs: DOWN < -0.10, BALANCED = -0.10 to 0.10, UP > 0.10. Heatmap scale caps at -0.50 and 0.50."
)
dev.off()

pdf_fp
```
